reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Down to earth guy with a passion for understanding business, and cares about his students.

Brandon is steady. Will push at times, but you can push back a little too - be engaged and the progress will come. Cases include risk-capital firms, and not just "widget" firms, so the spectrum is covered. Also, Brandon seems to connect with a wide variety of student types which is nice. The video essays are a nice chance to practice. Excellent!

Brandon is the best professor at UW-B, enjoy him UW-T he is truly amazing. He uses case studies instead of textbook so you learn using real world examples. You must go to class and participate but he makes that easy. His lectures are interesting and engaging. Lots of papers but they are short and easy to write!
Dont miss his class

One of the best professor's I ever had. He also teaches BBUS480. Try to avoid Chatterjee! Brandon is much more fun and interesting, you learn a lot more in his class. I wish he taught more classes. There was not textbook, just readings. We wrote a lot of essays but they were short. You also have to participate in class.
Brandon is wonderful and very helpful. Lectures are very clear and organized, I loved the class! Very patient and helpful when I have questions. Best professor in UWB!
If you like case studies and short papers, take him. Make sure you show up in every class. Best instructor in uwb.

It seems I get to end my college career with one of the best teachers. Brandon is truly a treat! Lectures are fun and engaging, and you actually learn A LOT. No text-book, or test, but expect to readwrite a bit. No attendance required but grade will take a hit if you're not there. I wouldn't consider this an easy A, but it's well worth your time.

Best instructor EVER! Clear on his grading criteria. Explain his lectures clearly and very detailed. You will learn a lot from his class. This is the 3rd class I took from Professor Fleming. Expect for homework, at least 2week.

Yes he doesn't always say where the readings are, but everyone should know where they will be. Either the Harvard site or on canvas, its not that difficult. If you come to class he discusses everything you need to know and answers any and all questions. Awesome professor!

Usually when U use canvas, a description of what U are supposed to do is on each assignment. In this cls, you'll see a blank page with a due date. You hunt through the syllabus, the schedule, and then the lecture slides trying to find what's due. You find it in a vaguely named lecture file. Then it tells you what to read, but not where to find it..

After hearing all the great things about Brandon, I was surprised how much I disliked this class. He was not the easy grader everyone had told me about (and I'm usually a 4.0 student). His smug personality also rubbed me the wrong way. He would assign things without thoroughly explaining the concepts and then grade harshly. He's not for everyone.

Think he is under pressure to make his class harder. Arbitrary grading scales on company project. Very little patience to let you finish talking, would often cut people off. Arbitrary grading was received towards end of quarter, hard to change grades.

Brandon used case studies to teach management. It worked for me because I associated the concepts with a vivid scenario of some kind. Sometimes he will push on the class a bit, but then he'll give a bit too. I would take him again.

I would say Brandon is definitely my favorite teacher in UWB. He is knowledgeable and he teaches students how to think and analyse in a business way. He is a lenient grader. If you show up in every his class and complete all assignments, you'll get a good grade.

Be ready to participate in his lectures, attendance is very important since he keeps track every class period and is accounted for your participation grade. Otherwise, very inspirational professor to have experienced. His teaching style is very engaging to where you will enjoy his lectures.

I really enjoed his class.  A very talented teacher. However, get ready to read long Harvard School cases and every week you have to produce a 2 page essay. But if you are getting behind it is better to let him know ahead of time. I wish UW Bothell had more professors like him.

For BBUS 470 & 480, manage your schedule to get him for both, it will save you so much time and effort for the class. You spend the quarter showing up to class (mostly in your pre-determined groups), participating in his stimulating lecture, sometimes going to the board, and writing essays. Show interest in him and he respects you. Best Prof around
Such a great teacher, I learned so much from this class. He makes the class really interesting, yes there is a lot of reading but his grading is fair. Definitely take him!

Brandon is a great teacher and really cares about his students. He clearly is into teaching for the right reasons and can really give you good feedback and career help if you take the time to meet with him.

Great teacher. He practices what he teaches and every lecture is interesting and relevant. Group projects were awesome in this class because he puts group together based on personality types.   He is real, approachable, helpful, and fair. The subject matter is challenging for different people at different times and in a fun, educational way.

A lot of readings of cases and short answers for each and required to do 3 out of 4 essays. He assigns group work all the time and a group project that's done throughout the quarter. There's a lot of work to do, but it is not difficult just time consuming. He tries to make his lectures exciting and get the class to participate in  discussions.

Fleming is by and large pretty great, I'd like to take him again. Being in class is pretty important since he goes over the material in every essay and homework assignment, so that's really helpful. Not too hard if you're willing to put the work in and pay attention to his feedback, which is usually pretty helpful. Slow grader though. Overall good.
Very nice guy who wants to see his students succeed. He is highly knowledgable about business and makes class engaging. I was in 3 of his classes at the ELC and definitely enjoyed them!

So far the best CSS teacher I had!! The lectures are clear, fun, there is a lot of activities, and he encourages students participation. He answers all students questions until they fully understand the material. There's a lot readings attendance in class counts toward the grade, don't miss! He has a lot of real world experience to share. AWESOME

Best professor in UWB I've ever taken. Will explain anything no matter how many times you ask. Super helpful and understanding. Makes you think outside the box within the real world. The only class I actually learned something helpful.
Professor Brandon is very approachable and kind. The materials presented are very interesting and he will make you think out of the box.

Out of all the professors I've had at UWB, Brandon was the best! His teaching method is great. He lectures and and stimulates the class by having the class discuss the topic. Attendance is graded so don't skip. Lots of reading and writing required but he's an easy grader. One team assignment. No exams or presentations.Learned a lot from him!
Easy grader & easy class. But a lot of assignments. You need to prepare for it.
The best class!! Highly recommended.

Highly recommend taking his class. I enjoy his teaching method, always uses case-studies instead of textbooks and encourages active class participation that expands your thinking. You will learn so much from his class. Definitely, my favorite Professor at UWB so far.

Great teacher, who I think should just start his own business. Vast knowledge, we joked he was Wikipedia. Great teaching style which makes you stretch your thinking. I would recommend him to anyone who has to take 480.

Fleming is the best Business professor I've had at UW Bothell. There is a good amount of essays required for the class but the professor really sets you up for success on the essays during his lectures. Overall, I learned a lot from this class and you won't regret taking it. Attend class and do the work and you'll be good.

Excellent teacher. He is clear, he understands his material very well. He interacts with students easily and I learned a lot from him. There is a lot of material to read, but very very interesting information for anyone to know, not harsh grader at all. I guess he is one of the best teachers at UWB. DON’T Miss his class.
very helpful , will work with you if you have any problems. great teacher good friend.
He is a very enthusiastic and hard working professor. Understands how busy MBA students are and is willing to work with them. Structure of group project made it easy to complete as a team.
Loved the case study approach (HBS Cases).  Facilitates class discussion through insightful examples and expertise in topic.  Good mix of academia and real world.  Highly recommended.

The work you had to do was a lot but in the end the grade turns out to be great! His not a hard grader at all. I was so busy that quarter but I got 3.8 in the end! can you believe capstone course can have such high grade?

Expect to work hard in this class and you'll end up with an equally good grade! Great teacher. You will gain a lot of real-world knowledge from this class. Brandon is really nice and fair. There are plenty of required readings, but they are not difficult. The best teacher for BBUS480 at UWB!

Brandon was a great professor.  His clarity was great, he teaches using case studies rather than a textbook which I found to be a more effective way of learning.  The only complaint if I had to note one was the delay in grading toward the end of the course, this in fairness was due to illness and a significant load (3 full classes)
he is extremely great. easy grader but there is a lot of material to cover in a short period of time. but this is the professor you want to take for 480.

I loved this class.  I have never been interested in Business Courses, until this Global class with Brandon!! I agree, he should be the only instructor on this course.  I loved coming to his class.  There is a lot of writing, but you feel well prepared and the group project was well organized. IF you cant show up you can make up some points.
Just an awesome class. Brandon Fleming should be the only instructor teaching BBUS 480 at UWB period.

Professor Fleming is a great professor! He really wants you to learn and makes sure it happens. If you show up, talk at least once a class, and do the assignments (which aren't very hard) then there is no reason why you shouldn't get at least a 3.5 in his class. If you take can any professor for the 480 capstone, take him!

Fleming says on first day he's not there to trick you-- he actually means it. If you're like me, used to text-quiz-midterm-final, you gotta get in a different mindset. This class is what the biz world is- no jargon, powerpoints instead of essays, and a lot of short assignments. He's showing you what a boss wants- not what a teacher wants. Wonderful

Brandon's class was easy. I love how there is no textbook used, just cases. Although attendance is not required, I recommend you attend because it will make a difference. You should also speak in class because the points will get you to a 4.0, or if not, pretty close to a 3.5.

Professor Fleming was easy-going and friendly. His method of using real life cases to teach us really helped us learn. Even though I was pretty quiet I really enjoyed Brandon's class discussion because it was interesting. I learned  lot from this class and my writing skills have greatly improved. I highly recommend taking it with Professor Fleming.
I really enjoyed this class. There is no textbook and lectures are like discussions about readings. There are couple of essays. I would recommend this class.

One of the most useful classes. No textbook required but the course is very organized and only focus on the important concepts that will be use. Definitely not information overload. A LOT of homework but he is not a hard grader. He makes you think and that helps to understand the stuffs much better and remember them longer. Attendance is almost 30%

Excellent teacher.  Makes you think critically while engaging you in the topic at hand.  Class is taught in a fashion that forces you to link other materials away from class and from previous class periods so that items learned are engrained in your work.

Great Class. Professor Fleming does an awesome job of tying interesting cases & articles (no textbook)both into lectures and the required assignments. Highly recommended to take him for 480 when it's offered

There is no textbook in the class but you will still have plenty to read . This class forces you to think critically about the cases you go over. The professor's style of teaching allows you to apply your learned knowledge about business concepts onto the short responses and essays. The case based class is different, but a good experience.

Take 480 with Brandon if possible. He really cares about his students learning and is reasonable in the amount of work  assigned. Have assigned readings done before class and participate in the discussions to get the most out of the class. Final was a briefing book, which I found to be much more interesting than cramming. Liked the class overall.
It's important to attend every class and reading articles before class to get involve into class discussions. Interesting and informative materials.
Best teacher for a capstone class... makes it so easy and he  is always willing to help. Uses case studies instead of textbook. Really awesome class experience overall.
One of the best professors I have had. He is enthusiastic and engaging. He used cases that were relevant instead of a text book.
Brandon is a great teacher. Uses current and relevant business issues for readings and lectures. Very relaxing and chill style yet knows his stuff.
Class information intestesting relevant to outside world
Great teacher, made classes interesting a related them to the business field in general.
He is a very enthusiastic instructor who leads students to think for themselves, rather than simply memorizing and regurgitating information. I would go out of my way to take more of his classes.

He is one of the best teachers that I ever had. He grades fairly, but students have to put in the time and effort in order to get a good grade. The required readings are reasonable and useful content (applicable outside of school setting). His classes are engaging and will not bore you to sleep. Other college professors should learn from him.
Really energetic and excited about the students learning. super relaxed schedule to make your quarter less stressful with other classes.

Brandon has a very unique teaching style and made the course very interesting.  I felt empowered after leaving class each day. I enjoyed the fact that the class was paperless and i could download my annotated assignments on my iphone. I highly recommend him  for any class.
Great teacher that offered tons of help for his students. I really enjoyed his class.
Great Professor. I hope I get more like him during my years here.

The best instructor I've ever had! He gives us very interesting cases to read. Sometimes cases are long but they are like stories and you never get bored reading them. His class is not stressful at all and it helped me to understand the subject better.

Fleming's class is generally low-key and relaxed. Homework consists of readings and reading questions. There are several 2-page essays you have to write. Class time consists of discussion of readings and time to work on course project. Course project is on a company and your group has to analyze it in several aspects. Take this class from Fleming.

Pretty awesome fella. Doesn't go very harsh on gradings because the subjects covered are pretty vague in general. No textbooks neither (woohoo!) but there are online materials you have to purchase (about $60 in total). Very clear and concise during lectures. Has a -5 points per day policy, which is pretty awesome compared to most other professors

Fleming was a good teacher. Gives great lectures that keep the class interested. No quizzes or finals. He does give a lot of essays but they are doable if you do the readings. Had a group project where you had to do an analysis of a company. No presentations! I'd recommend him

great teacher, thinking different need for different students. very thoughtful. the readings are a little hard for people whose first language is not English, but overall is easy. take his class and you will have fun in your class.
I highly recommend Fleming. He has an eagerness that kept me interested throughout class. There are no quizzes or tests. I learned a lot and would take a course with him again.

Best teacher so far. He is very helpful and kind. All the materials are interesting and he makes you think out of the box, building up your knowledge on how to manage the company. Please take his class. you won't be disappointed.

Great professor! I learned a lot from this  lass. Requires a lot of reading and writings, but it's worth it. He understands students' needs and very helpful. Class materials are not necessarily easy, but he wants to get us A's. Take this course with him. You'll love it!

The class is easy, you just have to sit for an hour or two a day for two days a week. An essay is due every week, but you can opt to not write 2 essays. He gives high grades even if you didn't write it too well. Essays are just two page double space 12-font. So it's relatively short.

Best teacher ever!!! Super easy if you pay attention in class. Make sure to do the first two essays out of the optional four (you need to complete only two), they are usually the easier ones out of four. There really isn't a text book for the class. You do need to purchase business articles from harvard business review and that is it.
Very caring teacher and very passionate about her work. A lot of reading, watching,, and taking notes but other than that, I would take another one of her classes again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Caring

reviews.comment: Had her for BIS165 and she was very lenient on grading. As long as you put time in at home to do reading and writing its very easy to get a 4.0. The reading and journal was a little much for me but I managed just fine in the end. Extra credit is provided. She is a very sweet person and understands if you can't get something in on time.
Lots and lots of reading. Can be kind of overwhelming to do all the notes and reading at times. Still super nice professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She was so sweet and soft spoken. The class content itself was a lot, but it also depended on how much effort you put into your notes. Attendance isn't mandatory; the only time you have to show up is for your discussant. As long as you reached the word count, you're good on notes. The final project was cool and interesting, really easy to pass!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Caring

reviews.comment: Overall Professor Roberts is a really nice teacher,but the assignments are really time consuming. This class is also reading heavy, we have to read so many pages and turn it into a summary to turn in before class starts. If you miss an summary assignment, it would tank you grade. Although the class had good information,but a lot to take in at once.

Great teacher! Pay attention to the course material and don't procrastinate or turn in late work and you will be fine guaranteed! Pay attention to the rubric. It can look overwhelming at first but when you get into it, as long as you stay on top of things you should be fine!

She's very sweet, class is interesting. A bit too much reading but as long as you contribute to final project and do 2-3 assignments she assigns all quarter, you will get 3.7-4.0. attendance not mandatory. just take notes because your handwritten notes or printed out typed word doc will be your midterm.

Professor Roberts is one of a kind!!! Brilliant professor. This course is very heavy on participation and reading literary works. There's a group project which was honestly so fun to make. Apart from this, this course ids very discussion and analysis oriented. So much fun and I will be taking another course with Professor Roberts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: I took both EDUC255 and BIS379 and loved both. Both online and similar structure, no meetings but did require 1-2 zooms to discuss class material in small groups (multiple time slots). While the readings/writing did require deeper thinking, the class was not hard. Prof. gives clear instructions, as long as you try you'll pass and learn a lot!

Although this was an online course, professor Roberts was one of the best i've had during my time at UW. You can tell she really cares about every student and tries her best to make sure that you succeed. Lots of reading/watching films but each week is structured as either a discussion or a 'short-essay' style quiz and a final reflection paper. 5/5
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great teacher! Encourages great discussions with students and knows how to make students feel comfortable with participation. She's passionate about what she teaches. Attendance is not required so if you do show up, she says bring your energy (no laptops out). You will write a lot but it is a very manageable workload IMO.

Without a doubt, Professor Roberts is the kindest teacher I've had. She emphasizes taking care of yourself and being honest with her at all times. Attendance is voluntary and she makes all of the assignments easily completable from home. There is a TON of reading, which can get to be too much, but overall not too bad. Wonderful teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Georgia was a great professor and super awesome to work with!

Professor Georgia's class is one the best class I took last year. I was intimidated at first because all of my classmates were Juniors and Seniors but I managed to survive. There's a lot of reading and writing but as long as you meet the requirements you're good. She's not a tough grader and I would highly recommend taking her class.

In relation to the teaching style, Professor Georgia had an outstanding balance of how to teach and what content should contemplate for her students. I have taken her three courses before, including BISAES 367, BIS 379, and BIS/EDUC 255A, in my undergrad journey. All in all, I would be without a second thought to take her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Roberts is probably one of the best professors I've had. She only has one assignment a week and she's a pretty easy grader. She's also really passionate about the subjects she teaches and you can tell she cares about her students. I would definitely recommend taking her class!!

Best professor I've had at UWB. She's kind, helpful, and her assignments are engaging. There's a LOT of reading, some of which is complicated, as long as you get the gist you should be good. She encourages deeper thinking and gives great feedback. A lot of discussions, but as long as you speak once you'll be OK. Easy grader if you do what's asked.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Inspirational

reviews.comment: I love this Professor! She is communicative, timely, and kind. I've taken 3 classes with her and they are my favorite classes. They require you to work to expand your understanding and stretch your learning but not in any unreasonable ways. Every bit of work feels necessary, no busy work. The content, organization and assignments are stellar.

Professor Roberts is passionate about the course material and it is infectious. The topic is interesting and she provides optimal resources to learn. Do the homework every week and you'll do great! The final essay is a great summary of the course. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof Roberts contributed to my undergrad experience and life experiences in many ways. The content she provides in class is applicable to life around us. She is knowledgeable, attentive, thought-provoking, and caring. She truly cares about helping her students be the best version of themselves. The content she teaches truly helps better society.

Professor Roberts is a kind and empathetic lecturer. I took BIS 379 spring quarter 2021. Her ethnic studies courses cover heavy subject matter but she presents it in a way that is not overwhelming and allows for mindful class discussion/reflection. Really if you demonstrate that you've engaged with the material you'll get a good grade.

She was a nice teacher, this class only had two meeting times with small groups, so I didn't really get to talk all the time. It was mostly independent work, make sure to do some research on readings in-class and outside for best results. We had quizzes in first couple weeks, then a couple standard essays for the rest of the weeks. Solid elective.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Hip Hop & Media can be exciting if you aren't familiar & looking to inquire. Dr. Roberts expectations are high & discussions require 5 posts if you expect to earn FULL credit for weekly tasks. Materials are crammed into assignments & no late papers will be accepted not unless there is some type of accommodation. Timing on due dates is awful.

Professor Roberts was my capstone advisor for my MA in Cultural Studies. She is absolutely amazing, incredibly caring, and really encourages you to dig deep. She has an exceptional knack for being able to help you work through ideas and gives great feedback. She makes her expectations clear, but make you cite properly! Would 100% work with again!!!

Dr. Roberts is an ok professor. I enjoyed her in my race and ethnicity class but this course just wasn't it. Useless readings, discussion posts you HAVE to reply 6 times for full credit, and two short essays about hip hop which were boring and dull to write. Content was boring, not the prof. Plus, the readings were so long and she expects a lot.

Doctor Roberts is quite frankly the best professor at UWB. She is passionate, extremely educated, and caring for each one of her students. I wish I could take more courses with this professor. If you have the opportunity to take any of her classes, I guarentee you will enjoy yourself, and the topics will never boring. Again, best professor period.

Dr. Roberts is a character. If you're into the class concepts or into literature (or music - talk to her about music), you'd want to be around her because she's friendly, funny, and REALLY passionate and knowledgeable. She grades fairly and gives really thorough feedback, I think I became a better writer thanks to her. Fantastic professor.

Georgia was one of my favorite professors I've had the chance to take a course with. Unlike many professors, she listens to her students, encourages a safe and friendly environment during class discussions, and is very friendly/caring/understanding. As tedious as some of the work may have been, it was never difficult and has proven to be valuable.

She grades very easily and is really more concerned that you're participating. Basically every class was a group-led discussion. She will not put an end to a group discussion, no matter how painful and dragged out it becomes. Take this class if you want to hear people regurgitate woke things they read on twitter. She's cool though

She is really nice and soft spoken. However, she assigns a ton of reading some of which are interesting and others not so much. She makes you take 2 pages of notes on the reading and the films on a notebook dedicated specifically to that class. So it is important to keep up with the readings every week (she doesnt check till the end)

4 papers, One of them was analytical, and the other 3 (500 words) were based on your personal experiences. Also, a group presentation about the readings. A fairly easy A if you complete all the requirements. Roberts is very kind and an easy grader. If you like group discussions, you'll love her.

Professor Roberts is the sort of professor that stays with you throughout your college career. Her assignments aren't incredibly difficult, but they make you think in ways that are ultimately more valuable. She is also one of the kindest professors you will come across. Take a class with her!

By far the best professor at University of Washington Bothell. The class is very relaxed, lots of class discussions and readings but they're actually interesting and enjoyable. No tests which is refreshing, and only 5 papers which were fun to write. Professor Roberts herself is one of the sweetest people, very open and welcoming. Take this class!

Dr. Roberts is soft spoken but well articulated and sharp. Her lectures will keep you entertained. There are lots of readings and you will be required to participate in online and in-class discussions. It was a 50% hybrid course and the online participation was weighed as heavily as the in-class participation. There will be group led discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I will value this course for the rest of my life - I'll never forget the opportunity Professor Roberts gave this class to engage with our course text (an amazing book, The Hate U Give) on a field trip to a corrections center for a book talk. If you're interested in learning about hip hop culture and what rappers stand for, take this class!

Dr. Georgia Roberts is one of my favorite teachers at the University of Washington. She's well respected and is an expert on the topic of Ethnic Studies and the history of America. 5 Star on all counts, highly recommended!

There was a lot of papers to read and the content was semi-difficult to understand in the beginning but it gets better! There are some pop quizzes, but just make sure to read and get a basic understanding of the main ideas from the readings. There's a lot of discussion work and two essays as well. Overall, great class and learned a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Roberts is such an amazing teacher. I really enjoyed her Tupac and Politics class, if you get a chance she also takes a group of students to a book club at a prison which was a life changing experience. Highly recommend her class.
she is so freaking nice. And a very soft gentle voice too!

Georgia is a fascinating professor and very kind. My only complaint of this course is that it is heavy on group discussion. I wish I heard more from her. She is a fair grader and there is no reason not to do well in her class. The routine of the class became a little monotonous: group discussion, a short lecture, online discussion board.

Professor Roberts is a great instructor, she co taught for this course although I think the class would have been better with her just teaching. She is on the quiet side, and somewhat easy to talk to outside of class. She had a lot of good insight and wisdom to share so that was helpful. Be respectful and dont talk over her, she gets pissed.

If you have the chance, take a class with Prof. Roberts! I took her BIS 351 Topics in American Culture class themed on Tupac Shakur and it was one of the best classes I have taken. She is very casual and her lectures and readings are interesting. You want to participate in this class because she makes it fun and engaging!

Georgia makes it easy to succeed by clearly defining what we needed to do to get the grade we wanted. We talked about controversial topics but she made it so that everyone felt comfortable sharing their thoughts. She was also easy to reach if you needed more help (take advantage of that!) & even assisted me after the class was over. Great prof!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: An amazing teacher and person. Her class was truly eye opening to me and encouraged me to challenge the master narrative that I've been hearing all my life about race and diversity. Do the disscussions and readings and you'll be just fine. I couldn't recommend taking a teacher any more!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I loved her! She is such a genuine and honest professor. She really cares about her students and what we get out of her class sessions. Participation is important but her class is so engaging and interesting that you want to participate!

Georgia is, hands down, the most inspirational professor I have had. Passionate, caring, and insightful. She addresses/discusses issues that need to be prevalent in academia. 10/10. A refreshing dose of truth.

Georgia  amazing professor. Take her class!  She is genuine, caring, Interested in her students. Everything to know isiterally in the syllabus; read closely. Assignments were openended to showcase our style/creativity/abilities. She gives fantastic feedback before grading essays. Advice: don't get behind/be organized, communicate, use feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took her online class, BIS 313, and I found it very interesting and insightful. There were weekly discussion posts on canvas that require participation, and a few other short essays. I don't have any complaints about this course. It was an online course that required full participation, so don't think the workload will not be heavy.

Georgia Roberts is by far one of my favorite professors. I've taken her for numerous classes in my undergrad and she has always been a very fair and understanding professor. She comes to class with a unique approach including relevant class discussions and helpful lectures that apply to what is going on currently. She is great!!

I have taken taken Georgia for multiple classes in my college career and there is a reason for that. By far Georgia is the best professor I have ever had. She not only cares about the subjects in which she teaches but she genuinely cares about her students. Georgia knows how to make group discussions very engaging. Highly Recommend you take her!
She's very down to earth and relatable. The work/knowledge presented is engaging and is applicable to current and future endeavors.

Professor Roberts is one of the most genuine and outgoing instructors I've ever had the pleasure of working with. The subject matter of her course are full of depth and complexities that are enlightening to unpack with other like minded people. Her  course structure is flexible and the course objectives are always well definied! I recommend her!

GEORGIA IS AN EASY GOING TEACHER, BUT SHE IS NOT VERY ORGANIZED, AND LIKES LONG DISCUSSIONS. SHE BARLEY LECTURES AND EXPECTS YOU TO FIND DEFINITIONS ON YOUR OWN. SHE MAKES YOU WORK FOR IT. SHE ALSO LIKES YOU TO READ INTERESTING STORIES AND USE QUOTES TO BACK IT UP.

Georgia is a very cool person to begin with.  Some of the best teachers are those who know how to be laid back.  She is a happy person, despite struggling from personal health issues, and always has a smile on her face even when she's not feeling well.  As long as you put in effort, do the reading, and complete assignments, you should do well!

Roberts is Phenomenal! I would recommend taking BIS 351, BIS 490, and BIS 499 or any class that she teaches. She is clear with her expectations and any question you have, the answer is literally in the syllabus.  Hands down! This professor is passionate, creative, real, and loves what she does. If you want your mind blown, take her class.

Professor Roberts is one of the strongest, kind-hearted teacher I have had.  She takes the time to focus on the style (in my class it was Realism).  If you want to learn, this class and this teacher will get you there. Cool group thing. Take a group, assign a short-story. Have group come to class and be the teacher.  Innovative. Brilliant teacher.

Georgia was incredibly helpful in understanding the materials for some rather big topics in the course. She is accessible when you need help and is actually invested in learning about her students. Discussions are a key part, so be sure to participate! Georgia is passionate about the topics she teaches and it shows in how she presents information.

Georgia is the best Professor I had at UWB. Every day she came to class energized and the whole class fed off of it. Her lectures we're so interesting and you could tell how passionate she was about the topic. I would recommend taking BIS 351, BIS 490, and BIS 499 with her like I did. You will learn a lot and thoroughly enjoy it at the same time.

One of my favorite classes at the UW. I would highly recommend this class and professor to anyone, especially to those that care about the lives of humans. The readings are great and the writing assignments are enough to learn from but not so intense that you don't have enough time to actually be intrigued by the reading material.
Her class was amazing love it great professor!!!!

Took her Hip Hop class online.  Learned a ton of really interesting/relevant stuff.  Would definitely recommend.  My only complaint is that she wasn't a strong presence/voice on the discussion board and as a result some of the discussions were allowed to get really inappropriate and offensive.  Other than that a really captivating class.

Really great teacher. As a business student some of these "touchy-feely" classes are painful, but she is good at challenging students to think analytically about the subject matter and their own perspectives.
Really nice and helpful... Easy class... interesting class... easy going teacher
very passionate teacher!! she knows what she's talking about! Make sure you go on the filed trip at the end of the quarter!!
Great class, overall!

Best Professor at UWB hands down and as someone who has taken Ashbaugh and Dimeo that is a BIG statement to make. Very much cares about her students and how we learn. You should definitely do the reading because class participation is a must!! She is a must take in my opinion!
Great Class,  Lots of Readings but learned a lot.  Would recommend to anyone serious about Learning about the subject

This class was AMAZING. I cannot speak highly enough about this course or this instructor. This course will make you think, entertain you and maybe even blow your mind. Prepare to rethink how you look at hip-hop and life in general!
Georgia is a fantastic teacher, probably one of the best at UWB! She's super easy to talk to and has really engaging material. Definitely would recommend taking her class before you leave UWB.

The hip hop class during summer was an awesome class overall. Her quizzes are very easy but tricky at the same time. The books (no texts) were also interesting to read..I actually read them! Be prepared to reflect and explore the topics covered in the chapters. The struggles, politics and the general history behind hip-hop can be a touchy subject.

Roberts is an excellent professor who cares about her students succeeding. I took the hip hop class during the summer, which you could tell she extremely adored this topic. Her classes were a lot of fun since she didn't lecture much. The only thing to beware of are her weekly quizzes. You need to read the material in order to get a good grade.

This class was a Tupac culture class. She is so nice, she knows her material well. You are expected to read 50-100 pages a week on essays that relate to issues in culture. Depending on the course structure, you only have to discuss in class and pick a couple on a topic for a final paper and project. She really wants to help you succeed and learn.

I had Professor Gani for two classes (B DATA 200 & 232). Class is project-based and can either be done solo (Can be difficult since the expectation is the same as a group) or group (choose groupmates wisely), and no exams for these classes. Very funny, professor and I can tell that he really cares about the success of his students. Highly Recommend

Solid professor, had him for BDATA200. PICK YOUR GROUP WISELY! A lot of your points is on group projects so make sure you have a solid group or you will be annoyed. No midterms/no finals - just group projects only, a couple in class assignments (easy), has LinkedIn Learning assignments that are so long, but easy. Overall good class.

Best professor hands down. Gani explained concepts super well, was patient and allowed for questions, and made microeconomics an enjoyable class. If you attend class, take notes, and do you work you will get a good grade. I wish I could take him for macroeconomics.

He was an incredibly hard grader and honestly has a power trip. He asks for student numbers on exams, and asks what other classes you take, which is weird, super lecture-heavy, and moves fast also not understanding at all!!!! and consistently looking for ways to dock points.
Goated prof, Gani is 6/5 if i could hes a great professor and will always help you. His classes do not have exams or quizzes just a few easy projects. W class W prof W life.

Professor Gani has been one of my favorite professors at Bothell. As long as you go to class and listen, you will be able to get a good score. Even if you don't (like I did towards the end), if you shoot him an email, he can perfectly explain your questions, and you can tell he actually cares about his students and them doing well in his class.
Great course!
He's nice and funny. Take him! He's also knowledgeable about data viz.

Professor was handicapped this quarter, having to teach a class last minute- as a result, the unpreparedness & disorganization during the course really showed. However, he was really lenient with grading and submissions as a result. Plus, he's very committed in helping you with your code during office hours 💯

Took two courses with this professor. He's honestly one the best professors at UWB. There are in class assignments, so attend class. Tests and quizzes are similar to the content taught. Easy class and good professor. Notes are useful for this class. Can't emphasize how much I recommend this professor!!
what a goat

Overall a GREAT professor. I took his data viz class BIZ 232 and really enjoyed his teaching. He is kind and patient and gives great feedback. The homework isn't too difficult, though the final is a group project. I would definitely take his courses again.

Clearly is passionate about what he is teaching and truly wants every single one of his students to succeed. Workload was not too time consuming at all. Notes are your best friend. There are 5 problem sets to be worked through with a group you are given at the beginning of the quarter and 2 exams (not bad as long as you study).

Professor is clearly passionate about economics and math, often working through a problem multiple times in class to make the answer clear for everyone. Allows opportunities to discuss and keeps his class engaged. Almost everyone in the class came to class despite it not being a requirement. Overall, definitely one of the best professors at UW.
A lot of math. You also have to attend every day as there isn't a lot of resources on Canvas, if any. Exams are thankfully open note, but notes in class were not the best unfortunately.

Your grade is dependent on 3 exams, attend lectures bc there is nothing on canvas in terms of teaching missed content. No homework, everything from handouts to sample problems are covered in class. The exams are hard in terms of TIME, many stay the entire 2 hours of exam but the content is similar to class content and study guides. Def hard class

If you had Nedita before prepare to be disappointed. No online lectures, slides are hard to understand if you aren't there, and very little amount of outside work (if you don't study). One quiz, 3 in class experiments, 2 exams + the final (open note). Please go to the lectures. Exams are basically the study guide though.

Professor Gomez is passionate, caring, and knowledgeable! The class is not easy though. 70% of your grades consist of 3 exams. There are no textbooks, readings, videos, or nothing: you MUST attend the lectures if you want to pass this class. It was not an easy class, but I absolutely would take his classes again.

Great professor. Very passionate about the subject and he explains everything very intuitively to the point where I personally needed minimal notes. He is approachable and always open to help. The course is graded almost solely on three exams. There's no homework. I recommend reviewing basic calculus, that will make this course a lot easier.

Overall, this class is hard, its tough. It's not necessarily super math intensive its more so hella formulas. Combine that with no outside help, lectures REQUIRED bc theres nothing on canvas. Teaches and lectures fast and just doesn't offer any review before diving into concepts. Id avoid if you can but if not, beware.

Responds to emails 2-7 days later, if at all. Offers little help outside of class. When he does help, he does not listen and instead railroads the conversation. EC is offered but only to the winners of the classroom participation. Uses the same 5 worksheets all quarter. You won't know your grade until the end because he doesn't understand Canvas.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 70% of your grade is dependent on 2 midterms and 1 Final but professor Gomez does a great job preparing you with handouts and exam reviews. Attendance is essential to your success in the class, but if you show up and put in the effort to study you will be fine.

Professor Gomez is great! His class covers a lot of content, so attending lectures is essential. He explains the material clearly and incorporates fun class games for participation and extra credit. Grades are based on three exams, class games, and a quiz. Success requires a commitment to attending lectures and taking good notes.

Professor Gomez is the best! He takes hard content and explains it in an easy-to-understand way. His class games make learning fun and offer extra credit. Participation is generously rewarded, and while attendance isn't mandatory, it's essential for success. He's a fair grader who even gives points for mistakes. I definitely recommend his class!

Prof Gomez is actually a great professor if you listen well during lectures and take notes on everything he writes down on the board. The biggest tip is to learn and watch out for his wording on practice sheets and practice exams that's how I managed to score well. His exams are open note, no HW, and you have to keep reviewing in your free time.

He's kind and very passionate about the subject. The grade was determined mostly by tests, but he does a good job prepping you and he's very accommodating (he made the tests open-note for us). Overall, a great prof!

He's a decent teacher, but his class is pretty difficult since he only grades you on two exams and the final. All the exams were long and tough to get through, I put in a ton of time and effort just to barely even pass this class. Not worth the stress tbh.
Professor Juan is a nice, easygoing professor, although the course is overall difficult. There isn't any graded homework; in fact, three exams make up 70% of the total grade.

Professor Gomez explains things very well but he goes over concepts very fast. There's no notes or recorded lectures on Canvas which means you have to pay attention in class. Tests are very hard and a lot to cover in two hours. You're only graded on your exams for the most part, but at least they were open note. No study guide for the final either
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he's a literal joke, this class was a joke, the exams are an even bigger joke.
There's a reason why his difficulty is 5/5
His class is terrible, expects you to know everything and grades you only on tests, which are extremely difficult to even pass.
hardest class ever
Makes the class way harder than it should be, most stressful course I've taken
Will screw you over with his exams, the questions are nothing like anything he reviews or goes over in class. Teaches way too fast and concepts are hard to grasp.
RUN
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. There seems to be a major disconnect with how long problems take to solve, and how long the prof thinks they take to solve. No one has time to finish exams, and the class scored an AVG of 51% on the first exam. Almost all class points come from exams, so if you don't do well, you won't pass this class. It's not worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: take this class if you want to fail. everything taught and reviewed are completely different from the exams, which is worth majority of your whole grade. his classes scored below a 50% average on the first exam and barely gives enough time to get through half the test. not worth the stress and wouldn't recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DONT TAKE HIM

Prof. Juan is an amazing teacher- he's genuinely passionate about economics and cares about his students. However, make sure you attend lecture and take notes because he doesn't record the lecture or has any notes on canvas. The tests are also weighed a lot (each midterm is 20% of the total grade, and final is 30%)

The professor had contradictory expectations. Some of the sample problems given and the problems gone over, varied greatly from the questions on tests in most cases. There seems to be a trend in underestimating how long it may take to complete some of the a multi-part problems. The professor did offer loads of extra help, which was appreciated.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher! You can tell he has a true passion for what he teaches! He gives great lectures, do not miss them! He doesn't give homework, which means grades an based mostly on exams (which can be very difficult). I would take him again, the material can just be hard to grasp.
i tried so hard and ended up exhausted disappointed and i have to take this course again. i wish i didn't pick this class

Professor Gomez is a fantastic instructor. He's clear, stays organized, and grades fairly. He's always checking in with class to make sure we're all "with him", and always takes the time to answer any question.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great teacher, probably the best math teacher I have had yet. Gives great feed back, goes over all topics and doesn't skip steps. But there are only a few graded assignments and the tests are long but he allows notes. Would suggest, but make sure you pay attention the class moves fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Gomez is EASILY one of my favorite professors at UWB. His geeky jokes open the room for a relaxed, fun and informative course.   Pros: - Funny - Course is super applicable for business students  - Amazing at explaining complex concepts  - Student Success-Oriented   Cons: - Textbook is trash and needs a codex to translate.

Mr Gomez is one of the most nicest prof I have ever met. He truly cares about you and his lectures are clear. He is funny and he will give students games one in a while. His tests and quizes are extremely hard though but if you're willing to give extra effort, you'll pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: Very helpful and engaged
Very hard tests that are not like his prep material and LONG. Plan your time because chances are you will be fighting the clock.

I really learned a lot in his class and compared to the other professors teaching the same material he is the best. The lectures were awesome, and without them I don't think most people would be able to pass. It is certainly a hard class, but you learn a lot of valuable material from a great professor.

Dr Gomez is one of, if not the absolute best professor I have had the privilege of learning from. He doesn't waste your time, clearly communicates the objective, and  is highly efficient. His lectures are everything, don't miss them. The book is worthless in comparison, don't even waste your money on it.
Great professor. His handouts and lectures will provide the material for the tests. Fun in class assignments.
Juan expects a lot from you, but his lectures are clear cut and move in a predictable flow.

Show up to every class and be attentive and you will not have any trouble. This class is great for good test takers who don't like homework. I didn't even have to study outside of class and found his lectures to be very engaging for what can be an extremely dull topic!

I wouldn't recommend if your not going to study and work HARD. He is actually a good professor and after the class you realize you learned alot. With that said, the exams are difficult and long (some dont even finish). I failed my first 2, but with extreme studying passed the final.

Very tough class but doable. I struggled with his first exam because it's two hours of intense math but you get a sheet of notes. Although the test questions are tougher than what he goes over in class, he does emphasis which topics will be covered. Studied using sample problems, didn't get much from the textbook. Work hard & you'll pass, got a 3.1

Juan Gomez is one of the best three professors I've had since starting here two years ago. He is extremely knowledgeable. He has a genuine passion for economics and for teaching. This is a difficult subject and his expectations of students are high. Work hard and do not get behind. You'll get out at least what you put in.

Do not take his class if you are not fluent in algebra and simple derivative taking. The entire class is algebra/derivative based. If you're good with that and some basic statistics skills, take his class! His exams are very basic and straight forward, with no trick questions. His class experiments are fun and easy points. Very interesting lecturer

Just attend his classes, pay attention, and do all the hw and practice exams then you'll do fine. There is a lot of repetition and he practice problems and emphasizes the most important topics in his exams.

Professor Gomez was extremely helpful. The class is a rather work-intensive course. Expect to study VERY hard for the exams, but if you attend class and do the work, it isn't hard to do well on the exams. Gomez is always willing to answer questions and give more examples and he was very friendly and willing to help. Great Prof!

Gomez is a very good teacher and very knowledgeable, though, the content of the class is difficult. Attending class and completing the optional homework is highly recommended to do well on the exams. Also he is a hard grader on exams.

Gomez is a ok teacher, I've had him twice now and with smaller classes he's able to spend more one on one time with you. I think that is challenging with him is that the material in hw doesn't prepare for you in his exams. Nice guy though. Likes to walk around alot when he lectures.

He was extremely helpful he even did a 2 review days before a test that weren't schedualed classes one of the days was always a weekend even.  He is very committed to help you succeed in his class because he knows it is a challenging class.  He was a great teacher I will take another class with him definately

This is a challenging professor and I don't see any way to a good grade if you don't really do the homework and read the book. That said, I hated econ before, but really enjoyed his class (and was able to get an A). I didn't see anything on the tests that he didn't cover, but most people I talked to sluffed the homework.

This is definitely the hardest class I have taken. I like the professor and learned a lot of material. However make sure you have a good understanding of statistics before this class. I had to relearn statistics while taking this class. His exams make sure you understand the material thoroughly. You cannot slide by just knowing the formulas.

Extremely hard instructor! Goes way too fast with not enough explanation. No ability to ask questions, tests are very hard, exam review are not held during class! If you want to review for the exams you have to go to school on a day off like Friday mid day or Suday afternoon! Exams only have 5 questions, takes a long time to finish. DON'T RECOMMEND

With regard to the 5/08 posting you need to chill out - no one is smearing Mr. Gomez's name.  Take a moment to look at the other posts.  I'm an A student and I will second the opinion that he moves way too fast with the material and his tests are not consistent with the homework, inclass work and at times even the study guide.

Look, I get straight A's, 3rd year in school, & usually I can teach myself well. Econ is a hard class, lots of concepts/graphs. BUT, this teacher doesnt teach systematically. He is all over the place. And tests are HARD, the opposite of the homework, so you have to understand more than what you learn. I could do all the HW perfect & got D on tests.

In response to 03/09/2008 comment, the comment is libelous.  The material covered is what you should have learned in Intro Microecon with a little more math added.  It was not over people's heads.  Maybe just yours.  Test were EXACTLY what we should have learned.  You just didn't get it.  Don't smear Gomez just cuz you don't get the concept.

The professor knew economics really well, but he taught at a level way over our heads. There were expectations he had of the students that were not feasible for first year business students. THe class went too fast to grasp concepts. The tests were never anything like what he said they would be. I would not recomend this at an undergrad level.
No Comments

Very nice guy and knows his stuff, however the class moves extremely fast and the prof. never goes over the homework.  in class experiments, 2 quizzes, and participation give you an easy 30% of the grade total, however the exams can be very difficult, if you aren't careful you will run out of time on exam days.  Allows notes and gives study guides.

Very good teacher; teaches a bit fast, but is fair considering all the material that needs to be covered.  HW assignments were not due, but were helpful with exams.  Provides study guides before exams that were very helpful, and allowed 1 page of notes.  Lectures are mantatory to come to.  Very good teacher, reccommended.

Cool class experiments. Nice guy Prof, knows Econ, but really bad class. Prof is rigid, grades hard, talks fast, holds back info. Uses Bb. but posts homework piecemeal 1-2 days before lecture.  Book hard to follow.  Get ans keys but homework not reviewed in class.  Tests heavily weighted and overloaded-easy to run out of time. Comprehensive final.

He is really fast in his teaching. Lots of his instructions are kind of vague at time.But if you go to him he will try helping you out. Book is horrible and difficult to follow. Over all the teacher is difficult and tough.

This instructor takes a reasonably difficult subject and makes it harder.  Talks fast and with a heavy accent.  The book is nearly useless (but he thinks it's great), homework is assigned before the lecture is given and no class time is alloted to going over homework.  Tests are grueling!  DO NOT TAKE THIS INSTRUCTOR!
Good style of teaching.  Can be challenging if you don't put the time into it.  Willing to clarify any questions.  make sure to stay on top of things.
very hard prof. the only managerial econ teacher left. don't take him, gives very hard left field exams

Tina is amazing. Very well organized, very knowledgeable, great individual feedback. Took her classes online and despite me not liking online classes much typically, hers were consistently engaging, interesting, and fun. So happy I had her, one of my favorite professors ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Shes a good person and all, but not a good professor. Her instructions are really confusing and she gets scatter brained frequently. On the flip side shes very helpful one on one and gives very in depth feed back on your work. Her feedback is the best Ive gotten from any professor at UWB, but she should work on her public speaking.

She is super organized & her lectures are really engaging. You're asked to discuss interesting questions w/ your table members frequently. I didn't really read anything but they're easy to skim for HW which is fairly decent & not hard, just writing assignments, no tests. Participation & attendance dictate your grade but it's well worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I think people forget that this class is offered as a quiz section, and not as a lecture. The literal point of the class is that we come in to work on the course content rather than receive a lecture based class. Professor Gliboff is great and really lenient, which really helps the workload. If you want to access a lecture he literally posts them.

He is prob one of the worst profs at UWB. Dosen't teach any of the material, we learn from the textbook and youtube videos. Somehow expects us to know what we are doing? Only meet once a week and yet we still get out early because we dont actually do anything in class except for "work" on problems. He is also lowk rlly sassy.

There is no exams what so ever, the class is super chill. It's an easy A. But if you're thinking of wanting to actually learn physics to do well on mcat or dat, etc in this class get ready to study all the material. He won't teach it to you, but you'll be in groups working on worksheets every class period. He gets paid to stand there basically .

Easy class, but basically all the learning is self study. Class itself isn't a lecture, but rather groups working on problems he gives and explains to the whole class every 30 mins or so. Textbook is free online and can be a little overwhelming, practice problems and weekly tests are ok. Much of the weekly assignments seem to be autograded.

I had him for BPHYS 114, and he's the same chill and easygoing professor. Honestly one of the most chillest professors I've had. He doesn't teach in class, we just learn from the textbook/videos on Canvas and use the in-class time to do group worksheets. Super easy to pass because all or most assignments are graded on completion. Amazing PFs, too!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He doesn't teach much but he expects us to know what we're doing. The TAs do a lot of the class work and seem more attentive than the actual professor. The class and work overall is an easy A if you use some resources but a lot of the assignments are worth 1-5 points, except the online hw. No final and you can do the group work from home.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Awesome class, not that hard if you look at the videos and do some practice problems, homework and quizzes were straight forward.  Overall i really liked this class and thought it was well structured

This professor absolutely doesnt teach nothing. I am actually surprised how this is a university level class. I mean it's good to get an easy A in it. But I expected real lecture teaching, just in groups the whole time. You'll actually have to self teach yourself to make sense of what is going on. A lot of people are so lost in this class lol.

Great class structure! Everything is consistent, and the grading is clear and fair. Weekly quizzes can be a lot, but I take them over exams any day. Also, I love how you can do revisions at the end. It shows he wants us to be able to learn at our own pace and ability to correct ourselves. In class assignments are kinda pain but its okay
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Easy A, honestly prefer not needing to go to class to learn. It was annoying at first to have to self study everything, but for the easy A and online tests I will take it over in person any day.

I liked was that the grading was clear, and it's SO easy to pass. But I barely got the material being taught & it was mostly just muscle memory. It's a fast-paced class. There wasn't enough time to retain information about Physics and what he's teaching. The TAs are ok, but do get confused sometimes. The Prof didn't feel significant enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst STEM prof at Bothell. Doesn't actively teach, expects us to learn from the very confusing textbook and each other when no one knows what's going on. The TAs give conflicting/incorrect help and groups were switched up every class so no one really gets to know anyone. Homework is online and very time-consuming. Easy A, frustrating structure.
quiz and quiz the time is lost in the classroom
quiz and quiz
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: His grading system is made more for his convenience than for students. His teaching style in class is interesting. Talking to him one on one he is arrogant. Take it for the easy A and ignore who he is as a person

Dr. Gilboff is a great teacher in my opinion. However, the class structure relies on student responsibility to familiarize yourself with the material for the week in order to succeed. For my learning style, I prefer this structure as opposed to hours of lectures on end. Read the textbook, do the practice problems, go to in-class meetings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's a pretty chill prof. There are only three types of assignments each week: weekly homework (online), quiz (online and open book), and in-class participation. Also, there is only one final exam which is online and open book.

Gliboff expect you to learn the material by yourself outside of class by reading the textbook and through the linked crash course videos on canvas. The lecture portion is just group practice problems and he does not teach any material during these lectures.  I do not recommend if you have a hard time teaching yourself new material.

Professor Gliboff does not care about the students whatsoever. Very unpassionate about what he does. Rude and late to reply to emails, if he even does. Boring lectures, and exams are 10 times harder than what is actually taught in class. I would give him a zero if I could

Professor Gliboff is extremely light on instruction and extremely heavy on frustrating auto-graded assignments. Most of this class is busy work. He honestly believes that students do better when they're not taught the material, and instead just figure it out themselves. He doesn't respect your time, and doesn't teach you enough to make up for that.

Doesn't seem passionate about teaching whatsoever, lectures were boring. Hard to reach outside of class and extremely lacking in instruction for every assignment, especially the final paper. Took me emailing twice and a long wait to finally figure out what he wanted, only for him to tell me that I did it completely wrong. DO NOT RECOMMEND.
He doesnt teach and he gave me a failing grade when I completed the assignment. When I tried to reach out he wouldnt respond.
Doesnt prepare you well for the class, also doesnt seem passionate in teaching.
Doesnt teach well, his exams were 60% average and his reasoning was the students needed to try something different....
All group projects (which he chooses)! He is very caring, responds to emails quickly and clearly has everything in canvas. The group projects are awful!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: He is pretty good professor, and test are not hard. He gives me a lot of practice problems during the class.

Really nice guy. He might seem a little harsh in time in class to some (not to me), but if you have any questions or concerns he is the most understandable physics teacher if you are willing to spend the extra few minutes to go to his office hours or send him an email. Good looking too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: A personable and approachable professor. He understands teaching is not a "one size fits all" program by providing extra office hours to work with students who ask for help. He considers a student's genuine effort in the class when grading. During lecture, he is empathetic to the class as a whole and often assesses the atmosphere for understanding.

I don't have enough nice things to say about this professor. He understands that not everyone is going farther with physics and that most students who are taking his course are going into medicine or engineering. I had to miss a couple classes and he was very flexible when working with me to get caught up. Take this class if you have the chance!

I only had him for labs but during labs he seemed to be un-interested and didn't seem to like answering questions. Again, I didn't have him for lecture, he only supervised labs so he might be a great lecturer. but I was unimpressed
I like when you count homework more than exams

He is not a good instructor, lectures were dry and confusing. That being said, all 4 tests(including final), only make 35% of the grade. I learned nothing at all this quarter, and still passed because I did all the homeworklabs. He put a significant curve on the final grades. So if you need to master this material for your major, avoid him.

I had him for Physics 121 lab and Physics 123 lecture and lab. I dislike the class organization because it is built around "learning from your peers" and daily group work. A lot of the time your peers don't know what they are doing and it makes it difficult. He is a fair grader, but he doesn't grade anything himself, which is frustrating.

If you ever get a chance to take physics with him, do it.  He is always in class early, explains things very clearly, gives reasonable assignments and reasonable grades.  I wish I had taken him for the other two physics classes.

Such a fun class, and for a level 100 BCORE; it was exceptionally informative. You get to do a mock trial, debate, and a myriad of other things. This class is great at being fun, lax, and highly informative on the law as well. In my opinion a must take.

What I like about him is that he's super-flexible. You can blow 4 deadlines to do them later (he calls them resurrection tokens). I didn't notice it in the syllabus until later, but he has "exam bomb protection" built in where a high grade on weekly stuff will pull up your score after getting low exam scores. Anyway, he works to keep your GPA up.

Such a great prof. I couldn't go, but he held a movie night for fun. There was a film and short stories to read each week, but all he asked was that you annotate them with your opinions, so totally manageable. Final project was making a short film. Final exam was skippable if you did well on midterm and kept up on readings. Great experience overall

Professor Doyle is a great professor, but as a BCORE class, I would say not to take. There are 2-3 readings a week and 1-2 films to watch as well, along with a midterm, a final exam (that can be skipped if you do well on the midterm), a research paper, and a short horror film you make as a group. Lots of work for a BCORE class, but great prof.
Great professor! Caring, knowledgable, and funny. Definitely learned a lot and would recommend it to everyone somewhat interested in acting/public speaking/theatre.
Very chill guy, would recommend for any classes he teaches. He genuinely wanted his students to succeed and was very lax with his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took Doyle's Intro to Acting class because I love acting and needed an easy 5 credits. Suffice it to say, I got both and even then some. I actually often looked forward to this class as I felt it was a getaway from my actually hard or rigorous courses. Doyle has a way to inspire a level of confidence in all class mates, making scene work fun!

Pretty good class, although he isn't too lenient towards absences. First half was focused on public speaking, second half was focused preparing for a trial with your assigned team. The midterm and quizzes are all online. Be sure to hold teammates accountable for their work, otherwise some teammates have to end up doing everything themselves.

(horror bcore) great prof! Loved his class, not difficult at all. Decent chunk of homework but it's just reading+annotating horror short stories and films. We wrote 1 major paper and made a group project horror short film (groups assigned). Final can be skipped with all HW turned in + 95% on midterm. Easy to approach, super sweet, had a great time!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: cool chill nice professor. class consists of basically watching and reading horror. work isn't hard its just a lot. i stg I have hw in this class than my other major classes. midterm that covers all the readings and videos, you'll write a paper, and make a horror movie. easy credit but a lot of work
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: BCORE120: he was one of the professors who taught this course and he was amazing! Had him before in my first year and even then was great, caring, and friendly too. He's easy to get along with and not scary at all. The class itself was kind of a lot for an elective but he's an easy grader and is lenient with late work. Lots of group work ez A 10/10

Very easy class that's also very fun. You do a massive trial simulation for about half the quarter with a group assigned to you and it's as easy or as difficult as you want. You prepare for a trial and compete against a different team. Showing up to class is important for many attendance points and the tests/quizzes are take home.

Super interesting topics learned in lectures, especially if you like horror/thriller/psychological twisting movies. We watched The Witch, Raw, an episode of The Haunting of Hill House, and more as homework. Wish I appreciated his class more in my first year. Easy A, make sure you take notes because he quizzes you about what he taught in lectures.

There were many assignments, some felt useless, but some were very interesting! The class was fun, but the lectures were really long and felt a little disorganized. Prof. Doyle was entertaining and funny, and connected to his students well! He was also very forgiving with grading policies, I would take any of his classes!

Did BLead102 during the summer, Passing. Doyle is very chill and he's really fun to be around. He is very considerate even with last minute issues. I believe he's very big on group projects and general interactions so be prepared. Overall everyone seemed to enjoy themselves and in the process I learned much about the course.

Professor Doyle is a nice professor, I took his BISIA 230 performance mask class and it was one of the best classes I have took in my academic career.
Pros : 
* Clear assignments 
* Gives feedback for assignments 
* Class is fun
Cons :
* Only 1 sick day allowed
* Group work (minimal)
I would take another of Professor Doyle's class again!

Gavin's an easy grader. But the problem is that he has mandatory attendance. You are only allowed one sick day. After that, he docks 15 pts for each class missed. He doesn't care if you're sick. Gavin is nice in person but in emails, he can be mean. He insists you do things his way and forces you to team up with who he arbitrarily chooses.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: the best professor I've had so far and for a horror movie class!!! just great- if you get him you're lucky. lectures are very interesting and make sure to take notes. tests are open-note and challenging but if you take notes you'll be just fine.

Great professor! His weekly quizzes offer a question (worth a good amount of points) that is just there to vent and wrote about your past week. He is the only professor that i know of that does this and i really appreciate it.
Would definitely take one of his classes again

- kind/funny prof but his critiques online are lowkey a bit harsh (like on our paper's) although he is very sweet in-person. gives helpful feedback.
- there was a few questions on the midterm he didn't mention in class lectures and there was a lot of trick q's.
- lecture heavy so make sure to show up to class!
- i would 100% take this class again

A great personality of a professor who wants his students to enjoy learning. He cares about his subjects and gives interesting lectures with a reasonable workload accompanying it. No midterm or final, besides a group project of our choosing depending on what we all wanted to create.
Very nice , made the class very fun and interesting. Definitely a high level professor.  As long as you come to class and do the assignments your straight chillin.

Throughout the quarter the assignments he gave were really easy. The midterm, the final and the research paper were the most challenging assignments but if you put in a little effort, you would be okay. He is an easy grader for everything but the paper but he gave a lot of options to improve the paper and extra credit.

You have to work hard if you want a good grade. He's a very nice professor. Assigns a reading/movie every week. Grades research paper pretty harshly, so you shouldn't slack on the first draft. Gives good feedback on the first draft. Grades group project based on effort. Tests can be hard/easy, depending on how good and detailed your notes are.

DOYLE IS GREAT!!! He does a great job making lectures fun and worth going to. He makes sure to give each student individual feedback and it really helps us in the long run when it comes to working on our projects. 100% recommend this guy.

By far one of the best professors ive had at UW, this professor (who has a JD) helped me in my law class, helped me excel in my class work in his class but also has been an excellent mentor with my work life. this professor has made a 20 credit workload feel lighter and helped me grow as a person. If you wanna take this guy, do it, you wont regret.
gavin is a character, you wanna be around him cuz he's funny and passionate about this subject. Fair grader also, quiezes were relaxed and mask creations were fun in the studio.
