Either best / worst teacher--depending on YOU. His lectures are fantastic, funny, & interesting. He did regular quizzes on reading (but, if you did the reading you were set--lowest dropped). Online exams w/most of the questions on study guide (pre-write+ cut/paste answers in!). There's group work, but he seems to grade on effort. super nice guy.

Lots of reading and quizzes every week. Was really stressful as you had to do projects, study for quizzes, write a reflection, AND work on the essay at the same time at one point in the quarter. Good luck if you take him.

reviews.comment: Just horrible.....

DO NOT RECOMMEND

reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Awesome professor. Really liked his class. Also, did you know he's qualified to be a lawyer (he got a JD at UW). If he uses the same passion and dedication he uses in theatre to practice law, the world would be even more interesting.
Doyle is a sugar good teacher along with easy. I took him for bcore so Im not sure how he is in a different setting but I would highly recommend taking him.
Awesome teacher. Everyone really likes him.

Gavin is super funny, kind, and caring. He does a lot of group projects, but theyre graded on personal effort rather than the final product. a lot of the grades are participation-based, so dont miss class. For papers, he grades more heavily on the rough draft. And his written exams are essay-heavy (but he lets you pick which question to answer)

Great teacher and really fun class. I learned a lot of valuable things that I won't forget. However, for a 2 credit class, it was pretty tough. Despite that, I loved the class and recommend it!

reviews.comment: OMG he's amazing! He's so nice and super good at replying. Gavin is a really nice guy. If you take his acting class, you'll be doing a lot of group work. He may not let you pick your own scene partners, which is the only negative. Otherwise he's really enthusiastic and passionate about acting!

This professor has been the worst one I have ever had.  Not only does he grade your papers, discussions, etc. based on if he likes you or not. reviews.comment: He had an amazing class. He gives lectures, which are boring, but one one day out of the two you have him for class. The other day is a fun day. The work you have to do is basically always an A but you will have to study for tests.

Lectures are really long and you have to type/write fast to get everything down because he changes the slide super quick. He curved the midterm so the average was a 90% and that was great. He's cool, take his class.

Gavin grades your drafts rough to squeeze as much effort out of you but goes easy on your final work. he knows not everyone believes they are talented at first and will grade you based on effort. Gavin also likes to get involved in projects and is upfront and honest about his work. I've taken him twice and he never fails to impress me.
He's a nice person. Helpful. Sometimes you might feel he's undervaluing you but I think that's his strategy to make your acting better. Take this class if you like memorizing long lines.
Fun, fairly easy (though you'll need to memorize a few things)
get a good group/coordinate with friends, or prepare to do all the group work yourself

LOTS OF TEST, LOTS OF ESSAYS, AND EVEN MORE VIDEOS YOU MUST WATCH! If you do not have at least 5-8 hours to just sit and watching the videos and readings all day. Then please do not take! Not a good professor

do yourself a favor and DON'T take this class. unbelievable amounts of work that is really time consuming (hours per assignment!), material is disorganized and doesnt make much sense, so many essays to write within one week! she hasn't graded anything and it's been 6 weeks into the quarter... it's extremely easy to burn out just dont take it at all

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR.

I have never ever failed a final exam up until I took this course in the fall. Professor Harewood is funny and fun to listen to, however she is an extremely harsh grader and will give you zeros with no explanation whatsoever. She gives a ridiculous amount of homework and gives you little time to complete it. Her idea of an "acceptable" grade is a C average. The questions she asks on homework are obscure, and they are often unclear. Most people dropped out of this class after the first week. RUN.

The professor is very kind and understanding, however is not a great teacher. Professor Harewood is hilarious. Easy work load and as long as you turn in your assignments according to her descriptions and participate in class you will get a 4.0. Professor Harewood is very nice however you will have to work for your grade. reviews.comment: This class was very interesting, Professor Harewood is fun, interesting and trys to include everyone. Discussions are interesting and she's very funny!  If you put forth the effort you'll be fine.

Taking this teacher is not worth the risk to your grade. Her grading is maddeningly inconsistent. You get punished for not meeting whatever guidelines she's made up in her head at that moment. Don't let the fact that she's nice fool you. This professor fails to teach and your grade suffers for it.
Mark my words, the course load is absolutely inhuman! Tough grader: completely inconsistent and unpredictable as well.  Avoid like the plague!

Harewood's class isn't difficult but her lectures are a little hard to follow, although I really enjoyed the class discussion periods. Her project descriptions are incredibly vague so follow up questions will be needed. The group work also seemed relatively unproductive, but the final was fun!

She is a good teacher but not helpful at all. She doesn't lecture the lesson. You have to do everything by yourself and with the group. She is not clear enough with the both group works and homework. If you are an international student. I don't recommend for you to take this class. It is difficult. Too much homework.

I have taken two classes with Susan Harewood and she is one of my favorite teachers at UWB! She is hilarious and I actually enjoy her lectures! She is really great about remembering everyones names and is patient and straight forward with every student. Yes, you may think she assigns a lot of work but it isnt too bad.

While I feel bad marking Prof. Harewood so low, it must be done. While she is one of the nicest, passionate teachers I've taken, she is also one of the most unrealistic, mindlessly difficult, and demanding teachers. While I recommend her classes, beware of the heavy workload!

Read & understand the book by taking your own notes.You might be more confused if you rely solely on her lectures as she tends to exclude material.She waits until the last min to pass out guidelines for assign's and if you're like me & need more time to write lengthy papers, remind her early on! Takes attendance daily.

I had him for 360 last year and now 444. His lectures can get long and dry after a while, but otherwise he's a very passionate professor and you can tell he enjoys the subjects he teaches. No exams at all and the whole class is pretty much team based. His grading criteria is kind of wack but honestly his grading isnt super harsh, for example he never deducts points for late work. Just super boring lectures

I believe this class was a waste of time, you don't learn anything new from 360 and he would often ask us if we did a certain subject in 360, he's the professor, he should know!

I recommend Health, Medicine and Society for an elective if you're okay with a 5 minute solo presentation as a final. Mostly readings and discussions with groups in class. Follow the assignment guidelines and you'll probably be good…

Best advice I can give is to meet the teacher in his office hours. When you meet him in his office be ready to give him hundreds of questions. He cares about your success.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: If you're taking Technical Writing class, be sure to choose him. He knows what he teaches and he has the proper English knowledge. He grades fairly and gives good feedback to your essays. Make sure that you read all the reading assignments and put effort in working the in-class worksheets; it will be very helpful in the exams. He is very thoughtful
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He gives 4 pop quizzes, but as long as you do the reading and show up to class, you will be fine. Not a tough grader as long as you do what he stated in the grading rubric. He loves participation. Really good teacher, explain the assignment well, I learned a lot about Sustainability after this class.

reviews.comment: He gives 4 pop quizzes, but as long as you do the reading and show up to class, you will be fine. Not a tough grader as long as you do what he stated in the grading rubric. He loves participation and take points away if you don't talk. Really good teacher, explain the assignment well, I learned a lot about Sustainability after this class.
