Assignments and requirements were often posted late on Canvas, and grades were slow to appear. For example, a quiz taken two weeks earlier took about a month to be graded.

Worst Professor I ever had, literally the worst. Don't take the class with her unless you need to. All she do is sit in class and let you read the syllabus, and do all the writing yourself. Every time when someone try to ask a question, she'll say did you read the syllabus? I don't want answer that question, you should known the answer. Avoid her!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Despite what others might say, she's a pretty good professor. If you listen to her feedback and go to her office hours, you'll excel just fine. Listen to her lectures and read the material, and you'll be just fine. Just don't expect responses to emails; go in person. Assignments never get graded on time, though: it's more of an if, than when.
Took BIS 421 with her, the class and her teaching style is insulting to anyone with a schedule. Extremely inconsistent "vibes based" grading, no respect for other's time. would never take again.

Do what the assignment specifications say, and the class is easy. There are a few quizzes/exams, but you get notes, and it's not that bad. There is absolutely 0 thinking or creativity involved in the writing if you just do the formatting and rules. If you fail this class, it's a skill issue.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: A washed up professor that really doesn't know what she's doing AT ALL when it comes to grading writing assignments. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Do your self a favor and do NOT take her course. It was single handedly the worst experience I have had at UWB. There is no clear grading for her quizzes or tests, she will tell you one thing yet expects another, so overall she is very contradictory which make studying and taking quizzes difficult.

She will grade more towards the low side. You will also have to negotiate every quiz, test, exam you take. Also, most of your assignments aren't graded till after the final, so you have no idea what your final grade will be.

Professor won't grade a huge portion of the assignments until after the final, so you won't know what your grade is until its done. Also, she grades very poorly. Average student grade for exams is 70, and average for the final is 60. If you need to take this class, switch professors ASAP.

Honestly, yes can be sarcastic, condescending, whatever other negative adj people use on her.
HOWEVER, she is there to explain, and explain until you get it.

Tbh i feel like most ppl leaving - reviews haven't had parental discipline before. I def was not a "favorite" (she was sarcastic to me as well) but i had good chats and laughs with her.

reviews.comment: If you're willing to do the readings and attend class, there's no reason why you can't succeed in this class. Her feedback may be blunt, but it's incredibly valuable. prof. kool is a very good professor! she can be a bit harsh sometimes, but she is super helpful and will practically tell you what to fix in your paper and how to do it if you go to office hours! she is also kinda funny lowkey, but overall, she is a nice professor!
shes very mean. very sarcastic. picks favs dont like her

If you do what she asks, you'll have no problems!

reviews.comment: If you are someone who puts in the effort to get at least a 3.8 in all of your classes, all I can say is good luck my friend.

Kool is not as terrible as people say, BUT you must get in her good graces. She doesn't put any grades into Canvas, so you're gambling and hoping for a good grade. I ended with a 3.8, and I don't even know how. Make sure you're paying enough attention in class, or else you'll become the student that she always bad-mouths every class.

Honestly, I don't like her as a person. She's rude when she gives feedback, calls people out, strict when it comes to attendance, and she's a picky grader. But she's at least better than some other professors I've heard about. The work honestly isn't too hard, I passed with a good grade. Just make sure you show up and do everything on time.

Professor Kool's class is a real challenge. The grading is tough and the assignments can be vague. But with effort and using resources like Unstuck ai, you can get through this class. It's worth it if you need the credit.

terrible professor, often tells students to shut up or be quiet. doesnt have a quiz or exam timeline. often changes criteria for some students she likes and doesnt like. rude and offensive, told an exchange student to stop talking because they couldnt understand him. very tough grader and creates different points to remove points.

reviews.comment: My class was BUS 421, not sure what the other name is. Her course is extremely unorganized. Most of the assignments are ungraded so you get no feedbacks. Avoid her please.

It's really not as bad as everyone makes it out to be if you put in some effort. If you follow the paper specifications, copy the samples as much as possible, and go to class, you'll be fine. Note that Kool can come off a bit rude when she gives feedback but I wouldn't take it to heart.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very tough grader. Her criteria is not very clear and she will grade you entirely based on what she deems is correct. Make sure to attend office hours. That is the only way to get a good grade. You have to put in effort to get a good grade for this class.

Horrible is an understatement! I often use this website and always thought that the students who gave their professors a bad rating must have not been diligent in the class and ended up with a bad grade hence take their frustration out on the professor. But I can confirm, easily the worst professor I have EVER had. Avoid her if you can at all costs

Beware - If there is another option, take it. Tons of assignments right off the bat that all have very intense grading and requirements. I usually do well with writing classes but this one was unlike anything I have had in the past. Many links are broken in canvas so you cant get a head start and only have 3 days to work on an assignment.

reviews.comment: I genuinely believe she is racist. Would always unfairly judge my work so to test, one time when she came around the class to check our work I decided to switch papers with my white classmate to make sure. As usual she found a bunch of nitpicks in mine but said his was perfect when she didn't realize it was actually my work. Happened multiple times

Nancy is actually a caring professor if you are willing to spend time with her in her office hour. It is hard to read her feedback, but she will tell you every single detail if you ask her. My first drafts were very bad, but she told me how to fix it, and I ended up having a 3.8 GPA. She is an easy grader for most of the assignments.

There were so many assignments that I remember that were given 2-3 days prior to the due date without warning. These assignments were often given vague instructions that fail to detail what expectations are without reading the textbooks. Also, her expectations on draft assignments specifically are very high, so do your drafts like it's your final.

I am astounded that this professor has graduate degrees in English but cannot teach basic writing in a consistent or effective way. Her grading is completely random and arbitrary. UWB can do MUCH better.

It is NEVER clear how the end paper should look like. We have samples/requirements, we bring drafts and fix it many times, then you get Kool's feedback with comments like "See samples" (I saw samples - its same). Fixing it all barely increases grade to +0.2 out of 4.0. Opening hours with Kool did not get a better result. It's ALL a waste of time!!!

If you can avoid taking 301 with her, please do. She doesn't know how to use Canvas at all. You will have to submit print copies for all instructor drafts. Her comments are very hard to read. Don't try to revise your papers, just go straight to her office hours. Don't ask questions in-person, she will humiliate you in front of the entire class.

She did not grade any of the assignments until the last day of quarter, and most assignments were never graded, including the final. She does not give feedback to any of the papers if you don't give her a paper copy, which she said is optional to turn in! Avoid this teacher if you need a good grade in this class.

reviews.comment: Although I learned a lot from her, she is very frustrating to work with. Has office hours but is never there. Does not respond to any emails sent to her. Wow. Do not ever take a class with Nancy. Extremely rude, humiliates you if you ask questions, and is terrible at grading papers. It's like she's using a Magic 8 Ball to grade our work. Never graded midterm. Final grade felt like rolling a dice, I was expecting 0.9 - 3.0. Ended up with a 3.3 bc she only graded the final papers. Could be different every quarter

The content is not hard, but it is hard to get a good grade for the papers. The average is below 3.0 for drafts. The essays are 50% of your grades. She grades extremely slow and is not good at using canvas. You would not be able to tell how well you're doing until the last day. Pro: The essays are interesting because you get to choose a topic.

Avoid at all costs. She has not given a single final grade for any of our assignments nor our midterm and its week 9/10. Extremely rude toward students. Will not answer your question. Will cut you off and embarrass you in front of the class. Cancels her office hours every week with little notice. She is a terrible professor.

She really wants you to learn the material and only if you understand it you will get a good grade. People here who say that she is a bad teacher are the ones that don't go to office hours and coasted by in their other classes with this being their first real class.

I personally enjoyed Kool but I see why many are upset with her: -Not very responsive to emails -Doesn't answer emails if it's "confusing" -Unclear and contradictory criteria -Hates having to teach online (admits it) To pass, you must: -Visit her office hours (only way to obtain a good grade on instructor drafts) -Show some enthusiasm -Not skip
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: If you try hard on rough drafts, show up to class, and attend office hours, you should be fine. She can seem rude sometimes but is actually a pretty nice person.

Fair grading but significantly more challenging than any other writing class I've taken. Enjoyed what we did in class. Outside of class content was tough. She isn't a bad teacher though, and people who say so probably just got a bad grade and don't want to take responsibility.
Disorganized, distracted, late with feedback. But she will have a lot of office hours

Online content is chaotically unorganized, not in chronological order. Tons of busy work and "side quests". Starts new assignments before finishing previous ones. Read until your eyes fall out. Runs it like a writing class without any clear expectations or rubrics. Rude and condescending, expects students to "just know" what her expectations are based on coursework from previous classes. Homework barely rates as busy work. Expect writing north of 40 pages for the ten week course.

Worst teacher I've ever had. Took on Zoom. Not understanding, doesn't care about students. Thinks online is the same as in person. Offers NO partial credit so enjoy harsh grading marks. WARNING. DON'T TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. Not meant to teach this class at all. Horrible feedback and poor grading techniques. Isn't comfortable with explaining and treats you as an idiot for asking questions.

The midterm hasn't even been graded yet. Avoid her if you can, I'm sure any of the other professors are better than her.

This teacher is seriously the MOST UPSETTING teacher that I have ever had. Grading is very poorly outlined, she's condescending, unhelpful, impatient, and overall just rude. There's lots of busy work for this class, and none of it prepares you for exams or projects. Nice lady, but my HS teachers were 5x better.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Never shows up to her own classes in person lol

Kim Cunningham is sweet and caring, but I wouldn't recommend her if you want to learn. Lectures are fast-paced, lacking substance as she reads off the slides. Answers to questions and instructions can be vague and unclear, which made both projects a bit more stressful than they should be. Assignments do not help on exams or quizzes.

Kim is a sweet and kind person. When it came to her teaching, I would recommend finding someone else. Her teaching style is not good. If you want to just pass your class, take her. If you want to learn, don't take her. Her answers to most questions will be dull. Unless you enjoy lectures with no substance and bland instructions, find someone else.

Prof Cunningham's class is easy to pass if you're more homework orientated than test orientated. Most of the grade is the weekly assignments and major projects. She's super clear about grades and you can access anything on her Canvas. You can pass without attending a class.

reviews.comment: She is very sweet and reply backs to emails really fast. Only problem is when she lectures, it gets pretty boring since she reads off slides. Project 1 was really hard but project 2 wasn't too bad if you dont have bad groupmates. Alot of hw but its not too bad.
She made everyone in the class feel super comfortable asking questions

reviews.comment: Most caring teacher I've ever had, stays as long as she can after class to make sure everyone gets help they need. Very approachable.
Super easy to talk to outside of class. Genuinely cares about her students.
Lectures were great at preparing for the exam
Most engaging lectures I've ever had
Learned a lot, super engaging lectures

reviews.comment: I'm really bad at accounting But she tried really hard to explain everything I wasn't getting to me to the best of her ability
You guys are missing out if you don't take Kim as a teacher
I learned a lot from her class 10/10 would take again
I was having a super rough quarter, but she was very empathetic and helped me succeed more than any other teacher has when I have been going through something during a class
The sweetest teacher I ever had

This class was very easy to pass but i felt like i didn't truly learn anything. I signed up for a hybrid class but something came up literally every day we had an in-person class scheduled and the entire quarter ended up being remote. She seems nice but just reads off of slides we're given. She is very good at responding to emails fast though

class is 2 hours straight rapid fire through 100s of slides. doesn't explain concepts just reads off the slides. 2 projects throughout quarter managerial was lwk hard, final group project @ the end. she responds quick but for those wanting to learn accounting, don't take unless you want the free credit. everything online- assigments/exams/tests.

Shes a nice teacher but if you actually want to learn accounting then I wouldn't recommend. Lectures are 2 hours straight of rapid fire through the 100-150 slides taking notes is hard because she just goes through em quick. Easy if you want the credit, all tests and quizzes and hw are take home through connect. nice teacher but disorganized

Class is 100% used for lectures (2 hrs, non-stop talking), so I don't go bc all materials can be accessed online. It's easy to get full scores on homework/quizzes/exams (done in your own time, online). I can guarantee a few YouTube videos and Google searches will give guidance on what to do with the big projects of the quarter as they did with me!

Very lecture-heavy class with long boring lectures that last nearly all of the class without much engagement so difficult to pay attention. Easy class but she's a very tough grader, especially on project #1. Tests are all online and taken home and you have several days to start it. Group project at the end of the quarter which is fairly easy.

Although the exams are done online and outside of class, there is so much homework with the exercises, learning objectives, and quizzes for each chapter. Very little help was offered for the two big projects and the professor spent too much of class time racing through around 100 slides for each chapter.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: All homework and exams are online on McGraw Hill. I would recommend lectures in person compared to her online recorded lectures because she can help you with class exercises. She replies in less than 2 minutes on email and is free all hours of the day. I emailed her 1 hour before an assignment was due and she helped.

Definitely one of the tougher classes I've taken, homework often takes hours and introduces new concepts. Good luck on exams many students ran out of time. Grading especially exams and projects is slow and harsh, but she does offer regular Zoom office hours for help and has an interesting background with real business experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This is the most time consuming class I've ever had. There will be so many questions on your exams that your grade drops because you can't finish all the questions. Very tough grader, she cares about the students learning and has impressive credentials and is accessible, but the material itself is bad/hard to understand. Good luck getting a curve.

Great professor with unique expereince in defense, medical, and entreprenurship. Wants you to learn, so not happy when AI used for homework. Very structured and intense but if you do what she teaches, you will do good in the course. If you don't pay attention or try to take shortcuts, you will not.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the hardest classes I have had so far. Generally, I found the class hard to follow, and you can get lost very easily. She doesn't make the most comfortable environment for asking questions. It is a very heavy workload class. I would not take it again unless I had to. She is pretty flexible with offering help outside of class.

If you want to have the most stressful time of your life, take her!!!!!!!

She will give you anxiety, make you feel dumb, she is SUPER harsh on grading. 

Would never ever take with her again even if I had to delay my graduation

Avoid at all costs. This is the type of professor who teaches things in the most complicated ways that aren't clear at all. If you ask her questions, she makes you feel like you're dumb for not understanding it right off the bat. Do not take the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She has lots of work experience so good at helping you understand how the material is used. Course was challenging since I don't have ops experience and not my concentration but she wants you to succeed so that helped a lot. Expect heavy workload, lots of simulations and group work, but if you do the work you will learn and get a good grade.

You can tell she really cares about ensuring students learn and get useful skills (Excel). She will make you work for the grade. But classes are usually engaging with simulations. I did not expect to make paper airplanes in college, but now I understand Lean better than reading the book. Hoping she teaches project management next year.

This class in general is a hard one, but she does a great job of offering support as needed. The courseload is heavy and you definitely have to work for your grade, but Professor O'Neill makes sure you have what you need to be successful. She's very good at offering her support and makes herself available for all her students.

Professor Kim O'Neil's course is demanding, not the type of course you can cheat through! Her lectures are insightful, and group projects deepen understanding. While tests are tough, they're fair. Professor O'Neil's caring attitude towards her students is evident. Highly recommended for those willing to actually learn.

She teaches all the math w/ slides so it's hard to follow. Also, the math we learn in class does not translate to the homework so it's a lot of self teaching in that regard. She does a lot of simulations in class that really help with understanding the non-math concepts. Semi-rude when answering general questions. My hardest core class so far.
avoid!!!

Not the most challenging class but the most difficult one to achieve an A in this grade because there were too many problems in exams to solve before time out. By that, I mean that in every exam (Midterm 1&2 and Final), there will be 13 to 18 questions. So beware of time when taking the test because you might not finish the exam on time.

Kim is one of my favorite professors. She really cared about my success in her class. She met with me on Zoom whenever I asked and she was super helpful with explaining the statistics problems. The class was very difficult for me but she helped me get a good grade.

I learned so much about business technology with real projects. We had to develop models in Excel, create and query a database, and generate a dashboard in Tableua. I used a lot of this in my summer internship. And Kim met with me on Zoom to help me with some questions. She is a tough grader but she really cares about students.

Overall,she is a wonderful person, despite the fact that she may be a difficult grader at times. You'll be alright as long as you do what's expected of you. Expect to work on a lot of projects, since there are 5 in total for the quarter. There will be four individual projects and one final group presentation, as well as two exams. Very much reccom.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Takes forever to grade, and I mean WEEKS. To be exact, our first individual assignment she didnt grade until few days before the midterm. Extremely tough grader with such unbelievable expectations. She says she wont grade hard but in reality she takes off points for things she didnt even ask for. Dont take her if you care about your grade

I dont understand how she has good ratings. This professor is awful and frankly doesnt care about peoples grades. Shes an incredibly tough grader for no fken reason. ALSO she doesnt teach, instead you have to learn from a LinkedIn video she provides. Would not recommend taking her. Worst professor Ive taken at uwb and Seattle combined.

Kim gave me a new perspective on project management. I look at healthcare differently as I go through the motions at work. I wonder how something could be improved, what would that project look like, how would it be executed and the success measured. Very useful learning and applicable in all aspects of life.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She appears tough and strict, but she really cares about your learning. She sets up 2-3 office hours before an exam. Exams are open-book and on myStatLab. She grades exams with your Excel sheet, so she gives reasonable partial credit. You should take good notes, ask questions, and study a lot to get a good grade. Her class is not an easy A tbh.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: This professor is rare. At first she seemed tough and strict, but she really cares about you and value your engagement with the course more than being crazy and competitive anout grades. Very responsive and she is always ready to listen and help you to be successful in her class Just be honest and work hard. Shes straight-warded like business lol
Always gave help with homework, very easily accessible and made sure that she had plenty of office hours that worked for everyone. Also gave individual help.

You'll need to work hard in this class to get a good grade.  She's very nice but she won't let you just pass through without doing the work. Uses mystatlab for homeworks and exams but that helped me. Really cares that you learn. Will work with you to make sure you do.

Statistics isn't easy for me, but she makes it easy to understand. Teaches fast since there's tons of material to cover. Quizes and exams are similar to HW problems but with a twist. Always willing to meet with you and tries to help you understand it.

Very enthusiastic and reasonable professor. Doesn't give you the easy way out and challenges you, which is definitely for your benefit as a student. Lecture slides could be more detailed, however. But always ask questions. She's a really friendly and good business statistics professor!! Highly recommend her for any future business classes.

She was one of the best professor I've ever took at UW-Bothell. She was strict, so don't expect an easy A without pushing hard. But, her lessons were interesting and fantastic if you do pay attention in class! Be ready for lots of field trips, homework, and quizzes. Also, she's super friendly and funny! I recommend taking her classes if you can!
Knowledgable and cares about students. Fun tour of Boeing for lean manufacturing. Lectures give you most of what you need to know. Do the homework and pay attention in class and you'll do ok.

Gives out assignments late and never returns them in time. Feedback on assignments seem trivial and shows she clearly did not examine the assignment carefully. Her ways of giving out extra credits are more than trivial. Only gives out point to students that are lucky to win simulation. Late to class. Only talk to half of the class, ignore the other

Expect to spend a lot of time doing busy work. Have a good note sheet before tests because she has short answer questions that require you to have all of the steps (sometimes 7) to certain topics. I spent about twice the normal time of a business class doing hw/projects/preclass/etc
If you have the option between Understanding stats, BIS 315 and Business stats BUS 215, please take BIS 315, do not take BUS 215....Nuff Said

She is the best teacher! LOVE her class. This class is not an easy A definitely, but it is possible to get A+. A lot of homework but she is SO helpful and carefully listens to her students. She is SUPER professional and knowledgeable. It is your loss if you dont take her class, seriously!
GREAT QUALITY! ALTHOUGH LOTS OF HW, THE TEACHER IS VERY NICE, KNOWLEDGEABLE AND VERY LOVELY. REALLY LEARNED A LOT FROM HER. IF YOU WANT TO IMPROVE YOURSELF AND LEARN, TAKE HER CLASS.

I love her class. She is so fair that you can't complain. Although giving much homework, you get a lot from it too. Great and helpful class! She doesnt grade hard, gives out xtra credit, is willing to help. The class is not easy but listen to her lectures every class and that's all you need!

She assigned very long homework,that she sometimes forgets to enable and didn't bother to give extensions when she did.Takes a long time to respond back. The midterms and exams were very long,even knowing the material well didn't help with finishing on time or getting a good grade.I 've never had a more horrible teacher.

She's sarcastic at the wrong times, snaps at her students, and is not helpful. She takes too long to respond to students' questions. On the last exam, one of the questions didn't have the correct answer listed and instead of throwing it out, she penalized her students for it. Overall, the class wasn't too hard but avoid this teacher if you can.

Not the most helpful... Worst thing is she is notoriously late to class, which I find disrespectful and a waste of my time. Just does generic publisher generated power points. I ended up with 3.3, was at class everyday and participated more than anyone. Did all the HW as well. Test is what hurt me. Test is not relative to what you learn.

If you want to do well in her class, you need to study and make sure you understand the concepts.  she was more than willing to review my H/W before I actually submitted it.  Front & back page of notes for first exam. The last exam was take home (open book, open notes). Doesn't like ppl talking during the lecture though (duh).

You don't really have to go to class, and you don't really have to do much reading for the class as long as you just skim it to get the ideas. For the exams she allows one page of notes, and if you just copy and paste EVERYTHING from her lecture slides, you can find the exact answer on the exam. She's pretty friendly and reasonable.

U dont have to attend, but she does 2-3 in class assign. that are fun and worth points. Gives lots of extra cred. opportunity. Takes suggestions from students and will modify syllabus. Very organized-lectured always posted. Tests MC, you get notes, they are straightforward easy math and verbatim of her slides/text and Curved! BEST TEACHER AT UWB.

It's nice to have a professor who wants you to succeed. Work was reasonable and we were able to have 4 surfaces (2 pages F/B) of notes for exams. I learned a lot and we had really fun class experiments.

I think Kim is an excellent teacher, very knowledgeable, helpful and interested in what she is talking about. The class was fun, I really enjoyed it and would definitely take one with her again. Too bad she only teaches undergraduate Operations Management and MBA classes.
if you not good in public speaking - you will fail.

Generally one of the best classes I've taken, and will be seeking to take other classes with this professor in the future. Incredibly passionate and easy to connect with. Nice spread/ variety of assignments/ work. I enjoyed every class. Answers questions/ concerns very well. I really don't have complaints that are worthy of mentioning.

reviews.comment: Easily the best professor I have had. Assignments are well thought-out and require time to complete, but there are not many of them assigned. Classes are set up in a way that makes learning enjoyable. The professor is passionate about what he teaches and is very knowledgeable. Follow instructions on assignments, and an A is easily attainable.

He is a very tough grader who has very vague instructions on assignments which are things that shouldn't go together. No rubrics on anything either. His assignments are demanding and confusing.  You need to come to every lecture in order to actually know how to do assignments which is frustrating because assignment instructions should be clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My favorite professor throughout my whole college experience so far. The way he runs his classroom makes sense. He respects his students and provides a lot of feedback. Great professor. You need 98 for an 4.0 though.

As someone who hates learning about politics, and the government, this class was very interesting. No textbook, but there were weekly readings. Class overall is easy to understand and get a good grade in if you listen to the lectures. Keith is very passionate on the subjects he teaches, which makes the class more interesting and fun.

Such a great teacher, you can tell he definitely cares about his students and he is passionate about what he teaches. Not many assignments, which makes it easy but also means they're weighed heavier, so be aware! No final exam but a group debate at the end of the quarter and a few writeups involving the material. Would definitely take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Poor organization of the class. Never put things as assignments in canvas or upload any sort of modules so no one knows what is due for the week. Additionally, he does assignment guidelines in the assignment, only in the syllabus. Your syllabus will be your best friend in this class. His lectures are boring. Not easy. Do not take.
Professor Nitta is amazing. He's funny and caring. However, most of the work graded are group projects. So, if you can, pick people you trust to be your group partner.

Professor Nitta is amazing! Extremely accessible, small penalties for late work, funny, and awesome overall. The only complaint I have is with the group projects, in which I did all of the work for my four other classmates. However, Keith allows you to rat on your classmates who did nothing at the end of the quarter. PARTICIPATION MATTERS!

Great professor with lots of care for the subject. He is always willing to help students. The classwork is not especially difficult, but there are some stressful debates if you're not used to public speaking and a substantial paper at the end of the class.

You will grow in his class, his approach of how he teaches is different. However it allows you to grow and think critically, also you will work in groups that will either be your demise or you will gain and learn from your peers. Very cool Professor

Overall, he is a great professor. He is very helpful and supportive when you need help inside or outside of the classroom. There aren't a lot of assignments and he can sometimes be a little bit of a hard grader, so make sure to take your time with it. He seems to like small group work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is nice but an unreasonably hard grader. Most of the good students will get an A- (3.5 to 3.8). Very picky and unclear grading criteria. He is a REALLY good lecturer, though, and good at engaging the class. Attendance is basically required for participation points.

Prof. Nitta is great, charismatic, and a good lecturer. His workload seems heavy but when you start doing it, your grade will definitely prosper. Replies quickly to emails and gives long/effective feedback on assignments. Though his grading seems tough, the feedback is purposeful and suppose to help you grow. Participation matters a lot.

Professor Nitta the best! He's really nice and he always goes into depth about our readings and makes it so we have good discussions. He also gives really good feedback on written work and is willing to work with you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Keith's BIS300 course is not too difficult if you attend class regularly and read the text. Class is very much discussion based which was a nice change of pace. Clearly a passionate professor who respects his students. He also provides really well thought out feedback while grading your assignments. Would 100% recommend.

Professor Nitta is excellent in teaching and communicating, and facilitating the class. There are quite a lot of discussions of readings and research on a specific topic. Attendance is key. It is not a difficult class at all if you do the work.
One of the best professors Ive ever had. He is a hard grader, but he really cares about his students and is very friendly.
One of my favorite professors! Very good professor learned a lot about politics, make sure to turn in assignments on time and come to class.

Awesome professor, he really cares for his class and his lectures always present why the coursework/ issues presented are still relevant today. As long as you do the assigned readings and participate in online discussions you will succeed.

No busy work. All of it is gold if you are at all interested in politics. Very helpful in and out of class. Debate format for quarter-long team project is awesome for getting to know the topic. Not out to trick you, but you should go to class because the concepts are big!

Keith is a great professor. He wants his students to succeed. DO THE READINGS. He will randomly pick people to talk about the homework. He doesn't give a lot of busy work which is great. He understands that we all have other classes and lives. Is one of the few instructors that takes role. So come to class and you'll do fine.

What I liked about his teaching style: he presented main concepts in powerpoint when covering a new topic (giving me a vocabulary and some main ideas I could review later on); engaged discussions were always held after assigned readings;and if you take advantage of office hours he's helpful in framing concepts to your academic interests.
Keith is awesome! Go to class, do  the reading and you will do fine. He is fair and straightfoward. Doesnt expect very much busy work which is nice!

I took Keith for BIS 300 & BIS 338. Both classes were interesting and I enjoyed going. He had various ways of engaging students to keep it from becomming dull. If you do the reading and ask question you will do just fine! I would definitly recommend him and take his classes again if I could!
Not very clear in his expectations.  Like's to answer a question with a question.  Would not take a class with him again.

I think Keith is a great teacher. He is very humerous, making his classes enjoyable and fun. Also, he mixes his classes up well with discussions, interactive activities, group work, etc. He is not very clear about his assignments, which can be challenging,  however, this can be to your advantage because it allows you to complete your assingments in

Keith's classes are interesting and challenging. those who complain about lack of clarity, probably need their assignments spelled out for them. Keith wants his students to think creatively to accomplish projects. He is happy to work with students after class. If you're not interested in social change you might find his classes "pointless".

Professor Nitta holds his students to high standards, but is willing to work with students outside of class. Use his office hours. He also responds to e-mail quickly. His explanations for assignments are often minimal because he wants his students to be creative, not turn in cookie-cutter assignments.

Isn't clear in directions or expectations for assignments.  He grades harshly.  His classes are boring and seem pointless, filled with obvious information everyone already knows.  He does not engage the class, and it's almost unbearable.  Don't take his BIS300 class.  What is supposed to be an informative introductory class is actually horrible.
Do not take BIS300 from him! it is very boring and he does not do a good job at explaining what he wants out of assignments!

Dr. Nitta is a fair and balanced teacher. He holds students to a high standard but also helps when necessary. He clearly does a great job of teaching around each individual and teaching accordingly. Expect real world projects and massive interaction with Nitta and classmates. I look forward to classes in grad school with Nitta. Take his class!!!

You can tell she cares a lot about her students and her class. I thought her class was interesting; however, she is a tough grader. There are small weekly quizzes, and participation matters a lot. If you miss a day, your grade tanks. The final is a small group presentation.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Many days I would hope a bus would hit me before a class. She is convinced everyone is using ai or outside sources. Lots of homework and long boring lectures.

Ms. Spiegler is really sweet but oh my god there is an insane amount of reading! my section was about fairy tales which we really only studied for like one session. the rest were just random novels we had to take way too many notes on. i had at least one mental breakdown over her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Very passionate about the what she teaches but assignments were reading heavy and unnecessarily time consuming. Class sometimes felt more like a highschool English class than a history class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
I love this woman. She's a bit strict, but I think that's part of the charm. The class requires a lot of in person participation, most of her work is to be done off-class and then discussed in person.

There's few opportunities for extra credit, but if she sees that the class needs it, she'll grant it. There's very little leeway for late work, too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is a very passionate teacher but the class itself didn't have enough substance to even warrant the 2 hour meeting a week. reviews.comment: a little entitled about the priority of her class in your life (we're paying for this, it's not high school, she also treats you like a high schooler), passionate but lots of boring assignments and reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I was shocked when I saw all the negative reviews here. reviews.comment: She is a great person and very passionate about what she teaches, but so much reading for a bcore class. Lots of writing, group projects, and assignments. We didnt even use the core packet that she listed on the textbooks part.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: structured like a high school honors class: passionate but scatterbrained teacher who runs a very reading & discussion-heavy classroom with solid rules. she's passionate about her subject and very sweet, but it did feel like high school again and her teaching style isn't for everyone. don't recommend if you're busy and want an easy BCORE.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Spiegler is a really nice, caring person, but her teaching is not too great. She used to be a history teacher, so her class became more of a long series of history lessons than what I really signed up for (a fairy tale class). The amount of reading in this class is around 60-170 pages a week. She gives two late passes, but it's still a lot.

she's a great person, but for a bcore class, she takes it too seriously. she assigns more work than my chemistry and biology classes. she's heavy on group work, she'll call on you in class, and assigns reading that's almost pointless to the assignment. she's a great person but not a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Solid definition of good person, bad professor. She assigns lots of busy work that is graded 100% on completion, and doesn't use Canvas to give feedback on major papers so you don't know your grade until she gives it to you (even if she does give good feedback). Her lectures are slow and uneventful, but she's still a nice and pleasant person.

A good teacher makes you love a course. Long writing assignments are not the way to learn. If wanted a writing class I would take one. Just lazy teaching. She is tough grader. Basically if you take a class from her, you will mess up your GPA and hate your class. Interesting she asked feedback but was very defensive about it.

I took her course on Shakespeare. Spiegler is very enthusiastic about the course. Lectures on a book often begin with history behind Shakespeare at the time and Early Modern English gender relations partially relevant to the text. When writing papers, make sure your thesis is something she can agree with if you want to preserve your GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I took Shakespeare in Film thinking it would be easy. As someone who does not like Shakespeare, this class was not bad. The professor is really passionate about the subject and is always willing to help.

The class is centered around writing one large research paper to turn in at the end of the quarter. You choose your own specific topic to write about and are given instructions to accessing resources for research. Louise is very sweet, understanding, and constructive in giving feedback. You will have to work for your grade but because she cares.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She is the worst professor I have ever had in my life!! She is the most condescending person I have ever dealt with in my life and she makes you feel really stupid. Anytime I or any other person tried to ask her a question, she was very dismissive and made you feel like you were not a priority at all. Her classroom isn't a stress free classroom.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Took "Shakespeare and Film" with Louise, she is energetic and passionate about Shakespeare. However, we watched 30 minutes of each film, and out of the 4 required texts, we never spent class time reading or analyzing them. We did write essays on every one though. Class time was wasted, expectations are unclear, grades you based on her writing style
Tough grader, Stickler, and narrow minded.

If you want a research writing class--this isn't for you. Prof. Spiegler has an intense passion for history, which turns this class essentially into a history lesson. You HAVE to write a paper on history, and there are multiple history lectures. This is not what I signed up for.
she's overly enthusiastic and doesn't articulate what work is due the next day. she knows her stuff but can't articulate it at all

Avoid her if you want to keep your GPA. She's a nice person, but a hard teacher. If she likes you, you'll do well. She grades too hard for no reason. She nit picks at your worksheets. Oh you didn't answer the question in a complete sentence, even though it didn't call for one kiss those points goodbye. Not an amazing writer watch your GPA drop.

Dr Lewis is a really dedicated professor to her students and class! She enjoys what she teaches and it clearly shows. Asking questions outside the class was really helpful to my learning and she wants the success for all her students. Its definitely hard to learn just off her slides, so try and attend class!

Very excellent and respectable teacher. Has lots of course material but she was very gracious about the grading, especially for exams. She is very understanding and approachable too. Only con is that she can be a bit snarky at times.

Really fun and chill professor. I felt that students were pretty comfortable talking to her and asking questions or making jokes. Exams are not that hard and there's homework, participation, and lab to prop up your grade. Only cons are that lab is a lot of work and missing a class hurts because most info is in lecture and slides lack information.

Students should know this course is mostly self-taught. The exam material is not listed in the study guide, which makes preparation difficult. If you take this class, expect to rely heavily on self-study. The only positive thing I can think of; you can make up missed exams.

GREAT FOR MCAT REVIEW! very writing heavy. Every week you will have a writing assignment paired with homework questions; there is a final paper, mid term, and final exam. Rarely gives 100% in writing. Expect constant feedback and criticism! She can be blunt in person but passionate. Verbal explainer. Video lectures are what you expect.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: You need to know how to read peer reviewed papers and writing them is the best way to learn. The grades will not be failing unless you purposefully don't put in effort. Lots of writing, but a great mix of being in charge of your time as its only once a week in person. You learn to speak science clearly to others
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is amazing. Takes into consideration students' comments and lectures are enthusiastic and helpful. she is hilarious! Tests are fine and she gives great study tools! Lectures being recorded help so much even as a student who goes to class daily! Take her if you can, she is truly amazing! I would just want a change in the lab curriculum...

She's honestly one of the best science professors I've had. The class is very reading and lecture heavy, but she explains herself really well. Quizzes before every class based on the reading. As long as you go to class you'll be fine. Very generous grader on exams. Gives partial credit on multiple credit if you explain.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: good
Lectures are fast and you have to understand the material right away or you will not do well in the class.  I recommend studying for the class before you go.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professor treated her class as high school students and showed no respect to her students. She even accused the class of cheating even though she never gave us recommended material to study. She never gave us the time to absorb the information provided and test us before we had a chance to really understand the material.

I'm really not sure what the other reviews are talking about -- Dr. Lewis is fantastic. Is her class easy? No, but few classes in biology ever are. Her lectures are straight forward and to the point, she gives you the info necessary to succeed but she will not spoon-feed you an easy grade. You will have to work for it, but it's all worth it.

Probably the worst teacher I have ever had. She is very confusing and all over the place with her lectures. She is never prepared for class and is very condescending to everyone. If you can do NOT take her class. Avoid her at all costs!! She is a tough grader and does not give any feedback to anything. It is very clear that she shouldn't teach.

I feel that she generally cares about her students and brings a lot of energy to class. However, I always felt like her grading was unclear and chaotic. While she does give a fair amount of feedback, it can be pretty condescending at times. Is she the best? No, but she is better than other options. I will only take her again if I have to.
Her way of teaching is not good and she does not explain things when asked for clarification
WORST. PROF. EVER. that's all you need to know.
her recorded lectures should also be clear to watch because it is hard to see what she writes on the board and what she is talking about
she needs to teach things that are in the book and her tests should be easy. Otherwise she should be fired
Worst teacher at uw. Would not recommend taking her class or talking to her

Professor Lewis is very nice and she is available to help outside of class when needed. However, her lectures do not go by the book and go outside the contents and expects you to know information she hasnt clearly taught. She made the midterm exam harder than the practice exam and expected us to finish in the time frame and even said sorry to us.

She is really accessible outside of the class, and she is always willing to help her student JUST GO TO HER OFFICE HOUR or schedule an appointment with her. She does record her lecture, so if u miss some class, it's fine.

Dr. Lewis is one of the only professors in my experience that explains topics in a way that is easy to understand. She provides practice exams, a LOT of worksheets (they are super helpful, though), she records her lectures, and even hosts online web conferences the night before an exam. By far one of the best BIO professors. I highly recommend!

She is a really funny, intelligent, sweet professor. Dr. Lewis is great at lecturing and will help you with anything you need. She also releases study guides that are quite helpful for the exams. Obviously the class is not easy, so you have to put in work, but it really pays off in the end :)

Dr. Lewis is awesome! She is very clear on what she wants you to know, and will continue to help until you get it. We had to do many papers reviewing literature and she always gave good feedback. She funny and really knows her stuff, would deffinetly take again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--SO MANY PAPERS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Lewis wants her students to learn and do well in her classes. I've taken multiple classes with her, most of the time she offered review sessions before a test and it is always extremely helpful. She is very straight forward about what you need to know for each test. Does a lot of worksheets to help be hands on with the topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I've had Dr. Lewis twice now as a professor and I would recommend her to anyone interested in biology. You can tell from day 1 that she loves teaching, and that she is super geeky at heart. Funny, motivational, and a true genius at times, I have had few teachers in my life that compare to her.
Worst teacher I have ever had. Very unhelpful, tells us to look a the interet rather than teach herself. Do not take this teacher.

Dr. Lewis is a wonderful lecturer. She makes the most confusing genetic concepts straighforward and is very helpful in her review sessions and office hours. She is flexible and makes times outside of her office hours for students to see her. Her exams may be slightly tricky but mostly straighforward and fair if you study the material well.

Dr. Lewis is an amazing lecturer and I felt privileged to be in her class. I had her for intro to genetics and learned a ton. She grades tough but fairly, be prepared to work for your grade. Her lectures are good enough that you dont need a book and she doesnt require one.

Love her. Best lectures, she keeps your attention and explains things so well. She makes the hardest things make sense. very easy going and easy to talk to. If you're having difficulty, reach out and she will make time to meet with you. I've had her twice so far and without a doubt would take her again. BEST PROFESSOR AT UWB

I could only choose 3 tags, but she's also There For You, gives Amazing Lectures, and I Would Take Again. This is my second class with Alaron and she is the BEST biology professor I've had! I've had her for both BBIO 360 and BBIO 380. She's GREAT! She explains things in a very simple and memorable way. NEVER feel afraid to ask a question with her!

Makes it easier for you to understand things by putting herself into a biology model.  Easy grader on papers. Open-minded exam questions. Gives out points if you give logical reasons for your answers even if it's wrong.
She's awesome as a professor.  She's helpful, she will explain in detail, she's amazing.

Best science teacher I've ever had! She explains over and over until you get it, and she enjoys it. She gives lots of assignments but somehow they're all fun if you put your head into the class and what she's teaching. Her tests are clever and she gets creative in a good way on her test questions, so aside from studying, you'll have to use ur head.

Great professor! Fun and relatively easy.  Tougher exams but has review sessions which I highly recommend. I didn't use my textbook once.  Just be sure to go to class every day because she likes to give in class assignments.

Outstanding instructor. Really knows her stuff, very clear on assignments, interesting lectures, and extremely helpful, gives study sessions before exams. If you wanna learn, take class with Alaron. My favorite biology instructor on campus.

Online class is very manageable and respectful of your time while still teaching the material. Material is a bit outdated, however there are still things to learn. Didn't grade throughout the course. Easy diversity credit.

Prof: nice, interesting, articulate.

Class: individual presentations at the beginning, then group discussions. didn't do any lectures.

HW: readings, preparing for your presentation, and the final was a group oral exam.

I left the class wishing she did lectures. I wanted to hear her speak on important subjects using her expertise

Easiest class in my life, easier than middle school. Basically a GPA booster with a diversity credit. As long as you can write an essay once every 3 weeks and google news events you're getting a 100%. Genuinely doesn't care if you're in the zoom class except for the conference date.

reviews.comment: Freest class ever, take it if you need a GPA booster
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Her class is pretty easy and informational too, gives a lot of good insight on critical diversity and she is very well versed in the subject so if you want to learn more about it, talk to her! Class is on zoom but has a lot of reading but it's valuable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Inspirational

reviews.comment: This is the easiest class you'll take. If you want an easy 4.0 take her class! This class was synchronous online. Every class a group presented a discussion and then the professor would elaborate. It was fun and no pressure. The assignment every week is to write 4-5 sentences!! There's one group project and a final paper. Easy 4.0

I wouldn't recommend this class to someone, unless you are interested in equity in education. I would say the class is an easy A but very misleading at times. I could go into depth about how the syllabus can be misleading but I don't have enough space. kind of a joke of a class and kind of reminds me of an elective class in high school.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Cannot put into words how easy this class was, it was so easy its existence was forgettable from week to week. Discussions were easy yet informative, Quizzes were short yet interesting. If you need the credit, take her class. If you need a GPA boost, take her class. You are doing yourself a favor by joining her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: EDUC 205 is the freest class ever. Super easy class with interesting topics.

TAKE B EDUC 205!!!!!!! It is absolutely the easiest 5 credit class I've ever taken, the workload was very light consisting of a couple of assignments every now and then. On top of the easy workload, Prof. Merchant is a very kind and understanding person as she makes exceptions for deadlines if you can't get your assignments in on time 10/10 class
You can tell that she really cares about her work and the education of her students. Will definitely take a class taught by her again.
Natasha is amazing. I would love to take another class from her! She does give pop quizzes as well as she really grades on participation. This class was full of group projects and they were fun! :)
If you spend at least 10-30 minutes reading the chapter before class, you will get full credit on the quizzes. If you can somewhat be engaged in the class, it should be no problem to get an A.

Prior to this class I didn't know much, but the book she used and the way she explained topics was really eye-opening and intriguing. She is super friendly and approachable and is always willing to help.
Excellent teacher. Reading due every class. If you don't do the readings, you won't do well.

She was great! Very helpful, she reached out to me at the beginning of the quarter and got the opportunity to help with some of the classes. She is very helpful. I met with her during office hours and she helped me with everything I needed clarification on. CBLR was great too! I got a 4.0 in her class, discussions were good. TAKE HER for sure!
Take her!

I like having teachers like her who genuinely care about what they teach, she really helped us discover and learn how and what justice can look like in an environmental setting and on topics on local pollutions, and gentrification. Was a good basic course nothing difficult at all really and I walked away with learning more

Graded harshly for what is supposed to be an elective discussion-based class. Many of us are bio majors, and tell me why I did better in stem classes like physics. Grading is picky. There must be more assignments and not rely on three things. She has favorites, it is based on whether you are interested in what she is and if you work with her.
This class was the most frustrating class that i have taken in my years of school i would stay far away from this course if i were you guys.

I would stay far away from this course at the University Of Washington Bothell campus this course was the most frustrating and annoying course that i have taken. In my four years of being a student she was super complicated and does not respond right away with email she will literally take the whole week to respond i would give this class a 1/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Malone is kind, smart, accommodating, and fair. Her enthusiasm for Environmental Justice paired with fun activities each class makes everything way more interesting. She doesn't force people to participate in this discussion heavy class. She always relates student answers back to the topic and doesn't berate you for getting anything wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is nice but damn this class was HARD. It's a lot of material and a lot of busy work, but she grades in a way that is rather forgiving on students' end.
avoid her, ive never failed a class and this is one of the worst experiences I've had with a professor.

Mrs. Malone is such a sweetheart!  Truly cares about her students, and makes the sewing class super fun!!  Will definitely be taking her again ASAP.  No homework, no textbook, you show up to class with materials (this class was a tad expensive but she'll give you fabric if you ask), and you do all your work in class.

Knowledgeable teacher who is also really caring and compassionate. There is a lot of busy work for an intro class but the way that she teaches it makes it feel like it's not as hard as it was before. Very clear about assessment and grading, and always there to help you as well.

Environmental Justice is pretty heavy material but Dr. Malone makes it empowering and not just depressing. Shes clear about expectations and holds you to them but she is fair! I'm definitely taking her again.

This professor is very confusing with her coursework and syllabus. I can't understand what we're even supposed to work on. But she is quite understanding and is an easy grader. Group work is expected for the whole quarter. She is also the networking goat. You'll gain invaluable real life experience if you do extra credit.

This teacher has the worst layout of a class i have ever seen in my life. There is no clear schedule and often has random projects due within days that are not listed in the syllabus. Heavy group work based assignments. If you want to save your sanity avoid her, unless you want to spend hours every week trying to figure out what it is she wants.
networking goat, replies to emails within minutes, super chill and loves teaching real world skills rather than textbook skills. hates having students pay for a textbook so she doesn't use one
she responds instantly, grading is quick and straightforward, she is awesome
so much extra credit and networking opportunities

It's kind of like her or hate her, depending on whether or not you like group work. Stay on top of deadlines she'll accept late work but not after 48 hours after the posted deadline. Good: a. while she taught from a textbook she didn't make you buy it b. lots of extra credit if you get stuck with a bad group c. knowledgeable and great guests.

While she is a great teacher, knows what shes talking about, and gives MANY amazing opportunities and connections, the class is just very unorganized. Half of the time I didn't even know if the class was online or in-person. Be ready for a group that you have to do work with every week, and if u have a bad group ur cooked. LOT's of extra credit!

She gives good feedback but you have to show up to team meetings or you won't do well. If you put in the work, you'll give an A but make sure you meet the deadlines she'll accept late work but not after 48 hours.

this class isn't about business writing, it's about her own organization and you need to make free promotional material for her to get a good grade. if you're willing to be a dog and learn nothing you can get a 4.0
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: disorganized and kinda infuriating :l

Take her for business law, not for business writing. 

Pros:
Lots of opportunities for training, networking and obtaining real life experience. 

Cons:
You won't actually be doing business writing. Most of the course is about the organization the professor is affiliated with, and all the assignments are busywork. Course is confuising, disorganized.

I enjoyed Laura's class, but her coursework is very unorganized. Her assignments themselves were beneficial and relevant to the course material; they helped me learn a lot. There were two exams, each worth 200 points, but the majority of the work was completed within teams weekly. She also gave many opportunities for extra credit, which was useful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Her energy was great but felt disorganized. Changes due dates and schedules a lot so be on your toes. Work itself was quite easy and Westlaw was good. Advocate for yourself if you don't have a good group because it's a lot of teamwork. She is passionate and loves to talk about real life scenarios but gets off track easily. Do the extra credit!

Wonderful professor, with good work you can get a really good grade. Clear guidelines, tons of extra credit. You can use AI but with care as it will sometimes get the cases wrong. Very Westlaw focused. Loves to joke around and try to make class fun. At least 10% of each class were her using personal life examples to teach law. 10/10 wld take again.

She likes to use Westlaw. You can't use AI and do well in her class because the AI will give you hallucinated cases but she teaches helpful life skills. You get to meet judges and lawyers in her class and she's a great source of information. Make sure to do the practice quizzes and youll do ok on exams

If you don't like group projects stay away but she'll help you out if your team is struggling. Also gives lots of practical job networking and professional development opportunities like professional certifications in her class and professional conferences and job networking fonners

Lots of team projects with assigned teams but she offers lots of extra credit. Responsive. It was nice to not need to buy a textbook. She had a lot of great guest speakers and we got to watch court hearings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Just come to class and participate in the group discussion and your good. A lot of extra credit opportunities so no need to stress. Just one presentation you do in front of the class. Honestly, the chillest prof at UWB. Just go to class and participate during group discussions.
You can use AI in her class but she makes you show your edits. Lots of group work. Fast at responding to emails. Chill. She got therapy dogs for our class.

I recommend coming to her office hours. She gives lots of extra credit opportunities and is very nice. I liked not having to buy a textbook in her class. Honestly one of the easiest professors if you are willing to do the work. Make sure to take notes when she does the quizzes cause the quizzes are like the exams

There's lots of group project work. If you don't like working as a team, don't take. If you do and want work experience and industry connections take. People complaining about disorganization need to learn to read instructions. She organizes the due dates by modules so can understand why youd be confused if you dont come to class or pay attention.
THE WORST PROFESSOR FOR 307 DO NOT TAKE , DISORGANIZED SYLLABUS ON TOP OF THAT SHE IS THE WORST GRADER

Professor Umetsu is great. The class is heavy on group work but the work assigned in the quarter as a whole is not too difficult. The syllabus and canvas is very disorganized and it's hard to keep track of all assignments so make sure to mark down due dates for things often.

Nice and lenient professor, I recommend her. She gives out a lot of extra credit opportunities so be sure make use of that. A majority of the assignments are done in groups which makes it less work. Only problem I had was that her canvas was very unorganized, but overall, she's a great professor that truly cares about her students.

90% of the assignments in this class were group assignments, which I didn't love. It made completing work much more stressful and confusing. I feel like the course could have been structured better. But, there was no textbook required and the professor was super nice. There is just one main project and a midterm and final exam.

Do the practice quizzes. The exams are almost identical to the practice quizzes. Come to class or make sure to message your group if you miss class or you won't get credit for weekly group assignments. Low key, fun class. She's responsive to emails.

she is very nice. but this class is so unorganized. the most stress and ambiguity ive ever faced in a college class. most of the time nobody in the class knew what was going on or expected etc. if at all possible, i would recommend taking a different professor for 307. if you must take her, i suppose you can survive but be prepared for uncertainty

If you can't handle conversations on diversity and inclusion or hate team projects, this isn't for you. Lots of mini assignments leading up to the big one so you can still do well. If you procrastinate, I can see how this class would be stressful. Do the work, get early feedback for your midterm memo, do some extra credit, and you'll get an A.

Honestly one of the easiest profs as long as you put the work in. Learned a lot. If you have trouble with your team, let her know early and she will intervene and help you out there. If you're absent, be sure to keep in touch with your team because she dedicates class time to teamwork. Don't take if you can't handle uncomfortable convos on equity.

Answers emails right away. You get out of this class what you put into it. If you don't like group projects, stay away. Great guest speakers. Not everyone is up for a DEI centered communications class. But she made it clear on the first day this was the case. Easy class. Lots of people procrastinated in some groups and then panicked at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Assignments are easy, midterm presentation easy, final project would be easy if it wasn't a group project.

Those that rate her a 1 on here are upset they had to actually do work in a class.

She is so unorganized and gives out so much busy work. More than half the time, her assignments do not correlate with the curriculum. Its a business writing class but we touched on Law more than anything.

DO NOT TAKE HER! She is very unorganized, goes back on her word, & springs up assignments last minute. Be prepared to do 5-8 assignments a week that have nothing to do with the course curriculum. The only thing I learned was how to write an email, everything else was busywork or for the group project that made no sense.

I enjoyed professor Umetsu's class. If you are having issues with your group, she will help out but only if you tell her early on. Lots of group work but if you stay on top of it, you should be fine. Lots of extra credit as well. I learned a lot from the different speakers we had.

If you hate group projects, this course isn't for you. There's lots of assignments, but she also gives you great feedback and the assignments aren't that hard. You need to show up for team meetings and stay on top of your deadlines and you'll do well.

Really caring and inspirational. Learned a lot of practical writing skills I use in my job. Answers emails promptly. Great mentorship opportunities through her class taught like an internship. Easy grader but make sure to communicate + contribute to group projects if you have to miss class because she uses the last hour to work with your teams.

I owe my career to Professor Umetsu. I went through some medical issues that forced me to suddenly withdraw as a student. Even when I wasn't her student anymore, she helped me through the documentation appeals process to help me reenroll and graduate. Even after I graduated, she helped me network/recommend me to the job and career I have today.

Great class. Learned more than any other course ever taken. Fast feedback turnaround, practical writing skills I use for work every day. She wrote a letter of reference for my dream internship this summer. This wasn't part of the class but she also helped me with reviewing & revising a cover letter for this letter of reference that got me the job.

If you don't have time for an internship or team work, then this class isn't for you, because she puts you to work for an actual client. However, she guides your team through every step of the way, and if you don't have any internship experience then great. Great guest speakers. We got to meet/interview a retired Starbucks president. Easy grader.

Really caring prof. I was going through one of the worst times of my life and she reached out and gave me the encouragement I needed. When I emailed, she always responded almost immediately with a clear answer. her class gave us an internship experience and she wrote me a great letter of recommendation. Great guest speakers.

Do all the work, show up to class, and you should do fine. Great networking opportunities through amazing guest speakers like a retired Starbucks president we got to meet and interview. She really goes the extra mile to make sure questions get answered and we get good feedback.
She's great. I love listening to her guest speakers. I learned a lot. You need to be prepared to do the work and be ok with group projects.
She doesn't care about students and her grading sucks.

Instructor's teaching skills are lacking, and her grading is subpar, with minimal feedback. Her expectation is confusing because she is unorganized which makes everything worse. I would give 10/10 for the class but the teacher 0/10.

She's just okay. Personally, I think she does a bit too much of everything. Too much homework, she focuses more on outside issues when the class is supposed to be business-related writing. For a writing class, the homework was A LOT. It's easy but it's way too much. I would say take the class if you have no other choice left.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I loved this class! Most of the work you do is completed in class with your group. The community engagement aspect was fulfilling. Very easy.

This is an amazing professor but you have to be ready to put the work in. Lots of papers due and a presentation at the end of the quarter. She gives great feedback and expects you to implement that into the rest of the assignments. She is super sweet and grades quick. No text book needed but the research you conduct will equal the time spent well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Laura is a very nice and understanding professor. There are a lot of assignments but she grades fair so if you do the work youll earn a good grade.

It has been an honor so far to be in professor Umetsu's class. As a lawyer, mother of a toddler, and UW professor, she has her hands full yet, she delivers the best lectures and teaching methods. I have learned so much already in the class about business writing and am eager to learn more. I look forward to every one of her classes.

A very fun professor. She is passionate about what she teaches and it shows. The work isn't bad, just some writing and a fairly large midterm presentation and final paper. The guest speakers are a great part of the class, lots to learn from them and you don't have to do anything that class, just submit a couple questions for them.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: So when I first took this class I was intimidated because I heard that she was tough (with 30 pages for the midterm). It turns out that she doesn't make you write a paper for the midterm, just a presentation, and she gives pretty good feedback. Easy A, though you have to write each week. She also has a really good business network/guest speakers.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I had Umetsu for my negotiations class. She had an assignment every week so as long as you did the work you'll pass with a decent grade. She had the best guest speakers I've ever had for a business class and she knows her stuff. I recommend all friends to her.

Laura is a great professor. She assigns lots of homework, but grades fairly yet strictly. She grades super fast and responds to emails quickly. Attendance is taken every class. You probably won't get a shining grade from her but her class is worth it!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Honestly, if you're generally unmotivated like most students at UWB, you won't necessarily do well in this class. However, if you do work hard in this class, you will be rewarded. This is most definitely not an easy 'A', but she's definitely one of the best professors at this campus. Study regularly and do weekly assignments with reliable people.

Ok so if you take this class amd hate homework and participation you probably wont do well but if youre bad at taking tests like me and dont mind doing an assignment each week then take this class because she grades participation and extra crdit opportunities. Fun lectures and learned a lot. She also is very flexible with test times.

She is one of my favorite professors of all time. She cares about students, gives us lots of assignments which some don't like but I did because I'm bad at taking tests and it doesnt make the whole grade depend on a test. Entertaining lectures and she brings food.

At first, I was intimidated by the class but after taking the first exam (and finding out what she expects from you) it's not too bad. She is always filled with entertaining case stories and the homework and quizzed are not too hard too. Not to mention, the Exams are very similar to the quizzes. I took her for Business Law. Awesome Professor.
Amazing teacher. Not too tough of a grader, and is very intelligent. Lots of case studies and group work
She's chill. Very easy grader but you gotta write long papers. I got a 3.8.

In the first week, she handed out 4 case reviews and expected so much. I lost points with the first assignments. I went to her office hours and really showed what she was looking for and how to achieve that. By the end of the quarter, she became one of my favorite. Be prepared to write a lot. 10 pages for the midterm and like 30 for the final
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS
