reviews.comment: Professor Umetsu is my favorite professor of all time.  What's crazy is that, it didn't start out that way.  Initially, I found her course to be daunting and overwhelming.  But Professor inspired me to go beyond my bounds and to achieve in ways I never thought I could.  I gained so much from her course.  She really cares and is a great human being.

She brought us tortes on the day we studied torts. I still think about this.... Anyways, she really wants to see you succeed, and is more than happy to help you if you are stuck. Exams can be tricky, but she left ours open book and note. She's one of my favorite professors and her accent slips always crack me up... take her class if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor who cares a lot about her students.  A lot of assignments, but she herself is a hard worker helping each student succeed.  She's a fair grader, and very smart. I learned a lot in her class.

Good teacher. Lots of writing, but not surprising for writing class. Only concern is I procrastinate and she expects you to stay on top of deadlines. Really helpful feedback, laid back and fun class. Fair grader. Really cares about students.

Very driven. Probably one of the most practical hands on class I've taken so far. She introduced us to Dan Price, which was really amazing. She gives really good feedback in writing and really wants us to succeed. Talented teacher, cares about students, really takes time to make sure you improve  your writing.

Don't take this class if you want an easy A because she makes you work really hard for your grade. She gives you chances for revising, though so half the class are getting As. Teaches in a relaxed and fun atmosphere in the class, and she had an amazing field trip at the end of the quarter. She also fed us breakfast.

Good teacher. Could be more clear in grading but got better. Really useful classbut you will work hard. Gives extra credit. Midterm and final challenging but she gives good feed back and extra credit so of you flunk its your fault.

She is an attorney, so the class is VERY law intense. She lightens up as the quarter goes. She doesn't grade harshly, but the work she assigns is very time consuming.  She is very nice and easy to talk to. She wants to help students succeed. This was her first quarter teaching, so I think she's got a lot to learn and work out the kinks.

Laura is a pretty good teacher, but it was her first quarter teaching which made it difficult on the students. She started off assigning a lot of homework but then slowed down on the homework. She wants things done her way all the time, but it's always unclear what she wants. When you don't do it her way, he docks points. Pretty easy grader though.

Not an easy A. But very helpful material. Could be clearer in her assignments, but always emails back really quick if you have questions. I'm surprised that she'll sometimes email back within 3 minutes of getting an email sent really late at night. Tough midterm/final but you will learn sometime useful. Brings breakfast and tells funny jokes.

Laura is very nice, but her class is very difficult. Her mid-term and final is very tough and the instructions were often changing or unclear. I feel like her daily writing assignments were more useful than her research projects. She grades fairly and gives goodfeed back. Overall this class is very challenging but should prove to be useful later on

I'm going to save the trouble for many of you students and tell you to not EVER take this professor. I had to drop her class because she had turned a business writing class strictly into a law class. She's an attorney herself and will expect you to write an overload amount of essays on court cases and case laws due the next class session.
She is very nice and wants students to succeed. I would take her class again.

Professor Price has been my favorite professor I have had in my academic career. She is passionate, caring, and inspiring. Anatomy and Physiology is not an easy class but she makes it so fun. Her teaching style and thought-out labs made class easier to understand. Lecture-heavy but they are amazing.

course extremely content-heavy, but taught very well. weekly quizzes to help keep up w material. super fun labs. great lecturer and lab prof. very enthusiastic & wants everyone to succeed. one of the best & my fav professors @ UWB. would gladly take her again & highly recommend. course content is hard but she excels in teaching. greatly enjoyed.

Honestly a great professor. Lectures can get a little boring, but the content is interesting and she is passionate about it. Quizzes, homework, and exams are all well organized and you will know what will be covered. Group project was kind of meh, more like a side mission to learn something on your own and teach the class on it. Had fun making it.

Lectures are excellent and she is knowledgeable and passionate.Grading is clear and fair.Weekly quizzes were frustrating as it took me a while to cement info, but 1 was dropped.wish lab material weren't on the assessments; it was too much. I also thought a group project AND final exam were too much, but she graded easily on vodcasts.extra credit!!

Dr. Price is a great professor, she really knows her stuff! Helpful during lab and lectures well. Class is content heavy and requires a lot of studying/memorization. She is a fair grader though. 2 exams, weekly quizzes, assignments here and there and a group project. Attend lectures for participation points, it's easy to fall behind!

Amazing professor! one of the best professors I had at UWB. The class itself was content-heavy, there were weekly quizzes to help you keep up with materials so you don't overwhelm during exams. Two exams and assignments here and there. Labs were helpful too but needed a lot of work to complete. She is full of energy and wants everyone to succeed.

I absolutely love her!! She is the best college Professor I have ever taken! Shes enthusiastic, fair, organized, isnt a knit picker grader & shes nice. 2 exams non cumulative. 1 quiz every week on lectures. I didnt use the book because her lectures and slides were sufficient. Shes amazing!!! A&P is a hard class but she makes it worth it. Take her!

Dr. Price is easily one of the best professors I've ever had. She is extremely intelligent, and knows how to teach the material well. This class was extremely content heavy but she made it enjoyable and digestible. Her lectures are great and she is very kind. Please take her classes! You won't regret it.

Dr Price is FULL of energy. She makes her lectures interesting and easy to follow. Exams are fairly tough. I didn't read the book but I THOROUGHLY went through her study guides for exams. Used her powerpoints for it. About 2 quizzes a week. Very accessible and wants ALL of her students to succeed.

I love her! I had a few things happen so I had to miss class, but she is very passionate. She just wants you to learn and like the material. She will help and is very understanding. I would definitely take again. Beware, there is a lot of material though. Memorization is required.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Price was an amazing professor for both lab and lecture. She was able to tie the two classes together effectively and it showed through the high class averages on exams. She made you think (the material isn't the easiest to begin with) but she also helped you understand and connect it to broader ideas. One of my favorite professors by far.

She simply is the best! Everything about her class is very organized! On top of that, she works hard on grading assignments and exams on her own. She is NOT a mean grader either so you don't have to be afraid of losing points from stupid little mistakes. Her exams are very clear. I truly learned the material instead of memorizing it for only exams
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Lots of material to be covered, her lectures aren't the clearest. Everything is fair game, no lab practical though! Weekly quizzes and 3 exams.

Amazing teacher! It was her first quarter teaching at UWB and her syllabus was intimidating at first (she even states that everything is fair game in the book,labs, and lectures on her exam but she made it easy on us). I really liked how enthusiastic she was about her teaching, knowledgeable and was very nice and available to help her students.

Dr. Lee is one of the best education professors at UWB. I took every course she offered. She is not a “tough grader” - rather thorough and honest. She is caring, communicative, and values building relationships with her students. I continue to reference my notes from her courses as a graduate student. You earn the grade you deserve in her courses.

Professor Lee is a great teacher who cares. Class is pretty fun and if you go to class, you will have barely any homework to do over the quarter. When you do the homework make sure to read the assignment instructions like 3 times though because there are a few key things that she grades on so be careful of that. Do everything the rubric says!!
She grades based on a few key things, but her grading is tough. There's a lot of reading, and if you miss even one class, you lose points, which can impact your final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Uh she is okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Lee is fantastic! She makes the class very interesting and engaging. She is very structured and has everything planned out. She can be an intense grader but gives good feedback on what you need to change for your final.

This is my second class with Professor Lee. She's super caring and personable with students. You can tell she has a deep understanding of the content she teaches. Assignments are super reasonable and help you understand the content-there's no busy work. I hope to teach as smoothly as she does!

I had Nathanie for both BEDUC 300 and BEDUC 402, she was great! Super nice and made the effort to lecture in an interesting and clear way. She also integrated hands on projects and breaks in class so that we wouldn't just be sitting and watching lecture for 2 hours. Great and very kind Educator!

I'm a health studies major and if you need a 300-level class take this one because it's very easygoing and fun. The professor is very kind and makes the class active. If you like group discussions and easy assignments this is it.

Professor Lee was great! Her lectures and readings were very interesting and tied directly to what we were learning. There were few assignments overall but the end of the quarter stacked up fast! Participation matters because there is an exit ticket each day. There is also a lot of group discussion so be prepared when you come to class!

Professor Lee was a wonderful instructor! Her class was very well organized and the instructions to every assignment were clear. There was a lot of group work, but not a lot of group participation which was the only downside to this class. I learned a lot that I will use in my future career as an educator and I hope that I can take another class.

Very knowledgeable about subjects and has great care for her students. Lectures were long but she made them interesting and engaging. Has 2 group projects along with 2 exams where you get unlimited tries on the multiple choice part. Not a super tough grader but def be ready for noone in class to get full marks on a lot of the big assigments

This professor refuses to give out good grades. She'll take away points for no reason. She yaps for the entire class and then sends you home with assignments and exams that take hours upon hours to complete. Do not recommend.

This was was very hard and heavy on math, but Gulru was a beyond amazing professor! She was extremely caring and gave us every opportunity she could to succeed. Exams are take home and multiple attempts! There was a group project but it was not complicated. If you can take this class with her, do it! She's so passionate about her job

Her class is hybrid meaning half zoom and half asynchronous with fantastic pre-recorded videos. Rather than hw she gives weekly quizzes BUT there is no time limit and unlimited attempts and she responds VERY quickly to emails so an A is no problem. Also you don't need the textbook.

Her tests are tough. You'll want to make sure you have an excel spreadsheet with all the computations you'll need. Her lecture slides are very helpful and detailed and she brings in plenty of supply chain professionals to talk to the class.

You'll have 1 group throughout the quarter for multiple projects, including visiting a company to document and present its daily operations. If you go to her lectures, pay attention, and take good notes, you'll do just fine. Lots of example problems in class and in homework to prepare you for tests(1 page of notes). Her explanations are very clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Such a sweet teacher. She is happy to help you. Lectures may be a little long but she is a very fair grader. I thought I bombed the final but she rounded up my GPA and I got higher than i was expecting. Homework is nice because it is due at the end of the quarter, so you can do it the very last second and be fine. She lets you have notes for tests

Professor Gülru is on the most caring professors I had. She actually wants you to succeed. Sometimes she can ramble excessively during lecture. But if you ask questions, you will be happy to clarify the material. Not the most interesting class, but she will always be there to help

unorganized but fair grader. Exams are 70% class based and maybe 25% from homeworks. Her class practice assignments are what's going to be on there but altered. uses Pearson, I do not recommend buying the textbook, she'll teach it through--I could have saved like 60 bucks!
Dont be fooled by her sweet personality. Her exams were tricky and tough. Worst part is that she doesnt prepare you for them.

I really like Gulru. Her lectures are lengthy and broad. Sometimes she explains the material strange but she is willing to help students during offfice hours. Ask ask ask questions in class if youre confused! Shes very nice and supportive. Major downfall is that her lectures and activities hardly prepares you for her exams. They were tough
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's very passionate about games and very chill, but the lectures can get slow and insignificant to the point where you don't lose much by not attending. You basically self study the whole quarter as you make your game. However, grading is easy and I learned a lot. Workload is highly dependent on your game's concept and complexity.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Great teacher. The class will be status/checkpoints working on a final full application for a mobile device throughout the course.

The course is graded very nicely, as long as you meet the requirements generally you'll be good, at least that was my experience.

The teacher is hard to reach outside of class, response times are usually beyond 24h.
U gotta work 4 ur grade.

I LOOOVE him! I was honestly super nervous at the beginning of the quarter because of the reviews I saw and how exams take up 65% of the grade! But thankfully, it's not that bad at all. He's friendly, engaging, and knows what he's doing. He offers practice exams for the exams and once you successfully complete those, you're pretty much set to pass!

The material is difficult. The lectures don't help much. Most learning is trial and error or acquired from researching the algorithms online. Hansel definitely cares about his students and their success and despite a strict policy laid out, can be very flexible when the situation warrants it. Good professor, maybe not the best class for him.

Nice guy and gives great career tips, but not a very great instructor. Will loop around a topic for way too long to the point where youll feel lost unless you actively participate. Not much useful content to gain during lectures that will help with HW. HWs are super easy, exams are way more difficult than any HW. Take another professor if you can.

His lectures were sub-par because he doesn't really explain much. He just reads from his slides and gives you lots of links. Homework was manageable and only a few felt like a total waste of time. I was completely blindsided by the exams which had near-impossible time constraints while counting for 50% of your overall grade. Wouldn't take him again

He is very good professor who cares about his students' success, he is good at explaining things clearly and respect everyone. He can make this course goes in a relaxed way. His advise is practical and useful. I think he is a very professional and decent professor I ever met.

Hansel is a very good teacher. Going into the class, he expects you know certain things such as linked structures, trees, and Big-O but he was happy to modify the class structure to the pace of the students since a majority came in without this knowledge. He talks a lot about industry since hes a manager at Amazon and gives interview questions.

Really excellent professor! He taught the class very well, at it was clear that he knew the material backwards and forwards, he was always willing to answer questions, and very reasonable when it came to homework. I appreciated his willingness to help students individually, and would definitely take another class from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Good class. Attendance not mandatory, so if you know your stuff you don't need to go - but would recommend going anyway. No group projects, teaching style of asking questions rather than lecturing. Be prepared to write code by hand on test. Sample exams are great practice for the test, be able to do by hand from memory and you'll be fine.

He was one of the best at explaining concepts and giving alternative examples to obj-o questions. However, he did not know C++ (req class lang for hw) and he only taught 25% of class time. Easily distracted by questions relevant to one person. Did not treat student body like they were at the graduate level.

This class was poorly time managed, and a lot of time was wasted justifying difficult tests or discussing secondary topics. You will be expected to know all the lecture material not covered in class. Resources are first page Google hits and no textbook (one is recommended). He will meet you outside of class, but has no reliable office hours.
Great instructor! Explains things in much more detail that other professors didn't, which helped explain a lot of topics!

He's a tough professor who has no office hours and he's generally unresponsive to emails that you send to him. The assignments he gives are not at all well related to the material he's teaching. Outside help for his class is nonexistent in school, with the exception of a couple of tutors.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: He knows his stuff and seems like he could be a decent professor, but he was unprepared for this class and as a result it was a pretty negative experience. Exams are 65% of your grade and are really tough. Our first exam was chock full of what felt like trick questions, but this improved slightly on the next two exams. Will work with you, at least.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: He is a God among men of programmers. Bow before your master! In all reality, he does work for Microsoft so his ability to meet you after class is limited but he manages to answers as many questions as he can. If you plan to take any of his classes, make friends in the class. This is a good thing to do in any class.
He is a amazing teacher, he bring a lot of real world experience

Hansel Ong is a great CSS professor. I have taken other CSS classes and nobody comes close to how Professor Ong teaches. He genuinely cares about his students and has real-life experience in programming. He does have PowerPoints in class but also does work on the whiteboard and gives many examples on how things work. I would take him again.

The homework assignment topics are usually taught after it is due which is really unorganized on his part. Professor Ong reads off his power points during lecture, I wish he would have explained things in more detail and the small things about css as well. Graading can be inconsistent due to his grader.

Professor Ong has a clear rubric for assignments, but they require a lot of skills that aren't learned in class. Multiple choice section of tests is really tricky, as are "find the error" sections. Class is enjoyable, and he gives a lot of great career advice. I kind of hated my life this quarter with the assignments, though. CS is not for me.
Don't have much office hours. Didn't provide much help to beginners.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: BEST COMP SCI TEACHER EVER!!! 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 3 But for real, he is awesome. Will give great career advice during class.

This class was awesome because of how hands-on it was - I learned the most from the labs, which were quite a bit of work. A lot of really important stuff is covered in the lectures, and while her accent makes it harder to understand her, she explains things in pretty simple terms which helps.

The course was lecture heavy and super dense in terms of topic load but Oh is a very kind professor who remembered past students and was very responsive when I emailed with code issues. The midterm was incredibly difficult (took me 8 hours to complete) and I got a pretty low score but she let us do extra credit and I ended up with over 100% on it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the best professors in the Geography department
Very nice professor, lectures are very useful so it is important to show up

Great person, very funny, cares about her students. Not the best lecturer, course materials are sub-par at best sometimes. Nonetheless, cares a lot about your development and is the sweetest lady ever. Her classes are pretty easy so if you want to you can 4.0 her classes.

Professor Oh is one of the nicest graders you can meet in the geography department. She is lenient and respectable. She speaks very well, and her labs are easy to understand. Her teaching style includes many in-class activities that help with labs and slides for lectures, with up to five labs and two important exams. She is very funny as well.

Gunwa is a very funny woman and would be a great person to socialize with, but this does not translate to her instruction. She is not a good lecturer. Essentially, she will just read from the powerpoint and her speech is quite difficult to understand. This makes it a struggle to stay awake through each class and nothing is recorded.
Her English might not be native, she still tries really hard to offer a good class. She also cares a lot about her students. Go see her after school for questions. She is the nicest.

She is very sweet and kind, but the class is not great. There are weekly quizzes, and you don't learn everything you need to in order to do well. You have do do a lot of outside research in order to answer some of the questions. You don't really need to go to class cause the lectures aren't helpful anyway. Lab sections are great though.

If you do not show up in person, you will not have the information required for the weekly quizzes. Modules are provided and quizzes are open note but none of the important information for the quizzes are in the resources given. Teacher is nice. Responses on quizzes tell you to look for resources that do not exist.

A lot of people stopped showing up for class halfway, and I think that made her a bit more comfortable as she did admit to being shy. She has been amazing, understanding of different student's situations, and I really hope to take more classes with her. The labs were very well laid out and easy to follow. The readings are probably not necessary :)
She's very kind but her lecture is very hard to understand. Midway through the quarter a lot of my classmates gave up attending lectures and found it more helpful to read powerpoint.

I can tell this prof cares a lot, but for some reason she is incapable of designing reasonable assignments and projects. This is the worst professor I have had in my 4 years at UW (geog495, geog465). The grading is reasonable but the work is infuriating as it is clearly not well thought out. Stay as far away from this professor as possible.

Professor Oh is very knowledgable about her field and it is shown. Always gives clear answer when asked, and is very kind and understanding to her students. The class itself was lab heavy, but the instructions given were clear and the syllabus had all the information that you need about the class. One of the best professor I've had. Will take again
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is a very soft spoken professor who knows a lot about her field. She can have problems at times speaking in English or inspiring her students but she is very helpful when you get a chance to speak with her. The course was super easy at first, with most of the work being done in the final weeks of the class.

Overall, Professor Oh is very sweet and kind. She often provides decent lectures that provide lots of useful information for your labs and homework assignments. She is very responsive to emails and is very approachable for extra help. Beginning of the quarter focuses more on concepts, while the end focuses heavily on coding. Favorite GIS course.

Very soft spoken, so sit in the front of class. Syllabus is very clear, easy to see what you'll be graded on. Overall, I enjoyed 465, learned a lot of useful stuff (SQL, HTML/CSS). Labs weren't too difficult- I'd say no more than 3 or 4 hours for each. Only thing is course is starts slow and speeds up so keep up and don't fall behind

Although shes a respected teacher, it is extremely difficult to learn in her class. Most of the work is labs which consist of making maps using ArcGIS. There is minimal explanation on how to actually use the software. You are expected to learn yourself. Accent is also heavy which makes it difficult to understand lectures. Hard grader as well.
Terrible professor I have ever seen. Not clear on the instructions. Avoid her at all cost!

Extremely Chill Professor. Straight forward, organized, and knowledgable. One of the best professors ive taken at UWB. His assignment criteria is straightforward. There isn't anything bad about this proff.

This class is the easiest 370 on campus, and you will get an A, but it is a bit of a waste of time as you won't really learn much. Class was routinely cut an hour short. Osama is really nice and insanely helpful as he does this for a living for big companies, it's just a bit too easy. Would recommend if taken with hard classes. No midterm or final!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very easy class with short lectures, the topics in the class are not hard to understand and are stuff you pick up in the workplace anyways so no point in sweating about it
Some light individual and group work. About 1-2 hours of work max per week. 1 hour of lecture per week. He is a pretty fun guy. Some stories he told are pretty interesting.

(CSS370) May Allah bless this man most graciously ameen. Best prof I have taken at UWB, doesn't waste time with long lectures or assignments. Grading is as straightforward as it gets. Focuses on applicability from his job at a big FAANG company
He's a great professor and quite knowledgeable about software engineering, definitely take him if you get the chance!
Easy A not the best in terms of teaching the content but it is easily picked up when you work. If you really want to learn its also not a hard course just read the lectures.

Professor Hamdan is a wonderful professor that does a great job teaching CSS 370 by applying his relevant knowledge in the tech industry and exposing its realities based on his experience towards its students. Not many professors for 370 have a background like him, so take him and you won't regret it!

*Actually for CSS370*
Appriciate not having to go to class and basically buy in my 5 credits with little effort. All his material is stolen from another professor and doesn't set up his Canvas correctly. Lectures are ~30 mins long reiterating the stolen readings.
Only take if you just want the credits and don't want to learn anything.
Easy exams, not a heavy class for core. Highly recommended

Osama is a awesome professor! super laid back and chill. Works in the field (microsoft and google) while being a adjunct professor so he uses real life scenarios in his explanations. His lectures are really easy to follow and understand. Tests are easy and he helps you get prepared for them. Easy homework assignments. A real gem at UWB!
THE BEST TEACHER I WILL definitely take this class again

Professor Oh seems like a great guy, but I have not enjoyed his class. It's very lecture heavy with limited/no slides, which can be really hard to follow. He frequently asks questions of the class where no one is clear what he's asking for -- after 5 or 6 attempts he'll finally tell us the "answer", which isn't what he asked for at all...

This is not at easy class. But Dr. Oh is a really good teacher. He is a very easy grader when it comes to homework, make sure you study hard on the midterm and final. Hes a really nice, laid back and funny guy. Only problem Ive had was he speaks with a REALLY thick Korean accent and sometimes it might be hard to understand what hes saying.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Oh is a great teacher but hard to understand sometimes. I had never taken a business class before 210 and I enjoyed it. It did feel a little weird if you had questions about something and his response was along the lines of "this is it, this is how you do it, how do you not understand?" Posts almost everything from class online for review

Hyung is an awesome prof, his lectures are super engaging and funny. Even if you sit in the back, you will end up participating. The hw is graded literally on completion, and the exam questions are literally straight out of the hw. If you get the hw you'll ace the test. There is also extra credit on each exam worth 10%, extremely generous easy q's.

Dr. Oh is awesome. He is funny and tries his best to teach students that accounting is "fun and useful". The course consists of ten HW assignments and three exams (2 midterms, 1 final). The homework was graded very easily.. I only missed 1 point. The exams are straight-forward and questions come from homework/review q's. Extra credit on exams!

This is a great class. Very short homework and there is always one question he throughly goes over in class. Huge chance that its going to be the same question on the test. Tests arent hard but for the final go over all the homework assignments because he might copy and paste a random question from those.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He gets right to the point. Probably one of the best professors ive had. His tests are short and does not take the full 2 hours, and there are extra credit questions on them to. Be aware, getting above a hundred percent only gives you a hundred percent (not 109). Homework is short. He sometimes teaches us stuff not relevant, but still interesting!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof. Oh is an okay teacher. He tries to help us but his lecture is boring and he has a strong Korean accent. He stress that accounting is useful and fun to motivate us. He seems like developing his teaching skills yet but he still has some room to improve. I do not recommend his class. He is not horrible but not awesome.
Amazing professor. Motivational quote, "accounting is fun and exciting". Final is a bit harsh but overall the class is very good.

He has a thick Korean accent and can be hard to pay attention sometimes. I had to study extra at home and review so that I could fully understand all the stuff we learned in class.   He is very caring and his lectures are very slow. He tries to get student feedback, which doesn't alway work out but I recommend raising your hand for participation!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I took Financial Accounting as an elective (didn't need it for my major). Would not recommend taking this class unless you really like accounting or it is required. Prof is funny & nice but sometimes his lectures are confusing and not enough examples. I would highly recommend reading the chapters prior to class so you have a basis of understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Oh makes you want to learn accounting by saying its useful and fun and he's pretty helpful and funny. I found this class to be alright, a little challenging. You either get it or you don't but you still have to put effort. Tests are straightforward and everything from lecture but lectures can be long and boring. Final was pretty tough.

Professor Oh is a really funny guy! He really goes out of his way to teach his students  and providing funny examples too. He makes the class laugh and his tests / midterms are based off on assignments. As long as you do the assignment then you're fine. You do have to put in a bit of effort for this class. His accent is super sexy too!

He is such a great professor, uses any tactics he can to make sure students clearly understand the material. As long as you put in the effort, it's very easy to understand. Tests are all contrived of the homework he assigns which directly correlates to what he teaches that day.

A great professor who cares and wants you to understand the basics rather than just memorize them. No reading required because everything on the test in from lecture. If you don't understand something he will explain it as many ways as he can and if you fail it really is because you didn't put any effort into the course. Gives extra credit too!

Best professor I have ever had! He is enthusiastic and helpful. Makes a lot of weird, but funny jokes. Homework will take a good amount of time to finish, but they are great study tools for exams. Exams are quite hard because he likes to push his students to be analytical.

He is very enthusiastic about Accounting and the opportunities that stem from it. Good amount of homework. Tests are pretty hard. But if you go to class and do the homework you will get a good grade as he gives extra credit to mitigate the difficult tests.
Love love this professor! Must take!
He is amazing teacher!!!!! hope he will teach 211 tooo

This was his first time teaching and i think he did great. He makes sure to clarify everything you don't understand and tries to have everyone in class up to pace. He sometimes speaks nonsense but it is hilarious. He is a lenient grader. His tests are short but worth a lot question. As long as you understand the HW from the book you will be okay.

I think he is a great teacher. It was his first year teaching and he makes sure to have everyone up to pace. He clarifies everything you don't understand. Sometimes he speaks nonsense but it is hilarious. I think he uses time efficiently and the tests are short but worth a lot. As long as you understand the material from the HW then you are good.

He is smart and if you keep attending you will be fine. Accounting is hard but Hyung is trying to give students as much help as they need. If you are taking accounting for the first time of your life, take his class.

Definitely a tough class, but unstuck AI was a lifesaver for test prep. The professor's communication was hit-or-miss, but the course material was manageable with the right resources. Overall, a challenging but rewarding experience.

This professor mainly had terrible communication. No one ever knew if class was going to be in person, on Zoom, or recorded. Also, she took multiple days to respond to emails, she didn't grade anything until the very end of the quarter, and the final project instructions were super confusing.
AMAZING
They were my favorite professor I have ever had not only at UW Bothell but also CWU. She is so thoughtful and smart!

This class ruined my winter quarter. I was always on edge with this class, and nothing was ever clear. Projects were posted late and given 1 week for a group project to complete. For those who had a good experience, good for you, but I'm not sure the other 98% can say the same.

There were so many times professor would switch up on students like the syllabus, meeting times, etc. There was constant stress with assignments because our class was "hybrid", but we had only gone in person for the midterm/final. She didn't think about her students and expected perfection, but only did whatever she wanted on her own schedule.

Hybrid course that got turnt fully online for many reasons. Felt like I did not learn anything all quarter and it was thanks to super unclear instructions on a week-to-week basis and just an overall poorly structured class. Doesn't grade anything until the end of the quarter.

Doesn't utilize Canvas or her MH Connect program at all. Runs all assignments through Connect, which is fine, but then never publishes any modules or assignment instructions in Canvas. Literally posts useless announcements non-stop and when you need assignment or direction help, you have to sift through all the posts hunting for any instruction.

Literally forgets to host her online zoom classes (even on days when it's supposed to be in-person) and doesn't tell any of her students so we are all stuck in the waiting room seeing if we have class because she takes attendance. By far the most irresponsible, non-communicative, unhelpful professor I have ever seen. Don't bother emailing her.

Terrible, this class was supposed to be a hybrid class, in-person Monday online Wednesday but we had no in-person classes. They were canceled either a couple of days before or sometimes on the day of and it was changed to Zoom or just a lecture video. I taught myself all quarter so what am I even paying for? Save your sanity, don't take her class.

HORRIBLE. Do not take her this "hybrid" class is fully online basically. Has never held an in-person in class other than the midterm. Does not provide any help or explanation unreachable outside of class which she never holds. Save yourself and do not take her.

Terrible communication and grading. Sends information last minute or not at all. A waste of time to even try to communicate with her outside of class. All of her course is via a third party platform. She does very minimal grading and still has not graded any assignments 7 weeks into the quarter. Also gives no direction/info to projects or exams.

Stay away if you care about ur sanity. Class was supposed to by hybrid half online and half in person. we had no in person classes besides midterms and finals, she would inform us a few hours before her in person classes saying she canceling. worst organization ive ever seen for a class both financial and managerial. botted good reviews. stay away!

Hasn't responded to any of my emails. Avoid this professor at all costs, I feel like they do not care about anything any student has to say. This professor is a perfect example of someone doing the bare minimum to get paid.

Goes through lecture slides too fast, doesn't show up or allow students into Zoom office hours then blames the students, doesn't post grades until the very end of the quarter, and gives no guidance on the final group project.

It's a senior course and hard if you are not proficient in Excel or self disciplined to learn. Worst part was a few students who didn't show to classes busy abusing the school's resources. Irony was her project was case in point of how to use accounting and technology to stop this from happening in businesses. Great teacher and total professional.

Took class Spring 2023 and had internship. I have great respect for time she spent to help me and other students. She runs companies, is active in community and family. I wrote this review because the bad reviews are not true. She is engaging, knowledgeable and accomplished. I'm proud we have her as a Professor and mentor. I learned so much.

I have my internship thanks to Professor Orchideh! Lots of students love her. I took her 210 and 211 courses. I also got into UWB Business School Accounting Program. Had no clue what I was going to major in till her. She is so supportive! She grounds you in real business in her classes and teaching style is to learn and apply what you learned.
Never received the final exam/project scores even when the class ended. I seriously don't understand how this is fair to students.

POV AMAZING teacher, person and business woman. Students survive, succeed because of her support and understanding. Her experiences, connecting news to what we learn made it easy to learn. I'm a student of color and she is an inspiration. Unfortunate she's up against the traditional businessman professional biases from some. We need you professor!

She is a caring person with alot of experience but she seems to be completely checked out of the class alot of the time and most of the work/teaching is done by videos online. You will not know your grades until the last week and she does not answer questions outside of class. I would take the class again but it can get very stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Talks about herself way too much and makes her lectures extremely dramatic. Lots of busy work, and she teaches about 5% of each chapter during class. Tells lots of stories about her multiple businesses and her personal success. Does not understand canvas. However, I would take her again only because her grading is very easy.

Professor cares more about her businesses than her own class, forgets to publish assignments, and will not grade anything until the final week. You do not know your grade until the last week but she is a strict grader which is nonsensical. Horribly strict grading and expects you to know everything

Orchid supports students in class and outside of class. Is patient and kind. Assignments clear, all are auto graded except for project and Final part 2. Makes time in class for us to work on assignments so she can be there to answer questions and walk you through the hard ones. She is respected the industry. Mentored me to get a great job.

I liked her explanations with business experience. I learned why accounting is important to my marketing major and when I start working. There was a lot of work but you got to do a lot of it in class. You definitely have to go to class, ask questions and pay attention. Easy final multiple choice from past quizzes and problems from projects.

The Professor was great at the start of the quarter, but things started to fall apart after she was gone for two weeks. Tasks for assignments and projects started to change. The final was a trainwreck as it was changed within minutes of walking through the door. Overall there was a lot of confusion that cost people's grades.

I was nervous about taking this class. I have never worked with technology outside of excel. I really enjoyed this class. The instructor taught this from the accounting perspective which made it easy to understand. She gave me confidence in my knowledge of accounting and helped me apply it to something real. I hope she teaches tax class.

Professor Orchideh is great teacher. I have learned more from her in this class than I have in 1 year of classes at UW Bothell. She takes the time to explain but she doesn't give you the answers. I respect that about her. Everything is organized and laid out. She is way too nice and understanding.
Terrible. She just changes the syllabus mid quarter! So disorganized and very rude! Don't take her for any classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: The class overall is good, do not miss any class! Homework and quizzes are on Connect, there is a group project with presentation and a final on the way.

Orchideh is by far the worst professor I have ever taken at UW Bothell. Halway through the quarter somone cheated on our midterm so she punished all of us and voided the midterm for everyone which made our final worth double. 10 minutes before the test started, she changed the format again so everything we had studied for no longer mattered.
worst professor ever

Do you love huge projects with little to no instructions? Do you enjoy having no communication and not receiving grades till the last day of the quarter? Then this teacher is for you! 

Almost every class she just talks about random stuff like meeting famous people or about her own shops. Not a good learning experience whatsoever.

Absolutely avoid this professor at all costs. She still hasn't graded our final, and BOTH of our projects and the next quarter is starting soon. She doesn't respond to emails, and her lectures are horribly organized. Everything about her and this class are just disorganized in general.
It's been a few days after the deadline and she has not posted final grades yet. She would not respond even after reaching out to ask about when she's planning to finalize the grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her schedule for tests and projects became very disorganized and hectic. Project guidelines were unclear at times and tests became different than what was previously stated. Her TA grades and heavy work for everything she is supposed to do. She failed me as a professor, and lacked basic communication to set us up for success. AVOID HER ASAP!
The class itself is mostly online based with a big group project at the end and its relatively easy, but the professor? Just a genuinely erratic and frustrating human being.

I want to first start off by saying don't listen to all these people saying she is awful. I find her a very good teacher who cares and will help you out and has a lot of real-world experience. There is a group project portion of the class where it is mandatory to show up and it is graded so make sure you do show up and you will be fine.

I would like to start of by saying the obvious. AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS. She was absent for 2 weeks straight because of "pneumonia" and when my fellow classmates miss one day of class they lose 10% of their grade. Very interesting professor, she gets her TA to grade projects that he doesn't even know how to do. Do yourself a favor and stay away.
Not accessible outside of class, never responds to emails, stubborn.

I hated accounting. She made accounting understandable. Her lectures and slides walk you through the problems. Her work examples helps a lot. I would not be in business school without her support. Connect auto grades almost all the assignments. She is super responsive. I think if you want to learn and ask for help she is right there for you.

More of a lecturer rather than an actual teacher. Most lectures are about herself and her experiences during class and barely goes over mathematical sides of concepts. Class and canvas page is very disorganized, the only grades put in canvas are the grades the TA inputs, so you don't know your grade until the final one is posted to your transcript.

I questioned what I thought I had learned in the program when I started this class. She helped me and others see a total different side of accounting. Everything I learned came back to me where I could really see how accounting is used in business. She pulls it all together in this class in the class project. She is caring and so patient!

Misleading reviews from a disgruntled few or ONE? Don't believe it! See the other reviews and ask reliable students. She is busy with all her students, makes time and helps them in and out of the classroom. That's why! Why you trying to reach her outside of class anyways? Shouldn't you be in class asking? Just stop. We see you!

Took both 210/211 with this professor. Agree that she rarely responds to emails and her project instructions are little to no help. She's a great person but as a professor she could def be better. In 211, heavy load in the first month then it gets slow in the following month bc of mainly group projects. Easy grader. Exams were online and were okay.

I have had this professor for the past 2 quarters and both quarters had failed to enter in final grades on time, her instructions are confusing for projects and gives little help. She is not organized and every project you get is probably going to ge pushed back. Only good thing is the class was online.

Professor Raisdanai is a very helpful instructor. She responds to email questions in a timely manner which is consistent to other instructors I have. She explains her expectations at the beginning of the term that if you do the work, you will get good grades and she adds plenty of extra credit. Grading is fair and feedback is helpful for learning.

Simply a lazy professor who is too busy with other things. Never will respond to email or text, hasn't submitted final grades, skips class, and makes the assistant teach instead. There were 0 directions, your left to figure out so much on your own, due dates are always wrong and changing. Coming from a high achieving student, avoid this professor.

Took this class winter quarter. Had her for 210 in fall. I'm helping my sibling register in Spring and saw some of the reviews. I have to say that Orchideh is one of the smartest teachers. Everything for class is outlined on Canvas. You have access to everything at beginning of quarter. She helps us in groups to do the work. Just need participate.

I have a ton of respect for Professor Orchideh. I had a lot of priorities this quarter and she took the time I needed to help me so I can graduate. I do not think everyone knows how much she does for students and what she has accomplished for us. She is a great teacher, direct and total autonomy for how you learn. Wish I had her for other classes!

The class is okay. At times it was really hard but if you're willing to put in the effort it's not so bad. The professor herself is okay, she ignores emails, texts, and isn't great with technology. She's really lazy and isn't clear on directions for assignments. If you can find classmates to work with then you should be okay.
she is so random and all over the place, never in class, leaves randomly, no direction and makes NO SENSE. I would give her a 0 if I could, DO NOT TAKE HER.

In class all she does is read lecture slides to the class which is such a waste of time. Im retaking this class right now and my professor (Murgie Krishnan). I highly recommend this professor 10/10. He expect you do watch the lectures before class which prep you for USEFUL class time where we work on practice problems which preps you for the hw!

My least favorite professor. You will not be able to reach her outside of office hours, never responds to emails or texts. There are 2 big projects in the quarter, and if you do bad on these say goodbye to a good grade. She gives the most vague instructions for these projects, so you will have to figure everything out by yourself. Avoid her... 0/10

A lot of Connect chapter work and two main projects that will raise or tank your grade, she is a good professor in terms of understanding the concepts and explaining them but the course content didn't really allow us to utilize the concepts we learned until the two big projects. Could be better but wasn't the worst thing in the world.

Honestly she could make her class better but her only downside is that she is disorganized, doesn't answer emails or questions and her instructions are super unclear. You have to rely heavily on classmates to figure things out. Luckily this class was online for me which made everything a little easier but I wouldn't recommend her.
One of the best professors I have ever had!

Horrible professor! Never responded to emails or texts and she did not put any effort into the class at all. Didnt grade a single assignment until the day after grades were due at the end of quarter. My financial aid was almost revoked because of her lack of effort/professionalism. Should not be a prof anymore!

She didnt enter final grades in time so now I am in jeopardy of loosing my financial aid. She also doesnt respond to emails or texts. Contradicts herself constantly especially for assignments. Bad professor who cant get her crap together. Now I have to fight to get the financial aid money I earned back because she cant do her job.

I regretfully took this class over the summer. She's unresponsive to emails and texts, so office hours is the best (only) way to reach her. She can come off as rude at times and can contradict her own words. She grades very late. She changed the assignment/exam weight very last minute, so students were upset that their expected final grade dropped.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class mostly projects (3), where 2 are independent. All the homework and assignments are on Connect. She is very flexible on assignments and due dates. The only thing I don't like is she doesn't go over example problems, so her lectures are just word which is a bit annoying when there so many applications problem on the homework and assignment

I LOVE HER! Literally the sweetest, she honestly cares and will do everything to help you. If you have a question she will answer it and leave you feeling like you can conquer the world. She uses connect and everything is through that. The class is pretty easy to get a good grade in as long as you ask when you aren't sure. Def taking her again!!

Great professor. You need to do the work to learn though and pay attention in class. Hard for me when I have a full-time job and family. This professor gets this. Doesn't micro manage and is flexible.
Love her! She is supportive, very knowledgeable and cares.
Landed a job based on what I shared I was doing and learning in AIS! Stoked!

Had Professor Orchid for financial accounting. She is awesome I took her for managerial accounting. Managerial was hard for me to understand and she met with me to help me through it. We did differential analysis for our final project which covered business decision making. The knowledge and experience made everything we learned click together!

She is legit. I struggled in most classes. I work full time, have a family to take care of. She was understanding and so supportive. She has a 0 fail policy. I thought I was going to fail but the way she balances her grading with demonstration of knowledge not just completing assignments really helped me learn the subject and pass the class.

This professor does not mess around. I'm in an internship in ops where I sit in meetings and do analysis for the company's suppliers. I am using the framework I learned from this class. I did not realize how much I learned from her. Thank you Professor Orchideh!

My last class for graduation. Professor encouraged us to attend networking events and helped me with my resume to include what we were learning. I got a job from one of the firms I met. She is awesome. Her classes are working sessions with shorts to the point lectures.

Taking all her classes she teaches. You actually really learn accounting and how to use it in real applications. Accounting is not easy, tedious and broad. She gets what we need to understand and know.
Professor Orchideh best teacher and mentor!
Just got a job using the project we did!! Professor Orchideh connects all we learned in accounting with technology and business. She is so supportive and helps build confidence in what we know.
Great teacher period.

I did not think I would like this class because of the IT part. Professor O did a great job creating a project focused on accounting to solve real business problems for a company and the use of technologies to implement accounting and the required internal controls to improve the business. I actually learned a lot more than I thought I would!

Just got a job as a freshman thanks to Professor orchid. I used my projects we did in her class to apply and in the interviews the questions covered some of the issues in the case studies we did. I felt very confident in what I know about financial accounting and business because of her.

Very difficult quarter overall but she supported all of us with long lead times with due dates. Exams were broken out so we have a many chances to improve our grade. She is so approachable with any issue. She let's the class weigh in on milestones and takes our feedback to improve the class experience.

Professor Orchid is the best. It is my second class with her. What I learned helped me with my internship interviews and I have an accounting job now for the summer! No more retail! Students who engage & participate will do well in her class & beyond.

this quarter was tough for me and professor o made it bearable. she is the reason I'm staying to graduate. she is an amazing teacher, professional and the work she assigns seems tough but has purpose. you really get it after getting through the learning curve. i have new confidence to be an accountant one day. we need more teachers like her.

I liked Professor Orchid, and he clearly understands accounting and business. That doesn't make her a good teacher. At all. If learning ANYTHING is more important to you than the most tedious but easy A, then take someone else. Or take her in the Autumn quarter when you still care about school.

Professor Raisdanai! This is my 3rd class with her. An amazing teacher! Course is balanced. Tough and easy work. Mostly project group work which helps with learning technology concepts. She keeps us focused on accounting relevance. To do well you must participate, read and engage to do well. She won't let you fail if you have personal problems!

Not your usual professor. First professor I had that wasn't textbook easy. She really makes you think, work like a professional. I was so worried I was not ready for the profession but her class was transformational. I wish more Professors taught like her. She is incredibly supportive but you must do your part to succeed.

Prof Raisdanai is the best accounting teacher at UW. HW amount is fair, she gives you 3 weeks to do them (4-7 problems)! Quizzes are multiple choice. Case studies/lectures all real world application. I never used the codification till this class. I feel better equipped to be a working accountant when I graduate. She is so supportive. Love her!

She barely teaches, only focusing on codification and case study, which are not helpful for your homework and exams at all. Over 42 students have registered her class on the first day of the quarter, but only 28 left after two weeks. You have to spend all your time to finish her homework, but learn nothing related to the quizzes and exams
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Be prepared for inconsistent teaching and having a massive amount of homework and cases. Instead of teaching relevant material, you will hear rambling of her life. Please take a different professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Really nice professor but I was literally drowning in the massive amount of homework. My problem echos when she fails to teach her students during the two hour lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: By far one of the best professors I have taken. Your grade will be based off of how much effort you put in she doesn't give easy A's but she also won't allow you to fail.
Excellent teacher, great real world references. Adapts if any difficulty in class. Take home exams, projects, quizzes, really learned a lot from her. She uses Connect and Canvas.

This professor will give you an amazing experience if you're pursuing any career!! She cares that you understand the subject and will work with you until you get it. The work can be heavy if you don't put any type of effort. Do homework and understand the concept and you'll do amazing!! I will take her as a professor again!

She is the best professor EVER!! The class lectures are really good and she would post them on canvas so we can look back on it. There is a bit of homework BUT they are pretty easy if you look at her slides. The midterms are really really easy if you do the study guide. Her final is basically all of the midterms so keep those!!

One of the most caring and informative professors Ive ever taken a class from. I am NOT a quantitative person and I passed financial accounting with a 3.7 easy. Her lectures are easy to understand, the homework actually helps, I actually learned a TON.
Take her. Trust me.

There were 5 exams, and lots of homework each night through Connect. She has connections in the business field but is not the best teacher. Her projects were slightly repetitive and took up a lot of class time and were not provided with rubrics, so she will mark you down with a system you didn't know existed. However, lots of EC opportunity.

Sad class ended. Professor Raisdani should teach all our classes. Great learning environment and amazing leader. Does not give easy A or F. Really cares about student success. Grades to recognize if learned the material, with chances to make up where you don't. Some students think breathing should get 4, not at UW. Awesome mentor and A is earned.

She is my role model, gives confidence for me. She always available outside of class to help. Assignments are online just need to do before due date. She does 4 exams and final to break material down so you don't have to study all 6 chapters for mid-term and all 12 chapters for final. 2 projects relevant help get jobs. She got me internship!!

Prof Orchideh best teacher I had so far. I'm a sophomore pre-business. She makes the course interesting and understandable. There is so much to learn. She connects it to real business world. The course and grading is clear/organized. She is always available, even 3am to help. Her grading style is caring. She accounts for corrections and effort!!

She's inconsistent with grading; if you are her favorite, she will unfairly make sure you get 100% on each assignment to convince you to go into accounting. You can get an A, but you must work hard, especially if you are not a teacher's pet. Over 10 hours of homework each week through Connect, and two projects she will not provide a rubric for.

While the professor is obviously intelligent, she isn't good at explaining. She doesn't give rubrics for the two group projects and she gives an exam every 2-3 weeks. Homeworks are very long. At the very least, the exams and the finals are all taken from the online study guides.

Before anything, I would like to say that I took STMATH 427 with Professor Paparella, but it did not have the option.

Professor Paparella really cares that the students understand the course material as opposed to anything else, and that makes it really easy to engage in his course. Quizzes and problem sets should be obvious if you pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really chill guy. Lectures go much more in depth than textbook/homework, but sometimes it felt like he was complicating the content a bit, so it was a little hard to follow. Exams (2 midterms + final) are exactly like the practice ones, which are very straightforward. Matlab homework after every lecture. Also, he's kinda a hottie

Pretty chill class. You don't have to show up to lecture unless it's a quiz day, but I would recommend it. Quizes are easy but, make sure you show your work clearly I got docked a ton of points for the first two weeks. Homework takes 1-2 hours and exam models the practice tests. Professor cares about the students, and easy to reschedule quizes.

Best Calc 2 professor I've had. I took this class twice before and learned more here than in both attempts combined. Explains concepts clearly, and if you ever don't understand anything you know exactly what to study. Challenging class obv (calc 2) but very fair.

Professor Paparella is the GOAT if you don't mind a professor who takes the time to incorporate humor into his lectures. Homework assignments are mainly your source of reenforcing your learned concepts from his lectures. Tests are what you mainly want to spend time studying for. Quizzes every Monday at the end of the lecture.

Amazing Professor! Not only does he hand out formulas to memorize but explains where they come from. He makes conceptual topics much more digestable. He's very caring and acknowledges that students have a life outside of college. His homework workload and tests are reasonable. Hands out practice tests which really helps with the actual test.

I've taken classes both at the UW Seattle and Bothell campus and can say that Professor Paparella cares the most about what students learn and take away from the class. He does a great job of balancing what students need to master in this course to be successful in future coursework while being respectful of the students' outsides commitments.

Problem Sets are 50% of the grade, 30% on quizzes and 20% on participation on EDD. Only allowed to collaborate with at most 2 of the same people throughout the quarter on problem sets. No exams but problem sets are difficult and take a decent chunk of time. Lectures are recorded and posted on Panopto for supplementary purposes. Need to know LaTeX

Took STMATH300. No tests or quizzes -- do your best on the problem sets. Dr. Paparella is qualified, skilled at teaching, and has reasonable expectations. Course load is not heavy nor difficult. He provides great advice on research and career choices. Best math prof at UWB I've taken so far. Wish there was more collaboration in class though.

Great prof. He openly acknowledges that his students have lives outside of this class and assigns the workload accordingly.

His 402 has weekly assignments worth 80% of the grade instead of exams. His lectures go further in-depth than the textbook does, so you'll want to show up for class. Very responsive to questions through both email and EDD.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. Goes above and beyond to explain why things work, rather than just giving you a formula and making you remember it. I came out of the class with a better understanding of the intuition behind math, not just certain numbers memorized

Excellent Professor, He is not easy, but it's manageable and his lectures are the best of any professor at UWB. There are no exams, but all the assignments are proof based which is a nice refresh from all the recipe book math classes at UWB. If you want to learn math take this professor, but if you just want a easy professor he is not for you.

His lectures will solve your insomnia. Very indecisive with grading and homework. Expect shifts in how homework and tests are assigned/graded/weighted. Takes examples straight from the book, so there are no supplemental examples to help you with quizzes and homework. Study with fellow classmates and stock up on caffeine. Prepare for a long quarter.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Out of all the math teachers I've had over the years, this guy is the best. Super chill, fair grader, clear lectures. I've had him for three classes now, four counting an Independent study over the summer, and I'll definitely continue taking his classes.

60% of the grade is weekly quizzes (8 quizzes) , but the lowest two will be dropped. 20% for the final and 20% for the midterm. Extra credit in the final. He graded nicely: you only lose points where you made a mistake and he doesn't deduct again later in the problem. He uploads his lectures online, so you can keep track even if you miss a day.

Always on schedule and on topic. Demonstrates enthusiasm for Matrix Algebra. Clear lecture with copies of notes and video lectures. Quizzes and tests are straight-forward with no surprises. Convenient office hours. Cares if you understand the material. I felt prepared for everything. Overall, a solid professor. Take them if you get a chance!
His lecture is super boring and is not helpful at all.
Highly recommend to take this professor! His lecture is clear and well explained. If you do the homework and reviews, then you will do fine on the exams.

Homework is split in two categories: graded and supplemental. The supplemental isn't mandatory(or graded) but is really useful. Quick and reasonable grader. Theory heavy lectures, but the tests are pretty standard math tests.

I have taken classes with nearly every mathematics instructor at UWB, and Paparella is easily one of, if not THE, best one. If you have the opportunity to take a class with him, take it. I only wish that he had been hired earlier so that I could've taken more of his classes.

Grading attendance seems unreasonable in a university class, but your attendance will be graded. His tests are pretty difficult, so expect to read. That being said, he is very knowledgable and wants to share what he knows with his students. If you don't understand after lecture, go to his office hours. He's happy to explain it again for you.

Pietro is a very good instructor. He's very clear about what he expects from you and assigns take home assignments and tests which are hard if you don't do the homework. We had to do some proofs for this class, so expect them on the exams. Linear algebra is not easy so reading the textbook is sometimes necessary as Pietro moves in a fast-pace.
best prof ever!!!!!!!!

This professor only knows how to waste time talking about herself. 3 exams and they were all timed and hard. She expects us students to be able to do it as fast as she does, but she has experience. She also only talks and talks about the same thing when she can summarize her lectures. AVOID HER.
Exams are really difficult and the course overall has been very unorganized.
Does not explain course content well and doesn't teach what is on the exam.
took her online class and she's so unorganized. really poor and unprofessional communicator. most of us have no idea what her expectations are for exams and project.

I liked how she doesn't read off of the slides; but that means you have to attend lectures to get a lot of content. I didn't really find the textbook that useful, so I just attended lecture. There are 3 exams which aren't too bad, but she throws a couple curveballs for each exam.

Professor Pajanen humor made 8 pm class much easier to sit in. The project is really important so don't ignore it and start working on it early. Study, don't skip the class, do homework, work hard, and she'll reward you when it comes to the final grade. If you don't do well in her class it's totally on you.

Attending her class will not help you get a good grade on the exam. You might as well do not even show and get the same grade. There are a bunch of math problems on the exam and she barely covers anything in class. She should focus more on teaching math and getting people to understand it better rather than teaching concepts from the reading.

WARNING!!! If you cannot TEACH YOURSELF using the book and MyOm lab. you're screwed. Told us she was an easy grader, that we only need to read definitions in the book, and that she would focus on math since people seem to have trouble with it. None of that was true. only two classes focused on math all quarter, and she did not teach it well.

Very engaging professor, never a dull lecture. The midterm and final I found to be a tad bit unrealistic; considering the 60% average on the final after removing the extra credit question. Instead of curving a difficult test she offered extra credit in the form of essays. Don't expect an easy A, this class requires a lot of work. Good luck!

don't take if you are not a computer science major. He is knowledgable but he has high expectations of his students. He loves leetcode, in-class exercises are graded for effort/trying. start hw/projects early, exams are pretty difficult, be prepared to lock in if you took an easy professor for 342.

I have a lot of respect for Pisan as a professor, but I was disappointed by how the class material was created using AI. Lectures tended to be rushed since each chapter was long and he'd cover 2-3 chapters per day and the practice test questions were AI-generated in large folders, which made it confusing to see what would actually be on the test.

Laughably easy programming projects offset by incredibly difficult exams. I regularly score 98-100 on CS and math exams and these exams really challenged me. He often cut class short, and even "let" us go home early during the two review sessions because no one had any more questions. Study guides were also AI-generated, which is unacceptable.

Took pisan off the advice of an alumni of close to 8 years. The way he described pisan is NOTHING like the Pisan at uw bothell today. Pisan now is BITTER, ANGRY, and looking to punish anyone he can. There must have been some big AI job scare at uw bothell to make pisan feel like he is in danger, because he is TAKING IT OUT ON HIS STUDENTS BIG TIME

Pisan in his personal blog constantly posts about how angry he is at ppl for using AI to make apps. His exams' nost difficult questions are not covered in any of his lectures, or his study guide material. Essentially a red herring. He goes on vacation the day after he grades his final exam so no one can talk to him about it. Is this a good prof???

Apparantly Pisan used to be a great professor in the past, but not anymore. I received a great (4.0) grade in his class, but I can tell that his manner of teaching compared to his exams are REALLY unfair. His study guide is basically a feint, because the hardest questions on the exams will NOT be covered by the study guide or review sessions. Avoid

His lectures are helpful and I like that he gives explanations. However, there are only 2 tests and they are weighted 60% of your grade. He uses Medium/Hard Leetcode questions in class and on the midterms, with very fast/unhelpful explanation. The exams is all that matters, be prepared to solve lots of difficult problems in 2 hrs. Strictest grader

He never teaches how to approach the LeetCode problems. We had two LeetCode mediums on the midterm and final, unfair, given minimal explanation. One student even lost points on a correct part because it was considered an easy tree insertion. Do not take this class. Wait for the next quarter. Not worth the mental pressure

Pisan is unremarkable. His class is pretty easy and mainly consists of lectures with in-class activities, biweekly projects, and a couple tests. Just don't expect him to do ANYTHING above the bare minimum. One student got laughed at for asking him to supervise his CSS397. Gives AI generated study guides that don't pertain to tests. He's not special
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Pretty average cs class the main difference is the use of leetcode, if I wasn't a stone cold truecel I probably would've struggled more but to those who are fakcels it might be a bit unfair to have a leetcode medium on an exam.If you plan on taking ths class its worth it to learn data structures and leetcode prior to as it makes it much easier.

You will need a therapist after taking this class. Less on the professor himself, more on the archaic fashion of teaching this school still projects onto its students. Professor Pisan is helpful outside of class, but during lectures I suggest you shotgun 3 redbulls back to back to keep alert. Also not everything on the test is mentioned in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He only gave 6 projects throughout the quarter and no other homework, although there were in-class assignments. He didn't prepare us well for the mid-term, and had the audacity to say he was disappointed by our scores. He learned from his mistake, though, and prepared us well for the final. Not bad, but wouldn't necessarily recommend.

He is responsive on Discord. Understanding. Plays everyone's games and gives verbal feedback. You better attend class or you will miss vital announcements like presentation and playtest dates and class cancellations. Nothing is posted on canvas and only on Discord if you ask him. Most of our learning was on our own. So many class cancelations.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Nothing worse than a professor who pretends to be nice. Smiles in class, acts supportive, then slashes points with vague feedback. Cold in office hours, fake polite, and somehow always “too busy” to clarify anything. Just be upfront about being harsh instead of pretending to care.
A lot of leetcode problems in the exams. A lot of stuttering throughout his lectures. Not a good choice unless you like a stuttering lecturer.

You'll want to attend his lectures because they're actually useful. You technically don't have to but they're basically required to succeed in his class. He gives you plenty of practice with Leetcode problems, so you can understand the material better before you use it for programming assignments. Exams are difficult; study hard!

While he is a very kind professor who clearly cares about his students and the subject he teachers. His test are poorly designed, while some of the questions actually tested material you learned, others required that you had random bits of information he may have talked about in class for less than 5 minutes. Frankly, there is no good 430 class.

He is a very understanding professor. Any questions I had he was able to answer, and any issues I brought up he was able to address well. His lectures could afford to be more structured, as often times his attempts to provide a quick example would end up taking half the class period. Grading was a little harsh, but I did end up learning a lot.

The lectures were helpful, and we usually had a warmup on leetcode to apply whatever we are learning or about to learn in class. One thing that I disliked about the class were the exams. The exams arent crazy difficult, but because it was on paper it leaves room for some very simple mistakes. Not only that, he graded them harshly.
