reviews.comment: She definitely made this class harder than it needed to be. Graded by HW (essay Q's) and in class essays both of which she grades pretty hard. There is A TON of reading (pdfs posted on canvas) which are upwards of 50 pages twice a week and they are very dense. She is open to office hours and was helpful when asked Q's. Not impossible-but hard class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great professor. She had engaging lectures, but she also posted them on Canvas/did not take attendance, so you don't have to show up unless there is a quiz. There were a decent amount of quizzes for this class, so you just had to study the course materials. I didn't use my textbook often, but showed up to the lectures, so I got the gist there.

Took Udell for developmental psychology. Her class is lecture based with some short essays and tests. She's very knowledgable and she uploads all of her lectures onto canvas.  You will do just fine if you do the readings and study her lectures.

Dr. Udell is a clear and strong instructor.  Her lectures were well done.  Her assignments were clear, although I did need some clarification at first.  This was a 200 level class, so her expectations were at that level.  The tests were fair.  Dr. Udell does have strong boundaries, but she wants her students to do well.

I was really looking forward to this teacher, and she seams really funny in class, but she was super hard and not helpful. I asked her for help many times and she did not help me. She was rude and mean with her feedback on assignments and she graded really hard.

She's a tough grader. Definitely study! She's also very disorganized, and you get this feeling like she, herself, only tries to do the minimum for teaching. This is a lot of problems, but I will also say she's very understanding of the subject. She cracks really great jokes, and she does help when you need it. Overall, I think she's just average.

I've had Udell for the past 3 quarters straight and all I can say is that she is a bro! At first she may seem really strict and unclear but as long as you're willing to put in the work her classes are quite doable. Also her funny sense of humor makes up for the loads of reading you get.
She gives you clear instruction of what she wants, no buff what so ever. The way she teaches is super cool and funny!
Such a good teacher! She gives you the test questions the day before the test. As long as you show up to class and pay attention you will do well. Really interesting class too!!
Oh my gosh, she is so wonderful. Absolutely hilarious and very clear on expectations!!! Such a fun summer course. Highly recommended.
Great professor! I had her for many classes and always learned more than I expected. I am taking her next quarter again! :)
She was and is my favorite prof. at this university! Every class I have had with her I walk away with more knowledge than I had expected to learn. She's also very funny!
fav prof at uwb! if you want to learn take her! only she is a stickler on grades!!
Loved her.  She was helpful and offered to clarify if anyone had questions.  Would definitely take her class again.

My favorite prof! I'm currently taking my 3rd class w/ her & love it! Very clear on guidelines, instructions & expectations. Well structured lectures & worksheets due each class (some graded, some not). Readings can be articles on BB or e-reserve, some classes she teaches have a text book & some don't. Gives prompt up front for essay tests.
Fabulous instructor.  Her lectures actually sink in and I retain the material. She keeps the class moving and relivant.
Excellent teacher- highly recommend. Lectures were structured and clear, writing assignments short and simple, quizzes easy. Hard not to succeed in her class- and enjoy going!

I have taken Udell for many classes at UWB. She is funny, easy to ask questions to, responds quickly, and her slides with lecture really help. If you just answer what she is asking you in worksheets and quizes you will do fine, you cant make things up, she'll catch you.

This teacher was just awful.  They really need to explain what they want the class to do.  Myself, as well as the entire class, were just confused about most of the assignments. The study questions were posted within hours before the test so they really didn't have any use. I would definitely not take this teacher again for Developmental Psychology

The whole class struggled with figuring out what she REALLY wanted us to do on homework assignments and quizzes. It was hard to prepare for quizzes when all she gave was the chapter. She would post the quiz question at midnight the day BEFORE which would only benefit night owls and insomniacs. Critical grader, very knit picky, and inconsistant

Professor was always prepaired and interested in the topic.  Some concepts were a little challenging to grasp but professor was always available to help.  Enjoyed the class and would take professor again!
Borrrrrring.  I think other readings would have helped me learn more and kept awake.   A class like this should be much more informative and interesting.
She grades hard but somehow you don't dislike her for it. She is interesting and interested in what she teaches.

I love Professor Udell.  She may be a tough grader, but she is extremely knowledgable in her field and you can learn A LOT from her.  Her classes are fun, and infomative at the same time which makes going to class easier... She's extremely likable.  I would highly recommend Professor Udell.

Not for students with bus major.  Seems like "correct" answers were based on her psychological findings, this type of course where everything is based on "theory" is never good because if you disagree then you fail, but if you agree (w/Udell especially) then you pass.  Unless you have to take a course in psychology I highly recommend not taking her

I really enjoy Udell's teaching style.  Her worksheets are difficult and you really have to think about the question.  If you are willing to do with work you will succeed in her class.  I would definately take more classes from her in the future.

I love Dr. Udell's class and her teaching style.  She is clear, transparent, and engaging and she using many different methods to teach the material.  I highly recommend taking her class.  She is fair and available for assistance if needed.  I especially like her candidness in class.  It makes things interesting.  LOVE HER!
I have really enjoyed being in Ms. Udell's class. Her teaching style is very clear, and her class is very interesting. She is a tough grader, but you learn a lot in her class.

The articles were so boring.  Stats, research methods, blah, blah, blah.  Reading 20-25 pages of this stuff (make that two of those articles sometimes) and doing the responses for EVERY CLASS got old quick.  I admit that she is animated and draws attention.  Girls eat this stuff up.  I don't have the patience for this.  GREAT female-to-male ratio!
I really enjoyed BIS 333 with Udell.  She is an awesome teacher and extremely fun to listen to lectures.  I look forward to taking more classes from her!
didn't learn anything new here -- too easy

WONDERFUL TEACHER!  I would take her again and again.  Lots of reading but you learn a lot and nothing you can't handle.  Very passonate about teacher.  She is helful and understanding.  A lot of group work and lecture.  Test are easy as long as you do the study guide.  Love love love her teaching style.

Anyone interested in Psychology or adolescents at risk will love Risk and Resilience. The material is fascinating and Udell creates a relaxed conversational learning environment. The essay quizes help you integrate and process the material really well. This class makes it fun to learn.

This was an excellent class and Udell made it very interesting. She has a relaxed conversational style in class and there is a lot of discussion. She is approachable and very clear in her expectations. She really wants her students to learn and is very fair. I highly recommend this class.
She is extremely clear and you know exactly what she wants. She is also a very interesting lecturer and the class is fascinating. I would highly recommend her class.
Great Teacher!!! Really appreciated her teaching style and I learned so much from this course. This is the way a class should be taught. It was interactive, fun, and interesting.

Taken for global health, super nice and respected professor. Group heavy but makes sense for the course work. Not too many assignments, and a larger final group project that is given class time to work on.
Prof. Vicky is amazing! I'm not sure why she doesn't have 5/5. She's fair, knowledgeable, and very caring.

Vicky is very passionate & extremely knowledgeable. This class truly made me think outside of my comfort zone and made me passionate about the class material. She likes to pinpoint people on the spot, but not in a malicious way, she just wants people to think outside the box. Quizzes & homework really aren't that bad as long as you're participating
Nice intelligent lady, poor teaching. Interesting class, not the right teacher for it. Very confusing and unorganized. Test was not comparable with the lecture.
Nice intelligent lady, poor teacher. Interesting class, not the right teacher for it. Very confusing and unorganized. Test was not comparable with the lecture.

B WRIT 134. Ashley JoEtta on Canvas. Gives good feedback before the due date. She loves to cancel things last minute so check your email EVERY DAY before heading to her class (especially if you live off-campus). Accessible outside class if you make arrangements. Just be ready to talk about race and language a lot (it's almost a sociology class)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Ash is motivational, gentle, understanding etc. She made me feel seen & cared for. I was taking three other classes over summer q and she stated if anyone needed an extension just let her know, no explanation needed. Easy 4.0 if you do the busy work and one big final essay of your choice but she gives feedback before submitting the final. 10/10

wasn't clear on what the final paper should be as well as not telling us what was needed for the final paper because we only met up for class twice the whole quarter. she uploaded the final with no rubric on the final week and the class didn't know what was required until the final was uploaded, esp when 1500+ words were required. very stressful

I had approaches to social research with Dr. Vaughan and she had long assignments that give you only a day to complete. She was swell when answering questions but those few assignments led to a final research paper and presentation that were all harshly graded. Pray that the rest of your classmates do badly so she can round your GPA. Good luck!

Professor Vaughan is kind and will let you turn in assignment whenever even though they're late. However, I am giving her a horrible rating because her teaching methods are confusing and not clear whatsoever. 

For class preparation for her teaching she just doesn't seem prepared at all and I honestly learned nothing valuable in this class.

Nice person but not the best teacher. Awful at grading on time and a little too critical when she grades. Impossible to get an A above a 3.6 or 3.7. Most of my friends and I got B's despite always attending and following directions on all work.

Awful grading techniques even if she's a good teacher. I did every assignment and got A's on all of them until the last week because I had a surgery. She knew about the surgery in advance, but granted me NO extensions or support, and gave me an I (incomplete) grade that I had to make up. I did not like dealing with her.

She seems nice at first, and is generally accessible outside of class and willing to help, but it doesn't help a ton. Her instructions are generally unclear for assignments, her grading is incredibly harsh, and she doesn't feel particularly approachable. The only redeeming factor of this course is that she allows you to resubmit anything.

Nice teacher but I would not take a class with her again. Likes to answer questions with a question. She is not very clear about assignments, which can be extremely challenging for students. Not very approachable.

I took Denise in Spring of 2021. Denise is really dichotomous in some ways. Her lectures actually arent bad at all and I never had an issue with the time spent in class. Shes cool, helpful, and really nice. On the flip side, shes a tough grader and borderline refuses to give full points. Hardest 4.0 Ive earned based on her approach to grading.

Little to no organization at all, no rubric for projects at all. She will say that she won't be as harsh on exams and other important projects, but she will. The political simulation is made only for vocal and enthusiastic people. The slides she posts will not help, only during her lectures. If you want a good grade, don't try your luck here.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Extremely unorganized, very unclear expectations, and little to no criteria on what to study for the exams. She is enthusiastic but she is easily distracted and will go off topic very easily. Taking notes is difficult because she'll only offer verbal examples and examples usually trail off into a brief off topic discussions leaving in the dark.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The work is simple but the professor is a ridiculous and unreasonable grader. Forget about a 4.0, a 3.9, a 3.8, or a 3.7. Most of the good students will get a B. If you are lucky you will squeeze out an A- or B+ (89-92%/3.4-3.6). Very picky/unclear grading criteria. Shes okay if you dont care about your GPA. Otherwise, you are walking into a B.

She tells you that this is not going to be an easy A because a lot of people go into Intro to Public Speaking and Communication because it's easy. Several people then dropped the class. You will not receive a 4.0, but you will become a better speaker for the better. Her 4 quizzes are easy. You HAVE to do all the assignments.

You will learn a lot. Structure isn't great. The class is basically a series of group assignments except the midterm, final, and policy memo. She is a very strict grader. Unless you are an A type personality with the ability to think quickly about a range of ideas, your GPA will suffer. She rarely gives As. Be prepared for long nights researching!

I learned a lot from Professor Vaughn however there is unclear grading criteria. She gives assignments out at the last second, expecting them to be done with very little time. Also files and other things are late to be uploaded. Exams are incredibly difficult and take a lot of time. If you are quick to think of potential policy you'll do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Denise is a very knowledgeable and caring professor. She knows exactly what she wants you to learn and has lots of experience as a professor and as the Speech & Debate Supervisor. She goes out of her way to help students and will always be there for you if you have any questions or concerns. Amazing professor! Would strongly recommend to take her!

Denise is a wonderful debater and a decent teacher, but DO NOT take this class if you care about your GPA. She rarely gives 100% on debates, and is a tough grader on papers as well. She also tends to have multiple big assignments due at once and doesnt give a lot of notice about them so if you do take the class be vigilant in checking canvas.

If you practice for the speech and meets the time requirement, you'll get a good grade. 4 easy quizzes based on readings but very general. She's very sweet and nice, a talented public speaker, and is willing to provide extra help if you need. Cares about students, accessible outside class, and creates safe space for sensitive topics.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Talks a lot and goes off topic often but is funny so it's kind of OK? Tough grading on the group assignments throughout the quarter but the exams are graded less harshly. She loves debate and goes crazy for the class debate simulation that happens.

Let me be the first to say that as a teacher, Professor Vaughan is a great. She is extremely good at making a safe/fun environment for the awkward subject of debate. However, she graded WAAAAYYY TOO TOUGH for an introduction class! It was ridiculous that the best speaker could only get 46 out of 50 and the rest of the class received C's and B's.
Great teacher, grades WAAAAYYY too hard for a 200 level/introductory class

The first speech is kind of nerve wrecking, but by the last speech, I felt much more comfortable. The two tests are easy if you study. She is a tough grader. She really cares about her students and is always available to help when it's needed. Also makes time outside of class for her students. Great prof! Definitely recommend.

Expect to be nervous for the first speech but then it gets much better and easier once you know people. The tests are easy if you memorize the study guide as she only asks things from the study guide. She is a pretty tough grader.
While she isn't an easy A, if you do the work (and there's very little) you will do well! She provides great feedback and is really there for her students.

She is very funny and full of energy. However, I find that she can be very confusing when it comes to assigning homework. She is also a tough grader which can be very frustrating. Expect to work a lot with groups and participation is a must. She is there for you if you have any questions.

Denise Vaughan is HANDS DOWN the BEST professor I have ever had at UW Bothell. She is stress free but will be stern when needed. Shes fun but serious. She LOVES debate and it helped me with my public speaking tremendously!! I took two of her classes, BIS302 and Debate class. SOO WORTH IT! SHES AWESOME!

I have taken multiple courses with Prof. Vaughan. Hands down, Professor Vaughan is the best professor at UW. Clear expectations-pedagogy & energy motivate proactive learning-compassionate & understanding-always willing to help & listen-inspirational . Professor Vaughans' influence was instrumental in my success at UW. Thank you Professor Vaughan

-inspirational -not many tests, -clear on grading -there for you -participation matters -group project based -would take any of her classes.   She is an awesome teacher and she will answer any questions you have. and shes very funny and will try for some laughs in class :)

Prof. Vaughn is a breath of fresh air. Prof. V's genuine concern for her students' future, encourages her students to go outside their proverbial box. She helped me tremendously during a very stressful time, and she is always willing to go the extra mile for her students. Her lectures are engaging, and push you to use your critical learning skills.
I really liked this class a lot and it made me go outside my comfort zone since I didnt think I was that good.

Grading are very subjective, especially participation. Class is very unengaging (its a technical class tbh) and boring. how come we can participate in a lively way and get good participation score?? This is basically a self taught class. 3 quiz, 2 projects. Not a bad prof, but yeah....
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 3 multiple choice quizzes and 2 projects, one group and one individual. Took her almost a month and a half to grade my first project. Very boring, unengaging, lectures. Not a bad person, but be prepared to teach yourself, the lectures barely helped me at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 3 20mins MC tests, super dry lectures that basically read directly from the PowerPoint. and 2 projects.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Valerie was one of the best professors I had. She taught at a pace that was easy to keep up with and explained everything in great detail. She really knows her stuff and cares about all of her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Valerie is an AMAZING professor. She cares about her students and wants to see them succeed. She is very clear in making sure the students understand the concepts. The course is tough but I learned so much in her class. She is willing to help you when you are struggling and will teach you different ways so that you can understand where numbers

Professor Valerie inspires you to love accounting. she helps us whenever she can. Accounting is not an easy class but she helps you do well in her class. Valerie was extremely knowledgeable about the subject, and that showed in her lectures. The tests are difficult. You do need to spend a lot of time to study.

She is a funny teacher and willing to help you. She gives a lot of extra credit. Test heavy as mid-term and Final are most of your grade. Online video lectures not helpful. Tests not too difficult, but be sure to study only the hw and the practice tests to prepare. Allows one page of notes, front and back. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Li is a caring instructor. She cares about how you learn. You got her emails when you missed your homework. Exams are hard but you can do it if you keep up with the class. Strongly recommend.

Valerie is awesome. The class is hard but she made it easier to learn. Some classes are taught online. But it is not like an online course where you do not see your instructor. Valerie is super approachable. Very responsive to emails.

Valerie was a really solid teacher for Intermediate Financial Accounting I. Half the class was video online learning, so you didn't have to attend class some days, which was super nice for most people. She gives lots of extra credit, its definitely reasonable to walk out of the class with a 3.7+ with the way she curves! She teaches very well.
Amazing professor. She is very passionate in class and wants to see her student succeed.

the most genuine, caring, enthusiastic professor I have ever had the pleasure of sitting through! Valerie is by far the best accounting teacher I've ever had at UWB!I highly recommend taking her classes.
Professor Li is an excellent professor. Shes always kind and helpful. I am glad I had her!

She is one of the worst professors at Bothell. She just uses her powerpoint for her lectures, but you have a better chance reading the textbook. The quizzes were okay, but the tests were confusing because she writes them in her own way that was different than in class. The homework was useless too. Don't take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This is the worst Professor I e ever taken. She teaches straight from PowerPoint the entire lecture at a very slow pace. The class with this professor was the most useless 10 weeks of my life. Quizzes are simple. Homework is completely irrelevant to the material covered inside the class. Youll be fine on exams as long as you study the reviews.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved taking Valarie's class for Accounting. I am taking it in the Winter quarter of 2017-2018 and I have had nothing but good things to say about Valarie. Extremely clear on her expectations for exams, and she has no problem clearing things up when students are confused. I absolutely loved Valarie and her teaching style. Love Love!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Worst class I have ever had the misfortune of taking. Please just do yourself a favor and don't take Valerie- ever. Especially if you are an accounting major who actually wants to learn the subject. I feel like I have just wasted 10 weeks of my life in her class, learning nothing and being left feeling frustrated and completely confused. Horrible!

Professor Li does a terrible job teaching accounting. The average grade on both the midterm and the final for my class were below 60%. You think she does an okay job until she hands you a study guide and you realize you know only 1/3 of what's on it, then when you ask for help she cannot explain anything on it. 2/10 would never take again.

I say "get ready to read" because that was the only way that I learned anything. Maybe it was just a miss-match of learning styles. I learned nothing from lectures. The tests had nothing to do with lectures or homework. I left upset, sure I failed the final. I am incredibly confused about my grade, but very happy I passed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her class is boring but you have to go to class to get participation points. Midterm and final are easy. A group presentation at the end of the quarter. She doesn't post your grade in Canvas so you don't know your grade in final exam and presentation.

She is a great professor and person. She knows a lot about the topics that teaches and she is passionate about it, so the lectures are great. Absolutely great professor! She is super informative and organized. Very easy to get in contact with and the course was relatively easy.

This is the worst professor I've ever had. She does not teach at all, just lectures through the powerpoints. The homework is somewhat irrelevant. Quizzes are fairly simple. Focus on the review guides and you should be fine.

Bored during the lectures since she uses powerpoints. She solves some problems on the board which is helpful and learning catalytics is very, very helpful as well. Easy A on HW and quizzes and exams are mirrors of those as well. To do well, participate, do learning catalytics, HW & quizzes, and read the book.

Valerie is pretty easy. But with that being said, I really wish she was clearer on her grading policy. She doesn't post any grades on canvas, so you're left guessing how you're doing. Her curve was strange as well. Apparently she curves higher for lower grades but the better you do, the lower the curve
This is so far the best accounting class I have taken. The professori is super clear on concepts. Also super helpful. The tests are tough.

She tends to go really fast on lectures and so it's definitely hard to follow and take notes at the same time. Answers to all hw is given online quizzes are online, midterm was hard. She doesn't explain well and her hand writing are small everything was hard to follow. She was explaining stuff that we weren't going to be tested on.

She was very very very bad! She would make so many errors in her lessons, then fix them on the spot, once you have learned the wrong info. She didn't treat this class like an into, and expected us to grasp complicated ideas within a moment. If you have the option to run, RUN!

Too many negative comments about Valerie . ..this class was super easy, 80% of it was recap from 200-level, seriously, only a little bit of new info.  If you plan on being an accounting major, this class should be easy. If it's hard for you, choose another major!  She's nice, and helpful, but honestly you shouldn't need help, it's EZ!

If you value your education then avoid this professor. She is extremely unorganized, incredibly difficult to understand and harder to hear. She tells you to read the book, yet can not handle basic objections when its pointed out that what she is saying directly conflicts with it. TA does the grading and uses tests she has not written or looked at.
Best Professor! Helpful and patient. Her schedule is busy but she tries hard to help you! The best thing is she listens to you. Hard exams but she grades generously.
Nice professor with awesome personality! Approachable and organized. Highly recommend taking this class. You need to keep up and you'll be fine.

Not organized at all, jumps back and forth from one concept to another. Avoid her for managerial accounting!! I usually get above 3.0 in all my classes. This is the first time I got under 3.0. The quizzes, homework, midterms, and finals are nothing alike which made it harder.

Admit it, Accounting is tough.  Valerie is extremely helpful in clarifying class material. There are a lot of chances to earn points since she has a good variety of assignments. She only tests what she taught and went over in class. Go to class, pay attention, read the book and you will do well. Don't expect an easy A being lazy and restless.

Valerie is awesome. It is hard for her to explain the material but she does everything possible to teach you. The notes that she gave were amazing. Really helpful for exams. Make sure to study sample exams, the actual exams are almost the same. Relatively easy course.

I was a little uneasy at first with her lectures, however with time I started really liking Valerie. She is extremely nice and helpful! Almost every class she made everyone laugh, she is so amusing! :) I wish I could take her again for my future acctg courses.
She's not an easy teacher, but all accounting classes are hard. She doesn't spend enough time showing the actual math, a lot of what she does in class is talk about the concepts.
Extremely tough, did not understand a word in class.You have to do most of your learning from the book, which is pretty good. Midterm and finals are pretty hard. try to avoid.

She has strong academical knowledge. She is able to push the class to a upper level. She is very nice to students, and has bunch of time after class to help. Since English is not her fist language, it is unfair to judge her. Generous on scores.

Very bad professor, hard to understand, wastes a lot of time, does not do many practice problems. Reads slides. Super slow paced with no energy or enthusiasm. You will be sitting frustrated. Count on a lot of self study. No quizes, 3 small group projects and 1 big group report, homework online. If you can, do NOT take her.

Lectures don't really pertain to the content at all. Attendance is graded, but going to class does not feel helpful because you barely learn anything. You have to teach yourself the material to really understand anything.

Shes nice and cares a lot about students for sure. My first review got taken down somehow but you will not learn a thing in this class unless u learn yourself outside class. Extremely unprepared and gives answers for every single test in class without explanation. Will not respond to messages sometimes.

If you want to learn the material, take another professor. If you want an easy A, this class is for you. She gives out a lot of bonus points, does the quizzes for you, and if you have questions on the final she helps answer them. The midterm was on canvas. Bad at teaching but easy for grading.

She is my favorite teacher at bothell. I'm not great at math but she was able to explain the concepts really well. I never used excel before this either and i genuinely learnt a lot. She's also the nicest and most caring professor I've ever had.
she's very caring the class was light work

Easy A due to online quizzes and a kind professor. However, mandatory attendance was painful. Lectures were agonizingly slow and included 30-60 minute off-topic rambles. Critical material was barely covered; focus was on basic concepts like median/mode. The professor also talks super slow. However, I'd take her again for the easy grade.

0/10. Fine if you just need credit and get math. If math is a struggle run! No respect for students names or time, bad lectures, never on time, barely in class. Easy work but bad questions on the test. Will test for things she doesn't teach. rude, unprofessional, and a poor educator. Seems to be better for higher level math. Easy on late work/tests

If you need to actually learn, don't take her. She never knows what she's doing and is often late to class or never shows up to the zoom meetings. Terrible communicator, will not respond to emails unless you go to your advisor to get a hold of her. Never updates canvas so you don't ever know what your grade is. Worst class i've taken.
If you struggle with math please take her

she was a sweet woman and everything, but she cannot teach or explain how to solve things. you need to learn on your own. don't go if you want to learn, do go for an easy A if you already know the material. very lenient on due dates.

Unfortunately, many of the recent negative reviews for Professor Williams were true for Summer 2025. Canvas pages were often broken, professor was frequently late to class, lectures were unbelievably unhelpful, wasted class time on "polls", and so on. You'd be better off with Youtube videos.

Professor was consistently late to all of her lectures. She doesn't actually teach anything, but instead just reads off of notes that are incomprehensible. She's nice, but do not expect learning anything that will help in Calculus. If you actually need to learn, take a different professor; Or, if you want an easy A, take this class, you won't learn

Not the greatest, much of class was lecture over the lecture notes that are completely unreadable 90% of the time. Definitely caring about students, but EXTREMELY disorganized and consistently late to class (even close to an hour late to the final). Easy class for an A, hard to really learn anything.
Professor is extremely disorganized. Does not teach properly and doesn't respond to emails or messages asking her questions. Avoid.

Professor doesn't teach. She gives us lecture notes that are extremely difficult to read. In class we have to do polls for the majority of it. Doesn't respond to emails. Avoid if you want to learn. She's extremely caring and I can tell she loves her students. But avoided teaching when she could and plenty students fell behind.

professor cares about the students but cannot teach. She reads off her illegible notes and spends 30-50 minutes each class on polls. entire class just ends up being a quick useless review. if you already understand the concepts, then i guess the class would be fine; however, if you're trying to learn, it's best to stay away.

I don't know why her ratings are so good. She is a good person, but man... I did not learn a single thing from her. It is a really easy class to pass, but if you want to actually learn the material.. don't take her class. She let us use our phones on the final because not everyone had a calculator. Go straight to calculus if shes the only option.
Amazing professor recommend taking

Professor Williams is kind, caring, and genuinely wants the best for her students! Workload was manageable, and I found the class to be a nice refresh to prepare for Calculus. Overall, the class was good!
Really down to earth, humble, and understanding.

Professor Williams was very funny, sweet, lenient, and patient. She's a very easy grader, not the best teacher but the class is pretty easy if you know basic high school algebra. Lots of in class work done in groups, which is how you basically "learned and practiced". You follow her as she does the work. The grade scale is very even and fair.

Sweet lady but meh teacher. Our class was supposed to be in person for the whole quarter but she ended up switching to Zoom in the second week of school starting and only taught in person a few times after that. Super disorganized, seems like she's lost constantly. Doesn't know how to teach but tests are take-home which makes it easy. Solid A-C.

Professor Deborah Williams is a bit of a mixed bag. Her workload is low, but she doesn't explain every topic. Whether or not you should take her depends on your current knowledge of the course content.

Professor Deborah "Debby" Williams is a bit of a mixed bag. Her workload is low, but she doesn't explain every topic. Whether or not you should take her depends on your current familiarity with the course content.

Took her for PreCal 1/2. All tests/quizzes were take home, so you can imagine how well everyone did ;). Overall, you will prob learn nothing in her class as she is very disorganized and does not have the greatest lectures. Easy 4.0, but I can't imagine having her as a teacher for a class you actually need to properly comprehend.

She is one of the easiest prof Ive had in terms how lenient she was on hw deadlines and grading but she almost never taught the material in class leaving you to do all the teaching yourself outside of class. Class time was wasted on polls and hw questions but never had any proper lessons on what we needed to learn for hw or exams.
I love Professor Williams ! Her lectures may be a bit long sometimes but as long as you follow along, you are surely to get a 4.0. I wish she taught my calc class.

Nice professor but she really does not seem like she knows what she is teaching sometimes. She is very disorganized. I feel like these reviews are fake, or the negative ones aren't showing. I know several other students who felt that she was very slow and that made her lectures very boring and hard to follow.

Professor Williams is generally so kind and generally cares about students. Her exams are posted online as a PDF and she will give you multiple days if not weeks to work on it. If you missed an assignment or are falling behind, she will let you submit it late. Prof Williams is so chill and generally wants her student to succeed. Take her if you can

Take her she is really sweet and understanding literally the best professor at UWB she helps you out if you need help and make sure the class understand the context. There is a lot of material a midterm and final its online but she make it so you get it

Professor Williams is such a caring and kind professor. She is generally so interested in teaching this course. She assigned us 100 late passes and is so lenient about everything. It is extremely hard to fail this class. Take her if you can!

Debby is super nice but you will not learn much in this class. Pushes back deadlines and HW is insanely easy, as well as take home midterm/final. No reason not to 4.0 this class. Do not take if you need to learn stats. She is very caring and wants you to learn but is the most lenient professor I have ever had

I love Debbie! Incredible teaching. 100% recommend you take her classes. Assignment and project instructions are clear, office hours are easy to schedule, and feedback is incredible! She is also really funny and caring.
Easiest professor ever. I guarantee you will get an A in her class. Her teaching is lecture heavy, but she goes at a pace that you can handle it. Homework is easy. Midterm and final are easy.

Could not have asked for a better prof for this class. One of the most caring profs I've ever had who tries to get everyone to participate a little bit to get people to learn something. If you are confused on something simply asking her for help will be enough to get you an answer.

Professor obviously cares a lot about her students' learning. Even after having surgery, she still made optional lectures that we could all watch, and, on Fridays, she hosted optional zoom sessions for students who needed help on any homework. She also gave us a study guide for the final which made review pretty straightforward. Overall great teach

She's a really caring and considerate professor and I'd definitely recommend taking her for other things like MATH 123 or BBUS 215. Her lectures can drag a bit but you take the time to reach out and attend office hours and stay a bit after her classes, she'll be more than happy to make sure you know what to do. Very wholesome professor.
BEST PROFESSOR IN THE UNIVERSE

Hands down the BEST professor at UWB. I love Debby because she was such a caring teacher! She always went above and beyond to ensure that we understood the material. She is easy to talk to, and always in a good mood. If you don't understand something go to her Office hours!! She truly cares about her student's success, which is very motivating.

Debby is such a sweetheart. There is no reason for you to not get a 4.0 in this class because she is so lenient with deadlines and an easy grader. Seriously, take her class if you can! If you don't understand anything, ask her, she is super caring and wants you to get the highest grade possible. All HWs are on mystatslab and 2 group projects.

Professor Williams is hands down my favorite professor I've had. She has a kind heart and cares a lot about her students. If you're planning on taking Calculus I would recommend taking it with her, she ensures you understand the material, and is very understanding if you need an extension.

Debby is an amazing Professor she honestly has a heart of gold and I would love to have her as a teacher again. She was my teacher for calc 1 and business stats, received a 4.0 in both AMAZING TEACHER!!!!!

I came into the class after seeing his 5/5 rating here thinking "there is no way a professor can have that many 5 star reviews". I was wrong. If you have the opportunity to take him for a class, do so by any means possible. Trust me.

Exceptional and very likeable person and professor! He is committed to the success and satisfaction of all his students. Most instructors only collect feedback at the very end of the course when it's too late to benefit you, but this instructor seeks it throughout. I'll miss being in his class. I wish he could teach more classes.

No words can describe my feelings for this professor. He is the GOAT. Definitely take him, you will learn a lot from his experience, and he invited a guest speaker who inspired students like us to work in the cybersecurity field.
Amazinh!!! Just amazinh!!! Loved his class!!! Loved the presentation that he invited guest speakers to about dark web!!! Honestly one of the best ever classes i have taken!!!
I loved his class it got me more into cybersecurity. He is really nice and generous. Definitely recommend.
Great professor, great person, highly recommend him. Very enthusiastic about the subject and cares for his students. Frankly, there isn't anything else I can say except he is just an amazing guy.

Professor Lidster is amazing. He really cares about the topic he is teaching in a way that makes you really care. The lectures were always interesting, he was extremely kind, and in each lecture, he would tell us dad jokes. 10/10 would take this class again.

There are no words for me to express how much I loved this class, and it was all because Lidster! He was an incredible teacher; this class is not even part of my major, but I would take it again just to have him again. He's extremly caring and passionate; cybersecurity was never IT for me, but he sure made a great job at making it interesting!

BEST PROFESSOR EVER! He genuinely cares about student's well-being and health. He made the class engaging and easy by giving us hints and making tests easier. In addition he'd release the class early if we've gone through the content for the day!!

HANDS DOWN THE BEST!!! After his class was over I cried. The most caring individual I’ve ever meet. A inspiration to me. Words cannot describe how caring he is to his students. He really sparked my interest for cybersecurity. Love his class. You won’t regret taking him. The coursework was light and impactful. He is a gem at UW.

TAKE HIM!! Honestly I was loosing faith in the whole CS department until I took his class! Easy to follow lectures, super caring, and straight to the point! There are a few papers, but not a lot of "fluff" work! The way he teaches and explains things, I could be in a coma and still pass because of how clearly he explains stuff!! You'll learn a LOT!
What an absolutely wonderful professor. You can tell he really cares about his students' learning and growth. His teaching is clear and concise, and he takes students' feedback seriously.

Best professor I have ever had. Not only did I learn A LOT but I had so much fun doing so. The way he taught made it so much easier to retain the information. He was always clear, straight forward, reasonable, transparent personality, willing to help and answer absolutely any question and always showed us that our learning is important to him.
Best professor I ever had.
I would take this man for every class if I could. You will NOT regret having him. You'll likely fall in love if you take him.

A truly exceptional professor. He cares deeply about the success of his students, both in class and in their careers. The workload is very manageable, and not a minute of it feels wasted. His decades of industry experience help make the material even more interesting a relevant. Please do yourself a favor and take one of his classes if you can.

An amazing professor. Even said that "everyone should get an A in my class". Little to no busy work, most things have a purpose. Flies through lectures fast. Always willing to answer questions, related or unrelated to topics at hand. Extremely invested in his students and their success. A lot of topics covered, quizzes are open-note/internet.

I have had him for 2 classes. He gave out clear instructions and made it clear what you needed to do to succeed in his class. Gave out helpful tips for succeeding in the workplace and life, I really like him.

Honestly one of the best professors I've ever had (took css310 and 415 with him). Lidster should be the standard for others. He's beyond caring when it comes to a students success and learning achievements. He's always down to talk and has a ton of experience working in the field. An absolute MUST TAKE if you ever get the chance! A solid gem at uwb

Nicest professor I've ever had! He made the information easy to understand and the told us exactly what was going to be covered on the exam. As long as you take simple notes during the lectures you should pass with flying colors.
Biweekly presentation and group essays. 2 quizzes, and no final. His lectures are amazing and easy to follow. This might be different from 310 but it was a great class.

An absolute gem at UWB! One of the most caring and helpful professors i've had yet going into my senior year. He takes the extra time to make sure everyone finishes his courses strong. His classes do have lectures, but they're mostly open discussion with students. There is a paper every 1-2 weeks, but he gives you examples to follow. A must take!

Relatively new to UW but has been my favorite teacher this quarter. He has a good mix of humor and actual information that make lectures a lot more bearable. Quizzes are a great kind of learning checkpoint to make sure you're following and he is extremely caring and wants his students to succeed so if you're struggling he's always happy to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: This is one of the best professors I've had at UWB! I believe it was either Prof Lidster's 1st or 2nd quarter here but he has been fantastic! If you're taking CSS310, this is the guy. He has 2 or more DECADES of experience with cybersecurity and teaches this class in an amazing way. Quizzes are really easy (open everything). Take him if you can :)

This class is way too hard for a 20th-century American literature class. No extra credit opportunities are given as options for students to boost their grades, and she expects a lot from her students. I wouldn't recommend taking her. She rambles way too much, taking away from instruction. Doesn't care about you, and it was a big waste of my time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Nice teacher, reasonable grading, but confusing lectures that are basically rants make this class harder than it should be.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Taking right now and currently have a 4.0. Some frustrating or confusing choices in books, but more or less a good class.

She's a nice person, but the class was way harder than it should have been. You get grades late and there's not much that's worth going to class for aside from group work. You'll be fine if you do the work and participate.

One of my favorite professors. Took her twice. Challenging but rewarding. Many students complain about her, but I found that those who did usually came to class unprepared. She makes you work, but if you make an effort, she will go out of her way to help you any way she can. Amazingly knowledgeable.

She's super knowledgeable, and the books assigned were great, but her lectures were long, boring, and not super discussion based. She's very nice, but grades hard and has high expectations. I studied more for this class than my other two combined.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Most difficult class I have taken at UWB, due to the complete lack of awareness and organization of the professor. She knows a great deal about the subject matter but is a very bad teacher. Unreasonable expectations. Majority of the class was her rambling about everything.

One of the best professors at UWB, IF YOU ACTUALLY WANT TO LEARN. Yes, her classes are hard, but her expectations are clear from day one. Just show up, be on time, prepare to participate from the readings, and use her guides on Canvas to write good papers. Don't take her if you're a lazy student who just wants a 4.0 in a VLPA class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Watts' classes are content-heavy and involve lots of reading. You not only read good books but learn about why and how we read with theoretical resources. She provides great feedback when it comes to assignments. Three essays dispersed throughout the quarter, which require a great deal of time and effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Worst professor I have ever had. Goes way too far off topic and has the worst attitude towards students. I would never take a class she teaches ever again.

Linda is a very nice lady but she's rather scatterbrained and not very clear in her expectations. When I took her class on Zoom last fall, I found myself dipping from class early several times because I just didn't really connect with the material or her teaching style. Wouldn't recommend this class to students who aren't English or related majors.

This class was a joke. She gives out A's easily but NEVER any perfect scores, and you can tell. She's always nitpicky about SOMETHING. I only took it because I'm planning for teacher certification programs.

Linda was great! Writing assignments are the main mode of teaching so be prepared - they aren't easy but they do an excellent job of making you think and reflect critically on the concepts from class - be thorough, follow the prompt & you'll be fine! I loved the readings and format, and have a much better understanding of how literature works now.

Professor Watts is very nice however you will have to work for your grade. There is a lot of reading and writing, and many small in-class assignments, but as long as you work hard and turn in your work on time you will get a good grade -- she is not that tough, and more concerned with critical thinking and reflection. She's not out to get you.

I took BIS 370 last quarter and am currently in 371. She's a nice person but very disorganized and not the best lecturer, more so this quarter than last. Since the assignments are somehow all the same, her classes can be pretty easy but repetitive if you know what she wants to see on them - read the prompts carefully.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Watts is a nice person, but her class is just...difficult. I can tell she's passionate about the subject but she tries too hard to get too much done without enough time. The assignments weren't explained very well so there was a lot of confusion among students. If you dont like group work, she's not the teacher for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lectures are extremely boring. Professor Watts rambles and repeats herself for the majority of the time and we lose lots of lecture time because of it. It is hard to concentrate and to actually be interested in the literature read in this class except for the book-length works as most of them make little sense.

Linda literally doesn't teach anything in her lectures. Course content and material are really cool, and the assignments are fun enough, especially in groups, but there's no support from her as a teacher. DON'T take her if you don't want to teach yourself.

Avoid this professor at all costs. Her emails are rude and so is her feedback on writing. She doesn't lecture in an organized way, doesn't explain assignments well, and just kind of leaves you hanging for support that she can't give.

Nice lady and gives great career tips for those interested in teaching, but she's not really a good instructor. Will loop around a topic for way too long to the point where you feel horribly lost because of her rambling. Not much useful content to gain during the lectures but they may still help you understand the books read in class and essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I took several classes from Prof. Watts. She was harder depending on the level of class she was teaching. I took BISAES 364 (historical fiction), BIS 371 (c20 lit), BIS 407 (children's lit), got A's in all 3. She's a nice person, and is knowledgeable, but has high expectations of students and fails to teach in any sort of organized way.

Prof. Watts is a very pleasant person, but I found the books and assignments to be uninteresting and shallow and when I discussed my papers with her after they had been graded: she was incapable of clearly stating what I could have done differently to get a higher score. Very frustrating, unpleasant class. I'll be avoiding her in the future.

Mixed feelings. While she is nice and communicates very clearly, she is disorganized and also the hardest grader ever - subtracts points as for trivial reasons. You may follow the rubric and think you did well but the realize that you get a B. A 4.0 is 97% or above in her grade scale. It is impossible to get a 3.8+ in this class.

Mixed feelings. Prof. Watts is passionate about her subject and has cool class actvities, but is a really tough grader. Definitely plays favorites like these other reviews say: she LOVES students who participate, ask questions, or show engagement with the class material, and hates those who are lazy and want things handed to them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Watts doesn't care about your outside life at all. Most teachers have been pretty understanding and compassionate in this pandemic, but Professor Watts is not one of those. I work full time and go to school full time and I reached out to Professor Watts about this and she basically told me to suck it up. Really tough grader. No late work.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Worst professor I have had at UWB. She was unclear about a lot of assignments and blatantly played favorites. Class was agony to attend and always by far my least favorite part of the day. I'm still unsure what the class was even about. If you are thinking of taking a literature class for VLPA credit find a different professor.

DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS. We are in the middle of a pandemic, yet she has no compassion for her students at all. She grades very tough, will mark down points with no explanation at all. There is no rubric for any assignments. Having camera on and talking counts towards your grade. No matter how much effort you put in, your grade won't reflect it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Don't take this class because she would question your abilities & it will greatly affect your MENTAL HEALTH! Even you are participating in this class, do all the writing, and EVERYTHING SHE ASKED FOR, she will GRADE YOU LOW. The thing is, SHE NEVER HAS CRITERIA FOR GRADING OR COMMENTS WHY YOU HAVE SUCH A LOW SCORE. IF YOU MSG/DM HER, SHE IS RUDE.

This professor lacks the ability to teach in any sort of organized way but somehow she is aware of that and compensates grade-wise. She plays favorites quite blatantly - likes students who participate a lot and complete work.
Good Professor. Only gripe is that she talks and talks and goes on these long-winded tangents that cost the class valuable time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Great teacher, although she does assign a LOT of reading and homework, but it's best to always stay on top of things. If you won't be attending class, make sure to let her know beforehand so you're excused on that day's in-class work. Very, VERY enthusiastic about class content and very helpful if you reach out. Feedback is really detailed.

Linda was such a good professor! She was extremely caring and kind, a good lecturer, and gave great (REALLY detailed) feedback on essays. Expect to write about 3 papers throughout the quarter and you will read 2 novels and a few short stories. Class is mostly discussion of the readings. If you like to read then this is a great class to take!

Definitely a veteran in literary studies - founding faculty, managing editor for a teaching journal, etc. - but she's really awesome. She is easy to talk to and if you need an extension or help with a paper she will grant it. Also has a great sense of humor.

She is a very tough grader and gives dry lectures. Will not let you make up in-class work. I told her I worked full time so I might miss class and she told me to rethink my priorities. If you don't work and have time to devote to this class, she will be fine, but if you are a student who works a lot, find another teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Amazing and very understanding professor. Very clear about assignments and grading. Very sweet and friendly too, always ask for help if you need it, whether that be an extension or anything - I feel really welcome in her class. Great class, put thought into your answers and DO ALL THE READINGS (seriously) and you'll do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Halfway through the class and I love everything about it. Linda is extremely respectful of diverse student opinions, and makes assignment guidelines clear. She cares a lot and is very accessible in office hours. She always makes class more interesting and engaging. The papers and homeworks aren't hard and graded fairly.

Linda will certainly make you work - but as long as you show up to class and show at least some interest while completing her assignments you will certainly be fine. Says she's in your corner and is a fair grader. Will challenge you, for sure, but she really wants to see students succeed.

It's only midterm week but I really like Linda and highly encourage others to take her classes. She is highly knowledgeable and genuinely passionate about literature. Gives very helpful comments on essay drafts before the final one is due, and really does her best to help students succeed. Please take any class with Linda that you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: This is my second class with Linda. I must say she's very insightful and very kind. You can tell she cares about students and their learning. She's always here to help you and is a fair grader - but do be warned because there is a lot (and I mean a LOT) of reading. She is highly respectful of all opinions that may come in class discussions.

Definitely a freshman course in that Dr. Watts talks very slowly and calmly (it borders on patronizing). Very little reading assigned and few assignments but she grades tough so be sure to thoroughly read the rubric and while the tone of the class isn't serious, she grades seriously. She does give back fantastic feedback on assignments though.

Always gives good feedback and the readings and assignments in this class are not necessarily hard. Her final assignment is very interesting! I highly recommend taking classes with her, especially this one. She's also very nice and very knowledgeable :)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Nice teacher but very confusing way of learning, everything is said to be synchronous when it is asynchronous and asynchronous when it is synchronous. I thought she graded pretty hard on writing assignments but she is very good at teaching the subject matter (and passionate too!)
I thought she grades pretty hard for essays, but she's still a very knowledgeable and enthusiastic professor. Not too much work to do in the class. I would consider taking another class with her.

This class was pretty easy homework wise, but there is no such thing as late work. For a VLPA credit I enjoyed the class and did not require lots of reading or studying, no tests or quizzes only a few written short personal essays and a presentation. Linda is nice but explains things to the point that you no longer understand.

Not gonna lie, I was scared when I saw her reviews on here, but I really like Linda's class. She's a very nice person and adapted very well to the turn of the century known as Zoom University. She's the kind of professor who's always available to chat and it's nice that she is if you're interested. Not a super tough grader but still a fair one.

Linda was definitely nice. However, her grading was confusing. She doesn't ever give specific guidelines. She doesn't provide rubrics ahead of time and doesn't really explain why she would take points off. She also assigned a lot of group projects during the pandemic which was inconvenient for me.

Not a fun class. The syllabus is in Q+A form and you have to click on each question, get taken to a new page for each answer - its extremely confusing to understand how the class works. Assignments are sprung upon us with no clear description. Never going to give you 100% on an assignment no matter how good. Talks but only makes you more confused.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Get ready for long explanations that only lead to greater confusion. Every handout she gives is almost 10 pages long on description of the assignment which is really unhelpful. ANTI-TECHNOLOGY, doesn't post grades and turns red any time someone has a laptop/phone out. Never heard of anyone getting 100% on any assignment. Treats you like a child.

Her lectures are usually short and concise, very hands on and really fun. You learn as much as you put in to the class, so remember that.  not too heavy with assignments and drops your lowest quiz score. Overall she's a great professor with lots of experience.

She is a chatter and will over explain things to the point of confusion. However, she knows her material and is obviously super passionate about teaching and her topics. If you need the class to graduate, maybe try a different course. If you are actually interested in the topic, then go for it!

The only difficulty I had was with the first assignment (close reading). Since the assignments were all pretty similar the rest were pretty easy but repetitive. You HAVE to keep up with readings and participate in group discussions but other than that as long as you try, she's a generous grader and encouraging English teacher.
She was great!  Don't take her class if you are a slacker!  I would take her again.  She is nice and very helpful!  Loved her class!

Linda is very smart and is a very good teacher.  The other students who made negative comments clearly didnt do their reading or their work.  Many students cut class or didnt turn in their work and then love to complain when they get a D.  I would take another class with her. She knows her stuff and I learned a lot!

This professor was soooo boring. She doesn't really lecture, and claims she doesn't talk much...but she rabbles on and on and on about everything until you are more confused. She is one of those teachers that will never give a student a 100% on a assignment, no matter how good it is. Her syllabus is like 13 pages long, and still nothing is clear.

This lady rubbed me the wrong way in every aspect of her and her class. I could have sworn i was back in high school by the way she treated her students. There was no compromising with her.Her way or the highway. She used bb as like it was a blog. The in-class writing exams were ridiculous. Love how she "forgot" to give us reviews at end of quarter
EXCELLENT but tough professor.  She was extremely helpful, and the class was fun!
there are many reasons why her classes are small.  Beware!

Was very helpful!  Always willing to work with me.  Does expect alot of involvment on Black Board, but you are always keep up to speed, no excuse to fall behind.  Most creative and engaging writing assignments, learned a ton.

GARBAGE!  I knew more about the film topic than this lady who would brag about never using a camera or a cell phone...100% unfair in class essays and she never taught one class but instead let 1/2 and less educated student talk about film theory ...worse class I ever took from UWB
No Comments

Worst Teacher I have ever taken! I could not stand talking to this lady. Her syllabus seemed alright, perhaps a bit of work; however, she is crazy! Expect at least 5 blackboard posts each class day. and oh yeah a day is dedicated to reviewing safety procedure. every other day is consistent of her blabbing on uselessly, she doesnt help students!
This class felt like a complete waste of time. Too much talking .. overdoes the whole bb thing ..

Over explains everything in class & on bb to the point where it is overwhelming! She is excessively strict about deadlines & grading. No exceptions, letter of the law mentality. Although she makes herself readily available to students, it does no good since she is so standoffish in her manner that you leave feeling derided by her intelligence. Make

Takes 3+ days to respond, most unclear grading criteria, extremely disorganized. I had 8 assignments due within the first week of the quarter. The amount of HW assigned was beyond unnecessary. I wish I was exaggerating when I say this is the worst experience I've had w/ a professor in my entire time at college(I'm a Senior). Would never take again.

Uses 4 different platforms for assignment, and doesn't grade anything until the very end of the quarter so you have no idea what your grade is. Constantly having complications with tech, so half of assignments are either delayed or cancelled. Lectures are pointless and a waste of time to go to, didn't provide any real world application in marketing

Not a good professor. She uses Kritik, CCUW, Stukent, and Canvas, which makes it really confusing to understand where your assignments are and keep track of everything. Lectures were a drag and not very informative. Her grading isn't very accurate and informative. The assignment instructions don't match the rubric.
Overall, the class was not as bad. There were simulations she made watch and learn from. I found Kritik was kind of annoying though.

Considering other reviews, if you aren't able to navigate canvas and other platforms, its a tech skill issue (stands for technical 🤓). There's a lot of assignments across different platforms, but they were relatively simple. I think Professor Yang brings fun concepts to courses but it can be confusing. Lectures can be interesting. Has a 30% accent

Extremely disorganized, makes you pay for multiple different simulations all of which teach you basically nothing. Coming to class was always a waste of time and it made more sense to just do the busy work online and not attend. Group heavy work and graded on Kritik by classmates evaluations which is pointless.

This professor uses 4 different platforms some of which are paid and don't add class value. There are so many assignments due within a day or two of each other and most of them are just busy work. She is also super unorganized and unclear about instructions and due dates. Not a hard class, but frustrating.

Professor uses Kritik, which means 25% of your grade will come from other students grading you and not the professor themself. There is revenge grading and if your score is low because classmates simply have a high horse, you will have to suck it up. Do not recommend, I did more work for an elective class than capstone courses.

Professor Yang made this course super engaging, even for someone like me who isn't as interested in the stats side of marketing. The interactive (though repetitive) assignments helped me grasp the concepts, and working with a client felt meaningful. She was also really understanding when life got in the way. I'd take another class with her for sure

The course is a mess; modules are all over the place and there's too much unnecessary work, all hw is busy work, uses two extra digital platforms you have to pay for, lack of care for students, disorganized & unclear group projects, and the overall coursework is just not worth it. First professor I've ever had difficulty with respecting.

She is new to UWB so structure was a little unorganized. Lectures are fun and she makes them interesting. Homework is pretty straightforward that are either individual or group that leads up to the final project and she is a chill grader as long as you show effort. Online midterm/final were difficult though. Individual simulation was fun also.

Love Love Love Jaki Yi! Such a helpful professor who offers help and advice to those seeking higher education. Her lectures are super entertaining, and the homework is pretty easy. I will def take more of her classes!!!!

Professor Yi is extremely knowledgeable and kind. She provides a great learning environment for students and is a great teacher overall. I learned so much in her class, and always felt comfortable reaching out to her.
i love jaki yi!

Took BIS368 with professor Yi. This is my second time taking her class and she is AMAZING!! She is a psych prof that UNDERSTANDS students mental health. Work load is never excessive and easy to understand. Absolutely would recommend her classes!!!

Things to expect:
-6 weekly homework quizzes
-1 Practice group project (lasts a day)
-1 Final group project (lasts roughly a month)
-Mid-term and Final exam (with an open notecard)
-Textbook Readings
-Semi-participatory in-class lectures

(Competent instructor and lectures. Main reading ideas are covered in lectures and used in exams. Rating: 4.75)

Professor Yi embodies what it means to truly be an educator. Professor Yi has never once made me feel lost as a student, and has a very clear path that you can follow even if you get lost along the way. If you earnestly do your work and do your best to engage with the class work, you will easily 90%+, this is coming from someone with a 2.5 gpa.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very sweet and understanding professor. Good feedback, interesting lectures and in-class activities. Attendance technically isn't required but there are in-class activities each day that go toward your grade, and she will often tell students in class what in the power points will be covered in exams.

Professor Yi is very knowledgeable, and makes even complex topics easy to understand. Her lectures are engaging, and she encourages questions and makes everyone feels comfortable participating. The assignments were well-organized, and her feedback was always helpful. She truly cares about her students' success.

If you're taking Intro to Psychology, I highly recommend Professor Yi! She's approachable, knowledgeable, and makes the subject easy to understand. I would definitely take another class with her in the future

I loveeee Professor Yi! I took her for Intro to Psych and she was amazing! She taught the lessons in an engaging and clear way. If a students takes a shot at answering a question and they're wrong, she'll help to guide them in the right direction while being really encouraging. The course content was also really interesting.
(BIS316-ASIAN AMERICAN PSYCHOLOGY) I

Very nice and attentive towards students. Has a lot of experience in the psych field. Short quizzes every week worth 10pts, as long as you do the readings you will do well on them, she drops the lowest quiz score at the end of the quarter. A lot of group work so make sure you sit with people you get along with.
nice lady, interesting class, lots of reading but simple assignments
I took her for Intro to Public Health Policy, and she was great. She cares about what she's teaching. There are graded in-class assignments and one group project

Honestly enjoyed her class. Very dedicated to teaching the materials and having us understand the concepts. Bunch of snowflakes on here acting like she owes them something, but if you pay attention and do your work, you learn a ton. She always takes her time thoroughly answering any questions you have which I really appreciated. Would def recommend

She's a super sweet and knowledgeable professor. However, she takes a long time to grade and respond to emails. I've emailed her on 2 separate occasions for a grade change on an assignment and that has not been done. She rambles during lectures, making it super boring so it's unnecessary to show up.

I agree with what others have said. Guiding yourself on the lectures with the slides at home would probably be more beneficial than spending time in class. The work is easy but she takes a very long time to grade. Very sweet and understanding lady, but I would rather take a different prof if I had to do it again.

i'm 99% sure she graded with AI. never posted grades in a timely manner. all her feedback was meaningless AI sounding slop. it docked a lot of points from my final because it said i was missing a section (i definitely wasn't) and when i emailed her she doubled and TRIPLED down before actually looking at what i submitted and giving me points back.

Professor Yi was a good person overall. Class felt useless in a way like it could all be said over a canvas announcement. Many people stopped showing up to class. Canvas and grading are very unorganized. Grading takes a long time. She does give 2nd chances if she finds you have used AI to complete an assignment. Work is easy.

Prof Yi is good but not great. She isn't really clear about assignments and takes a long time to grade things. Still haven't gotten a grade on a paper we did a month ago. She has an accent that makes it diffuclt to understand her in lecture. She says that she wants to reduce our stress but then gives us a group project.

Professor Padilla was very passionate about the topic and explained things in ways that made sense. You do have to show up to class and do the homework/readings in order to understand what is going on. The more effort you put in the more you will get out of the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Padilla is an awesome and passionate professor who is always engaged with the class. The assignments are easy if you follow the rubric, but the workload is extremely heavy. This was by far my most stressful class, mainly because of the amount of reading on top of the actual assignments. She's extremely slow at grading assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Respected

reviews.comment: Overall, if you do your work on time and participate, this is an easy class. The assignments can be a bit tedious, but doable. She's very attentive and kind, but willing to call on people at random if no one is participating.

Dr Padilla is a very kinda and compassionate professor who is extremely passionate about Ethnic studies. I have take two courses with her, both had weekly readings with a midterm and final, alongside a final paper. Her course can be alot if you struggle with readings. However, by participating in class and doing the readings, she will reward you.

Really nice, understanding and caring professor, I don't understand all the negative comments on here about her 'biases' because understanding and confronting history is not 'liberal'. She assigns a lot of work every week but it's doable. There is a final and a midterm, and an essay due at the end of the quarter.

very biased in all of her readings and assignments. doest see others perspectives but her very liberal one, and I say that as I'm in the middle of the political spectrum. not helpful when you need clarification and assumes your doing something wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She teaches a class with lots of biasses. She seems nice but beware she hates phones out during lectures and grades harshly sometimes

Extremely self centered. Thinks everything she says is correct and has a very narrow view point on things. When she doesn't agree with a student, instead of positively reinforcing them or trying to develop the conversation, she is condescending towards the student and tries to "push" them towards an answer that she thinks is correct. Don't take.

Honestly she's not as bad as everyone says. I took her BCORE as a last resort because I signed up for my classes late. Anyways she's a tough grader, but I always felt like she was clear and I could ask questions.
Yes a lot of reading, but not more than my other classes (I am a STEM major btw). Put effort in and she'll reward you for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: She has high expectations but they aren't very clear, even if she is always open to offering help. The assignments take a lot of time. Her grading was very subjective. Due to word limits (instead of page limits) the extent of your knowledge is not always communicated. If you want to spend hours on short assignments, this is the class for you.
As others have said...

Useless teacher for this latino studies class. Does not have an organized approach to the course at all. Her grading technique is a joke, unreasonable and very illogical. Unclear essay prompts and exams. Do not recommended at all!

She sucks at being communicative and is extremely specific on what she wants on certain assignments and exams. I would not take this class again because if you dont meet her requirements youll practically fail. She failed me on the midterm even if I wrote the right answers because she wanted me to write more on certain details.

She is really smart and you can tell. She is super specific on what she wants you to say on assignments. Her lectures were quite boring but luckily I didn't listen to them much. It was a lot of reading and material to get through which was stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Padilla is probably the best professor I've had here at UWB.
