Native American literature was one of my favorite classes. He truly enjoys his subject and is fair and reasonable in his work load.
I found most of the classes to be pretty boring (I took it as a requirement)... he knows his stuff, so if you love the topic I'm sure you'll learn a lot.
This prof is ok if you don't mind paying tuition for standup comedy.  Otherwise, save your money.
No Comments

This professor is fantastic. I would recommend that every student attending UWB take at least one class with him. I particularly liked BIS 366. He is funny and interesting to listen to, and really knows what he's talking about. I would say he's one of the best professors at this university.
Really seems to know his stuff and is very engaging.  I like the use of films in the course as well.  One of those courses that makes you think.  Seaburg was very approachable and encouraging.

very interesting class and professor is wickedly funny.  I thought his expectations were very clearly stated on each assignment and grades were more than fair.  It was a real shake up of my worldview (and I mean that in a good way).

Skillful professor.  Class time is divided with lectures and movies.  Does not like quotations in papers, and does not give much help to understand what he is really looking for.  Very vague at times.  Not a very interesting class.

I took BIS 209. I got 100% in that class. She was always very caring & put a lot of effort into seeming passionate about the topics we discussed. For this class, as long as you put real thought into the work, you will probably get an A.

Prof Carrie Bodle was very nice and gave clear instructions/grading criteria. Prior video editing experience not required but def makes it much easier. I strongly suggest taking this class, it was so fun :)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Carrie is a great professor to take for those in the IAS/MCS sphere or are interested in taking an intro course for video editing. She makes her expectations clear but also gives you ample room for initiative to be creative with your projects. This class will give you as much as you put in to it. I learned a lot about editing videos now.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Carrie is so fun. She's a talented artist and a passionate professor. I learned a lot, despite the course not quite lining up with what I hoped I might get from it. She was extremely organized and very clear about her expectations, which I thought were very reasonable.

BISIA 344 is one of the best courses I've taken at UWB. 10 weeks to learn a lot about different forms of video production. Lectures are intriguing. The assignments are interesting and graded fairly. Prof. Bodle is a super nice person and willing to help you develop as an artist. If you are in the MCS major like me, take her.

I love Carrie. I took her my first quarter at UWB and have had her for three classes total. I am totally inspired in all of her classes and am so grateful I got to work with such a  wonderful professor.

She's nice but not a super easy grader, you have to invest time in your projects to get a good grade. Got a 3.3, granted I could have done a lot more with my projects. We went on a pointless field trip to henry which was mandatory but had no real purpose. We didn't even get to see inside the gallery. I learned a lot about video though.

She's a good teacher. The class wasn't for me. But she was super helpful and nice. She made the class more interesting. I think she was a bit worn out this quarter (pregnancy). But she's engaging and well versed in the subject. Assignments are clear and she's passionate about her course.

Very enthusiastic about the arts, brings a lot of passion. She is very helpful about everything. But classes are discussion based, which gets a little boring at times, and can seem unproductive. But the video part of the class was very interesting.
Spent a lot of time giving project feedback and really cares about her students.
Gives feedback that's completely useless. Doesn't ever give out good grades even if you follow the advice given to you.
Awesome and helpful

His lectures, when he held them, were quite entertaining. He is a funny guy, and certainly understands digital forensics very well. However, he constantly cancelled class, and some of the classes he did host were too short and not very beneficial to understanding the topic. The class was a very easy A, but I didn't end up learning a whole lot.

I think if you are looking for an easy A this is a great class. Majority of the learning is done though textbook readings, most lectures are canceled (5) this qtr for us. I wouldn't say I learned as much as id like to have from this course but still a pretty chill class!

Real recognizes real - Kuzma is the professor to take if you have an internship/job over the summer! Super chill, flexible with time, and always strives to make his lectures interesting via guests which ranged from CEOs of companies to dark web software brokers. Some of his earlier lectures were pretty boring, but then ramped up week 3.
Extremely nice, funny, and chill professor. You can learn a good amount from this class and generally, he tries to make classes fun and short.

I know why everyone loves Bobby, the course is the easiest A ever. We had 2, 1 page papers and that was it. Class constantly was cancelled. Lectures were half sitting in silence or listening to a tangent, or lecture slides that didn't teach anything. Honestly was a waste of tuition, yet will get you the 5 credits. He does grade fairly and is nice
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor Kuzma is a very nice person, he is understanding and nice to his students, in addition, he got a good sense of humor. but he will also point out where you need to improve which is good for your growth.

Every CSS student should take one of his classes. He's awesome and really knowledgeable and passionate about cyber security. Assignments are straightforward and he wants you to do well on them. His 310 class was fully async, not sure about his others.

Took his summer CSS 310 class. Nice guy, really passionate about cybersecurity and really inspirational towards students interested in a similar path. Straightforward assignments/projects that are relevant to the field. A much better Kuzma than the NBA player.
Very passionate about his subject. Very easy to talk to. Lenient on deadlines and grading. Very interesting and engaging class.

Bobby is a great teacher! You can tell he really cares about his students' learning and growth. Assignments are straightforward and easy to complete with the resources he provides. Canvas page is very organized. He should teach more classes in CSS.
Really fun prof to take, if you are looking for an easier class and just want to learn about the subject I highly suggest taking one of his courses.

Probably the best professor you'll ever have in your university career. He's really relaxed on requirements and basically guarantees you a 4.0. Would rather teach you than have you do boring work. Really amazing guy :) wish more professors were like him

Arguably easier than other sections due to having Leetcode and paper assignments instead of the programming assignments that the other sections have. I've taken Awad's 343 previously and decided to retake as I didn't do well on the final and IMO the hw content has the same difficulty. Pan makes it easier due to better direction and explanations.

Professor Pan is great, he is patient and can clearly explain everything. But the grader of this class is a bummer, she grades harshly and unreasonably without a grading rubric. She even deducts your points with the right answer, if you don't check it carefully, you even don't know you should get a higher score. the thing that makes it bad is that
Took CSS343 over the summer and it was a great course...highly recommend him for 343.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: His lectures can be a little dry, but he's very patient with answering questions during class and office hours.

The HW consists of 1-2 questions by hand on paper, then tricky Leetcode mediums. Only 1 project at the end of the quarter. Pretty easy midterm/final. Not a lot of time spent coding so it's hard to know if we're being set up to succeed in future courses or not. Boxiang is great, just not much practice implementing topics into actual code
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He seams like he is very versed in his topic. He is very organized, thorough in his teaching, always willing to provide support, and very patient with questions or in office hours. Lectures were pretty mellow but personally interesting to me. He seams new to UW but adjusted quickly and non the less led the class very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He doesn't give feedback on grading. The study guide for the final is not comprehensive as he tells you. Lots of reading with the majority of class time not focused on the material you are going to be tested on. The material is good but I have never taken a class where I felt I spent so much time and effort for so little return.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Boss, has truly reached out to his students throughout the entire semester. Each lecture applies to real life situations. While taking this class you feel as you are growing as a person. The BHAG project will motivate you to better any aspect of your life. Lots of quizzes, 3 group presentations, 2 papers, Average Final.

BEST CLASS I EVER TOOK. He expects you to do the reading, but everything that we learned applied to leadership. He is very authentic and actually teaches things that you can directly apply in your life if you want to lead people. This class was not easy, but totally worth it.

quiz everyday. readings everyday. great stories and incredibly nice to everyone. The type of guy that will put 16 hours a day into teaching. participation, BHAG, and final is your whole grade. everything else does hardly anything so he grades that stuff super easy (quizzes aren't even worth much)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Alan is an amazing professor. He takes time to understand the needs of his students to make sure that class time is used wisely. The class itself is not easy! There is a ton of reading (5 different books + many articles). Pop quizzes almost every other class, 3 essays and cumulative final. If you work hard and participate, you will get a good grade

DON'T Take him and do yourself a favor, there is a quiz every class almost. A LOT of reading and the material wasn't really interesting. He ruined the class for me. If you're a female then though luck, he is self-righteous. He'll pretend that he's helping but he isn't. You'll work in this class but wont get and A also the final is cumulative.

Come to every class get extra .2 on your GPA. There are pop quizzes in every class but they are the same as the study guide. Most assignments are pass or fail. His final is not that hard if you just pay attention in class and read in depth. The BHAG essay took me a couple hours. The key to this class is to READ. Got a 3.8 and didn't try that hard.

This is the best experience I've had while attending the UWB school of business. Mr. Boss is very professional, and better yet, his is very passionate about what he is teaching. This is a true professor. Very balanced and material context that will be resourceful for a whole life.

Expect lots of POP Quizzes. Worst grade that I have received in my academic career. His expectations are not clear. Your essays will be "pass" or "fail" with little feedback. There is a A LOT of work, definitely a lot of effort was made for such a low grade. Avoid this class if you have a job as the readings+ workloads are kind of heavy.
He made it sound like your opinion matters, but in reality, it doesn't! Lowest grade I got in my entire college years. I hated his class. Didn't learn anything valuable.

As said before, best professor I have ever had! He is truly inspirational! His class is not easy, but I don't know that I have ever learned or grown that much from a class before. He has projects that help you work and improve yourself. Everything is straightforward and he does work with you to have the best experience.

Alan is the best teacher at UW Bothell hands down. His teaching style is incredible. He is a great leader and teacher. He is an inspirational person and professor. He makes class very interesting and relatable. Listens to what students want and is very flexible. Takes attendance very seriously. I HIGHLY recommend his BBUS402 and BBUS 473 class!

He teaches you like an adult, and expects you do to your work. With that said, it is one of the most inspiring classes I've taken. You learn more than just textbook stuff, you learn about yourself and life. Take him if you can.
Excellent professor.I like his teaching style.
Great teacher! One of the best at UWB.
Excellent prof!
Boss is the best prof I have had in my entire education. I graduate next quarter and really wish I had discovered this sooner.

You will have lots of reading to do and some quizzes. Most of the readings have easy concepts but they are helpful in dealing with daily life. Boss is an excellent professor, one of my personal favorites. He will make you feel proud of yourself if you do your own BHAG, even if you feel like you didn't achieve much. I highly recommend him.
Take this class! Alan Boss is the absolute best! Life changing, seriously- best experience of my education, and i graduate next quarter.

Lots of reading, lots of work, but the concepts are easy to grasp. The best part: Boss is genuinely interested in seeing his students succeed academically, as well as personally. His lectures are inspiring and relevant, and while you may question some of his methods at first, it turns out has excellent reasoning behind everything he assigns.

No wonder it is a required class. This is a life changing experience guys. He doesn't just teach about business or leadership. He teaches about LIFE. He helps you to become a better person. Do yourself a favor and take his class. Worth well the money. No joke!

Boss is an EXCELLENT teacher. I absolutely loved his class. Class was always interesting and I learned a lot through the course. I really appreciated that he is genuinely interested in the success of his students academically and personally.

The course is very reading intensive. However, the supplementary material Boss provides helps solidify the theory. Any business major who is looking to "make it big" should take this class. It gives you the tools for becoming a successful and well-adjusted leader.Oh, and it's very lecture focused: miss as few classes as possible.
he's the goat

I had him for Brain and Behavior he's very kind. He wants you to be engaged, and if you participate, you will pass. he's very understanding and really gets that people have different situations. Honestly, he's one of the best professors at UWB. It was an honor being in his class. I learned a lot about myself and what I want from the classes I take.

Dr. White is very kind and understanding, and he really cares about his students. But the class can feel unorganized, and lectures jump around, making it hard to follow. We also had fewer in-person sessions than expected, and grading was slow. Great person, just a confusing course structure. I'd for sure take his course again if I could!!

This professor has been my favorite out of all three years at UWB. He is so caring and understanding of students. There are 4 exams, all with inspirational quotes, and the one you did the worst on is dropped. They are cumulative. Most classes are over Zoom, and there is a lot of (easier) homework. He gives infinite extensions IF you email him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr, White's class was fine, but hard material that needed in-person learning for sure. I was fooled into thinking we'd have in person lectures every Tuesday/Thursday. He lives in Illinois. (we had 5 lectures out of 19 In person). if you are an in-person learner this might be difficult. The lowest test score is dropped. His PFs are kinda rude. 5/10.

Generally a great person. Very excitable, open, and understanding. However, his coursework lacks structure, making it difficult to follow. Lectures jump between multiple unrelated topics, creating confusion. Readings were straightforward, but the exams were unexpectedly challenging.

What a great proffesor! First time I got 100/100 on a exam. I really enjoyed all his lectures and the way he explained things just made sense. He is also a really funny guy it's kind of hard not to pay attention to lecture :)

Great person but not a good teacher. Made things very confusing, and when you asked a question, made it even more confusing. Lectures are very long; I fell asleep a few times. He is very understanding when it comes to missing assignments, always grades very late, even though he has TA's.

This professor is an amazing professor, with an engaging way of teaching the class. He is friendly and open to questions. However, I will admit that this professor may sometimes not get to everything in the slides because of his enthusiasm for the subject. Do not worry though, because anything not covered in class is not on the exams.

He is a nice person, not professor. He's enthusiastic but lectures are too long. He grades big assignment last day. Group work is depends on who you're with. midterm is hard, asks trick questions but lets you retake and takes average of 2 midterms. final is online. But his grading sucks. lectures go off topic.

While he is nice and cares for his students, his lectures can be complicated, long, and sometimes go off-topic. He also takes a while to grade regular assignments (with two student TAs), as the last half was graded around the quarter's last two weeks. However, he is understanding and will try to work with the students to resolve certain issues.
Professor was very kind and understanding, teaches very well. I enjoyed taking the class - had a few reading assignments each week (easy) and attendance is mandatory for participation points!

Dr. White is one of my favorite professors I've ever had! He's so enthusiastic about what he teaches and cares for how much his students are learning. I've always felt cared for in his class and really wish I could have him as a professor again!

Bryan is a very nice guy... but..... he is the most disorganized professor I have ever taken. He is also very rigid about strange things involving group work. He assigns a lot of homework and goes on long tangents that he expects you to remember for the tests. Oh, and his tangents take away from the content we need to know for the exams.

B BIO 372 ~ Stem Cells

Dr. White is an amazing person, and he really cares about his students. However, he is unorganized, and he didn't post the lecture slides until class started. He also didn't grade anything until the end of the quarter, except for the first midterm which he graded about 2-3 weeks after it was due.

Dr. White truly brings compassion and equity into his classroom. I 100% believe that he wants everyone in his classes to succeed, so if you have a chance to work with him, I would not hesitate to take the opportunity. Though I admit I struggled with how absent-minded he can be at first, he will never blame students for something he forgot.

A really awesome professor, very nice and polite. Reading the textbook would be very helpful and the chapters listed on canvas. Very organized canvas pages. Drawing experimental project in a group of 4 or 5. A very good class overall and very interesting too.

Love love love Dr. White style of teaching. He really does love teaching and you can see it. The only con is probably all the people trauma dumping their mental issues/dissabilites and sidetracking the class (Dr. White is usually too nice to tell them to shut up). Otherwise great class to be in!

Loved loved Dr. White. The way he teaches just makes you fall in love with the subject. I was never an A student, but when I actually understood the topics due to his excellent teaching is when I excelled. You are not tested on what you remember but more on what you understand. One of the few teachers who actually loves teaching! Take his class!

Engineering/CS hopefuls: AVOID. This is a weed-out class taught by someone who doesn't understand the stakes. A 2.8 here because she forgot to teach a topic can ruin your placement. The "easy A" reviews are traps set by trolls. Protect your transcript and take literally anyone else.

Also, expectations for what topics will be on the exam is very unclear, practice material doesn't really correlate with the exam content, and TA's don't know what the professor expects us to know on the exam either.

The decision to enrol in Sara Biley's class has proven to be an unmitigatedly detrimental error in judgement, representing a pivotal moment of profound misjudgement in my academic journey. Were I granted the opportunity to select again, I would unequivocally elect to refrain from enrolling in the aforementioned MATH 208 course with this professor.

she does not know how to teach.

illegible handwriting, no lectre recordin, practice exmas dont have answer keys, new topics on exams thats NOT ON PAST EAMS?? ta does nto know anything that goes onto exams nor do they know how to access our homework. makes me very sad
The TAs literally teach better than her. Lectures are extremely off topic to the homework and exams, does not teach anything of value. Avoid this professor at all costs!!!!

Absolutely terrible teacher with terrible slides. Refuses to do recordings, mandates that you cannot have your laptop out in class. In the grading system is absolutely awful. Losing 9 points on a 10 point question because you drew a face wrong and refusing students to regrade is horrendous. I think UW policy just makes it hard as well.

I always feel confused about how much I need to know for the exams.There's no recording for lectures. Lectures are messy and barely relevant to hw and test. Her handwriting is unreadable, and notes itself are not that useful. It is really hard for people not good at math but need this class for prerequisite.

reviews.comment: It is evident that the educational value imparted by this professor is NEGLIGIBLE. Should one wish to compromise one's GPA, this course of action would be THE most effective strategy. The assignments are bizarre, and the exams are not aligned with the lecture. The situation is further exacerbated by the fact that her handwriting is illegible.
Take this class if you enjoy skipping lectures and learning on your own!

Prof Billey is nice, however she does NOT teach the content well. Her lectures are confusing and her notes are messy. The test content (and even homework content) are barely relevant to the lectures. The people that do well in this class are likely already familiar with the content. I do not recommend taking her if possible.
Do not take this professor, her handwriting is unreadable, half of her lectures her microphone is off, and her tests are very difficult.
EXTREMELY DIFFICULT EXAMS!!!

Do not take this professor. Avoid at all costs!!! She sucks at teaching and doesn't record lectures. Tests are hard and you are given minimal time to solve big problems. If you want to save your gpa don't take her class.

reviews.comment: I have ABSOLUTELY no idea what those who gave it good reviews are thinking. Is Sara Billey the best math teacher they've ever had in their entire life? There are so many better math teachers at UW. Her explanations aren't thorough, and her exam style is inconsistent. If you don't attend class, you won't have access to the learning resources at all.

DO NOT TAKE HER AT ALL COSTS. Exams are nothing like previous exams, lectures are unrecorded, homework is extremely difficult and irrelevant to class concepts. Talks in lecture for 20 minutes about things unrelated to class material only to rush through the actual content the remaining 30 minutes. Just a research professor who hates her job.
Lectures are not recorded and assignment/exam criteria are not clear. Avoid at all costs
Seems like a nice person who understands the topic, but always goes off topic during lectures and has a very poor ability in explaining concepts.
The lectures are difficult to understand, and assignments are submitted before the material has even been covered. The assessment criteria are unclear. Highly not recommended.

Extremely hard to follow and never records lecture. Talks quietly and doesn't use the microphone despite teaching in a huge room filled with students, and her explanations are convoluted and do not match the information in the textbook/on the internet. Covers material after homework about such material was already due. Avoid at all costs.

I don't recommend taking her class. I couldn't understand a word she said in lectures, and she doesn't record them. She glosses over important concepts. Her handwriting is illegible. Her exams are extremely difficult. Since I started watching Thomas Carr's lectures on YouTube, I haven't attended her class once, and my grades improved significantly.

Sara billey is very nice and sweet. However, her lectures are not very friendly to people who are not very good at math. Her handwriting is very messy and I cannot read her lecture notes. They are all over the place. I recommend taking this class if you are good at self learning and have the patience to read the textbook.
No recording, pure lecture with few notes, Not recommended

Clearly loves the subject and loves talking about it. He took a proactive approach to adjust the class to continuous feedback. Just a great guy. Easily one of my favorite professors I had in the CS program. I also think I learned the most in this class out of any despite it being one of the most difficult classes I took. Highly recommend.

Probably the best professor in UWB CS I've had. Engaging lectures, lots of time for homework (and sometimes give extensions!) and accessible on discord. There were multiple times where I had an issue and I just messaged him and we worked it out either the same day or in office hours. You can tell he looks out for his students and their success!

I took Professor Browne for CSS 342 and CSSSKL 342. He is an amazing professor with engaging lectures. He definitely has clear grading criteria and offers lots of extra credit. Exams were straight forward and he was always enthusiastic about helping students. Truly one of the best professors I've ever had.

Professor Browne is the best orator/lecturer I've ever witnessed. His lectures are concise, to the point, and fun. He does not waste your time. Genuinely cares about your learning and has fun with his job. He spent a total of two hours with me to fix an unusual computer issue and wasn't mad. I'm genuinely sad I only had a 2-credit course with him.

The best lectures @ CSS UWB, he is a spirited person and the energy he brings to the classroom makes it more enjoyable to be in class. He prepares you very well for exams with rehearsals, and no surprises on exams. One of the most empathetic professors here, responds quickly on discord to questions and gives thoughtful responses. 

10/10

Professor Lagesse is excellent. His explanations are always clear and inspiring, and he cares his students. I deeply appreciate his intelligence, kindness, and how approachable he is, always making it easy and comfortable to have meaningful conversations with him. He is the best professor I have at UWB, and you can also learn a lot from him.
His expectation is too high. Doesn't give good grades.

Has a habit of indulging into side topics that are not really needed for understanding fundamental concepts. He has a quiz every other week and they are weighted extremely heavily (7% per quiz). The quiz only consists of two questions so the margin of error is very high. Its the equivalent of taking a midterm every other week. Very stressful.

Brent is very fast-paced but super knowledgeable. Start early on your programs and ask him lots of questions. His quizzes are based on his lecture slides. Read them and practice the problems in the lecture slides. 

If I could have taken him for 343 I would have. He's a great instructor, if you don't understand ask him, and he will re-explain.

Lectures often run on tangents but are very attentive to questions brought up in class. If you are not well versed in programming fundamentals, his teaching might be too fast. Overall a very engaging professor I would recommend him if you're very familiar with course prerequisites.

Brent is an outstanding teacher and incredibly knowledgable on everything security related. He presented the course content in an interesting and relatable format. There is an expectation that you spend time reading the course material and gaining a deeper level of understanding than what is presented solely in lecture. 10/10 would take again!

Brent is smart and passionate about what he teaches, but that doesn't mean he is a good teacher. He has very poor assignment criteria that always change after assigned (and it's quite often) and his lectures are quite frankly boring and he teaches too much stuff too fast and early compared to other 343 professors. I learned nothing new in the class

reviews.comment: Homework does not have clear instruction, so be ready to read over 100 new discord messages to get some more instruction on the homework. Class is not recorded and he talks really fast.

reviews.comment: He seems to be smart and knowledgable but doesnt know how to teach, doesnt explain HWs at all, makes changes to HWs randomly may be a night before its due, doesnt record class because of privacy concerns. reviews.comment: Doesn't record lectures for "privacy reasons." Considering we are doing everything remotely because of COVID, I think this excuse is pretty inappropriate. He's big on working in breakout groups, but doesn't spend much time talking about the practice work we did, and then expects us to have something to turn it. Doesn't explain assignments well.

Lectures were not helping. He was confusing. Last minute changes. I got a bad grade after a lot of work. I have always had 4.0 but my GPA went down after taking this class with this guy. I am taking css343 and the instructor is more reasonable and organized. I don't know why they let MA instructor teach BA classes
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The worst experience in UWB. Hard to understand. Class is a mess. Lecture is not organized, and you are expected to read and learn yourself and come to ask a question. Mostly you won't get an answer. Makes huge changes in assignment last minute. Super strict with due dates even an earthquake happens in your place. You need a miracle to pass a test
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Brent sometimes does not respond to emails. He changes assignments last minute. His grading is very hard. A lot of people got 0s when they should have gotten partial credit. He teaches okay but is too fast most times. Class got canceled due to snow and he still gave an in class 'assignment'. If you want to pass, dont take him.

Professor Lagesse is a GRADUATE professor, and treats UNDERGRAD classes like that. He assigns work that upper level classes haven't done or heard of. Brent knows how to teach sort-of. He speaks too quickly and is not clear on assignments. He changed an assignment the day before it was due. Half the class wont pass.

He's smart with a dash of great personality&orator-ship. Lectures are good but don't expect to become an all knowing person in a topic he teaches. He knows most of the stuff with seldom having less clear answers. Had a lot of quizzes & homeworks. Expected tough grade but he graded good. He assists in most situations. Gear up for multiple  readings.

Brent is really good at teaching and he really knows his stuff! There are a lot of stuff to cover, but he tries his best to let you know what are the most important ones and he really cares that you learn the concepts. He helps you prepare for the midterm exam and he encourage students to go to his office hours.

Better than most professors in the program.  In-class discussions are informative and clear.  Assignments are lax as long as you know the material.  Tests/exams are also easy if you study well, otherwise you won't pass them.  He provides PP study guides.  Study those and his lecture slides, he posts them all on Canvas. Did I mention native English?

He's a pretty cool guy! Text book was not necessary. You learn about interesting stuff and he's a fairly easy grader, so go to class, write down everything he puts on the white board, and you are super set. He's really open to research projects with students, so hit him up if you like computer security and are good at it!
I don't understand why she got 2.1/5 here. She is super nice and hilarious. Also, the class is easy, I will definitely recommend her especially if you are tired and busy enough with other classes.

Class was overall very hands on, most work was group projects. If you step up and work with your team you will do just fine. Presentation are graded pretty easily and you are given a lot of time to work on your papers.

ProfessorBravo did a great Job overall explaining the importance of team design and how to really connect with people. In this course you will learn about. Most homework is group projects, so if you must work hard to compensate if your team is slacking. I lucked out with a great team. Most group projects are doable solo, so no real excuse.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bravo is one of the worst professors at UW Bothell. Her whole class consists of nonsense assignments that do nothing to prepare you for a career. Each week all you do is talk about “how group work makes you feel”.
Don't expect to learn anything. Just get your credits and graduate as soon as possible...

The only reason I took this class is because it was required for my major and the other option wasn't available. The class has less substance than a LinkedIn post and is just a long string of tedious busy work that teaches you nothing. If I took a shot every time she said "empathy" I would be dead in the first week of class.

She teaches one course concept which is empathy but does not show empathy towards her students. Your grade depends on your group and she chooses for you. Even if you do well and your team does not you guys share the grade/damage. No empathy at all. Would not take this class again.

You only learn about one topic, which is empathy. She herself does not apply it at all. Disorganized course, late grading leaving no room to improve, and gives little feedback. Did not make any announcements about the first day of school being asynchronous. Group projects are crucial and assigned, so you gotta hope you get a GOOD group.
Grades everything based on your group. Terrible teacher

Class is not an easy A, Patricia is a hard grader and a large majority of the assignments are group projects. There are multiple presentations in the class and there is really only three large assignments and they are all group projects. Overall, not a hard class if you put in the work and show up to lectures.

402 is a group based class centered around the analysis of HR corporate buzzwords. Expect her to contrive reasons to fail you on assignments if you give her the impression that you've seen through the ruse. 

Like many in human resources, she is an unserious person who takes herself VERY seriously.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Patricia Bravo's class was the worst I have taken at UW Bothell. Her class is all about empathy, yet she is one of the least empathetic people I have ever met. If you take her course, be prepared to walk away having learned nothing, with a disappointing grade, and being laughed at by her. Also, be aware that 90% of the course is group work.

Professor Bravo's class wasn't great. The workload was too much, with 5-7 team assignments every week on the same stuff. It feels like she makes things complicated on purpose. Also, it's not fair colored students get in trouble more than others. Even though I got a good grade, I'd warn others to be careful about taking this class.

She preaches empathy but shows none towards students who have genuine reasons for not being able to make it to class. She claims to understand that "life happens" but docks an insane amount of points regardless. She has also been teaching the same few concepts for the whole 10 week quarter and I have learned nothing new from what I already know.

Don't ever take this class. Really awful, The class is easy but the professor is the problem. Doesn't even let you have a Redo or extension. Will be nice to you in class but 1 on 1 she is really rude and not a very nice teacher. Plus too much group work but the final is individual. makes no sense.

This professor will intentionally choose to over complicate the class because she herself does not feel that what she teaches is important. And she is absolutely right. The last 10 weeks we have discussed the exact same thing over and over again. She is also a bit biased, I've noticed colored students get penalized more than non colored ones.

This class was horrible. The material covered is not very difficult however the workload is ridiculous. Professor Bravo assigns about 5-7 assignments a week which require to meet with your "team". Teams are made up of 5-7 people and almost every assignment is to be done together. Despite getting a high grade I would stay away from this class.

Patricia comes across as any HR professional does; She's nice to your face in front of people but not such a nice person when dealing with her one-on-one. She's not skilled in lecturing, and we only my 7 out of 17 class periods for lectures. Students write the questions used on the exams. Bravo invests little time on teaching and helping students.

Work is manageable and as long as you pay attention in class/do reading you'll be fine. She's pleasant enough and willing to answer questions. Part of your grade is decided by team with everyone getting a say. If you did nothing, you could be a pain and still get a good points.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: She smiles to your face but can be very spiteful if she doesn't like you. She does not mind watching students fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Show up to this class and answer questions, do exactly what her instructions say, nothing more nothing less and you'll get an easy A. Her lectures are hard to listen to, so be prepared for that. Overall its an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Wonderful, warm, engaging instructor. I enjoyed her Managing Teams class; every day was a great class. I got top marks for all my papers, but heard from others that she can be a little harsh in her grading if you're not extremely specific. Classes are fun and very interactive; some kind of activity in every class. I'll take her other classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Very "smiley." Grading is fair and participation is very important. Decent amount of reading.

Took this professor for two classes (BIS 342 & BIS 343). Class were pretty easy but this professor doesn't respond to any emails at all. He can also be rude and sometimes when you ask him for help he doesn't even know how to help you either (He's not very flexible with deadline). He only grades work (all the way from week one) till grades are due.

The midterm and final were done on paper, and you def had to study to do well -- but there were no surprises. All the material was thoroughly covered in the lecture slides and during class, and Dr. Burns was always willing to answer questions. He is super knowledgeable about the subject, and you can tell he cares about the topic and students

Particular with grading, can't use the word 'Lab' in a lab report (he will minus points). Exams are hard enough to not wing, recommend studying every lecture slide or cramming AT LEAST. Has an hour lecture and hour in-class work time structure. Professor started a red bull addiction during my quarter with him.

Difficult to get ahold of. The only email he replied to was a day after the assignment in question was due. Modules were published inconsistently, to the point of not being available before certain lectures. Would say he'd fix/do something then never get around to it. Content was a breeze, easy A, but the class itself was too stressful. Not good.

A waste of time! I learned nothing. Several emails were sent, NO responses. He struggled with technology and was very defensive if confronted. Things posted late, expects exceptional work in short period of time, zero communication/updates on Canvas for over a month. I got an A, it is not worth the stress/headache of trying to manage this teacher.

This was the worst college level course I’ve ever taken. This instructor does not post material for the week until after the due date has passed and has no constructive feedback or communication with the class. He states he will contact you with feedback, but doesn’t until it is essentially too late for any of it to be useful. 0/5

He is impossible to get ahold of, grades way too tough for someone who grades at the last minute so you cant really know what your grade is going to be until the last day, and epidural post assignments and not fill them with any content so you never knew what to do until after the due date cause hed push the assignment back a week.

reviews.comment: Prof is inaccessible and clearly is forced to teach this class. He is clearly overwhelmed and checked out.

Dr. Bustillos was hard to contact (wouldn't respond to emails for about a week). His feedback on assignments was vague. The rubric for the main group research paper wasn't posted until week 7, which made it difficult to write our paper because my group and I didn't know the requirements.  Ask for extra credit assignments. I had to fight for points

I took an online class with him and had no problem. The next quarter I took a lectured class from him and he was horrible. Charismatic, but idealistic and a jerk. Obviously has very little interaction with nurses or what they do. Would not recommend him under any circumstances.

I don't know what all the bad reviews are for. I quite liked his class (intro to cultural studies), especially the last few weeks where he made the lectures really interactive. He's a very smart, approachable, and engaging professor and a dean with good goals overall for IAS.
Saying this professor is bad doesnt do go far enough. I got dumber after taking his course. Easy class though. Got an A+.
Terrible professor.
Really smart guy.  I just need to write down some of the words he uses so that I can look them up later!  Awesome guy.  Very handsome too:)
Would highly recommend this professor. I was lucky to take 4 classes from him. He will challenge your thinking in innovative ways. Lots of group work.
Great teacher. Whenever you have questions he is always willing to help. He is also willing to listen.

Really easy course but interesting too.  You do a lot of writing but it's pretty straightforward stuff, mostly your thoughts about readings.  Group work is fun too.  Library exercises were helpful as well.

He's a good teacher and will give you good feedback, his grading can be a little nitpicky and harsh but he's a nice dude, so he'll tell you exactly what to improve for your final portfolio. Only complaint is having to print articles out, especially since he will not let you use your computer to open the reading in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Brooks is nice but his class is set up very strangely. All instructions for assignments are overly complicated and often weird. Also, he doesn't put grades on canvas and makes you print out everything. Along with not putting grades on canvas, he doesn't grade normally; nothing is a percentage or out of points when you get your papers back.

I took this professor looking at the other ratings, it was a mistake. 

This man will make you print out an assignment for every class, super vague on his feedback on assignments, and doesn't even put grades in canvas expecting us to calculate them ourselves.

On the first day he said, "I rarely give out A's". That's all you need to know.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--So many papers

reviews.comment: Loved going to the fandom lectures, since the prof is just another dedicated, humorous fan. Grading system is vague, and there are pop quizzes (sometimes open note or group). However, my grade didn't tank from missing a few. PAY ATTENTION TO DRs before class! Printing is costly, but you can reduce # pages. Genuinely cares and encourages creativity!

His grading system doesn't make sense and you don't know your grade until the end of the quarter which is very unhelpful.He makes you print out everything which can be costly. He makes effort to know his students personally but the coursework is tough.The final paper is brutal and the feedback is harsh, but he's just a old guy following the rules.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great teacher and nice guy as long as you give an effort you will get a good grade

This teacher doesn't display grades and makes us calculate it on our own, along with having an inconsistent and awful grading system all around. Some of his grades were even objectively wrong, such as formatting issues. He lazily reviews students' work, often skimming over bits and make statements that do not align with content in the paper.

PB is a good teacher and encourages you to be creative in his assignments. Be ready to print literally EVERYTHING. Every reading, every assignment. He has DR's due in the beginning of every class. He assigns a good amount of reading and work but overall enjoyed his class and his humor. He values a good work ethic and cares about this students.

BCORE as a concept is not meant to be hard or even require a ton of work. I put more work into this class than I did for any of my other classes

This class is a GPA killer if you're going for a 4.0. You'll be okay if you do every assignment and don't miss too much class. His grading system makes no sense and you will never know what your grade is.
Loves to argue with his students on the most random things. 10/10 professor. tickled my funny bone plenty of times

pb is an awesome guy. always open to answer questions and help you along the way to his MANY assignments. funny in class and leaves a lot of creativity in your hands. if you do the bare minimum he'll give you the bare minimum grade. you truly get how much effort you put into this class. i learned a lot from this guy. just be ready to write a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dont take him. Im telling you just dont idk why he has a high rating but trust me dont take him
Wating a lot of paper with professor brooks. Does help with stuff but is pointless with his grading style
His grading is so confusing. I am an international student and I had very tough time taking this class. Very harsh grader

I've taken this class with another professor, and I have to say that Peter Brooks' grading style is all over the place. If you care about your GPA, I would advise against taking his class. I ended up with a 3.0 in his section, but I got a 4.0 with a different professor. Trust me.

I mean if you want to learn go for it. But if you care about your grade PLEASE CHOOSE ANOTHER PROFESSOR. His grading system is chaotic and he expects you to print everything. I see people saying he is funny...he isn't.

I dont understand why he has such a high rating. As a teacher he is super helpful and will genuinely care about you if you put in the effort. My biggest problem with him is his grading system. I had no clue what my grade was the whole quarter. He is pretty tough tough grader but I wouldn't recommend taking him honestly.

He puts never puts in your grades in campus and half the assignments you have are never on the dashboard you have to manually check in the modules which was such a hassle. If you care about your GPA save yourself and choose someone else. He's writing based teachers and its so annoying cause you waster so much money. Take ANYONE ELSE.

By far my most enjoyable class! I have him for two classes back to back so he's very understanding about the workload. Lectures in an interactive way and finds way to engage the class. A lot of group conversations and clear grader. HILAROUS BTW. Would 100% take again!
PB DAH BEST.

This class will be as easy or as hard as you make it. Make sure to take advantage of EC opportunities. Assignments are printed for grading, so you'll need access to a printer. Prof has a great personality and creates a community within the classroom. Pop quizzes don't hurt your grade much at all, but read everything assigned just in case.

Pop quizzes are low-stakes. If you can write and make up information, this course will be easy. Every day is an extra credit opportunity. He has conferences where you talk about assignments and anything else. This course has a heavy workload, but it is rewarding. During office hours, he loves listening to students complaints about mostly anything.

Brooks is definitely a character. He cares a lot about his students and is super easy to talk to. The class is very participatory, has a lot of reading, and has pop quizzes. I didn't enjoy the workload but Brooks as a person is great and his teaching is effective.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: He's a nice guy, but his grading system is crazy. For the whole quarter I've had no idea what my grade was, and I'm not even sure if I'll know when the class is over. A lot of his teaching is through Purdue Owl and it makes it difficult to understand exactly what he's looking for in an assignment. Would take him again, but not my first choice.
Most of the writing content we learn is from the Purdue OWL which he assigns for homework. He seems like a really great person but does not teach writing enough for you to write the way he wants.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Many describe him as funny--true if you are a deeply unfunny person. Chronically online Gen Xer w/ a penchant for irrelevant anecdotes and an unwavering love for his own voice. Fortunately he doesn't believe in paying for textbooks. But he will expect you to pay $30+ to print your assignments for him. Sounds a bit like Gru from Despicable Me btw.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is nice, very funny, and knowledgeable. But his class is HARD and I probably would've gotten a B if it wasn't for the extra credit.

If you're trying to learn, I would definitely recommend this professor. If you're trying to get a 4.0, would really not recommend. Peter Brooks is genuinely a unique and kind individual. His grading... really tough. Quite frankly, his grading system is weird and difficult to achieve a high grade. Suggest taking another Professor for the GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Peter is one of the best lecturers I've had. He's funny, knows how to engage a class, and has a lot of great wisdom to give. For a 2 credit class, there is more work than you might expect and there are pop quizzes so make sure to do the readings. He makes class time fun and worth going to. I find majority of the assignments he gives are relevant
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Good professor, but still has some things that just "..." . Expect pop quizzes, do assignments and remember the things that he taught the previous lessons. For EC, take notes of what events he take interest in out side of class, he will mention it. Ok class, nothing impressive. Could not see the hype everyone had for him. Will not take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Brooks is open and encouraging to his students. He will critique your work and then give you useful feedback in return. He makes sure his students understand him and personally helps them too, he likes to talk to students individually if they seem to be struggling, he is a great lecturer and teacher I felt very comfortable in his class.
This professor is a great lecturer and really caring and funny, but I think he graded a little too hard.

Really kind and caring professor. It was my first quarter in university and he made it bearable. BWRIT134 requires a decent amount of time and effort. It can get overwhelming at times, but Peter is there for any concerns and usually gets back to you really quickly. He gave helpful insights for school and is a great person.

I had Professor Brooks for BCORE133 and it was honestly a class that helped me a lot. Professor Brooks is a very caring person and gives back detailed feedback on all the assignments you do. He's very responsive and thorough person and will move heaven and earth to help you out. His expectations are clear; follow instructions and you'll be fine!

This class was great. The readings are interesting and the essays give you freedom as long as it will fit the prompts. Prof. Brooks himself was a really good teacher - he gave very thorough feedback on assignments, was really present in and outside of class, had great jokes, and genuinely wanted us all to succeed.

Probably the best available for 135. Funny and caring dude who gives very good feedback on any and all homework that will set you up for later assignments and beyond. Takes attendance every class. Midterm project was hard as hell but once that was over the 2nd half of the quarter and the research paper were much easier.

Professor Brooks is by far the best professor I have ever had. The assignments are not difficult if you listen in class and contact him when you have questions, I started them a couples days before they were due and was able to pass the class with a really good grade. Hes a gem.

Peter Brooks will go down as being one of my most memorable teachers. Brooks did give some tough assignments, and at first I wasn't a fan of them, but as I got further into the quarter I realized how helpful previous assignments were. He is a real caring gem who will have you work hard and give you phenomenal feedback. Absolute legend do recommend

Brooks is a great professor, gives really good feedback and is overall pretty forgiving if you have proven that you do your work. Only con is that the big project is a group presentation and that is a big grade but if you get stuck with group you dont click with hes understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't take this man. He be making you do the most for the grade. Hard grader and you have to go above and beyond for a 4.0.

Definitely wants to get a discussion out of class. He makes class engaging and interesting. Has lots of opinions about things but it is interesting to hear and he has an interesting perspective. Gives good and fair feedback. Not and easy class but not an overly hard class too. I thought it was a great intro to the IAS school.

PB is awesome. He's very funny, extremely laid back, and encourages students to talk to him outside of class. He feels like a buddy to us. For the reading response homework you only need 1-2 paragraphs. There are 2 group presentations that are pretty easy, and there is one long research paper, but he grades it rather easily.

From what I hear about other BWRIT professors, PB is one of the best. He was always clear on what he wanted from assignments, and assigns a fair amount of work but will always be willing to help you on it. He has a unique curriculum that is really engaging and fun. His manner of teaching is extremely calm and respectable, and he's very funny too.

Peter is awesome. He really cares about his students learning and succeeding in class, and offers to help with future needs and understands when there are personal issues that come up. The readings were interesting and he leads very in-depth discussions. He's also one of the funniest people I know. Would definitely take again!

Great professor. Really funny and open. You need to do the work and pay attention, but it's bearable (assignments are not tough, they're just long). He gets that everyone has a life, he doesn't micro-manage, and is very flexible. Great intro to IAS in general. Gives excellent feedback.

PB is an actual god among men. One of the best classes I have taken. He wants you to be as good as you CAN be in your writing but he helps you every step of the way which is really nice. He makes the class very interesting and he has a lot of energy which makes you not get bored! He is amazing!

Lots of writing and reading, but the topics are really interesting and benefit you a lot in the long run, to be honest. He is willing to help you with any questions you may have in class, and very accessible outside of class. His broad interests are awesome too. He is slow to respond via email, but other than that I think he is great.

Amazing, awesome, and I would be hopeless without him. He is really helpful during office hours, and his lectures are also really clear. It's definitely a worthwhile experience, and even if the assignments are difficult, it's very doable. I learned a lot in his class, but also enjoyed the material! 10/10

Peter Brooks is one of the best professors I've had at UW Bothell. He's a tough grader but as long as you do the work and try you'll receive a good grade. Unlike other writing classes I've taking he's able to make the class fun and interesting so you'll actually want to go to class. Also recommend him if you know a lot about WWE.

Prof. Brooks is a one-of-a-kind instructor. He is incredibly tough when it comes to grading assignments, however, don't let that discourage you. He genuinely cares about his students & that is shown by the way he teaches & the relationships he creates. His class is worth all the work. He'll make you an exceptional writer & person as well.

one of the best professors I've had at UWB. at first I was hesitant but after a couple classes I saw how much he cared about our work and how well we did. he really does want to help you do better and if you ask questions, you will get the answers you need. great dude overall and great professor.

He is super nice and funny. At first, I was afraid his class would be hard because it's college level, but it turned out to be easy. There were a lot of papers to write, but they all helped you out for the final paper. He forgets things easily, but he is really easygoing and sometimes lets us leave class early.

when I checked for his rating in the beginning of the winter quarter, I was nervous. but as the quarter went on, I gained respect for professor brooks. he truly cares how well his students do and really makes sure you know what your doing. he's a great professor and person. he's hilarious and really makes the class atmosphere super comfortable!

he's a great professor and super fun and engaging, I would take a class with him again. there's a ton of writing and homework in general but it's not too hard. if you're in the 135 class beware the interview project, not hard just a lot of work!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Brooks is a great teacher. Everyone gets along with him, and you can tell that he genuinely loves his job. He does make you work for your grade, so be prepared to do a decent amount of work over the quarter. Nonetheless, he's a really good professor and I recommend him to anyone.

Pro: gives excellent feedback. Con: grades harshly. There are other professors who also give good writing advice without the GPA hit, so I'm not sure it was worth taking his particular class. Funny, but spent a lot of time talking about pro wrestling and gave extra credit related to it, which sucked for those of us who are clueless about it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Amazing Professor!! He's hilarious and it's guaranteed that you'll never be bored. He also meets individually with his students after every major assignment, which really shows that he doesn't treat you like just a number. The only con is that there is a lot of work. You'll have a writing assignment due every class period, so you cannot miss class.

Dr. Brooks is a really funny guy.  However, if you take his class you will be overloaded with homework.  Most of his assigned projects seemed like busywork.  He had our class watch a two-hour documentary that we never referenced.  He is also an exceptionally tough grader, and uses a lot of pop quizzes.

As a person, Peter is AMAZING. He's really funny, and treats you like a person rather than one of his many students. He's a really, really great guy. He's also a good professor as well. Organized, knows what he's doing, but assigns A LOT of homework. There isn't a day you come to class without something due. Wouldn't recommend for an easy A.

I really enjoyed this Professor last quarter. Personally it's nice to have a teacher who follows the NBA. He does assign a lot of work and could be a tough grader. But he really cares about making you a better writer. Plus he cancels classes the week after essay deadline for conference discussions. He helped me strengthen my writing weaknesses.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He may seem great in the beginning, but definitely a harsh grader. He gives out way to many assignments and he doesn't teach well enough to write in the way he wants. He just gives the assignments and waits until you ask questions. If your just trying to pass the class I would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: He is an amazing teacher!! His lectures are funny and he acts like a peer which is great. Also he gives people a lot of extra credit so that's a plus.

He is a very fun teacher. The Essays you have to do are the same for all BWRIT134 which is 4 or 5. He is some sort of game journalist so he knows everything about video games. He has solid humor and would recommend.
The absolute best professor for 301. Her office hours are quite flexible and her feedback is super helpful!

Very caring professor who cares for the success of her students. The beginning weeks are difficult with back-to-back drafts. But once those are completed, the class is a cake walk. Feedback was clear, and exams are fairly easy with a kahoot style + written portion. Overall, if you can keep up at the start, you'll be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing! Was very clear of feedback in instructor drafts and was a very nice professor overall! She explicitly tells you in detail why you got the grade that you got and was also very clear in lecture. One of the best 301 professors!

Bad! She didn't allow late assignments, yet she would spend almost the entire lecture going over the previous assignment. Not to mention she would assign a LOT of work, worth a lot of points. She was a harsh grader and if you had time to ask her questions in class, she would deflect the question and then walk away while you tried to understand!

Know before taking: Attendance is mandatory, people write their names to show you were there. The course is messy, in class she would not fully help with questions, would walk away quickly. Lectures are boring and you can't really grasp what she is talking about it goes from one thing to another thing. Good thing: She did give me a good grade.

One of the best professors I've ever had. Very engaging with the class, and the assignments are actually useful; I learned so much and will use the skills I gained in future applications. Super caring, available outside of class, and lots of extra credit opportunities. Assignments also have very clear grading criteria, which I appreciated.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very caring. Great office hours. Understandable and human. Gives good examples. Good grader. If you ask her for help you will succeed. A good person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: She's super nice and cares about her students. There's 4 main assignments and they're not that hard. The only thing I regret is not doing reading homework early. I thought the exam would be very hard but it's not that bad. She has easy extra credit opportunities that count towards it too. NGL, her lectures are very long and she yaps quite a bit.
Great professor, cared, was available and helpful 10/10

Gives great feedback to make sure your pattern papers can receive high grades. Super friendly, has PLENTY of extra credit opportunities. Tests are straightforward and you can have cheat sheets for them.

I took professor shaw my first quarter at uw and have taken her 3 times since. This professor truly cares about your success and makes sure she gives you the right critique and comment to improve your work. Additionally she has tons of extra credit opportunities which apply to your exams grades. Exams are all open books or notes (depends).
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Shaw is an amazing and caring professor and her class didn't cause any stress. She is very accessible and accommodating with due dates. The curriculum (not hers) felt ancient and not applicable to CS/STEM majors. The pattern papers aren't that bad, and Professor Shaw tries her best to make class fun. I would take any class of hers again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Caring

reviews.comment: Carol is the sweetest professor ever, the class is group work heavy, but the work is manageable and you can always come talk to her if you need more time. There's also lots of opportunity for extra credit work, and there are lots of peer review sessions before you have to turn in your final papers. Take this professor!

Professor Shaw is such a sweet professor, and really cares about what she teaches. She also really cares about whether her students understand the topic being discussed and uses her abundant class time to go through any questions on assignments and really walks the whole class through them. 100% take 301 with her if you can!!

Decent, not a lot of work overall and easy grading up until the last paper. Other than that, she's chill and lets you redo assignments for a better grade (except the last paper). 93%+ is a 4.0 so that was nice.
Don't like her method of teaching, forgets a lot of stuff and expects you to know it. Sort of rude, is not open to negotiation.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof Buttler comes off very educated and respectable. Her choice of subject and class material is so relevant and engaging. She wants the students to succeed, so she will let you redo assignments. Class is reading and lots of small in-class activities. My only issue is that the class was a little scattered and didn't exactly flow well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Skip class? You won't pass.--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Buttler is a great Professor. She is pretty laid back and easy going if you put in the work, if you slack off she will help out if you want to learn. The course work is easy and relatable to all back grounds. I would recommend taking her class. She also grades easy until the last paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: by far the best professor I've had. There has been nothing unclear of her directions, she is very precise and detailed so be sure to listen to what she has to say! She gives super helpful feed back as well as unlimited attempts to improve your work, very helpful and positive professor! Also, very intriguing lectures that help develop your writing!

The subjects she goes over in BWRIT 135 are very interesting and relevant to society today. She focused a lot on financial, racial, and gender/sexual orientation subjects within literature. Super passionate and a pretty easy grader as long as you show effort. I would not recommend taking this course if you skip often or turn in assignments late.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Probably one of my favorite professors. She really wants her students to do well in class. Beginning of the quarter can be a bit hard because her style of writing is different BUT! she lets you redo your assignments multiple times and you'll receive full credit for it. My writing skills definitely improved because of her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Buttler is an amazing person. The first class I took with her was difficult; I took more classes with her and got used to her teaching style and she really helped me immensely improve my literature analysis and writing skills.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: shes awesome, my best advise is make friends the first day and you will be solid the whole quarter
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I had Tasha for 134 and I think shes a really great person. Shes super funny and loves to roast people in class. Id say shes pretty disorganized and sometimes its unclear of what she wants for an assignment. But once you understand her style you should be good. Take her feedback and do exactly as she says on papers, youll get an A.

I don't mind her, she seems like she's trying, but she's just so opinionated. Her assignments aren't very hard, they're just time consuming and redundant. Overall, the class isn't bad, it's just a lot of mundane work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Buttler is very precise about her directions and assignments. When she reviews your paper make sure you do exactly as she says. She's very flexible, if you establish good communication you'll do just fine! She's also quite funny.

I took a BCORE hybrid course with Tasha. It was an easy class, do the assignments on time and pass. Her class was not organized at all. We went on a couple field trips which felt like they were planned last minute. Be careful when she gives you your final grade, she uses the grades of canvas without the correct weights for every section of the clas

LOVE TASHA! BEST PROFESSOR EVER! I'm glad we became great friends and love her teaching style. Although she may grade a little tough, but it has really helped me along the way. I love her personality and charisma. The love and care she has for each and every one of her students goes above and beyond her role as my professor. 3

I've always had issues with english teachers but Professor Buttler is amazing! She is a tough grader but with good reason. She actually cares about students and gives great feedback. The class discussions were interesting and she encouraged the class to be more open minded. I ended up leaving the class as a better person.

Tasha helped me understand that it's super important to relate ideas to a larger context and use credible sources to support your claims. I feel this class has 100 level difficulty, but I learned 400 level skills. Classes were very interactive, requiring discussion of an interesting array of media. If you participate as she intends, you will learn.

She is extremely unorganized but I am still left with the idea that she is extremely intelligent. Her writing class gives off the vibe of being an economic or political class but I didn't mind as she is a fairly easy grader and her assignments don't ask too much of the student. Extra credit is a must!! DO IT! It'll bump you up from a 3.5 to a 3.9.

She's okay. Probably one of the most disorganized professors/instructors I have ever had in my life, but the class doesn't ask much of the student anyway. It was a bit of a bummer for me considering I took the class wanting to strengthen my writing, yet all the class has centered around is American politics. She can get a bit preachy.

This was my first quarter here and Professor Buttler gave off a very friendly vibe to her students. She's funny and lenient. I found it easy approaching her whenever I had questions. She understands her students. However, she can be disorganized with what we need to do in class. Her assignments are easy and help in a way.

She's super chill and gets along with all of her students! I really recommend taking her classes because she will help you succeed! I get along with her the most out of all of my teachers. Some of the lectures might be boring, but it's interesting to know.

Professor Buttler is an excellent instructor. She has an unconventional way of teaching, buts effective. Her support throughout the quarter was unparalleled to any professor I've had in my academic career--she gave me confidence to do well and I have a completely new lens on writing and myself. If you aren't doing well, she really tries to help you

Amazing professor, really knows how to get students into their work. She comes off very liberal and opinionated, but does not shove it down students throat. Will get you involved in current topics and issues and incorporate it into your papers. Really wants her students to pass and succeed. By far my favorite professor!

No doubt, you will gain new skills out of this class that will help you in the future. Tasha makes you want to become more aware of whats going on in society. Her work is a lot easier when you can provide examples with current events. All assignments can be revised for full credit. Just work hard throughout the quarter and you'll be good.
She's a homie. Take her class.

She was not a very good teacher.  All of her assignments had to go with her own opinions, and any others were questioned.  Very democratic.  Also, there was a strong tie to Orientalism in the class, which did not at all relate to the course description, and was an unnecessary element of the class.

Professor Buttler is an incredible teacher. She is very intelligent and is truly invested in the success of students who want to succeed and improve in their writing. She talks about controversial issues that are interesting to incorporate into her class, mostly current economics. She is a great professor and has helped me so much overall!

She's very easy to approach, and she makes things funny. We go through a lot of different types of material to find topics that we could write about. She's very helpful after classes, and if you ask her, she will help edit your papers. If you do all the assignments, and understand what is being asked, you will do well in this class.

By far one of the best teachers I've ever had and I doubt ill ever meet a teacher as great as her.She's definitely not an easy teacher nor, an easy grader, but if u stay focused and need her help, she's more then gladly to do whatever it takes to help so you can learn the material and get the grade you deserve.Ican honestly say I loved her class!

Awesome class, very interesting topics. She is hard on grades and writing skills but if you pay close attention to the skills she's trying to teach and you show her your intentions to do well, plus never miss her class, you'll pass :)

She is pretty disorganized, but that can be beneficial for the students at some points. Tests were easy, if you study a small amount and slightly apply yourself, you will do well. Her personality is pretty out there and she can be interesting.
Laid back and awesome is correct. Kept things interesting and brought interesting topics and subjects to the class. Highly recommend.

She seemed to be a very approachable and friendly teacher however her grading is harsh and ridiculous. She does not keep a running grade book so it is impossible to tell where you are at in the class. AVOID
Pretty awesome. She's super laid back and easy going. She assigns a lot of reading but half the time you dont even need to read it. Shes dope!!!

85% of the class was based on exams, 10% on quizzes, and 5% on participation. All we do in class is prove theorems, with little applicability to how to apply them to the homework problems. No practice exams are offered, although some of the exam questions come directly from the homework, quizzes every week. Take him if you are a good test taker.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Mann is VERY test heavy. About 80% of your grade is over two midterms (50%) and a final (30%). That being said, his lectures are very informative and easy to follow with a clear chapter schedule in the syllabus. He is conscientious and encourages questions in class, but be prepared to study a lot.

Don't take this prof if you aren't a good test taker. Exams are weighted 80% of your grade with 50% for midterms and 30% for the final. His homework assignments take at least 5-6 hours to complete on a good day. He is good at lecturing but throws new concepts at you very quickly, so be prepared to spend a LOT of time outside class reviewing notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tough, but doable. He is a good professor teaching very tough material, give yourself enough time to absorb it and use the resources you have. If you get behind, it gets hard to catch back up.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Great lectures, super easy to follow, and he answers all student questions very well. The class is also supplemented by a really good textbook and a really good set of videos that he filmed, so there is always a resource available if you need it.

That being said, the class is HARD and there is SO much homework. Tied for the most homework I've had.

80% of your grade is exams and unless you're an above average student you're going to struggle and probably fail this class. His HW takes an absurd amount of time to complete.
