Very upsetting, don't know if you pass or fail!!

Professor DeSmet is really nice and very interested in what she teaches. There is a lot of readings but as long as you show up to class for the discussions you should have no problem understanding the content.  Be aware of the attendance policy! We wrote a couple short papers and there was only two exams, but be very descriptive when you write.

Very unorganized. Refuses to post grades until the end of the quarter. Even if you ask her for your grade she doesn't give actual scores, just her assumption (i.e. "good," "not good," "bad"). Focuses way too much on the readings (which are very lengthy), which in the end had nothing to do with each other or the outcome of your grade.

GPA killer. She gives tons of reading, and most of reading were long and useless. She would not let you know your grade.  She says the grade depends on how much you improved. So you would never know your grade until post on grade report.

Lots reading!She is a nice lady, but terrible instructor. I think this has something to do with her lack of teaching experience. She never told you about your score percentage. I have no idea about the grade during the whole quarter; therefore, the students don't even have the chance to withdraw the class because they have no idea about the grade.

I took her one credit class in Butoh. She is passionate about the subject and honestly if you want to explore the soul of Butoh and your own movement, this is the class for you. It was exhausting at times dealing with my own trauma and working thru it but overall an heartwarming class. A little heavy on the hw/reflections but overall great.

To provide some insight on when I took this professor. I took her in spring quarter of 2018. As a teacher, I believe she genuinely wants the best for her students, but she is pretty disorganized considering the small amount of material in the class. Overall, easy class, attendance is 50% of the grade. I wouldn't necessarily recommend it to everyone
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: So much fun! Such a great teacher! You just have to show up for class and you'll get 4.0!
She is my dance teacher, very nice.

Professor Vinyard was honestly one of the best professors I've had at UWB so far, with remote learning she made work easy to understand and gave great feedback on writing. She is not an extremely hard grade like some of the other level 100 writing classes and I learned a lot from her in the one quarter I had her. I would take every class she had.
really caring and respectful. one of the nicest teachers I know

I would say that she is the nicest professor I have ever had. She is caring and knows what she is teaching. Everyone in class loves her not just as a professor but also as a person. I would totally recommend you to take her class.

I had her for two quarters, and she is an excellent teacher. She is super knowledgable and can answer any question you have. Theres only about 3 big papers assigned which make up most of your grade. She's a sweet and caring teacher who really wants her students to achieve. Would recommend taking her class, she's overall one of the best at UWB.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This course was truly transformative. What a gem of a professor!  The Interactive Learning course curriculum is engaging, tough, thought provoking and incredibly meaningful. You wil be hard pressed to find a Professor who cares more about your learning outcome or you as a student.. come ready to work hard though! It is not easy  but worth every min

I had her for Interactive Learning. The entire class concentrated on philosophers Freire and Dewey. Awesome stuff! They changed my way of thinking and I feel like I honestly grew from this class.  Hard grader and lots of work but you come out a better person. She is pretty strict  so if you have something personal come up, she wont budge.

Horrible. She makes you compete against each other for grades, and she is never clear on what she wants out of your work. She assigns far too many assignments and you end up trying harder to complete homework and to make her happy than you do learning anything.

He was okay, even entertaining at times. However, he is very confusing in his expectations for assignments and does not really give much feedback with the final paper. I wish he was more clear but the class was okay and the group project was very interesting. There were 4 quizzes, a group presentation, & a final paper so the workload is manageable
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took the team building class and thoroughly enjoyed his class. Dimeo is a very charismatic person and knows how to get people to open up and learn/work together effectively. I wish I was a Business major so I could take him again!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof. Dimeo class involves heavy public speaking, it helps to enhance your skills. He cares about all of his students and gives advice. He kept two-hours class worth it. I highly recommend you to take him.

Great professor and intro into the business major. So many life lessons taken from this course that can be crucial to personal and team success. Textbook was used but only one assignment came directly from it. Group presentation worth 25%, short 2 page final reflecting on what you learned 20%, and participation was worth 20%. Easy A if you try.

He is an absolutely fantastic professor. With an engaging classroom, the lectures are an arena of acadamia. He always ensured the fostering of intense group discussion through his group projects. Speeches beware, lots of tough public speaking. May not receive a 4.0 easily but the class is totally worth it. 100% recommend.

DO NOT MISS CLASS OR SHOW UP LATE. He has favorites and participation matters heavily. There is a 40 minute presentation, be very prepared for it. His class is not very helpful for actual quizzes so read book. Good examples, overall good tough teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dimeo is absolutely hilarious, and runs a highly engaging class. He says things that are in poor taste sometimes, but as long as you don't have a stick up your rear then you'll laugh and have a great time. Grading seems subjective at times, make sure you participate and come to class, and be as brief as possible in the business emails.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Really great course in my opinion. Learned a lot about practical business writing and presentation skills. Make sure you go to class, as he grades participation by how many classes you miss. The grading scale is a bit arbitrary and unclear, but just do a good job and you will get a good grade.

Michael Dimeo is a pretty good professor, but can be seen as insulting and blunt at times. He's a bit forgetful at times but he's a pretty easy grader on written assignments. But emphasis on the PARTICIPATION: he was never explicit on how much to talk in class and didn't give that many opportunities, landing me a 3.5 in the class. Not a lot of HW.

The class itself was very entertaining, but the grading criteria is very difficult to understand. Dimeo rarely followed the Syllabus and basically doesn't give A's. I got almost 100% on  every presentation/assignment and still got a 3.4. You don't really do anything in the class but its not worth it because he doesn't give good grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Extremely tough group projects in this class. He makes it worse by appointing random people to your team, and they ruin the presentation grades. Grading felt arbitrary. Arrogant professor and will scare you out on day 1. Avoid him if you can, or take it with Jack Whelan which you get a 4.0 automatically without effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Truly an amazing professor. As a freshman at UW, I can already tell this will be my favorite professor I'll ever have. Heavy emphasis on public-speaking, presentation skills, personal development, and working in a team environment rather than just doing things for the grade. Teaches life skills, and takes time to know you personally. A++

Easy class-just show up and participate. No tests,  just a persuasive speech and a group project presentation- which does mean the grades are not weighted on that many things. He is a nice guy and the concepts are really easy.

First day thoughts: I'm gonna get grilled so hard. Last day: I'm going to miss this class so much. This class involves more public speaking than Whelan's, but it will grow you. Dimeo has great stories, a good heart, and wise advice. He kept me awake for two hours at 8:30 AM. He may yell at you if you're late, but it's more funny than anything.

One of the best professors I have ever had. I had him as a professor as well as a mentor, and I would highly recommend taking one of his classes. Somewhat strict, but in the best and most constructive way possible. Always willing to help you out if you need it. His class is the foundation of my interviewing and networking skills.
Incredible professor. Great lectures and really cares about his students.

Great lecturer, funny and engaging and takes time to get to know you personally. Overall I liked the class but beware- if you are an introvert and don't do well at public speaking, it will difficult for you to excel. Grading on assignments felt arbitrary at times and the class was not the easy 4.0 I thought it would be

This teacher is not a horses butt like other students say. He is the best teacher that I have ever had. He is super funny and straight forward. I love a teacher that isn't afraid to call his students out. One of the things I love about this guy is that you can ask him personal business advice- that's valuable. Take his classes!
Great guy, don't arrive late to class, he'll flip . . .otherwise a great teacher/professor.  you'll learn-from and enjoy his class . . it's a guarantee.
This is great professor, I would recommend taking his classes.
Generally a great class. Could have been a little more organized but he was a good teacher and teaches business well and made class fun.
Professor was very knowledgeable and engaged the class in discussion. I really enjoyed his style and would recommend his class.
Best professor I've ever had! Makes class entertaining and engaging. The work load is light and he doesn't make you read more than necessary! He's AWESOME!
He is funny and awesome. Very clear.

I am graduating in one week and Dimeo is the best prof. I have had my entire time at college. Negotiations was fantastic and team building was perspective changing. Take every class you can with him. Don't be late, he will scare the crap out of you if you are.
Outstanding professor. One the best at Foster.
Grading is extremely subjective.  Interesting prof but definitely picks favorites.

Dimeo is the best teacher I have had at UW. He actually has job experience in his field and is passionate about the subject matter. Always gives personal feedback on assignments and will know your name personally by day 3 of the class. Freaking awesome dude.

I can honestly say my life would be a good deal different without this class. The energy Prof. Dimeo brings rivals that of multi-million dollar consultants, and he's a really no B.S. sort of guy too. As a CS major I wasn't entirely interested but by 30 minutes in, I was sold. You can learn SO much from him, it's just incredible. Take this class!
A good professor with lots of experience. The class isn't hard, but keep in mind that every point in it counts... The curve is very very bad... 3.1 for 91%, for example..
Very good teacher. Fun, understanding, and knowledgeable. Always willing to help you out. You might find him arrogant in the beginning, but don't let it to deceive you. Not a harsh grader at all.

Michael is easily one of the best professors in Foster.  I am currently in his B CMU 301 class and have loved every second of it.  He is full of energy, gets to know his students, and engages the class extremely well.  I could not recommend his class enough.

Michael is seriously one of the best professors known to man kind.  Not only is he an amazingly fun, interesting, hilarious, and engaging professor, but he is a wonderfully kind person in general.  Although this class is an all day Saturday class (in the summer) it is TOTALLY fun.  You learn a lot and meet great people. THE BEST!!!!!
Best class ever!

Completely fantastic! Gets to know students on a personal level and uses that to teach to their strengths. I recommend everyone take this class from him. Great guy outside of class just to talk to, too. Engaging and full of interesting thoughts/ideas.
Great teacher. Engaging and passionate about his subject. My best class this year.

Great motivator-- helps students find their strengths. Fun class, but ropes course is physical which can be a draw back for people with injuries or disabilities. Luckily Michael is supportive of whatever you can accomplish- however the rest of the class might not be.
Hilarious, thoughtful, and utterly brillant!!! I could go on and on...just take his class!!! ANY OF THEM

Great teacher! Very funny and entertaining. Class is fun and tries to keep things interesting. I wish more teachers were like him. I highly recommend. Also exams are straight forward- consist of T/F, MC, and short essay. Come to class and you'll do great.

The lectures are kind of boring due to the subject covered, but he's comical and keeps the class entertained. I enjoyed his humor. And the last session is outdoors and a little cold but a good experience.
Wonderful speaker and motivator.  He shows great interest in his students.
Awesome Professor!  Very energetic and knowledgeable.  His passion for the material makes you want to attend class. His experience/stories add so much to the class.

Super easy if you're a biology major whose taken anatomy 1. Non-stem students would find this class difficult as not everything is explained in the correct order or fully, but study well and you'll be fine. She provides previous exams that are pretty similar to the actual exam, same with the study guides. There are participation points.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: A sweet professor. Course will be difficult to understand if you're not good at science like me but with dedication you can understand well. She's very kind & sweet, it helps lower any class anxiety. Good at teaching, she makes panapto recordings too.

One of the BEST professors of all time, her classes are engaging, workload is very fair, passionate about her classes and is always willing to help out. I was not confident with this topic, but this professor made me genuinely excited to learn, and she provides extra help with study guides that ACTUALLY help you with the tests.

Dr. Downs is absolutely the best biology professor I have ever had. She made the information easy to understand and enjoyable. She gives out study guides for the tests that ACTUALLY have the material that will be on the test. She's easily accessible if you need extra help too.

Jodi made Brain&Human Behavior a fun class. Same routine every week, very power point and lecture heavy, but was doable. Interesting readings, graded on reading quizzes, in class assignments, midterm, final, and group project. Offered a lot of extra credit towards the end of the quarter, and if you're not a bio major, you may need to study more!!

Jodi was great! She taught brain & behavior so well, and it was great to apply lots of the material in a real-world sense. Her lectures are good and really keep you engaged. Although this is a biology class, I believe anyone could take it even if not a bio major because the material isn't SUPER science-based. Take this class, you won't regret it!

Professor Si's course structure, slides, and explaining every topic by helping us come up with examples ourselves and think of solutions to problems was great. The group discussion we had in
class were also very helpful because I got to know different perspectives of the concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Always easy to talk to and ready to help, the professor created a positive and welcoming classroom atmosphere that really supported our learning. He encouraged open discussion and was patient when explaining difficult concepts. His approachable attitude really helped me stay motivated and confident throughout the course.

The professor is consistently respectful, supportive, and deeply engaged with students. He encouraged questions, offered meaningful and timely feedback, and demonstrated a clear commitment to both teaching and student learning.

The professor was consistently rude and disrespectful, showing little interest in engaging with students. Questions were dismissed, and feedback was minimal. It felt like they didn't care about teaching or our learning experience. Very unapproachable and unhelpful, making the class atmosphere negative and discouraging.

Professor Si really understands how to help students learn the material and skills that are necessary in the workforce rather than memorization alone. This made all the difference in the world. Professor Si is leaps and bounds above any teacher I've experienced yet. More teachers should take a page out of his book.

Deep learning is a rapidly evolving field and requires engaging with complex concepts and challenging problems. Prof Si had us frequently engage in group discussions of the topics and AI's impact. The topics are groundbreaking and cutting edge. It helped expose us to different perspectives and share/learn from our classmates.

Some combination of the project and the literature review. The lectures were useful mostly as an introduction to a topic, with the my literature review and project bringing depth to a particular area and other students literature review increasing the breadth of subject material we covered in class.
Lots of extra credit oppurtunities and makes sure the students learn by giving them the extra credit oppurtunities, projects and exams arent very hard

Almost everything about the lectures is in c++ because the professor explained all the details and deeper the knowledge to support the student. Professor encouraged students to either work on in class problems independently or in front of class for bonus points.

This was a very interesting class. With little knowledge regarding machine learning it opened my eyes to the process and applications of ML and AI. My interest in ML and AI has grown since taking this class. The in-class examples and practice problems were helpful because I was able to clarify any questions I had about certain concepts.
Prof was good at delivering sophisticated deep learning and inspiring by using real-world applications and examples. Be sure you get ready for the projects and paper!

The instructor was helpful, caring, and kind. The instructor cares about students' future and careers and teaches with a real-world example. The instructor also has close and good interaction with the students and understands and tries with best effort to solve students' issues.

The professor was good at taking concepts we were learning and making us really think about the application and use cases of said concepts. I love that the professor always tries to make everyone feel comfortable in class, while also challenging us with real-world problems and puzzles.

This course was excellently taught and even with complex material, the teacher broke down with several hands on examples. The homework assignments were challenging, but the right amount of challenge where I had to problem solve and stretch my thinking yet I did not become depressed or discouraged by the enormity and/or impossible nature of it.

Professor Si frequently asked challenging questions during lectures and gave the class time to work them out individually. I found these problems to be intellectually stimulating and were an excellent tool in solidifying my understanding of the concepts that were introduced.
the best
Cool professor and very humorous. You will enjoy working with him.
He takes insanely long breaks during lectures and half the time struggles to answer very basic questions. Quite condescending of students, not a good experience.

Professor Si frequently asked challenging questions during lecture and gave the class time to work them out individually. I found these problems to be intellectually stimulating, and were an excellent tool in solidifying my understanding of the concepts that were introduced.

The professor was good at taking concepts we were learning and making us really think about the application and use cases of said concepts. It helped me think about some of the data structures and algorithms in a larger way and also helped me understand them more in the context of the real world.

Hands down the best professor or teacher I have ever had. His assignments are very applicable to the real world, and his lectures are very immersive and involve a lot of whiteboard/interview style practice problems. He also offers up to 10% extra credit for going up to the whiteboard or presenting your ideas to the class. You will not regret!
if you want an easy 4.0 css class, then take with dong si.
Lots of hands on and participation in class.
What a nice guy he teach us online with clear lectures and groups discussions even when having bad COVID illness.
Prof Si is caring and wants to make sure his students will be successful. Lots of the practices and small group discussions in class and available outside of the classroom. Nice man.
He is a good mentor on managing projects and a big group, and really cares about the students and their future career.
Professor cares about the students and their difficulties on submitting the work in a tight quarter.

Highly recommend to take capstone thesis with Si, inspirational, build your skill sets. 

He is also flexible on things and very generous. Motivate/encourage you to do things independently but also provide team support.
The capstone experiences with Dr’s DAIS group help me learn much more than lectures.
Prof. Si manage the capstone project in a very organized way and always give good career advices. His DAIS group has tons of resources.
Knowledgeable, helpful, and friendly.
Professor Si cares about his students, their career, and their future. I am also glad to work with his group and use the project as a capstone.
Dr. Si's lecture is inspirational and his advice to students is encouraging. The class covers both technical aspects and hands-on projects. Really recommend.
Prof. Dong Si is so nice and generous. He is willing to help whenever you need.
Participation really matters. You would have self-motivation on projects and research when taking this class.
Dr. Si is very generous in giving away extra credit when you answer bonus questions.
Tech both the technology and ethics. Literature review and project matter a lot. A lot of discussions and interaction in class.

Expects you to know everything before you go to class and gets mad when you don't, yet his method to prepare you is to throw a bunch of links to semi-relevant textbooks at you and tell you to self-study. Very condescending, especially if you ask questions or answer a question wrong. Definitely avoid!

Professor Si spent most of the quarter talking about his personal research. By week 5 or 6, we were still reviewing prereq content and hadn't gotten into any class material. Assigned a quarter long project but didn't teach any machine learning prior to project due dates. No structure, no textbook, slides were bare, made me feel stupid. Bad class.

He would often wait 15+ minutes for everyone to raise their hand on zoom to mark that they had an answer to a simple question in class. Waste of time. We worked on problems in class which was great but they were NOT relevant to the homework. It's almost like the homework is a separate beast. START homework early and go to the QSC for help!

reviews.comment: Good to okay lectures, definitely learned some new concepts from his class. Only gives out extra credit points if you are his special favorite. Only helpful in class, any help is hard to get. Kind of an easy grader, but it's very dependent on his TA.

reviews.comment: He really cares about student's success and future career in data science. Give a lot of advices and alway reply email fast.

He has quite a few project directions that you can play with AI and app design and have hands on experiences. Collaboration matters and learned a lot. He replies emails quickly and cares about your career development.
Easy going guy. Bonus points.
Solid professor, provides clear instructions. Participate in class

Dong Si is one of the worst professors I have ever had. He will not answer questions about assignment or answer emails. He wastes class time by doing in class bonus points for simple problems that will not help you with exams or homework. He often ended class over an hour early. Refuses to teach anything. He skipped teaching important topics.
He is terrible and doesn't care about students. I learned nothing from lectures that I couldn't have by looking at the slides from other courses for 5 mins.

He is way too tough on grading and has unrealistic expectations. If you have any life obligations outside of this class, I would highly recommend not taking this course. I've never worked so hard or been so stressed about a class before and still got my first B ever. As others have pointed out, the class is very unorganized.

He doesn't seem to care, is extremely unorganized, has grading criteria but ends up grading on a whim and very critically for project/presentation. Assignments were always due before he lectured over the material and had to be moved at the last minute (stressful!). Rude to students in class. Just reads off the slides and avoids answering questions.
Best. He use group discussions a lot and the students are motivated by the bonus points. Learned a lot from the project.
Doe not help students. Gives pressure to them. Just reads out the slides and does not explain them.

Professor Si is by far the worst teacher I've ever had. I'm about half way through my CS degree, and have never recieved anything lower than a B+ (for perspective). reviews.comment: Really cleverly crafted homework that requires you to consider a lot of good edge cases. Good step by step explanations of algorithms. Poor teacher for the SW design portion of the class. His style was to have us design something and then not comment on how he might have improved it, or give any real direction/thoughts at all.
He is a very nice professor. His teaching style and tests are as simple as it gets.

His lectures were a bit dry and boring, I noticed that ever fewer people showed up as the quarter went by. The main thing in the class is the research project and a few easy homework assignments. Grading on the final paper is very tough, he is very particular about the analysis.

reviews.comment: I love the pop up bonus parts which makes you focus on the lecture. His lecture is very clear.
Awesome professor! good sense of humor haha

I have to say I learned a lot from this course and his is really a nice guy. I like  the bonus question part of discussion and term project and the way he make complicated concept easy to understand .   could have more written homework  instead of just programming.

It was Dr. Si's first quarter here, you can see the effort and enthusiasm he put on the class and how much he cares about the students' success. The instruction is very clear. I feel much more prepared to take the thesis project thanks to professor Si's guidance on the term project.

reviews.comment: I don't know why this professor is rated so low. He's like the best professor I've had. He is passionate and is overall a super nice person. I did not pass the class but this was not his fault it was me not putting enough effort. And lets be real the people who rated this professor low just cant blame themselves for their own failure.

This is my first time taking CSS class and I have to say he is a nice guy and super friendly and actually cares about students. Before I took this class I saw so many bad reviews about him and make me wonder if I should keep taking his class, turns out it's still worth taking if you want to learn java.

I took IB computer science so I came into this class already knowing the majority of the content. However he grades hard. Even assignments graded on effort dont expect full points no matter what you do. Our class averages were almost always in the C-D range so that should give you an idea on how well he covered the material.

His written and verbal instruction and explanation are extremely confusing. In class, he tends to just reading off PowerPoint slides. Students are expected to self-teach and learn Java. Be ready to deal with tons of challenging homework with a few/no guidance. Pre-class quizzes require student to understand everything from new chapter to solve.

reviews.comment: This course is not supposed to be as hard as this prof makes it. assignments are completely nonsensical bordering broken. Furthermore he is a tough grader and gives weak feedback if any.

If it's your first time learning computer programming, don't take it from this professor. Even some of the experienced peers in my class seemed to be struggling. You will be teaching yourself Java. If your major is gpa restricted do not take this class, his homework and just questions in general are borderline unintelligible. Do not take this class if you care about your grades

It's hard to follow along with him and this quarter felt like a nightmare.

BE prepared to work with extremely challenging written questions on the midterms and the final exam. He told everyone BEFOREHAND that the final wouldn't affect our quarter grades for the course, but it did after he UNEXPECTEDLY changed the grading policy 3 days AFTER we took our final.. I would AVOID taking any of his courses if I were you!!

I actually took him for Investigative Biology (BBIO 355). This is hands down the hardest investigative biology class to get a good grade in. The amount of time he expects you to put into this class is highly unrealistic, additionally his grading criteria are very biased. DO NOT TAKE HIM IF YOU VALUE UR TIME AND GRADES!

Expects you to memorize small details, when asked if we should memorize something he said no but you should know the jist of it, then puts the whole thing on the exam worth a ton of points. Says we should have learned this in other classes but they werent a prereq, even in the prereq class we didnt learn some things and he didnt go over them.

This class for an elective is horrible for a non-STEM major. If you can avoid it, please do or it will wreck your GPA!! Very poorly designed for non-STEM students who are very capable but not prepared.

The lectures are boring and clumsy (he used old lectures from last year). This class should have been Intro to NeuroSci instead. Quizzes are confusing, disorganized class materials. Also lazy.

reviews.comment: If you are a CP major & aren't prepared for the STEM approach, please avoid taking this class for NW & choose a PSYCH prof. The structure of the course is depressing. Quizzes are unreasonable& based on at least 2-3 readings & videos he records for each quiz. The class has been one of the worst in my two years here, I HONESTLY DO NOT RECOMMEND IT.

Absolutely amazing. He focuses a lot on group projects, and it is a huge part of your grade. Luckily, I had a great group and we did really well. He tries to teach endocrinology from several different aspects so you really get a great understanding of the topics. His quizzes were tough, but as long as you do the other assignments you will be fine.

Dr. Wacker is one of the best professors in the biology department I have ever had. He is very intelligent and facilitated online class (due to COVID) flawlessly. His lectures are long and filled with an overwhelming amount of information but our online meetings were engaging and productive. Make sure to actively participate!

Dr. Wacker's classes are lecture heavy. He doesn't post lectures online (he posts blank PowerPoints), so attendance is necessary. He provides many examples for whatever concept he is teaching. His lectures definitely keep you awake; they are interesting! His tests are pretty straight forward. No surprises. Would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Wacker is an unforgettable character who has amazing insights into his field of animal behavior. However, he stated early on in the class "students who have had me earlier do better". This is because they are prepared for the cluster. His tests (most of your grade) are 80% based on your ability to remember specific anecdotes without context.

Very engaging professor! Knows his stuff and knows how to explain in laymans terms. Participation is important, he grades you on how often you speak. Make sure you post on the canvas discussions on-time and you should be fine. Exams are hard, alottt of questions on the sudy guide but expectations are clear! Love him! Very approachable

My favorite teacher I have had at UW. His lectures are fun and entertaining. However, DO NOT SKIP LECTURE!! His notes are not online and once you miss one class you easily can fall behind. Very clear study guides so although the exams are tough, and i mean TOUGH , you can easily be prepared. Very willing to help, super nice. Id take his class again

His test are super easy if you take good notes and memorize the diagrams he stars. If you want an easy A just go through the study guides he posts. Also, don't skip class because he doesn't post his lectures online.

Makes class as interesting as possible and is always looking for student engagement. Though he expects a lot from his students he makes sure that hes available to help facilitate the meeting of these expectations. Wacky guy but Id definitely take a class with him again

Best prof I have EVER had! Lectures are completely thorough and he's always available for extra help. He's also beyond hilarious. Great sense of humor. Grade is mostly based on exams and participation so if you go to class and PAY ATTENTION you'll do just fine. I also took B BIO 351 with him as well. Take him, you won't regret it. Best prof, PERIOD

If you aren't a bio major, it will be a little more rough on you, but manageable. It's TONS of memorization though. Exams are fair game (easier than I thought) and average grades are pretty high. Grades on participation and exams. No projects.

He only bases his grades one three tests. Beware! If you mess up on a test, there is no way to recover; he doesn't give extra credit except on bonus questions on the tests. His grading isn't the best.

Very unclear on what he wants you to know. Requires a lot of time and effort to succeed in his class. Lots of quizzes and participation based assignments. Labs are hard to follow. Would definitely not recommend taking any class with him.

You will get what you put into, like everything else. Don't listen to the reviewers with the negative comments - you'll have to put in a lot of work to get "a good grade", but what's most important is you'll walk out of the experience with concrete knowledge of the subject you're studying. He's hilarious as well. One of the best professors I took.
I will never take a course taught by him ever again!! Very unclear on what he wants you to include in your papers until he's already graded them. Extremely harsh grader and very unorganized.

Very friendly knowledgeable professor, gives thorough lectures, provides fill-in-the-blank notes, gives extra review before exams, is happy to discuss extra material in office hours (e.g. for MCATS). However very tricky, complex exam questions and grading can be overly harsh & nit-picky. Not an easy class to do well in and a bit frustrating.

OMG!! Super boring and drawn on, never relates his lectures to the actual assignments. For example we wrote specific aims for our experiments and then didn't discuss this in class but talked about how to get reviewed through NSF... which no one plans on looking into!! If you like to hear a teacher talk about himself for 2 hours you'll love this :)

MY FAVORITE PROFESSOR SO FAR- and I'm a senior! Professor Wacker is very interesting to listen to. He makes a lot of corny jokes that are entertaining. He is also very passionate about bio. He tells you what will be on the tests and whats important to know- go to class! His tests are still very difficult as he wants you to  integrate a lot!

I took his class after reading the ratings on here and was scared but it was the best class i ever took and he is the best teacher i ever had. As a person of color especially. His class was fairly easy, just show up. He is lenient and funny. He made class fun and i looked forward to class. I recommend him, I want to take his class again.

This professor mostly talked 2 hour straights and not even about the class. Everything he talked about seemed to be his own personal political beliefs which would be fine if he didn't quiz us on it. You have to know " the best answer". Expect those quizzes every week and they will be the only graded until the end of the quarter. Do not take!!
I liked Maurice when he attended class, but he was often up to an hour late to class and feedback was non-existent. Pretty easy 4.0 he graded all fo the work on the last day possible and graded easy

Most engaging professor Ive had at UWB. His class activities are creative and you learn so much from his class. Its true he doesnt grade anything till the end, but you know the quality of work you did. I wish I could take many more classes with him.

Home works are not graded, and we are still waiting for grades. I would expect some sort of a follow-up announcement about our final grade. His excuse was he lost his notes, but he could have graded along the way. At this point there should be a default 4.0 with comments and feedbacks about assignments. On the the other hand, he is a great lecturer
he has 10 assignments .... and none of them graded..... but grades are due Tuesday .... I have no idea what my grade is going to be and that is soooo annoying class is easy but kind of frusturated

Creates assignments out of seemingly no where, doesn't post things ahead of time, nor will he post assignments even after he's assigned them. He regularly changes the grading rubric and doesn't grade the assignments once he's received them. Gives group assignments and then grades everyone individually, why make it group? Bad organizer, pop quizzes.

reviews.comment: Fantastic. Super intense, big time story teller, very intelligent and inspirational. A little disorganized, hard to tell what's due when, but once you get used to his teaching style you can get a lot out of the class.

Dr. D is a very kind, intelligent and funny guy. He's passionate about the topics, and knows how to present them. He's also very flexible and will often remove/push assignments if the class happens to need more time, or ends up going a different direction. However, he can be a bit disorganized at times, but nothing too extreme.

Initially, he's kind of boring, but if you pay attention in the class and try to engage with him. You realize he's a good guy who wants students to learn and retain what he's teaching. Pay attention in lecture, do the homework yourself, you don't need the text book, ask questions if you're stuck, and engage in his lectures.

I thought ts professor was pretty lecture heavy and quite tiring as a 8:45 class. However, his expertise and lectures are generally helpful. I find myself enjoying him more in the quarter. He takes some time to get used to, so if you're not used to that probably don't take ts class.

Professor Jorgenson was very clear about what he expects from students. His classes are very lecture heavy, but the lectures are very relevant to the class material and homework, if you follow the lecture then you'll understand the homework. TLDR: follow lectures, do homework, be honest, textbook not needed, ask questions, if you try he will help.

Extremely chill, makes jokes while making an effort to explain the applications of linear algebra. More of an intro to machine learning course and stats then pure linear algebra. He's pretty clear and looks at his exam results to decide what to review.
My friend is taking ts class and they're really struggling and it makes me sad, because he isn't very helpful and yeah.... breaks my heart 🧸
Don't try honestly ts a no for me personally

Class wasn't too hard and some of his lectures were a bit dry. Takes a coding heavy approach which didn't resonate with some of the non-tech savvy students. Otherwise, the professor is chill and he doesn't assign very much homework. His exams are also on the easier side.

One of the best professors I've ever had. If you show that you are putting effort into the class, he will help you to the maximum. This course had midterm and final interviews in which he helps you out if you get stuck. You actually learn how to apply Linear Algebra in Python rather than just learn the math. Very caring and considerate prof.
Great professor. Lectures can get a little boring sometimes, but exams are not too hard and not much homework. Would recommend

Attendance is not mandatory unless for exams. Homework is easy if you pay attention in lectures. Almost impossible to reach out to him outside of class or office hours. Not a very good professor. I'd strongly recommend taking a different professor if you need to take this course. I found it easier to teach myself the material instead.

He also gives opportunities for extra credit. If you put in the effort and ask for help when you need it, you will do well. 10/10 would recommend.
His lab instruction is clear but a bit too long to read sometimes. He is hilarious and caring about students. I met with him many times in the EE lab on Saturday for extra help with the lab report.

Eric himself is very nice and is always available to help students. The problems are with his lab write ups! You spend more time trying to figure out what he's asking you to calculate. He also has you calculate things unnecessary to the procedure that you will not use later which is frustrating.

EE 331 Lab was so much fun with Eric. He gives a lot of opportunity for extra credit which is really great in the end. Eric is so much and really cares about the students and is there to help. He even comes in an extra day every week in case we have doubts or need extra help. Definitely looking forward to taking EE 433 with him or any other labs !

Loved him! Best class I have ever taken!! VERY ACCESSIBLE - he cares for students and wants them to learn and he will spend time outside of class, explaining over and over again until you understand. He was funny and his lectures were great. He REALLY is a gem. Last but not least, he is, without doubt, the most knowledgeable man I have ever met!

Wanted to kill myself everytime I entered class. Very harsh grader and either you get 100% on the homework or no points at all. No partial credit, no remorse. reviews.comment: Busy work but he's still nice and wants the best out of students. He encourages students to think differently and go out of their comfort zone which is a cool mindset.

reviews.comment: Good courses.

During my career, as a financial investigator, I worked corporate tax and investment fraud cases. The amount of money that fraudsters tried to hide on the financial statements was difficult to track and even more complicated to explain. This class showed me new ways to extract the information from the financial statements for reports and exhibits
Great professor! very intelligent, nice, and friendly. You learn a lot after taking his class. Any time I needed help I felt he was readily available to answer any questions.

Great lectures and he records some of the lectures so we can go back to listen to it, lectures makes you think about why we have accounting principles and if we should be applying accounting this way. Prepare for group projects which helps develop presentation skills. His classes are always engaging and never boring. I would take his class again.
