reviews.comment: Professor Holland is professional and rich with knowledge. This class involved reading lots of Harvard case studies but were very interesting! I learned important concepts in every lecture and found his lectures inspirational and fun. He is fair but will challenge you to critically think and show your understanding of concepts. Awesome professor!
Great at discussions, just pay attention and do homework.

He is not a helpful professor. He thinks that he is the smartesr guy in the class, he always say there is no right and wrong answer, but he only has one answer in his mind. If you have great points to support your idea, but is not the idea he wants, you will get bad grade

The worst ever!I participated every class and never missed any hw. He gave me a 3.0 and gave other student a 3.7 while our answers were exactly same.Do not argue with him-you won't get a reasonable explanation! He will give you very low grade on all your assignments! You do not get to complain about it because he is in charge of the department!

This class was really fun because it was completely based on HBS case studies.  Mr. Holland has a distinct way in grading, but you'll do find as long as you listen to his feedbacks and stay engaged during class discussions.  Don't take his class if you want an easy A!
He is just awesome. It is definitely challenging and fun. You will learn a lot from him.

I really felt that his contribution to my education in business was nominal. I took him for macroecon and it really didn't teach me about the subject at all. He tells you how something is and rather than you understanding it and analyzing what's really going on, he just wants you to regurgitate the information he gives you. His exams are HARD.
i took his macroecon class and he was just awesome. Trust me. he is very helpful and clear. After u take his class, u will love macroecon.
he is just awesome.i dont get why ppl rate him so low.
No Comments

Very knowledgeable about fin. markets and banks, but is very arrogant. There is only 1 correct answer (his). Tests are 100% about memorization of facts/lists/pros+cons and not about concepts. Frustrating. Call-on-me points are 10% of your grade and a waste of time. Interesting subject matter, but boring and ineffective class. Glad it's over.
Extremely Arogant - His way or the highway.  Can not trust him...
He will work you but he is a goood teacher.

The thing that made this course hard was the discrepancy between lecture content and quiz/test questions; make sure to study harder questions than what you're practicing in homework or lectures. Take advantage of office hours as well. Super kind and caring prof and would take again.

If this is your first math class in college i don't recommend this professor. You do all of the learning outside of class because this professor does not give lectures. They don't give much feedback or help you with assignments in class so I recommend going to office hours.

Professor Hoover is an excellent lecturer who supports students in calculus. Their lectures are clear with diagrams and examples. Be prepared for exams/quizzes by completing lecture videos and homework outside class. In class, group work is expected by collaborating with group members. Use their office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I've never been a great math student but Professor Hoover is a great instructor. The class is flipped so it's a lot of watching videos and notes at home but ask a lot of questions, watch the lectures, and do the practices and you'll be okay. Got a D my last time taking this class and now I think it'll be a B+. Taking again for BMATH123 in Autumn.

she's the most PETTIEST professor when it comes to grading. I have her 4 calc 2 & she marked me off points cuz I didnt grammatically explain something in the EXACT phrase she wanted (even tho i was correct). I emailed her with concern only to be met with the most unprofessional, petty, disrespectful & personal email back. idk how she go this job.

Professor Hoover is the best calc professor ive had so far! They really care about their students succeeding and her class structure is helpful for learning calc. I am taking this class and have been able to keep up despite the fact pace due to the professor. Expect group work during class and video lectures out of class also homeworks!

Really straight forward. Does a great job detailing and explaining how certain rules and concepts work. She does grade you for attendance, and even if you are ~20min late, she will have you make those up through other means. Overall, final was straight forward, just have to look at previous midterms and assingments, and pay attention.

flipped classroom instruction, complete lectures before class 3 times a week. After each class is a pearson assignment. 3 exams, lowest score is dropped. Weekly team quizzes that are open book, not hard if you do your lecture assignments. Always happy to help in office hours. Notecard for each exam and on the final. The final is insanely easy.

They use a hybrid teaching style where the lectures are online videos and in person you do practice problems with a group. Doing practice problems helps so much with math, so the expectations for the exams seemed clear. Showing up to class is a must since there are group quizzes that account for a good portion of the final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Gotta be one of the worse professors out there. Her teaching style is making you watch videos outside of class, many of them make 0 sense. The videos covers the very very basics of the unit, and in class you're expected to figure out very complex stuff in groups. The homework website cost $100 and it also sucks and makes 0 sense.

Failed the first time, but passed the second. They are very supportive and want to help just give a lot of work in WAMAP. I liked how they structured the class, very organized. If you put in the effort you will pass and they drop a lot of your lowest-scored quizzes/exams which helped me pass. I appreciate them as a professor, just don't get behind.

Class had open-note group quizzes and bonus points for good attendance. You were allowed 1 notecard for each exam, and 1 exam grade was dropped. She was very nice and answered all my questions. If you want a 4.0 you NEED to talk to her in office hours. Calculus is very complicated, but she will help you get a good grade if you put the effort in.

Taking a different math professor showed me how great of a professor Nicole Hoover is. She is aware that students have lives outside of her class and she is very accommodating of that. It was clear that she wants her students to succeed in her class, which makes her my favorite professor I have ever taken. I recommend her to everyone I know.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is a nice person and is considerate but her teaching style isn't. Most of the class is online lecture videos and the whole class is basically taught through time-intensive homework. If you struggled with math, ESPECIALLY over online school like I did, DO NOT take this class. Maybe its me but it was hard to actually learn the subjects in class.

The people who rate this Professor Hoover low and got a bad grade in this class probably get a bad grade in every class. She drops your lowest exam, 2 lowest quizzes, 2 homework assignments, and 2 lecture assignments. For exams, she will give you full points, even if you got it wrong. Just as long as your thought process was correct. ITS FREELO

If you have to take any math classes at UWB, take Professor Hoover!!!!!! She is the best. Her lectures are easy to understand, she gives good advice, and she has a grading scheme so that your lowest scores are dropped, both on homework and exams!!! I was terrible at math until I took this class and got a 3.9.

She doesn't understand the students side of her teaching. Class usage time we didn't learn anything new with it being mandatory to arrive. Grading was hard as even if you got the correct answer but showed limited work or not the way she likes it, you get zero points for that question. 10 min. lecture videos and practice exam was not helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Hoover is nice and caring. She tries to make opportunities to get points back. There is three tests and she drops the lowest one which is great! There is also a final but you are allowed notecards on it along with the exams. There are a handful of take home quizzes. It is pretty lecture heavy as there is a lot to learn in ten weeks  .

Dont recommend this teacher. Only lectures are 10 minute recorded videos that are nothing like the content on tests and quizzes. Class time was completely useless and a waste of time. Definitely have considered dropping multiple times because of how stressful it is.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: My class was hybrid and she had some videos that are a bit old but you take notes from the book that you buy and answer lecture/practice questions on a website called WAMAP. If you do all the homework and the assignments youll be fine since it is worth more than the final and really keeps your grade up!

If you are poor just like me, professor Hoover is very caring and delicate. Very well taught class, gives good feedback and clear instructions on what's expected. Nice person too

The tests are not too difficult if you've been following the homework and quizzes. But this is also a double edged sword since there's a fairly hefty amount of prep assignments, homework and weekly quizzes. Despite this I still recommend.

Had Professor Hoover Fall quarter 2020 for pre calc. Not sure what she is like normally, but we had an all online class due to the pandemic, and she was really understanding and gave pretty good lectures that were all recorded. The assignments weren't too tough, and the tests weren't too bad either.

I really enjoyed Professor Hoover's class, she is really patient and helpful to explain more challenging concepts. She was really flexible, and gave us ways to make up missed classes, as well as no penalty for late practice and lecture assignments. She was very accessible outside of class, with emails as well as office hours.
Very good professor that cares about her students. Make sure you do all the assignments and you will be fine.

Hoover is extremely laid back and a great teacher. As long as you show up and do the work, you will do well. No exams, just weekly quizzes and projects. She is super understanding if you have something going on. Definitely recommend her!!
Gives quizzes on Sunday?????? Kind of a stupid thing to do, but her class is easy and she's nice.

Weekly quizzes that are no more than 2-5 questions (with multiple parts). Gives tedious amounts of homework from MyMathLab (not optional) and worksheets with lectures to go with them (optional). reviews.comment: The difficulty is not necessarily hard but rather annoying she expects us to write every little thing down. One time she marked me down for not showing 1/2 <1 smh. Wow. I didn't appreciate how well she'd set up our class until I moved on to a WAY worse prof! Wish she could teach my current math course, too.
Well organized and clear explanation. Quizzes and exams are easier than the homework problems. Recommend taking her classes.

This class was a major improvement from the last math class I took at UWB. Participation matters, and we do a lot of group-work. reviews.comment: I've always struggled with math but Professor Hoover was really great. She goes in depth for each chapter and her teaching style works really well. She provides a lot of outside help and makes sure you understand the content.

awful teacher who doesn't actually teach during class but makes you figure work out in groups without lecture. she can be very rude and condescending. She uses a bad sense of humor to gloss over how she really doesn't teach more than a few minutes every class.

I would take her again.

reviews.comment: I have never been very good at math, and she would always try to inspire students that it was okay. But she made it impossible to learn in this class. It is strictly textbook oriented, and if you're ever confused she does not help at all.  She also grades by the decimal, so if you're .001% from passing, she will not round. Try to avoid her!

Doesn't really seem to care about the students. Nicole also doesn't seem to explain things very well and assumes everyone knows what they are doing. When asking a question it's extremely hard to get her to explain it in different ways.

Great teacher, I took her twice. If you study then you will pass. If you don't study you will not pass. Make sure you show up to class because participation is crucial. I really enjoyed this class and I recommend this professor.

As someone who has struggled with math forever, I loved Hoover. I voluntarily decided to take her again for Calc. There were only three major exams including the final, but there were weekly quizzes, which were not hard to pass if you knew  the material from the week. Very helpful whenever I needed it. She definitely noted participation though.

This is the first time in my life that I was able to skip math classes and it did not impact my grade. The class is mostly 15 minute lectures followed by an hour and a half of staring at the wall because she doesn't explain enough of the topic to finish the work. You are better off staying at home and watching khan academy or YouTube help videos.

This professor was very supportive of me when I was going through family situations. So I cannot say she does not care about her students. But I really had a hard time in her class because it was more group work based. And no one really worked together. And she really gave round about answers when you were confused on something.

She did exactly what she needed to do. Maybe the fact that the class was more textbook oriented, I wasn't a big fan of math in general, but she did her job well. Homework online kind of sucks but it does make her job a little easier. I wish the final would be worth more of our grade since it should be the reflection of how much I learned this year.
Avoid this professor as much as possible. She will not help you, she talks down to her students, and teaches strictly by the textbook, which is very annoying.

Nicole is a great math teacher. Nothing about her instructions are ever confusing and you can tell she truly cares about her students. The practice tests she gives out are so helpful and beneficial as they show you what to expect on a test. Seriously those practice tests saved me. She's definitely one of the better math teachers I've had.
TAKE HER! she is amazing teacher! calc2 is hard she knows that and is there for you! knows how to explain well!! for exam study her worksheets and quizzes and you should be fine!

I love Hoover! She passed out structured worksheets with places to fill in notes as she lectured, and then gave the class problems to work on individually or as small groups. I found this to be a very effective teaching style. Exams and quizzes are straightforward, no surprises, and she grades exams on a curve. Homework is online.

Nicole is an excellent prof. Classes consisted of lecturegroupwork. She hands out worksheets so you can follow along during lecture. They also include practice problems for groupwork. 2 Exams. Quizzes were once a week. HIGHLY recommend completing the worksheets bc there will most likely be similar problems on the quiz. Review hwquiz before exams.

Great and funny professor, not monotone. Quizzes were almost every week and were harder than exams. Homework is on wileyplus. She drops 1-2 quizzes depending on the class. Final exam problems are based EXACTLY from previous quizzes and exams. Easier grader than others calc2 professors, I recommend her. Not saying calc2 was easy though.

The worst professor ever!! Skipped class more than I did!! Class Schedule is Monday Wednesday, and she always skip  class on wednesday so that she can have a long weekend!! lectures are not related to the exam at all!! Lazy professor, the only grade you will get is just your mid-term.   Avoid this professor at all costs!!!!

She is a funny professor. But, get on her bad side or not prepare for lecture and she will snap at you! I enjoy her teaching and you work for your grade. However, her slides and lectures are useless compared to the material on the exams. She lectures about 20-30% of what is in the text, but expects you to know the whole textbook. Not very helpful.

Avoid this class if you can! Total grade point killer, ambiguous instructions, no way to track progress (only one grade given the entire quarter). That being said, the content was marginal and the instructor's interest was high so not a terrible class altogether. If there is another instructor choice for this class I suggest exploring it.

First, she's not as bad if you are prepared for class which means reading from 20-80 pages depending on the day. All I got on BB was my midterm for a grade. Read the cases and book since the slides are worthless. The Capsim is garbage and plan for you other business project since everything is due near the end.
I thought she was great and had clear expectations of what was required for the course. It was tough but taking a capstone course isn't supposed to be a walk in the park.

Everyone warned against having a class with this Prof. saying she was way too harsh and the class was difficult. For a capstone class it was a breeze, just read the cases and be prepared in class so she does not get in your face for not reading. I really recommend it.

This is a strategy class for an MBA program.  This is the best class I have ever taken.  The professor challenges my thinking in ways that I never experienced in my undergrad.  She is very knowledgeable, very insightful, very clear, and very engaging.
Dr. Hoehn-Weiss is very passionate about strategy. She is always willing to listen, but this course is a lot of work. Have fun with the Capsim.

The only grade we received during entire quarter was our midterm exam! We never received any grade on our final exam, strategic challenges project, capsim, or class participation! After 2 weeks of final exam, she just posted our final GPA on MyUW! My advise: if you can, never ever take the Strategic Management course at UWB with her!

She was the WORST instructor I've ever had! She has NO flexibility, absolutely NONE! She treats everybody like a high school students. I wish there was another choice for BBUS470. As somebody else said: "AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS, RUN FAST."
Manuela is one of the best professors I had in the MBA program. The material we learned was useful and relevant  and our class discussions were stimulating and engaging.

Awesome teacher!  Probably my favorite so far at the UWB TMBA program.  She is knowledgeable, helpful, and encourages discussion in class.  Her class isn't easy, but well worth the work.  I wish all of the professors in the TMBA program were as professional and effective as Manuela.

Manuela is a delight. If you study the material you will do well on the tests. Capsim is highly curved and the group project is fun.  I don't understand why people are giving her poor reviews. Honestly, it sounds like the same person wrote it. Also, she came to our graduation which was nice, most other profs didn't care to.

Class discussions are horrible, she cuts people off, and can't take others' opinions well. Exam materials are irrelevant to class lecture. She will stop her lecture just to tell students to stop using their cell phones which detracts from learning. Capsim is weighed too heavily she and never gave directions for it. AVOID  HER AT ALL COSTS RUN FAST!
A nice professor, but she is vague in her class discussions. Her evaluation was discouraging. Her exams were overloaded with textbook material that she didn?t fully discuss in class.

The class did not seem hard at all. We had ongoing group project- CAPSIM, which is great simulation how to run a company. She had great Harvard case studies. The problem was her grading. She was extremely harsh. She did not discuss 90% of the material that showed up on the exams. My suggestion is fight for your grade if you believe that you deserve

BBUS 470 was interesting. CAPSIM is a great learning tool. The class wasn't easy, mostly because of the teacher. She is a difficult person. Her critique was harsh and discouraging. Her exams were heavily loaded with textbook material that she didn?t discuss in class.  Her grading is extremely harsh. Prepare for a low grade. Avoid her if you can!

Manuela is a good instructor, but she is very difficult. I thoroughly enjoyed her class. It was very worth the time and effort spent on the material. Her lectures related to the assigned textbook readings. The best part about her is that she is willing to modify her class (within reason) based on the feedback of the students. One of my favorites!

The course was great. Its really worth paying to learn. The course contains a vast knowledge but the professor failed to convincing those knowledge to students. She just rephrased the key words from the textbook…nothing came from her real-world experience. Poor teaching skill. Best of luck for all of you taking this class! Study hard your butt off

Great Lecturer. Class was pretty easy. Had to run from Kane to the Oceanography buildings, so missed the clicker questions that were given right when the bell rang. He Loves His Eel Grass. Lectures were interesting. Tests are 1/2 from the lecture and 1/2 analyzing scientific data. Bring a rain coat for the field exercises

Such a great teacher. Really intelligent, approachable, and patient with students. And adorable. I think every girl in my class had a giant crush on him. Aside from that though, he is a really good teacher that seems to know everything. The test grading seemed really harsh and I panicked all quarter but in the end I got a 3.5 so no complaints.

Great Professor.  He is an excellent lecturer, and writes a fair, but long exam.  He is extremely knowledgable, and enjoyable to learn from.  Take a biology class with him for sure if you get a chance.
Good Professor.  Very clear lectures, and fair exams.  He does a good job explaining concepts, and is extremely knowledgable.  Take biology with him if you get the chance.
Very nice and engaging, his love of biology is contagious. The tests are reasonable if you have been keeping up with lectures.  Overall, a good teacher!

Horwith is everything you could want  from a professor- engaging, intelligent, funny, helpful, interesting, and enthusiastic. The clicker questions & tests are all reasonable & all you need for a good grade is to review the lecture notes. Don't even need to read the textbook really. ANYWAYS BEST PROFESSOR EVER.
Dr. Horwith is a great professor! He shows us cute animal videos and even uses Pokemon as an example of population changes. Although his first midterm was hard, the second one went a lot better.

His tests are painfully long!! You will curse his name half way through the first exam; however his lectures are interesting—most of the time. His love for anything Biology also becomes very evident early on in the course, through his nerdy sense of humor. And, yes he is very attractive and has a gorgeous smile.

One of my favorite instructors I've had at UW. Lecture is engaging and it's clearly evident that he's very intelligent. His high level of interest in the subject and in teaching makes lectures enjoyable and his easy-going personality makes him quite approachable. Tests feel too long. And he's so attractive, it's painful.

He is the best professor I've had in my life! Attractive, funny, nice, rich, smart, young, etc. This is random, but he wears different clothes everyday and he is the only guy I've met who looks good in bright orange socks <3<3<3

Micah is quite clear and often engaging... however i found that he often blocks out scientific curiosity (maybe thats just bio is general) Also... super long tests!! ALso... UTLTA CUTE (so hard to concentrate in class :P)

Professor Horwith is the best professor I had in UW. He has a very good sense of humor and makes the course interesting. His tests might be too long which, however, is the usual case for a bio class at UW. His office hours are on a lawn if its sunny, and he is extremely helpful and clear when explaining materials. BTW did I mention he's super cute?

If you try somewhat at all you will get a good grade in this class. He is a bit fake nice, made a couple comments that were disparaging while masking it with interest in your group project. We all know people who are fake nice but they let some comments slip that show how they really feel. Just fair warning.

He is a genius teacher that use self education technique, 90% of the class is team project where you get to create your own company, you will learn a lot , easy grader . appreciate the way he teach because I think it's the best way. A lot of fun
He is awesome.

This class is the easiest class I've ever taken. But don't think you don't get anything from it. The teacher is super nice and helpful. He makes learning so fun and I can just easily understand the materials without trying super hard. Everybody in class got an A (I guess)

Very easy A class but you still get something from it. online hw, online quiz (which u check ur answers for and get retries), and group final. very engaging lectures and makes you want to listen. class always gets out early as well (330-530 class, usually get out at 430). great professor overall

Does not allow for meetings outside of class
Expects you to know everything based on her 5 minutes of talking
Does not use her own materials
Bases the class off youtube videos
Does not provide feedback
Instructions are always unclear

Not a good professor. Class is a waste of time but attendance is mandatory. Spends the entire class stating that we need to look at every thing in the canvas. Does not do any actual teaching just puts on youtube videos.. Never answers emails and grades hard

DON'T RECOMMEND

grades attendance even tho ur not supposed to do that per UW policy. harsh grader but lacks feedback (especially on busy work). if you miss class for whatever reason your grade drops significantly but she doesnt care the reason
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Shes a very inspirational person with her academic background. But i cannot standdd this class. she grades so harshly and lectures are so brief. she expects us to review all the material on the module, but there is so much information (youtube videos, textbook slides, powerpoint slides) that i get overwhelmed.

The entire class is comprised of group assignments. One group project is due every week. She is not helpful or flexible when you have a bad group. She is loud and has a grating personality. The content of the class is repetitive and doesn't introduce anything new compared to other courses in the health studies major. easy A tho

I took their class in Spring 2024 and, honestly, I struggled with motivation because of the overall atmosphere. The professor seemed intent on appealing to students, yet there was an underlying tone of superiority that made the dynamic feel uncomfortable. The attempt to come across as edgy or relatable often felt forced rather than natural.

In-class activities-20%, Discussion-20%, Final Essay-35%, Final Essay Rough Draft-25%, textbook and course materials are free, lectures uploaded on Canvas, 10% deducted for each day when assignments turned in late, can grant extension upon communication before deadline

A good and kind professor. There is an essay due near the end of the quarter but as long as your grammar makes sense and you include everything in the rubric you should be fine. Grammar is super important to her. There is class activities each class and counts for a grade so participation is a must. No tests or finals other than the essay.
I cannot leave a proper review as the guidelines keep striking it.

He has perhaps the worst canvas page I've ever had the misfortune of seeing. Everything is hidden somewhere, half of the required sources aren't even on the syllabus, and he is VERY picky about what sources you use or where you get your info. Be prepared to get no credit unless you use HIS sources. On his own he's a nice guy and a decent teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took him for BIS 338, as a freshman. Great teacher, gave amazing feedback, and made class engaging. Assignments featured a lot of reading, but weren't too bad! I'd definitely take him again; his class was very interactive as well, as he often asked students for their individual opinions on matters. Very smart guy, and a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Honestly, only 1 note, HEAVILY Liberal. Which is completely fine, but when 100% of sites, videos, and textbooks are extremely left, it gets a little annoying. Great guy and teacher, amazing teaching skills, and I learned so much from the class. Even got an end of the quarter party with free food!

Such a good professor, even though I don't agree with a lot of ideas, I can't not like this guy. Barely gives any hw, super super lenient, and actually likes his job and likes what he does. Take this guy and your quarter will be fun and easy.
professor is very caring about the topics he teaches and his students as well. he was very flexible when it came to extensions and his feedback is helpful and motivating.

Professor Lambacher is a good professor and the class was fairly straightforward, Required a lot of weekly reading (almost too much) so get ready to read, and also had a lot of writing involved so be ready for writing essays + a written midterm and final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This was my favorite class this quarter. Through Jason's American government class I feel like I have learned more than all my years studying the government in high school. This class really provokes you to think critically and dig deep on serious issues that our country faces. It is clear Jason has a passion for what he teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great teacher, mixes lectures with discussions and allows you the proper time to get things done. Definitely can come off very left based politically but when its a class about politics, that kinda bound to happen. Stay on top of work and you'll find an easy A, Midterm was also online and was given a whole week to do.

Prof Lambacher is overall a good professor, class is just VERY reading heavy and has a lot of busy work imo. Overall super interesting class and lectures are interesting current event related topics. Id take him again for sure.

Jason is AMAZING! Yes the classes are reading heavy but you learn a lot of fulfilling material. As you take more and more classes with Jason you will slowly start to build up and amazing collection of literature. Jason is a sweet, kind, and caring profesor and I suggest every take at least one class with him.

Lambacher is a great teacher and person. He provides excellent feedback throughout the quarter, so much so that you can see your own improvement if you listen to his recommendations. You really do learn a lot in this class.

Genuinely the best professor I've had so far. Amazing conversations with the class, and great topics. You can tell he is a very smart and well educated man. We talk about heavy subjects, but he's very good about speaking of them respectfully. Also kind and understanding which is hard to come across. Definitely want to take his classes again!!

Oh my gosh do not take him. So many group projects at one point we had 3 at once with 3 different groups it was ridiculous. His lectures were so boring and he would randomly grade attendance when he saw that the whole class did not show up. Had us buy and read so many books some books you used once and that was it. The final was also horrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing professor that is fun to talk to outside of class. He is very open to new ideas and would listen to every student, which is further helped by how small the classes are here.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Great professor! What I loved most about him was the passion he had for philosophy, and his excitement to share his knowledge with students. Above that, he is an easy grader who cares more about your understanding of the material rather than how well you do on a mid-term or an essay. Would definitely recommend taking his class!

Professor Lambacher is an absolute favorite. The workload is fair, and the class pace is great. Group learning is important, and Professor Lambacher's understanding, it makes reaching out so easy. His passion for teaching and genuine connection with students set him apart. I really respect him and look forward to taking another class next year!

I took Professor Lambacher's course on Individualism and had a great time. He is very passionate about philosophy, has tons of knowledge, and cares about student learning. There is a lot of reading assigned each week (would suggest skimming as much as possible), but not a ton of assignments to go along with them. Talk with him when you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He cares about his students and is understanding when you talk to him. He also has genuine interest in his topics. There is a lot of reading he puts out (you could get by with not reading all of it). The workload wasn't bad, it was a discussion post/response and a page long (double spaced) journal weekly. Would def take a class with him again!
Very nice and fun teacher; he was an easy grader just beware that most of the class is reading with assignments being mainly a page long for the walking journals. Would def take again!
you really feel like youre learning and is a great educator who makes classes interesting and easy to talk to your classmates as well
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment: he has clear grading criteria. he responds to email quick and is super nice

Very easy A. If you just do your work decently and on time you will be totally good! He is very kind and caring and his lectures can be long but he is passionate and knowledgeable. I would recommend it!

The most inspirational class I have ever taken out of my three years so far. He makes international relations fun but very insightful to learn about. He's a professor that truly cares about students, we need more teachers like him in Eduction. It was sad for me to see it end, but this is a class I truly will cherish forever and never forget.

Nothing in his class is worth that many points, most people end the class with over 100% as a lot of things are worth "extra credit." I had him for his walking class and it was fun but there were so many readings. You can get by without attending the classes and just doing the assignments. The assignments are really easy to do and understand. Love!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a super friendly and approachable guy! I would say his course could be better organized because oftentimes we would be behind on course content and that would mean all the assignment deadlines would be mixed up as well.

While the class is very easy and lectures can be skipped, this teacher is a complete waste of your time and money. Spends the whole lecture talking about himself and trying to guilt trip students to feel bad for him. He doesn't care about your time or learning or anything but himself and is just there for a check. You will not learn anything.

It's just your average class. Major concepts covered in the textbook are also covered in lectures. Attendance isn't mandatory, plan your days accordingly and try not to skip when there are group activities. The same amount of effort you put in determines the outcome. Assignments are easy. It takes skill not to be able to pass this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took a course with Jason in the Fall quarter of 2023, by far one of my favorite professors. He is very kind and goes over stuff in class with frequency. Gave us many options for final projects and other assignments, also had a generous grace period for all assignments due dates. Would take a course again with him any time.

I took him as a BCORE class but there was no option to select that as "course taken." Means business and knows how hard it is to be a college student. Very lenient regarding grades as you have a week to turn something in after the due date and still earn full credit. He talks to me 1-on-1 to make sure I'm comfortable in class, communication is key.

Jason was not a terrible professor. I would take him again but the difficulty of his material completely shifted in a week. A lot of group work so choose your group wisely. His lectures are either really interesting or very boring. Regardless, you won't be miserable if you have a good group. His late policy is amazing!

Jason is by far one of my favorite professors I have had in my nearly 4 years of higher education so far. He made me fall in love with the public health field. His late work policy is incredibly generous and he understands how stressful it is to be a student. He honestly just seems like someone you could go out and have a beer with.

He gives you a long extension to finish work. Workload is a lot, but not difficult in content. Instructions for homework can be confusing. One big final group project due at the end that you work on throughout the course. He is not very good at responding in a timely manner. Little check-ins through the quarter. Doesn't listen to your concerns.

Jason was a nice guy. However, he could be a better teacher. He overloads you with homework and the group work is terrible. Throughout the quarter you have to be in a group to work on this final project. You do assignments with them every week and when you have a bad group mate then that sucks for you. His grace period is great.

This professor is the best. He does give a lot of homework, but he also gives lots of extensions. He is not a tough grader like how everyone is saying, but he grades fairly. Make sure to attend his lectures and read all the assigned readings. He assigns lots of articles, but it shouldn't be hard enough. Do all the assignments and you'll pass.

Not very proactive throughout the course besides time in lecture. There are 3-4 assignments due every week which can take time. Check-in quizzes are made to see if you paid attention in class. When grading assignments, no feedback is given so you don't know why points got taken off. Final group project assigned with little to no guidance.

Lots of homework but you can complete homework in teams of 10 if you want. His accessibility to the class made the work tolerable. No rubric available for assignments so it was incredibly difficult to understand assignments. I would take him again because hes nice and approachable with questions. Not a tough grader if you complete assignments
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Its impossible to have full marks on his assignments. He is so picky and a tough grader. Even if you lost 2 points your grade will drop significantly. I looked at the past good rates on here but instead it was different when I took him. Grade dropped from an A because he's such a tough grader. NO MATTER how hard you try you will still lose points

His assignments that he assigned are way too long reading that is complicating and complicated questions that requires long answers. Group project assignments are suffocating. I just wished he wouldn't assign homework that takes hours to complete. just straight forward understandable not stresses us out.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: If you have to take this class, GOOD LUCK. He gives around 4-5 assignments a week, which consists of reading long articles and watching hour long films. On top of the normal assignments, there's also a big research project that you'll have work on throughout the quarter and a book report.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Took him for SDOH during the pandemic and everything was online. There's a lot of reading, but you can get away with not reading some. Attended all of his lectures, great material, material can get a little heavy, easy going. His quizzes are not based on material he is teaching, he's doing it to see whose paying attention and watching the lectures
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: His curriculum didn't suit me. He just made us read a bunch of articles and watch a lot of videos to answer questions. There was a big group project that's split up throughout the quarter to do and it wasn't hard nor was it easy, just busywork. Overall wasn't really engaged and the material was eh.
great class, very flexible which is appreciated during remote learning times. assignments are reasonable and just make sure to listen to his lectures/lecture recording and readings .

Daniel is a great professor. His lectures are interesting and the material is easy to understand. However, the quizzes are very difficult for no reason since he puts in random questions from topics we've never discussed... Other than that, assignments are just busy work and the final project was ok.

He's funny but can be serious at the same time. He expects a lot from his students so be prepared to pay attention. His quizzes are sometimes hard to understand because they're worded weird, but all the info you need is in his slides so come to class because he doesn't post them. He's a tough grader but he's understanding and is willing to help you

He is the best professor I have ever had! I wish that I could take every class of his. He is super understanding and really cares about his students. He gives extensions and is passionate about what he is teaching. He asks us whether we like something or not and is open to feedback. HE IS AMAZING!!!!

Jason has so far been one my favorite teachers at UWB. He really cares for his students and understands that not everything revolves around school (if something comes up personally he will give you extensions on assignments). Hes super chill and knows what hes talking about. If youre in health studies take as many classes with him as you can.

I was actually in BWRIT135, not available in the drop down menu. Very clear assignment prompts and grading criteria on Canvas. In-class meetings are not very planned out and often cover material already on Canvas in a less organized way, which is frustrating with a mandatory attendance policy. Great feedback in Canvas comments, make sure to use it.

Anyone who has rated this prof below a 5, probably just didn't do the assignment and got a bad grade. This is one of the best professors I've ever had, super understanding and accessible outside of class and parenting with all my questions about the research project. He allowed fill credit for any late assignment and the workload was manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Morse was great! You can tell he is very passionate about teaching. I do have to say that he is a tough grader and is very picky about certain things. There are around 3-4 homework assignments a week, but it is all busy work. Make sure you can keep up and you can also turn in anything late until the final without any grade deductions.

The worst teacher ever rude and very judgemental worked very hard for this class but doesn't even respond to emails back very strict on attendance but doesn't show empathy or kindness with grading or actual concern to student

He is very petty and sarcastic (not in a good way) and both attendance and participation are graded, which is strange. Not very sympathetic for his students and his lectures weren't helpful. A lot of the lectures/exercises I did in class, I did not use for assignments. Too many writing assignments, spent too many late nights staying up doing them.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr.Morse is a kind professor, but I didn't know what to expect for my grade as there is no grading on Canvas. There are multiple weekly assignments, some take more time than others. Go to class if unsure about what the homework is, overwise the work can be done asynchronously and at home. Only gave feedback on small HW and drafts, not final paper.
very unclear in instructions. grades harshly. leaves no room for opinions. overall a confusing and disorganized professor - would not recommend.
This professor is very confusing and I do not recommend taking. Likes to not put in grades until the end of the quarter so you don't know until the end. Also does not follow his on prompt at all.

This professor made me hate English. English was one of my strongest and most enjoyed subjects up until I took this class. Professor is an insanely harsh grader and does not leave genuine feedback. I have a couple friends in the class and upon comparison, it seemed like the professor copied and pasted the same exact comments on all our assignments

If there is one thing about his guy, its the late-work policy. You can turn in any of the work for full credit until the finals day. He is too passionate about the subject, its not a good thing. Almost to the point that he doesn't consider other point of views. If you're anything other a hardcore liberal you're definitely doing a lot of revisions.

I love this professor. Awesome, great, fantastic, marvelous, kind, thoughtful, adaptable, polite, calm, resourceful, bright, considerate, chatty, easy-going, funny, very very very nice, understanding, made my life easier, didn't make me want to drop out but actually attend class. Got a 4.0 in each class. Great. Marvelous.

Prof Morse is a nice and fun guy. You can tell he is very passionate on specific topics and his grading shows as evidence. Really flexible with deadlines except for exams. Responds pretty fast to emails and is always willing to help out when needed. Could express myself freely in class and while there is a lot of reading, its super informative.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Morse is a really relaxed professor. He generally allows late submissions with no penalty and does not assign a whole lot of homework. While I would not call him an exceptional instructor, I would certainly take classes with him again as I enjoyed the flexibility and low workload.
Really easy on grading

In all of my time at UWB, I haven't seen another professor as disingenuous as Dr. Silva. Her senior seminar had little structure and was a waste of time. The work structure and expectations were not clear. She doesn't seem to care about all students. I would not recommend taking a course with her at any point.

I really enjoy her teaching style! Super caring, interesting lectures, and easy to reach via email. One of my favorite professors I've taken at UWB, and I plan to take more classes w/ her in the future. Participation points based off of random in-class assignments, so attendance is lowk mandatory (but enjoyable!).
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Love Silva! Community Psych was great, I got a 4.0, and is a great core course choice for psych majors. In-class activities (easy), can miss 2 w/ no penalty. Final group project w/ paper. 2 solo papers. Dense readings! No quizzes/tests! Have to meet with/ her once...DO IT EARLY IN THE QUARTER! Very clear grading criteria! Thoughtful feedback.

I've had Dr. Silva for a couple of classes and she is a wonderful professor. She spent an hour on lectures, and the class discussions were one of the reasons why I wanted to continue coming to class. She gives everyone one or two group assignments, and provides ample time and guidance to complete. I would take her classes again if possible!

Took BISPSY 350. She is another prof that is obsessed with group projects so don't take if that bothers you. Her class is graded by very few assignments so one bad grade will weigh you down heavily. As well as attendance MATTERS there are in class activities that cannot be made up. Many say shes flexible, but she is NOT.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took her for a bcore class, she's very sweet and caring and made me want to come to class. Very approachable professor as well as informative.

(Note: I took BIS 350) An exceptional professor. Great lectures and use of class time, constructive and touching feedback, interesting and memorable class content. Her assignments were unique and well executed. Her teaching style is heavy on reading and writing, but that's not a bad thing. If you can take a class with her, do it!

One of the best Professors at UWB! I loved her social psychology class and learned so much. She has a great way of teaching even the more difficult and sensitive topics, and the assignments and in-class work were often both fun and engaging. Super flexible with due dates, organized, easy to reach, and caring. You won't regret a class with her!

She is SO kind and helpful. Attendance matters cause she does activities that count as a grade but you can miss 2 activities. Her lectures are actually interesting & beneficial. There are 2 in person quizzes & she tells you what to study for them. There are 2 papers (you can ask for as many extensions you need) & one final group project to present.

She is great and so sweet. I don't understand how someone can be so nice. She has 2 quizzes but she tells you what will be on it. Ppt slides are uploaded online. Very easy grader. Take the class. You can miss couple classes without loosing points.

You will never find a professor as incredible as Silva. Never have I ever in four years of higher education actually felt sad when a professor had  to cancel class- until her. She is intelligent, driven, very well spoken, encouraging, inspirational, hilarious, and provides a space and teaching method that actually teaches you content. Just wow.

not a hard grader
easy to talk to

Amazing professor 
very engaging
easy to tap to
grades fast
not a hard grader at all

Great teacher and very nice person. Took social psychology asynch/online in 2021. Weekly, you'll have a lecture to watch, 1-2 discussion boards, and one written assignment all due by the end of the week. Clear expectations throughout. She's very kind and can meet with you over the quarter. Work isn't really that hard.

I heard a lot of good things about Silva, but I was disappointed with the class abs with her. Sure, shes nice and all that, but I havent learned anything honestly. The course is so easy, might as well be a jr high class. Thats how easy it was for me and others. She gives high grades to everyone defeating the purpose of a class. You wont learn.

She is absolutely amazing especially considering quarantine. She is a very easy grader and she is very flexible with deadlines. There are no surprises and the syllabus she provides in the beginning is all you need for the entire quarter. Would definitely recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Silva is one of the best professors at UWB. I've taken 2 of her classes (BIS 225 and BISSTA 304) and have enjoyed every single one of them. She's extremely nice, easy-going, and puts a lot of effort in creating and keeping a good class community. As long as you put effort into the assignments and participate in class, you'll get an A.

I had Prof Silva during the pandemic and literally such a sweet and genuine professor. Literally emanates goodness through the screen. Coursework was easy and interesting and enjoyable. Totally recommend taking her for Soc Psych!!

Professor Silva is amazing! She was very generous and lenient during the pandemic. Her lectures and the material covered throughout the class were very interesting and the assignments were actually fun to do. Overall, super sweet prof and worth taking! Recommend 100%!
She is the best professor that I have ever had! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!!!!
Awesome!

Silva was one of my favorite teachers. She really engages with the students and she genuinely cares about their experiences at the school. She doesn't sugar coat anything and she is real with the students and what she teaches. Read what she assigns!! It helps with the tests and are really interesting reads! TAKE HER CLASS!!
It's awesome when you find a professor who actually knows what she is talking about. Dr. Silva does.

Silva structures each class a bit different, this one was on women's lives in context. We had 5 online discussions, 5 homework assignments that were pretty easy, and a midterm a final project and no final! Some of the topics were controversial or heavy, but she is a solid lecturer and has a strong presence. She's understanding of absence just email
Dr. Silva is one of the true gems that UWB has. She genuinely wants her students to succeed and is willing to go more than half way to support you.

Prof. Silva's projects are always a central part of the grade. They stretch your thinking and are sometimes a challenge but it pays off in the end. Her quizzes are really fair and based on the readings and lectures, but she makes clear which readings to study. She is hilarious and has a great world perspective and a lot to share. I would take her
A very fair grader, assignments and what is expected is very clear, good teacher and would take again
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: She's amazing, willing to help and accommodate life. Very informative and relevant  lectures. Clear study guide. 4.0 is around 97-98% so you have to work for your grade but very possible to get it.  Great classroom atmosphere, and the Dr. Silva knows her field inside and out
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Silva is one of my favorite teachers at UWB. Lectures are engaging, and quizzes are just given to make sure students did the readings. Professor Silva usually gives quizzes when the class doesn't participate in class discussions.

She is an incredible professor! I have taken three classes with Prof Silva and am sad to be graduating this year and not able to take more under her instruction. I have been at UWB for four years and she is definitely my favorite professor.

One of my favorite teachers. She's super funny and is really clear on what will be on the test- her study guides contain only things that will be on the test. Her slides are really interesting and thought provoking and she's really nice. Take her class if you can!!

Dr. Silva is by far one of the best professors at UW Bothell! I've taken many classes with her, your grade is the amount of work you put into it. Her instructions are clear, and is super supportive. Take her class!

BEST PROFESSOR I have ever had. Shes sassy and funny like no other professor here at UWB.. Easy grader, only talks for an hour then the last hour is ours. As funny as she is, she is also very stern on what she wants for her class. This was the class who did that walk out last spring for the Diversity center! Great class

Silva is a very amazing instructor! She used engaging material, clear lectures, and has a wonderful sense of humor. Very flexible and understanding of students' needs.  As for the class, I've certainly learned a lot! The class is structured first hour is lecture, next hour is class discussion. I definitely plan to take a course by her again.
Amazing professor. This class made me feel like I can make a difference in the world. Take this class & jump in with both feet!

The best professor I've ever had. She has played a huge role is how I see the world. Readings due every class, but they are interesting and relevant. She grades class participation, so you must show up and you must be engaged. Clear study guides for all exams, but you MUST do the readings to do well on them.

She is awesome! If you want to learn and be engaged, I would recommend taking her! She really cares about students. There is a lot if participation involved (which I think is great!) that way students really engage in the conversations. Half the class is her lecturing and has students discussion. Overall great experience!

After spending thousands of dollars, taking several classes, doing hours of studying I graduate this Spring and can truly say that Professor Silva is the best in the IAS department at UWB!! She's passionate about her work and it is clear through her classes. I've taken a couple of her classes and only wish there were more professors like her.

The first day of class, she seemed intimidating! But as the quarter progressed, it became better and it went by all too fast!She's helpful and has so much enthusiasm in what she teaches that she pertains it to real-life events! Creation of social change :)I would take her classes again if I could! Midterm, 2 papers and a group presentation.

She's amazing! Topics are interesting, she is engaging. 50/50 lecture & discussion. Assignments were very clear and well laid out. She's extremely helpful if you don't understand something and motivating. One of the best teachers I have had in college!

This class is difficult but do-able (with a decent-to-good grade) if you participate.  Silva is conscientious and compassionate, though she asks for your attention and engagement, as any class would.  She is clear, funny, caring, and passionate.  If you truly care about the issues she teaches, you will love her classes.

I have taken her for BCUSP 170 and BIS 293: MATCH. She is one of my favorite professors at UWB. She is helpful, engaging, fun, and very interesting. Her classes are well organized and she grades fairly. I always look forward to taking her classes. On top of that, she is a great role model for Latina/o students on campus. She definitely is the best!

This was a very informative class. As the other people said, she's very interested in her subject. She does not grade hard. AT ALL. And the subject itself attracted a lot of interesting people. Take her!

She's very enthusiastic, her lectures are very interesting, her powerpoints are well organized have everything you need to know. She's able to break down concepts so they are easy to understand and uses real life, current examples to make it even easier. Her tests are fair and she gives you good study guides to help you out.

By far best professor I have had! She is so helpful and easy to talk to. Teaches very well and is very effective. If I could take her over and over again I would. Do not miss a chance to take her class!!!

Dr. Silva is by far the best professor! Extremely engaging lectures and you get the feeling that she wants everyone to understand and love the material. She is super passionate and very clear of expectations, and gives great study guides.

First off, she is super bomb. Second, she makes you get what she is teaching. Third, you can't slack off in the class, but if you do the work, then it will be a lot easier to do good on the tests. Absolutely love Dr. Silva, would take her over any professor if I could.

She is ok.her methods are different.In BISSEB 304, she lectures only 45 min, which is not even helpful.Then the rest of the class, the students discuss, and she observes and takes notes.If you are taking her other classes, you will gain her attention so she will listen to you and speak with you.If not, she will ignore you.she has strange attitudes
Dr. Silva is one of the best professors at UWB. She is very clear in her expectations and makes class so interesting. I always look forward to her class. Don't miss out, she's great!
Silva is amazing!! She was the most helpful professor and by far by favorite at UWB so far!

I am not even done with the class and I will give her super high marks because she is honest to goodness awesome!! She is opinionated and does not hide behind being p.c. I only wish this was not my last quarter because I would definitely take her again. Not easy but very fun and it's not hard to get a good grade in the class, just participate!!
Crystal clear class expectations, very efficient organization of learning goals.
She is such a sweet and understanding teacher! She makes psychology more interesting and add examples that are easy to understand. Highly recommended teacher!

She is by far one of the best professors at UWB.  Her interest and enthusiasm for the classes she teaches is what is best about her.  He goal is to have you understand the information rather than just memorize it for a test.

Prof Silva is awesome. A lot of lecturing in this class but she makes it clear and concise. She always tells you what to study for the test. Not a hard grader, but you still learn a lot. I definitely recommend her

She really cares about her students and very accommodating. Her assignments were clear to follow but at times didn't make too much sense. She encourages participation and doesn't care about grammar but rather your process and thought process. Overall would recommend taking her class!

Professor Ketcham clearly cares about her students and encorages learning at all levels. She is more interested in how your thinking is developed and much less about grammar. She allows space for complex and nuanced conversations about various topics and offers lots of help if needed.
I would take her forever if I could!

Ketcham is awesome. Super sweet, funny, and discussions are politically relevant. Easy to get ahold of. Assignments never feel like busy work, and the point is always very clear. 

Labor-based grading, as long as you do the assignments you will get a 100% by the end of the course. 

Would take her for all of my classes if I could.

She is an amazing professor who values hard work over polished products! It is easy to get good grades in this class as long as you are trying your best and participating. The only thing is that there are a lot of deadlines and the descriptions of the assignments can be a bit vague, although I do not see that hindering your experience by any means.

I had Dr. Ketcham for BWRIT 134, and as long as you stay on top of your assignments, you're guaranteed to get a 3.8 and above. Only thing I would say is that some assignments are not explained super clearly. Other than that, she's super caring and down to earth. She treats us with respect, and like we're adults. I would so recommend her class!

Dr. Ketcham grades almost every assignment on participation. No credit for missing work. One-third credit for incomplete work. Two-thirds credit for late work. Full credit otherwise. Furthermore, for most assignments, the one-third credit reduction for late work does not apply if the assignment is submitted within 48 hours of the due date.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Had for 132 & 133, Prof. Ketcham is great! Cares a lot about the students and the material. Easy to make up work & classes, and a grace period on most assignments. One book required for class, and make sure you have access to a printer. Be ready to participate, engage with your classmates during peer review. You get from this class what you put in.

I took both BWRIT 132 and 133 with Dr. Ketcham and am very glad that I did! These classes have definitely changed the way I think about writing and were accessible and not too difficult in the process. I leave every lecture thinking about something new

Dr. Murr is great! He is really passionate about the topics discussed and has clear assignment expectations. The assigned readings were sometimes difficult to understand, but he always took the time, both in and out of class, to help clarify. I would recommend him to anyone looking to take this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Reading and writing-heavy course. I would recommend taking an intro diversity course before coming to 255 because some of the content is presented at face value without context and that background info is necessary in my opinion. We also looked at local history like UW Black Student Union which I found super interesting. Overall, a great prof!

Things to Expect:
- Weekly class prep assignments (varies in workload)
- Lots of readings
- In-class small and large group discussions
- Occasional guest speakers
- Discussion posts
- Final is making a Padlet

(Straightforward and respectable professor. Class participation can be engaging. Moderate ranged workload. Fun guest speakers. Rating: 4.75)

His class is not very work heavy, there was a weekly discussion post and readings due which sometimes were difficult. He's a fairly easy grader. He also took us to a couple school events with guest speakers/ performers which was really cool! Def Would recommend!

BIS 490: I loved this class and enjoyed Professor Murr's teaching. Small group/seminar-style class. There were not a ton of assignments; most work was done in class, aside from a few assignments and the class materials assigned each week. Attending class and participating is necessary for both your learning and your grade. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Murr is amazing. I am taking two of his courses B EDUC 255 A (in-person) and BIS 379 A (online), both of which are pretty reading-heavy; not in a boring way, the readings are compelling and articulated well. He is super fun and chill, and pretty woke lol, he's currently playing SZA during group time. Also not a tough grader. Love this man

Dr. Murr is incredibly understanding. I took this class during spring quarter 2020, so it was online (it usually is in person) and he engaged with all of us and his lectures were incredibly beneficial. He tackles difficult subjects such as racism and sexism, and the readings he assigns are 150-200 pages, but are in the form of very engaging novels
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Books read were 150-200 pages. 1 book about every 2 weeks. 1 discussion post due every week. 1 easy project. The final requires some understanding of books so just look at the final assignment when quarter begins and engage during lectures, very helpful! Truly composed, caring, understanding remarkable professor! He even got an award recently.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: A calm professor who brings the topic of race and racism down to the students' level. Not extremely liberal. He will NOT try to make you conform to a certain way of thinking and your grades DO NOT depend on it. Very open-minded and allows students to voice their opinions and experiences freely. Come prepared with readings (printed) and to discuss.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I promise you that her lectures are engaging and fun! Respectful and lenient about deadlines. I was worried about taking her because of the comments about readings but those can be skipped or skimmed if you attend classes, since materials are covered in lectures. I wouldn't take this class with anyone else but her. A bit hard to contact outside.

One of the best professors I've had in my first quarter @ UW Bothell (Kirkland Campus) RN-BSN. She's simply the best and I happen to have her for another class, just sad that its an online, as opposed to being in-person class. I wouldn't be doing her any justice if I don't rate her a 5.0 stars. 
Thank you Jen, you're the best!
Jen is amazing. she's an amazing professor, she grades very easily and gives back very helpful feedback. We had not quizzes nor test.

Even though the class can be a lot and stressful. She's a nice proof, she may not respond straight away and even in a few days but she's supportive and really nice. Professors do have a lot of work too and they can be stressed out. As long as you speak with her she'll be there for u.

I'm not sure of the other positive comment about the class isn't stressful at all. That student probably taking 1 class. The truth is that she assigned a lot of reading and lectures a paper to write which she isn't accessible outside of class to ask questions nor she responds. This class is a lot and do not take it with any other research class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Not only assigns to many readings and long lectures and assignments. she doesn't even upload grades. she can go on over a month of not updating grades. since shes not doing that, what else is she doing. at least she should answer her students email. Shes not accessible outside of class at all.

shes a really nice professor, class isnt very difficult if you read the lectures. Shes supportive. and isn't very hard harder. Shes so FUNNY. I def recommend her. she wont stress you out at all and so understanding

One of my favorite professors. He cares for students and their learning. Since it was advanced seminar, it was reading heavy and they were challenging, but he more cared that students attempted to understand it and the in-class discussions were great to go understand the readings more. I had a good discussion with him about professional advice

I really enjoyed taking this class, and would look forward to every Thursday thanks to it! Prof. Jung's lectures were amazing, I always enjoyed his energy, and his passion for geoviz. Assignment instructions were very clear and he was lenient in grading + extended deadlines for the class as needed. Incredible prof and class! Can't recommend enough!

I really recommend this professor, a great choice! He is easy to talk to, friendly, and gives good grading feedback and allows you to redo assignments if you do not get full credit. Grading was fast. Fun projects. Lectures were interesting, and he has lots of good stories.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Good teacher. He was so kind and showed a great interest in our learning GIS/urban geography. Seems to really love teaching for all the right reasons. Assignments are unique and interesting. Fair grader who gives very helpful feedback with your success in mind. You do have to attend class because he'll dock participation without a legit excuse.

He is an amazing professor with so much genuine love and care for his students. He cares if you learn, and he really cares about you. I had an ear infection the first day of his class and was in the E.R. I E-mailed him, and he sent me a very kind E-mail in response. He's a wonderful professor and human alike. 10/10, would take again for sure.

Awesome professor with engaging lectures and a positive attitude. This is a CBLR class so you associate with an organization and use mapping to show issues within the community. The final project is creating a map with a theme for the community. There are 5 mapping practices throughout the quarter as well as activities during the lecture. Easy A

Professor Jung is a real gem. He is the most caring and passionate professor I've ever met! He genuinely cares about his students and this shines through in the lectures. It felt more like a friendly conversation than a lecture - he's super funny too! I always looked forward to his lectures because he was always so happy and goofy.

One of the best professors I've had. Very passionate and engaging during lectures. Class consists of 5 Map Practices which won't take more than 3-4 hours. A midterm and final which aren't too hard. Participate in class activities and you will do well in the class. He is a must take professor for an easy A I&S class.

Amazing professor. Coming to class reminded me that professors actually DO care about their field of study and teaching classes. NOT a technically challenging class at all. Honestly pretty easy and really fun/engaging. You will do group work. I did the 4hr friday class and some classes he would let us out up to an hour early.

Prof. Jung is all around a good guy, and a great professor. He is SO enthusiastic about what he teaches, and it exudes through the classroom. Grading criteria is a bit confusing, but overall a fairly easy grader. Hes a positive guy that keeps the energy going, thats something the whole class could respect and you could see that. Take his class!

Professor Jung is a really friendly guy, funny lecturer, and a fair grader. There are two exams and one group project. In between those, you'll have weekly homework and online assignments. Make sure to keep up with the timeline, his course moves along at a pretty fast pace. Sometimes his thick accent could be confusing but that's extra funny points

Professor Jung is the BEST, he is kind, caring, respectful and cares that you learn.  He is passionate about teaching..  He is great about getting back to you with questions .  He makes you want to learn in the most amazing way!  I highly recommend him as an instructor.  If you don't get anything out of his class its on you.  Funny and intelligent.

he gives everyone a B.  If you meet all his grading criteria, you get a freaking b+.  He does give an a- once in a blue moon if you can go beyond his grading criteria.  He also deducts points if you do not use his exact words.  And will ALWAYS find an excuse to take down your grade from an A to a B.  you need to know more than him for an A.

What a great teacher! He is really passionate about his field and makes sure to share his knowledge with everyone in his classes. He is very nice, so don't be shy to ask him questions if you are ever stuck.

Professor Jung is so far (3 quarters) my favorite teacher at UW. He's very passionate about his topic (GIS), and it comes through in his lectures and activities. His approach to teaching is great, and he emphasizes the fundamentals and the practical knowledge, but doesn't stress rote memorization. I've sought out and am taking a second class of his

Good professor, easy to understand and clarifies well. I took a mid-300 level course with no previous education in the subject, and he taught it so everyone could understand. Don't hesitate to take him.

He is a really nice teacher, clear on instruction and a easy grader.  Even though his lecture might be a little bored but u can see he really tried to make things interesting.  Take his class!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
He really knows how to teach.  Always try to find the easiest way to explain and also the direction is clear and understandable.  Take his class!!!!!!!!
You have to pay attention to his lectures, and you'll do fine.
easy to understand the lecture. Just pay attention to the exams. Some HWs are really hard.

One of my favorite professors. Very reasonable work load. Exams are very easy because cheat sheet is given. He also gives out slide decks and practice problems each class which is very helpful. Must be willing to learn on your own, though.

This is definitely a class you need to pay attention in! If you dont pay attention for just one class you fall insanely behind. He teaches as if the students already know the material, rather than to the lowest common demeanor. His teaching style is meant for people that can learn on their own.

Very well taught class that centered around corporate finance principles. Any questions asked were answered in detail. Probably more of a graduate level teacher as his knowledge is very extensive and the topics broached were not entry level. All around good teacher, easy to approach and well thought out course presentation.
cannot teach, and does not seem to want to teach

Makes the material understandable.   Shows all his work on the board and is willing to show the class how to do any problem that someone doesn't understand.  Tests are multiple choice, very reasonable.
I liked this professor and the course. The lessons were well communicated and example problems were carefully explained.
Knows his stuff!  Study hard, his tests will stretch your knowledge.  You will learn a lot if you do the work.

He really knows his stuff though is tough to understand. If you blink for a sec you'll probablly miss something he'll never explain again. He doesn't show all his work and does it really fast. Doesn't grade all assignments but you better keep up with it or you'll fail.
Not recommended! Always makes things a lot more harder than it used to be. Rarely reply email in which students face difficulty to ask for his help. Never show calculation on his work! Sucks!

He is a great professor in the sense is that he's passionate about what he teaches about. But lectures can be quite monotonous and at least half of the lectures are not related to assignments but attendance is highly encouraged. Assignments have lots of instructions but the feedback and grading is vague and you have to figure it out yourself.

Professor Milutis is extremely knowledgeable and passionate about art history and writing. His lectures are engaging and fun, and he's very generous with grading on essays. He also hosts workshops during class to help us with our writing. He's very approachable and loves to help if you ask him. Would love to take him again!

1-2 essays a week without clear a rubric (just a prompt), which is then graded with little to no explanation of the grade received and holistically as only three assignments. In other words, only three grades actually go into the grade book. Felt judged by professor in class. Only take if you LOVE art history or absolutely have to take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
One word can be used to describe this prof and course: vague.

Assignment instructions are vague, his teaching style and choice of words are vague, expectations are vague, and grading is vague.

It's clear he has an interest in art, but he has little to no excitement/energy for teaching. Grading is blunt, which is good, but somehow even more vague.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attendance was taken, lectures were monotonous and pedantic. There was little care for the students, little to no questions answered, although it was an incredibly easy class. Easiest A ever, but definitely a lot to sit through.
