Totally a change of pace from other courses at UWB.  You have to be willing to "go with the flow" but you learn a lot about performance and the way it affects society, and you learn a lot about yourself.
Unclear expectations, instructions for projects modified on the fly and without notification to the entire class.  Discussions were interesting and in-class activites stimulating.
No Comments
Performance studies courses are active, hands on, and utilize theater approaches to cultural problem solving. This includes activism and political performance. Non-linear thinkers will love it.
I liked the course overall - learned lots of new concepts in OOP and Java. Assignments were re-used from other classes. One exam was tough - two were easy to moderate.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: It was tough class - but, I learned a lot .
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Exams were riddled with typos and incorrect instructions Regularly tells class to figure it out ourselves instead of bugging him Constantly changes due dates He did his best to avoid talking Assignments were not graded until the end of the course Very low effort from him

He is not a good teacher; his lectures are so dry, explanations are really bad, homework is unclear, does not give enough practice for exams. Avoid if you can, but if you decide to take his class prepare to learn on your own.

The class is pretty tough but the quizzes and midterms are online on Pearson, and if you show up and ask questions, he's more than willing to help you understand things. Very focused on doing examples from the textbook in class, and grades reasonably.

grades on attendance even though he's not supposed to (per uni policy). he needs to understand everyone has personal things going on in their lives & not everyone is going to be able to attend every class. give some grace to students as things in the world are tough right now.

attendance is graded but very few come to class, the lecture is so hard to follow and he cold calls. Exams and quizzes are not related to in class exercises and closed note. not enough time given for quizzes. homework gets published just a day or two before it's due
Avoid him at all costs. Grading isn't fair, and clearly, he doesn't care.

He teaches you how to do the problems one way, for example using Excel then on quizzes and tests he expects you to just to the problems by hand. Come quizzes and exams, it is monitored while students are not allowed any notes, the quizzes are on a short time limit as well. Most of my class has failed to even complete them let alone pass.

personally the lectures were difficult to understand and there was minimal teaching, he just did questions out of the textbook and vaguely brought up terms expecting us to know. lots of cold calling but not too strict. optional final, 2pt pop quizzes based on an in-class question if attendance gets low, super easy hw/grading system (drops lowest 2)

Professor is passionate about teaching. Attendance isn't mandatory but if class attendance is low he gives pop quizzes for 2 pts. If you attend class you'll be fine. Quizzes are same type of questions as the homework, and homework is infinite retry's. Final is optional and basically all extra credit so grade won't drop, no midterm also.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He was pretty chill, very passionate about his job and getting students to participate. Really didnt give too much work and the class was extremely easy, the final was optional, he dropped two homeworks and as long as you did all the homeworks well(which were all easy) you will pass the class.
Prepare to be yelled at some times, but it's all in good faith. He talks about goats a lot. He will ask if you're happy, so ya better be happy!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Murugappa Krishnan is one of the most intriguing professors I have taken at UW Bothell. You will have many chances to become immortal, and often he will fix students posture. He will cold call you and expect you to know exactly what he is talking about, so pay attention! All in all, Murgie is an affable guy, and is kind. Long Live Luca Pacioloi!!

Barely took the time to actually teach us anything. Spends the whole class cold calling on students for answers to questions that we haven't even gone over how to do yet. All the accounting stuff I know so far I have taught myself. Going to class is a waste of time because he doesn't do any real teaching but you have to show up bc of attendance.

He cares more about your test scores than your learning. Less lecture time while quizzes approach fast. I have spoken to him privately about how I study and get 100s on the homework, but I still fail the quizzes. He said, "I notice a lot of my students have 100s on the homework, but they always fail the quiz." You have to teach urself accounting.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: 6-7 quizzes (drops 1-2) and an optional extra credit final. Super animated lecture style, made an entertaining class out of a dry subject. Be warned, he's a bad explainer - but if you read the textbook beforehand, the lectures will make sense. Cold calls aren't so bad, it's more playful and he never makes people feel bad for not knowing the answer.

Erm I suck at accounting and lowkey him calling on me was goofy but it's okay cuz my friends helped me but he will also help you. He really does care abt his students and I yapped to him at dining hall too. He was very kind and inspired me to pursue accounting and econ. He even emailed me at 1am resources for microecon and math. Take him! Do ur HW

His class was simple as long as you read the textbook before coming to class you should be set. We have 7 quizzes throughout the quarter he drops the two lowest and we have 3 hw assignments a week based on the textbook as well as the in-class practice problems. He's caring he does call on people during the classroom to make sure we are listening
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Probably the worst professor I've ever had, even worse than some of my community college teachers. He often calls on people randomly even though some of the students do not understand the topic.

Worst professor I have ever had in all of my years in education. He doesn't know how to teach concepts and cold calls on people on topics that haven't even been learned. His lectures are long and boring and hard to stay engaged. Never take this guy, even if you need to push back a quarter. Not worth your time or effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
By far the worst Professor I've ever had. 
I'm currently enrolled into this course taught by him and he is not clear about lectures and doesn't answer questions clearly either. He calls on students randomly and expects them to understand the course material when he isnt clear as to what we are learning. I would never recommend this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Do not take, yells at people who are just working on the problems, does not teach well. We just do problems the entire time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Murgie has to be one of the worst professors I have ever had. Before class HW is very tough to learn as he does not go over concepts. The 6 quizzes throughout the course have nothing to do with the lectures he provides in class. He cold calls people randomly. You will be learning concepts by yourself outside of class if you want a good grade.

He does not help students or offer office hours. Calls on everyone and belittles you if you are wrong. Expects work to be done before being taught. Grading is unclear you wont know ur grade til you see your final grade. Lazy, horrible and demeaning highly discourage

Overall, Professor Krishnan was nice and was quick to respond emails. Class was based on examples from the textbook and wasn't properly taught.  Before class homework, after class homework, quizzes, and random pop quizzes. Everything is automatically graded anyways so there wasn't much done besides sitting in the class confused for two hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Murgie has good character but the way he teaches isn't best. It went great at first but then he would include additional information about the next chapter and HAVE students answer. This would make students feel uncomfortable about being next to answer. His lectures become heavy as well. In addition, Excel wasn't properly taught.

Class is centered around online textbook/homework. READ AHEAD before class and maybe an extra chapter. Calls on students randomly to answer questions and will yell at you for not having the answer, even when he hasn't taught anything and reading isn't due yet. Best to answer questions voluntarily early then tune out rest of class.

Horrible professor! if the course isn't mandatory then please don't attempt his class. 
This professor is very unorganized and wouldn't clear the concepts. He starts a case study and then leave class without providing any answers and move on to another case.the he said- we don't need to worry about grades at the end gave us B+ without any reason.

One of those classes where you don't actually learn anything because most of the points come from brute-forcing the answers on a MyMathLab type of website called MyBusinessCourse. If you manage to understand the first few weeks of class you'll probably do fine; if you don't it will be hard to follow along for the rest of the quarter.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class for a prerequisite, and it led the majority of the class to panic about their grade after the class average of 14% on the first midterm. Many people ended up dropping the class right after the first exam because the mode was a 7%. Most likely tested on material that was mentioned very briefly. Don't take this class.

Very unclear professor. Goes over one thing in class gives an exam on something else. Overall structure of course was very disorganized. Practically whole class failed as the mid term average alone was 14/100. Would avoid at all costs.

Words cant describe how horrible he is. No clear grading criteria. Absolutely no material learned, gives random assignments whenever he feels like it with no context. Criticizes students for trying in class and yells if nobody tries.
For your own sake, don't take this class.

Taking the class right now. Makes an intro level class as difficult as possible. Doesn't allow students a chance to figure out what they did wrong and if asked, he threatens students with a lapse of Student Conduct and says it's "inappropriate". Accounting doesn't seem hard at all, but with this professor, it is.

Currently taking this class and I honestly don't understand what's going on. His lectures are not very good as he makes mistakes often and doesn't explain things very well. Also doesn't go off the textbook so the format for some things is different. The Midterm had content that was seen briefly once in class. Wish I could drop if it wasn't a prereq

Prof Kraft is a one of a kind person and is always there to help you. All of the course content has so much relevancy to life and he makes it very interesting when the concepts are not so intriguing. He's working elsewhere as of now but I want him to come back to UWB. He's the BEST, I highly recommend him as a professor.

Professor Kraft was amazing as a pre-calc 2 teacher. His lectures were always very informative and covered everything we needed to know, and he made sure that the problems we did in class were more difficult than his tests. He also had fantastic energy during his lecture, which made a 5:45 pm class much more bearable. Would absolutely take again
Amazing professor, very understanding and can tell he truly cares about his students success. Truly blessed I got him as my Pre-Calc 2 professor :)

Professor Kraft is an awesome professor. So caring and accessible outside of class. Math is not an easy subject, but he gave us a good amount of hw and practice problems that let us to practice as much as we can. Read the textbook before answering the hw, it takes a lot of time and practice but it will be worth it at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's so nice, and really cares about if you succeed. Never had a math professor care so much! He's always willing to help you outside of class too.

Kraft is a really nice calc professor. His homework is harder than the midterms so if you practice the hw you should be set! Beware of the final though... as the math department makes it instead of him. Also, he is very passionate about math and often emphasizes asking questions/giving feedback as well as visiting office hours.

Lectures can get boring and not exactly straight to the point since he is new. Ask questions and give him feedback, it'll be superb. He believes HW should be harder than the midterm and they were. Class average was around 90s. You can easily get 100 if you just do the practice midterm he gives out. Watch out for finals, it's not as easy but doable.
Offers a lot of extra credit and is easy to understand.

Tommy is kinda clumsy since last quarter was his first time teaching, but I can see that he tries 110% to be a good teacher and also he pushes his students a lot to do extra credit, participate, etc. Overall a pretty easy grader for a math prof, and very lenient on hw and exam scores.

Honestly probably one of the biggest let downs. Teacher is pretty nice, but grading is horrible. He grades so particularly based on the accuracy of the history you write in the homeworks. When he gives you your grades back, there are no comments written as to why you got the grade. This teacher made me hate the class in general.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Probably the worst class I've taken. You complete 3 major projects to present to  people outside the class but have barely 2 weeks to create these projects. He doesn't explain why you get the grade you receive and is equally unclear about assignments. Gives vague feedback then marks you down for not doing what he wants.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Great teacher, very smart. Unfortunately can be pretty unclear at times with what he wants and the whole class agreed. Overall a good experience though and I really liked him. Pretty easy class as long as you show up.

Professor Kurashige was awesome! We had super fun classes with lots of guest speakers and watched documentaries. Guy was very passionate about his work. Definitely expect to come to class though, it's not one you can skip a lot. Highly recommend him.

Prof. is nice. Class very unorganized. Supposed to be on activism but is purely on education. We have lots of guest speakers which are interesting on activism and social justice but course works still only on education, hard to make connections. Learning is solely based on reading even though he's anti banking method. Ironic!

Dr. Krisnamurthy is one of the most caring faculty members on campus. I asked him for some help outside of class and gave me great feedback. He is a marketing expert! He even helped me with my LinkedIn account. If you take his class, make sure you take advantage of this great opportunity as he truly cares about student success even after the 1/4

Sandeep is one of the best professors out there, his commitment to student success is what inspired me to be the professional I am today. I remember asking him about an entrepreneurial idea I had, and he connected me with high-level executives to present this idea. He wants his students to succeed no matter what!
Professor Sandeep was one of my favorite professors that I have ever had. He truly cared for my success not only as a student, but as a person and I am forever grateful for him.

Dean Sandeep's energy and enthusiasm alongside his motivating spirit encouraged my team and I to take on the ambitious project of hosting PNW's first MBA Conference. We couldn't have done it without his support and guidance.

Sandeep has been an excellent dean to the UWB business school. Encouraging growth and connections with local seattle professionals and always providing students with various avenues of growing. Though not rating for a specific class, I would highly suggest any business student to connect with Sandeep and use his experience to your benefit.

Dean Krishnamurthy is the best mentor, dean and professor I have ever had the pleasure to learn from. He always takes the time to advise students at UW Bothell, even students who aren't business majors. He supports student clubs, helps students with their goals and tries his best to help all students succeed. UW Bothell is lucky to have him.
The worst teacher in the whole school. I would never take this teacher again, waist of money and time!!!
Sandeep is a very cool teacher. Quizes are a piece of cake if you attend lectures. He is always willing to help you and answeres email questions.

Many students are very frustrated. He explains assignments and releases grading rubrics only after assignment is turned in. No details are given about format of tests. Practice quizzes are nothing like the tests they are supposed to prepare you for. He does not give feedback. Many students received the lowest grades in their academic careers.

This class was considered a capstone class for me, and I must say that this class was more useful than the other two capstone classes put together (BBUS470 and BBUS480). Sandeep gives interesting assignments in relations to the WEB. He also gives you the freedom to pick your own topic for the final project. Use your imagination and ace this class.
He's good, helpful and very encouraging to all students. He'll try getting the best out of you, only if you are ready to learn from him.
Great instructor, engaging, interesting, just plain fun!!!

Prof. made subject interesting and enjoyable. I would have to say it was one of the classes I learned the most from. He gives you good freedom on the projects but can give week feedback if he didn't like something. Overall not a bad guy

If Sandeep is one of the best teachers at UWB, then I am screwed! He is a nice guy, but not exactly a great teacher, he was always very vague with assignment directions. At the end of the quarter I realized I could have learned as much  by just reading the material.I guess he is O.K.

His teaching style is very eclectic. He pretends to listen to a student but he doesn't. Loves the Internet and gets easily carried away by clips which sometimes are not connected to marketing. There will be no low-hanging fruit in this class in terms of extra points for your grade.
Sandeep really cares about his students and was always available for help. Class lectures were good. Made class lively and entertaining. One of the best professors at UWB.

Sandeep is a great instructor. He is passionate about teaching and makes you curious. Lectures are not very long and always entertaining. You leave his class with a sense that you actually learned something. Not very many assignments, but the assignments you do have are worth alot. Don't wait to start working on the projects. Best prof on campus!
great prof.
Sandeep kept the class fast paced and interesting.  I would recommend him and can tell you that he is one of the better teachers of a strong contingent at UWB.
Extremely intelligent regarding Internet, WWW, Google search, etc. Lectures are entertaining, contain useful information, and challenge student brain capacity.
No Comments

Sandeep is a great teacher. Lectures are fun and interesting and never longer than necessary. In this particular class there were no tests; just a couple of group projects and some individual write-ups.
No Comments
Professor Krishnamurthy makes every meeting a fun environment.  The material is easy to understand.

Out of the 18 teachers I have had at this school he is in my top 3 favorites.  He gives you a lot of freedom on your class assignments which is very liberating.  But he's not affraid to give constuctive criticism.

DO NOT take this class. I only took it because it was online and I didn't read the reviews beforehand. This class was harder than a 300 level with insane amounts of work assigned each week - even by the end of the quarter I have some week 1 assignments ungraded. Getting grades and emails back from this professor take ages if you get anything at all

After taking this class, I learned how to make better decisions because I should not signed up for this in the first place. They are nice, but would shove a bunch amount of HW in your face (at least 20 hours of work per week for me), and take their sweet time to respond + grade things. DO NOT TAKE IT!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Do NOT take this professor unless they're your very last choice, trust me. Ridiculous amount of homework, you won't have time to learn. They rarely respond to emails & take their sweet time to respond. Huge waste of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is obviously in way over her head. She can't seem to balance her workload, and for a class that deals with fetishes, it's a shame. If my son had to choose between taking this class and dying in a river, I would get his plot ready either way. Abysmal teaching with a disrespectful attitude. She gets a 0/10!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Lichty is great and I'm taking BISPSY343 next quarter w/ them BUT I would agree lots of HW! It's not difficult HW, but it is a lot of assignments. Final group project; no quizzes/tests. Extra credit available. Accepts late work up w/ no penalty up to 7 days I think. Caring person! I recommend if you don't also work or have major time constraints!

TOO MUCH WORK. DO NOT TAKE AS AN ELECTIVE. If you have any other commitments/about to finish your degree, choose a different elective class. This course has been harder than any 400-level class I've taken in 2 years. Dr.L is passionate and caring if you're going through it and need to catch up, but save yourself the stress. Choose a different class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: WAY TOO HEAVY OF A COURSELOAD. I am spending more time each week than the 5-credit criteria should allow for this class. Lichty's assignments are not just long but CONFUSING, with dead links and long-winded instructions. i'm taking 20 credits each quarter, plus working part-time and it's ignorant of them to expect so much from students
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Overall, the course as a whole was pretty impressive and interesting. Really enjoyed the topics and such! The course load itself was a little excessive for an online class. A few assignments were unclear of what we were told to do and the professor was often very late on grading assignments as well. We also had basically two finals on top of this!

Overall, the course material itself was very impressive and interesting to learn. In terms of the amount of work, it was a little excessive because we basically had two finals for this class. Other assignments seemed like repeats of others ones and the instructor was very slow at grading the work as well. Some instructions for assignments were

Crazy amount of homework for this class. The subject is interesting but the online format is horrible and extremely overwhelming. Learning about sex/sexuality has not been fun purely because of the overbearing workload. Prof is very understanding and kind but assigns way too much. DO NOT take if you have a job/other commitments
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Am I learning or am I in a race to complete everything? Seriously? Not even BHS 300 was this annoying, I'm just worried about getting things done at this point. The homework assigments aren't even about learning either. It just feels like a fourth grade reading project that lasts 10 weeks. There's at least 10 assignments due each week. RUN.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class has more homework than any other course I've taken at UWB. The coursework isn't difficult, and the subject is fascinating. But the sheer amount of work each week has my head spinning. Dr.Lichty is clearly passionate. But if you take it as an elective, lighten the rest of your courseload because you'll be busy writing weekly essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof. Lichty is a nice, caring person but the amount of homework in this class is absolutely absurd. Daily homework will include watching three hours of video content and writing multi-page papers. Do not take this class online if you want even a moment of free time in your day.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Lichty is the most caring professor I've ever had! Lichty is an incredibly passionate professors, and genuinely wants to help students succeed. Class discussions were very interesting as well. I would highly recommend them!

i'm really interested in learning about sexuality however this class has sooooo much homework. it's too much, it felt like i had to rush assignments without feeling like i was learning anything. i like the idea of having a pleasure journal, a sexual health journal and having more creative assignments than most classes i've taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: They genuinely made me hate learning about sex and sexuality with the number of assignments they had us do. I came into the class excited to learn about sex and sexuality but as the class progressed the more work they required from us. The deadlines don't give you enough time to work on the assignment especially if you work full-time. don't do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof. L is an amazing teacher. They are very passionate about the work they do and care a great deal about their students. When I hit a rough patch they were easy to reach, very helpful, and allowed me time to catch up. There are a lot of reflective-type assignments, and a group project at the end as well, but nothing too hard! Highly recommend!

Prof L's class is interesting, to say the least. The final is a group project and is due a week before finals week which is annoying if your group is flaky. One day to present with no exceptions. Posted assignments pretty late which made it difficult to plan ahead. Class was on gender, if I'm being honest some of the material was a bit ridiculous.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
very passionate about their subject, but assigns lots of simple busy work. at the same time, a big chunk of the quarter is a group project that's awful if your group is lazy.

some of the material was kind of cringe in an "aggressively white queer" way, and you probably won't be graded well if you're not a very sex-positive inclusionist like them.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lots of busy work! The class meetings are awesome however it feels like the extra assignments do not always correlate.

Canvas was REALLY poorly organized. Had a hard time making sure I didn't accidentally miss assignments. Would post assignments the night before they were due. Will give you a bad grade if your opinion is different from theirs even on personal reflection assignments.

I will definitely take her classes again. She is very caring, sweet, and kind. She is flexible and understand our situations. She is a little clumsy and late on her grading, but she is not a tough grader trust me. She values your engagement with the materials and class discussion

Prof. Lichty had us read a ton, but they never discussed the material with us. So when we were expected to write an essay or anything else, we were completely unprepared. They also never actually taught us anything, theoretical not practical in class. We pretty much meditated and talked about feelings the entire time which was frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Prof Lichty is amazing! They are incredibly compassionate, one of the best professors I've had. During the quarter they took time to continually acknowledge our struggles and experiences as students and even adjusted some course plans in response. Keep up on the readings and while class isn't mandatory you should go, especially during group work.

She is a very nice person. She has an opened, growth mindset. She is a little clumsy and won't grade your assignments regularly, but she is not a tough grader. She gives people chances to get extra credits, cut off some assignments when things are tough and stressful. Very flexible and understanding. I would love to take her other courses in future

Professor Lichty is very sweet, caring, and passionate about her field. There is a lot of mini assignments throughout the week so be prepared, however she is flexible with late assignments. Also, attendance is not strictly mandatory but is crucial during the group project. A perk is that everyone gets to self-assign themselves a sexuality topic.

Professor Lichty is truly a one of a kind professor. Ive taken two of her bis courses now, and I can honestly say shes been my favorite teacher by far. She engages with everyone in class and she wants you to do good. As long as your attending the class meetings, youll be fine. Shes the goat�� (greatest of all time)

If you get a chance to take her, do not hesitate. She is amazing, cares about her students a lot. I have never seen a professor like her before. Great lectures, ready to help anytime, accessible outside of class. She kept on dropping a lot of assignments due to pandemic. Grades on effort mostly. She wants you to learn the content and focus on it.

Really exceptional individual, the kind of person that you respect not because they're the professor but because of the person they are and the way they lead a class. Can't recommend enough. If you should find issue here, the risk of failure is made low by they're total willingness to work with and for your success, however that need to happen.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: At first, I really respected and was looking forward to spending the quarter in her class. As the first couple weeks went by, I had a hard time understanding what it was that she wanted from us in the assignments. Many assignments started piling in along with group projects and I started feeling overwhelmed with the amount of assignments.

She seemed really sweet!! I was taken back by the workload of the class and had no idea what I signed up for. I found it very difficult to understand her assignments because of the way they were written and had trouble navigating her class because she sets up canvas in a very confusing way for her students. This course was hard to enjoy.

She is clearly very passionate and informed in the fields of social justice and community psychology. While I did not agree with all of the perspectives and tenants contained within the social justice framework, she made a point to speak inclusively and make my voice feel valued and respected. I very much appreciate her extending an olive branch.

Easy class. You get two attempts on quizzes (online), and assignments are simple, there will be some weeks where you'll have many assignments due but they're are not difficult so it shouldn't be an issue. lectures are very engaging and professor Lichty really cares about providing her students with engaging lectures. There will be a group project.

Lectures are engaging, homework is easy but there is a lot of it some weeks. The group project is a little confusing but as long as you read the instructions or contact the professor with questions you will succeed.

Probably my favorite teacher at Uwb, some of the feedback here is ridiculous. She cares, is passionate, and wants everyone to get the most that they can out of learning in ten weeks. Definitely recommend her, class discussions are engaging and eye opening. Open your mind and let it in :)

Aside from the ridiculous milestone work that you had to do, this class was fun and informative. I learned a lot about development, and even though people are saying she's difficult to access outside of class, she is more than happy to set up a time to meet with you. Do the online work and you will get an A in the class. She's made that very clear.

Lectures are practically nonexistent, she managed to turn a pretty interesting subject into a tedious waste of time.  Some of the homework was literally watching babies cry and reach for toys. There wasn't any explanation of the footage and it was barely linked to the textbook. She's not readily available, even during office hours.

If you are passionately interested in social justice you'll find a like mind in this teacher! I believe if you express that eloquently and keep a mind open to positively improve at inclusion you will get a good grade. She's very kind, patient, and clear about how to be a good scholar. A valuable cornerstone that nurtures fledgling students.

Lichty is very confusing. Don't follow the syllabus. She likes to change a lot of dates. Class time is not helpful, I only went for the group projects and a majority of the time, we didn't even work on our group projects like it says on the syllabus. She is nice though, and passionate. Only thing I loved about this class is NO TESTS!

This was the gender core class and it was amazing! I learned so much and felt moved and motivated every day. It really was an inspirational class. I loved the prof, she is very passionate about the subject matter and loves feedback! Lots of reading and writing. Group work, but it was a super fun class.
SUPER SUPER SUPER SUPER SUPER UNCLEAR I had no idea what to do till week 8 So confusing Don't take her class She talks really fast She is kind of nice tho

She is my least favorite professor in UWB! She takes forever to grade and she is very confusing and disorganized. She is not very clear what she expects out her students, she assumes that we are always following what she is saying. She talks super fast too. Other than that the content of the class was very interesting. A lot of group work
Horrible. Tons of tons of hmk.. can't focus on other classes. No life balance.
Really great teacher who is respectful and has great insight in the topic.
The exams are pretty unfair. This is especially towards the lack of covering the harder material in class, and his insane grading. Most of it is on your own.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Lam is intelligent & funny, but communicating information is not a skill he has. I like the topic of his class but was unable to learn from him. Incorrect formulas & solutions in his notes & test questions are worded poorly. Everyone stopped asking questions b/c he cuts us off before we finish our question & gives a confusing/unrelated 'answer'

Gave poor lectures that were unorganized, I was never sure what concepts he was specifically referring to. He rarely understood student's questions. spent too much time on chemistry behind semiconductor devices instead of how to apply them. I learned everything from youtube. He would go through the homework in class to make sure nobody failed
He's good
Positive: Funny, nice guy Negative: Poor english  Comments: Good smart guy, I would not take his class again

Going to his lectures is useless. All he did was copy what he had on his notes on the board. If you had a question he would ignore you. Doesn't post his lecture notes, which is frustrating because he doesn't follow the book. Puts little to no effort in teaching, overall horrible experience.

Lectures were long and often unhelpful. He goes very quickly and doesn't define anything, because he expects you to read the textbook before class, but there's no point in attending class if you read the book because the book is often more helpful than he is. Spends most of class deriving equations when you wont need to know how to derive anything.
Professor Lam is awesome and funny!!! His lectures were pretty good, but you'll learn more in the textbook.
Great professor! Cares about his students and will always respond if you need extra help.

Prof. Lerum is an amazing professor. She is very caring and understanding. She is a fairly quick and easy grader, and getting an A in the class is extremely easy. She gives you a 48hr grace period to turn in assignments. Very few assignments, only weekly annotations and 3 essays. The readings can be quite lengthy but lectures were interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Kari Is really understanding and if you miss a day for health or family reasons just Email her and she will dismiss you from the participation assignment. She also gives you a two-day grace period for every assignment.

Ok so where do I start with this teacher and this class. She makes the hw at a manegeable level and says the bigger assignments are just like the hw, guess what, they're not!! I took this class online because of covid and it sucked. She's kinda nitpicky with grades and I think with a different gradescale I could've gotten a 4.0.

Final grades are due tomorrow. I still have no idea what grade I received on the first paper I submitted. Or the midterm. Or any other paper or large assignment for the class. I could be failing- could be acing. I emailed for instructions and heard back weeks after things were due. Still no grades. No feedback. Nothing. She's beyond unprofessional.

Gender & Film was a hybrid class but it might as well be an asynchronous online class. Out of the 2 hours we met every week, only ~1hr is actually useful. Prof. Lerum is nice but the way she taught this class with an excessive online portion was awful, I like her when she did lecture and I'd take her in person. She answers emails quickly.

Professor Lerum is a kind, caring, and a very open-minded instructor. She assigns MANY lengthy readings so be prepared to read or at least do a thorough skim. Attendance is not strictly mandatory but the lectures are useful if you don't understand the material. She is an expert on all things sex work and social justice and is a fairly easy grader!

Not specific at all. Graded midterm questions based on criteria that was not included in the questions themselves. Lectures are boring and dont really add much. Midterm and paper are all that really affect the grade.
I would suggest you either avoid this class, or NEVER disagree or question any of the ideas or topics or she will grade you unfairly.

She's super nice. Though, her lectures taught us nothing and our final paper we had little to no guidance on. She just gave us a very messy rubric for most things and just re read it to us in class whenever we asked questions.

Lectures weren't focused. She was a scatter brain and did not have the attention of the class. It seemed as if she was out of breath when she lectured. Assignments weren't clear, she wasn't specific and she didn't keep up with the grading or communication via email. I didn't find out my grade for Fall Quarter until the day before Winter Quarter.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She is nice but she doesn't seem to care much as to whether or not the student's get any feedback.
I would avoid this professor. Fails to give feedback in a timely manner and it seems as though doing classwork comes second to her conferences.

Kari is a good professor. She is very helpful, flexible, and understanding. Her course consisted of weekly quizzes, two essays, weekly discussion posts, and a final reflection. She's a flexible grader. The only negative is that she was extremely late on grading assignments, such as the essays.

She was a great teacher in our freshman class. Her classes never felt like a chore to go to, in fact I know most people in the class didn't want to miss a week. She really gets you thinking but in a very non-judgemental way. My opinions changed a lot over the quarter and I've finished wanting to know more about her field.
She is a really interesting professor and you can tell she knows her stuff. Sometimes the class as a whole is just confusing, hard to get in communication with.

Very interesting and engaging class. Lerum assigns very good reading materials that really encourage you to think critically about a given topic. Also, they way in which she structures group work (you have the same group every week) is good because you get familiar with everyone, thus making a more comfortable atmosphere.

I absolutely love Kari Lerum. For a class that I assumed to be so incredibly boring and dreadful because it was required, she gave it all the spice it needed to keep me interesting and passionate about the topic. I never thought I would learn so much more beyond the textbook, but she definitely puts all of that into practice. Love her!

She's terrible.  Although she's clear on what we need to do, she doesn't teach the class what they haven't already learned from the textbook. First day of class she threatened the students and told them to leave saying they're easily replaceable. Oh and the textbook itself is horrible.
She is nice.
Fun, knowledgeable, and interesting!
Great class. Great teacher. Not condescending at all. Spent a little too much time on student's concerns. I would have liked it if grades had been posted through quarter instead of at the end.

She's a great teacher. One of the best kinds of pedagogy. She makes you feel welcome in class and is open to discussion. She wants to know what students think. She is also extremely knowledgable. Kudo's for Professor Lerum.

I took Kari's politics of sex ed class and it was a great class! The content is very interesting and the workload is quite reasonable. Kari cares very much about this topic, class learning and works to include all perspectives in open dialog. I highly recommend this class. Bring an open and inquisitive mind and you will do well.

she was really nice, I liked her, but she required you to read a ton of stuff, half of which she didn't even discuss in class. I got an A on everything and got a 3.6 so now I'm confused.  She was disorganized, and I heard she was an easy 4.0, not so sure now??? also not sure how I got a 3.6 when I got A's on everything in class???

She is a horrible teacher.  It is almost the end of the quarter and I really haven't learned anything, from HER.  She's really, really, bad.  I will never take her again.  She is ditzy and is so unclear it makes me want to pull out my hair.  Do not, do not, do NOT, ever take her.  Stay away, for your own sanity.
Engaging and accessible.  Does a great job of creating a collaborative environment.
No Comments

This was my senior seminar, and it was very intense.  Kari was expected a lot but she was very supportive.  Able to combine creativity and research and completely dig into my topic. Great, great course and a wonderful professor.

Great class. Be prepared for LOTS of work (i.e. reading about 150-200 pgs per week, and 4 pgs of writing on the reading every week, 5-6 pg film analysis, 10 - 15 pg midterm and final). Don't take this class if you don't think you can keep up with the work load. Great teacher
Lectures were not that interesting and orginization was a problem. Not enough feedback on assignments, and delays on handing back papers. She is a nice person, but I would not recommend her.
Interesting baseline class.  Obviously not her passion, but gave good examples to aid in student understanding and was fair in the coursework assignments and grading.

This is an outstanding professor. She is really knowledgeable and engages the class in interesting discussions. Not recommended for those who are looking for an easy instructor. She requires a lot of work, but is fair in her grading, and does not enforce rigid standards on assignments. One of this school's best professors, by far.
No Comments

OK, Sociology of Sexuality is probably going to be a pretty cool class anyway, but this one also made me think a lot.  If you freak about things like homosexuality don't take the course, as well as other sexual content.  But it challenged my assumptions in ways that surprised me.  She's also pretty funny and gets great discussions going.

I have taken Leo's class before and I've liked it since he is dedicated in teaching students about business and wants them to pursue some kind of business even though the class is basic and you will know most of it, he will make sure that you will understand the concept. Just take this class it's easy to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: In BUS 240 Intro to E-Business at Shoreline Community College, Professor Novsky's teaching is exemplary. He brings in guest speakers who offer real-world insights, bridging theory and practice. His commitment to student success extends beyond class. Enrolling in his course is a transformative experience.

Leo is a very kind and understanding teacher. He is very passionate about wanting his students to succeed. If you speak up and do the work you will be noticed. He gives a lot of advice that is helpful within and without business.

The professor's course curriculum is very arbitrary and he wants to give you too much, but in the end you may find that you learned nothing. Because he set so many tasks, he also gave himself a lot of grading tasks, which resulted in very poor feedback.
Best teacher ever.

Professor Novsky has very interesting lectures and a lot of wisdom. Class was never boring. He is also understanding about the personal or academic struggles his students face. Class was always a safe place where everyone was heard and had the opportunity to share and participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very nice individual, however not responsive. Minimal communication at his convenience.
Mr. Novsky was a great instructor. I liked how he had all of the assignments and projects laid out in Canvas. The class was straight forward on what you needed to do in order to pass

Professor Novsky, is a great instructor who
goes above and beyond to make sure that
each student understand the concepts and
assigments. Expect to read a lot and apply critical
thinking on his assigments. We had several
group projects were he supported us by
promoting growth mindset.

I really enjoyed taking this class from Leo. I thought the readings he assigned were really valuable and help give me a good perspective on what it takes to run a business. It's also obvious he cares about his students, and I really appreciate that.

There are some reviews complaining about how much reading he assigns but that's Flemings doing, not Novsky's. If you participate in class, do the readings and just show interest in general, you'll get a good grade. Like every other business class there is a lot of group work.
Failure should not be the only experience you share.  The homework was time consuming and boring. no value was gained from this experience

He is not a real professor. This class was a waste of my time and money. The other statements on here are false, my class last quarter was his first teaching experience.  We were all extremely disappointed with him, the material, and the work we did.
Funny, great teacher. Good lectures & lots of group work. He wants you to learn the material and is great at helping you. Lots of reading cases, no text book.

Leo is pretty cool! He's a great speaker and gives enticing lectures, but he assigns an unnecessary amount of reading sometimes. Up to 50-70 pages of dense case briefs are common with two days in between classes and longer ones for the weekend. He's funny yet unknowingly disrespectful at times. He is a fair grader and cares about his students!

Overall good teacher. Get used to participating because he will randomly call on people and you look stupid if you don't know what to say. Not sure if he realized how rude it was to call people out, kinda disrespectful. But, good teacher who was committed to providing the best course possible. It was his first class and he did exceptionally well!

Leo is simply awesome. This class had really relevant and useful life skills for those going into business. He really cares about students and is amazing at taking student feedback to shape the class. I truly hope I can have him as a teacher again!

The basic grading criteria puts a lot of weight on creating and polishing 5 technical writing documents. Make sure you do all the available extra credit because it is easy and applies to the grading categories worth the most points. I feel like it's harsh grading but if you read the textbook and don't skip class it's passable.
Knowing what I know now, I would've postponed graduation by another quarter in order to avoid taking this class with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Genuinely the worst professor I've had in my life. Grading criteria is extremely unclear and picky. She makes you buy her book to succeed in the class. Mind numbing lectures that don't give any insight on how the assignments are graded.
Genuinely the worst pro
Little to no instruction for assignments, extremely tough grader and talks lectures are extremely irrelevant to the assignments. Avoid at all costs.

Prof Anderson is one of the hardest and pickiest professors I've taken, if you do not follow her rubrics and directions you will lose points tremendous with no guidance on how to improve. Her lectures are so long to the point people fall asleep in class and she often cuts people off mid sentence. Her class was harder than any of my coding classes
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is the worst professor I have ever taken in my entire life. All you learn in that class is how to format Word. I do not know how this class is required. She is a VERY harsh grader, even with her rubrics she just says she "doesn't like" something and gives you points off even if there is nothing wrong with it. Whatever you do, don't take her.

I've had her two quarters in a row and she's really not that bad. She teaches you the concepts and gives lots of time to complete assignments (with extra credit too). However, her lectures can get long and her feedback can be vague. Exams are also tough and somewhat subjective. My advice: ask questions in class and really try to learn the content!
I would rather eat a bag of tuna fish cans, thank god its over

She's tough and requires that you spend a lot more time than you want. But I found if you showed up and put in that time you got more out of her. It felt at times though, that I was doing more than I had to inorder to have a chance to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
It's not the end of the world if you take 301 with her.
Pros:
- Everything besides final drafts & exams is only 5% of the grade (gives you lots of time to implement feedback)
- Over 50pts of easy, exam weight extra credit
- Helps you improve your writing
Cons:
- Participation is graded (not heavily, but still)
- Some exam questions are subjective
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Not as bad as I assumed from past reviews, but lectures are dry and her grading criteria is VERY specific. Tests are long and deceptively difficult. Take the time to participate and talk with her during class and it'll be easier to get through. Gives extra credit on homework if she liked your work and at the end of the quarter for exams. Solid 4/10
Very condescending, gives unclear instructions for assignments, and grades extremely tough. If you have any other option, do not take Laurie Anderson. Worst professor I've had so far.

She can be unreasonable and argues with students when they disagree with the point she wants them to get. She has conclusions she wants students to come to and when they don't, you can tell she's unimpressed. Lots of boring lectures and strict assignments with very particular rules and details that she grades very closely.

It's her way or the highway, doesn't allow ANY creative leeway on the topics of papers. Classes in CS should be objective but it seems that her writing processes are subjective to her whims. Worst of all she gives atrocious feedback and explanations in lecture. At all costs do not take this teacher for any course!!!! You've been warned!

Don't get me started on the papers, she is something else when it comes to grading the papers. Very biased and will not give you a good grade unless you understand her "knowledge" of the class. I will not let anyone take this class unless you want to suffer the consequences with her. Literally the worst professor I have ever taken. PLEASE FIRE HER!

AVOID AT ALL COSTS! This class is annoying, unhelpful, painfully boring, and ultimately one of the least enjoyable experiences I have had at UWB. The grading on the papers is all over the place, as is the order in which content is taught. The ONLY way to earn a 4.0 is to show up to office hours and speak in class often.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Trust me, this is the worst professor you could ever have :)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Every wonder what it feels like to be in a hostage situation? Take her class, and you will. One by one classmates will be randomly called on using popsicle sticks. You wonder... Will you be next? Or will you be saved by the sweet grace of the metaphorical bell. In all seriousness, don't take her class. You've been warned.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: For the love of all that is holy, DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS. I ended the quarter with a newfound fear of public speaking and probably an anxiety disorder. You WILL be randomly called on and humiliated if you do not know the correct answer to a question. The workload of this class was worse than my 343 class. She makes technical writing difficult.

The forced participation and random name calling was awful. You feel like you're in a warzone constantly on edge. If you weren't an introvert before coming to her class, you will probably leave one. most of the students in her class just stopped showing up unless there was an exam because of this.The one positive is that deadlines are lenient.

Don't feel like an adult in class as she makes it feel like high school. Seems genuinely passionate about her job but could be better in communicating w/ students - can sometimes come across as very condescending. Real picky when grading papers. Attendance is graded and lectures aren't recorded.

Take Chini if possible, but not end of world if her.

The professor wrote the textbook for this class and it is the worst writing I've ever read, and I'm shocked that she's teaching a writing class. Everything is absurdly easy and boring, but she treats students like children, talking down and being rude and misogynistic and generally treating this like a high school class. Seems behind on the times.

One of the worst classes and worst Professors I've ever had at UWB. She treats us like actually children. She uses Popsicle sticks to call on people, makes snarky remarks when no one wants to talk and is genuinely really rude. Also her grading is so unclear and it's hard to get full points on her assignments. The class is also VEERRY boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: WORST PROFESSOR EVER. she is literally the worst person to have as a professor. she hates her job
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment:
DO NOT TAKE HER! 
her grading is extremely unclear and gives whatever grade she decides to give.
she will STOP YOU when you try to leave in front of the whole class and embarrass you.
she calls on people with popsicle sticks like we're kids.
she will put you ON THE SPOT and expect a correct answer.
she obviously hates her students and her job.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Genuinely the worst teacher I have had. Honestly surprised she has a 2.9 rating on this. She makes fun of religions and overall hates her students and seems like she hates her job. She hovers to make sure you are not talking and are graded for participation even though she doesn't know your name. Hope she loses her job cause its obv she hates it.

I have Asperger's, taken CSS211, CSS290, and CSS421 with Anderson. I am just beyond convinced the people rating her bad don't want to do the work. Sure, she doesn't record lectures but you can literally: text her, email her, or sometimes even Discord. She's always there to HELP.

If my disadvantaged brain can do it, so can anyone. COMMUNICATION!!

I took Anderson for CSS290 (Topics in Computing) and CSS421. Taking this course with Anderson is very easy. We had to write multiple letters in this course, read a textbook and do homework for the chapter.

I will tell you, it is super easy! Anderson was also caring towards me. I've taken her courses since 2022. If you ever need extra time, ask!!

She is a fast grader and harsh grader. Very useful during office hours. Go to office hours to review papers before submitting. Tests are difficult. 2 Grammer quizzes (at home), 2 exams in person, and 4 papers (500-600 words). The papers are a new way of writing so they may take time and often times you need more words. Give yourself time to write.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Avoid this class. Picky with grades and if you don't write an assignment exactly how she wants it, then you're screwed.
DO NOT take any class with her Never!!! Ever!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Do NOT take any class with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Taking this prof is the first letter of her name, an L. She's unclear, penalizes you in PLANNING ASSIGNMENTS, is extremely pedantic, and doesn't answer questions properly. Her assignments are weighted so you can screw up on something worthless and it would tank your grade. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROF.

Do not take this professor. I Repeat. DO NOT TAKE this professor. This professor will put you through hell with tons of pointless assignments just to waste your time. She is an extremely tough grader. Her quizzes are known for curveballs. Make sure you take another professor so that you have enough time for important classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Anderson is an amazing person! 301 is a very demanding class and she did her best to cover all the concepts within the given amount of time. She expects students to show up to class which is very reasonable. A lot of them skipped class so I am not surprised if the class average is low. Go to her office hours and take her if you get a chance.

I will say that Anderson is SUPER accommodating and lenient with extensions. If you have a problem or question, never be afraid to text her or DM on discord! Communication and attendance is important to pass this class! A lot of people skipped class in the summer 2022 quarter, so I wouldn't be surprised if grades were lower on the fault of students

lecture very important but she doesn't record it nor pause for us to take notes. lot of awkward rewording and stumbles. She provides lecture notes without any important details. The questions in the homework were worded so poorly and confusingly that it was impossible to understand. It was awful. can't be expressed in words. Never take her class.

This is just for Anderson's CSS290 class. Anderson has been well-organized and clear with her instructions. She's also been quite flexible and encouraging to have students speak up about their experiences. Furthermore, she makes questions mandatory and has graduated students interviewed. Very useful, easy class!!
She is tough grader and she makes fun of students
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is tough grader and she doesn't hesitate to humiliate students.

She's a terrible professor, she has no idea how to engage her students, lots of awkward pauses in her lectures.  Was in a class where someone else came to speak, she spent the entire talk eating (when everyone else had masks on), and being on her phone inattentive.  What kind of impression would that give if any of the students did such behavior.

Her grading criteria is ambiguous and expects very specific answers. Half the class is failing but there are extra credit opportunities. The exams are all also extremely difficult and she won't curve them.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Pretty good prof - nothing if not accommodating! Provided extra credit opportunities for the exams, and for homework. Lots of work though, the paper and presentation drained me (and I took 301 with this class). However she really liked my paper and presentation, so pick a topic you really like. The textbooks a good resource for test prep too.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Loved having her as a teacher. I took her a while ago (first quarter we had online classes) At first I was worried about the reviews and did horrible on the first writing assignment. If you follow the examples for each of the papers and go to her office hours the papers should be a breeze. She was caring and made the final easier because COVID.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: I don't know why she is so harsh and picky about everything. There are lots of reading need to be completed by yourself in a short time and you need to write everything very carefully according to the principle, It is even like a coding process. It is hard to know what she want, so you need to go OH, bu there's still a big chance that you get bad g

So much work every week. Papers are due every week and reading is required before every lecture. This course can eat up so much of your time from CSS342 which is already a hard class itself if you're a transfer student in the CSSE major. Laurie was also a tough grader, and will always try to find something wrong with your paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Such a GPA killer. No redeeming qualities to her. Doesn't care about students in any way. Assignments are impossible to understand and she refuses to help at all. Responsible for CSS 301 being so bad. If you're in applied computing as your major, good luck trying to escape her because she's in control of that dept.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's a tough grader and has a demeaning personality in general. I would recommend going to office hours for help. Don't expect 100% since here grading is very harsh (she also grades drafts like they're the real thing). DO NOT TAKE at all costs; the workload feels like another programming class even though it shouldn't be.

The toughest grader ever. You can answer a question perfectly and she'll hold a grudge because you didn't use the exact wording that she wants. The class is "computers in society" where we compare the ethics of the ways computers are used and their possibilities yet, she doesn't care about the ethics side of it. She wants v technical writing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is awful. if this was taught by someone else it might actually be useful, but she makes you hate it and hate being there. she not accessible at all. I don't know why she teaches if she clearly does not care about any of her students or their success. I got the feeling that she likes failing students. It was an overall awful experience for me

She provides clear grading criteria, however, like her exam questions, they can sometimes be vague and unfair, with her already harsh grading. There are lots of writing assignments - the first half of the quarter will be fast-paced and difficult. It seemed like she didn't want students who didn't visit her in office hours to receive an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: My all time least favorite teacher, and worst grade I have ever received in a college class even with it being a 200-level course. She has a horrible attitude and cussed the class out on the first day. She is very unprofessional. Grades more harsh than most teachers, and is all around unpleasant. Never taking her again in my life.

Laurie is the worst teacher I have ever had. She did not teach in her class. You have to do things exactly her way or you get a lot of points off, there was no room for creativity or original thought. She had trouble understanding student questions, and answers and was an extremely unfair grader. DO NOT TAKE....
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She doesn't understand that everyone has different learning style: Some might learn better by trial and error, some might learn better by reading the textbook from top to bottom, etc. If you ask questions that already answered in the pile of documents that she has written, you will get in her nerves. So if you are good at memorization, go for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Took CSS290, career development. Teacher cared if students learned quite a bit but she could not explain concepts very well. Always eating in the class. Instructions on the homework are not too clear.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Not a very good professor, I won't take her class if I have other choice. Don't believe me? Just take her class then, you will see what I mean. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The mean for midterm in her class is 62.8%, 70% is passing -- do I think you'll learn a lot from her? definitely. Her class is extremely stressful, not just how she grades but how she treats students too. She expects a lot from you, and can take away a huge proportion of your time in CSS342, for an unimportant class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Technical writing isn't easy at all because of numerous guidelines with your format and word usage. Make the best of her office hours to get help improving your papers and really take her feedback seriously when revising your work. She doesn't go easy on anyone but knows how to guide you towards improvement when you really need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The papers are a lot of of work, but she will work with you after class or in her office hours as much as you need to get perfect scores. Her passion made a potentially dry and arduous subject really engaging and interesting. Her feedback is VERY helpful. If you can take feedback well and put in the effort, you can benefit greatly from this class.

Laurie Anderson is always passionate about teaching the material and willing to discuss the topic. I actually visit her office hour a lot and it was very helpful. Also when I asked her some questions through the canvas, she always responds me back quickly.(within few hours usually) It is not easy class, but you can learn important writing skills.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The instructor was very clear and helpful.  You don't get good grades only because you didn't pay enough effort.  If you have questions, make sure to visit her office hours. She is always happy to help!

She is a wonderful teacher. This is not an easy class b/c it does require you to put in a solid amount of work. Most likely, you will be taking this with other two CSS classes so make sure that you set aside some quality time for this class. Also, I would highly recommend to come to her office hours. She is very helpful!

Very good professor and very passionate about technical writing. Even though I got a 2.6 she is extremely organized and it is entirely on you if you do bad in the class. One of the classes i've learned the most from for real world applications
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: A lot of students disliked Dr. Anderson, but I don't understand why. Your responsibilities are clearly stated and Dr. Anderson is the most organized professor I've ever met. The exams were easy as well. Go to office hours to get help with revisions. There's absolutely no reason to get less than a 4.0 in this class.

I turned in an outline for a paper where I asked her for her opinion (in the outline) on two different ways I could go for my writing voice. She told me one of the ideas was bad and then took 50% off my grade for that assignment because of the "bad" idea.  That pretty much sums up her teaching style.

Laurie is an amazing professor. The class is well structured, you will be given a class outline on the first day, so no surprises. You have to read at home, the actual class has non-boring activities. Sign up for appointments, work on papers in multiple iterations, and all the papers will be very highly graded. I wish all teachers were as good!

I changed my entire academic path to avoid her.  If I had gone in scared and quiet, I think it could have been OK.  Her vision of our language is idiosyncratic and mechanical.  Writers can benefit from a unique and critical(narrow) vision.  But be prepared.   She is the only professor teaching a required class, be cautious and toe the line.

Turn in an actual effort for the rough drafts. Make appointments with her to talk about them. If you pay attention to what she says and make exactly what changes she requests and you will get a good grade on the final draft.  Tests are hard, study lectures and readings though and you will do fine.

Grading is fair as long as you follow her instructions exactly. Signing up to go to her office hours is HIGHLY encouraged. It could mean the difference between getting a 2.0 and a 3.0. Lectures are dry but tolerable. Get on her good side and she's a nice and helpful lady who really wants to help you out. The final was tough, so be well prepared.

If you take her class you'd better be prepared to write exactly as she does if you want to get decent grades on any assignment.  On rough drafts you'd better put effort in because she gives you a "fake" grade showing what grade your paper would get as is.  She grades so hard that it's your only shot at a good grade.  Lectures are straight off PP

Laurie is serious about tech writing. She expects you to give a lot of effort, which is necessary for a good grade. She does her best to explain why something you've done is incorrect, though sometimes I disagree with her comments. The final was different and way more brutal than the midterm. I really dislike writing, but she made it tolerable.

terrible teacher. The one thing I remember her saying is, "listen to me now, or you will NEVER understand this", which is not a very good attitude to have when teaching... Her comments on papers are never helpful, and talking to her doesn't make it any better. Worst professor I've had so far.

Worst professor I've ever had! She plays favorites like no other, and it reflects so much in your final grade. Among my friends in that class, we all came to the conclusion that if you can't write how she would, you'll most likely fail. She has such a closed minded view on how you should write, so unless you're willing to spend ridiculous amounts of time with her, I suggest taking the other professor for this class.

Get to know Laurie - I did and it paid off big. Yes she can be judgmental but turn that into a positive by making her like you. Class work is easy if you follow her directions and stay on track. Four essays, a midterm & final. Try scheduling a meeting with her during office hours, even if it's for a simple reason - it helps her get to know you!
Horrible teacher who doesn't have a clue what tech writing is.  No email just because it comes by way of technology, is not tech writing.  If you aren't a mind reader you won't do well in her class.
Don't take her class. Just don't. She's picky with her grades and if you don't write an assignment exactly how she wants it, then you're screwed. Do yourself a favor and don't take this class.

Terrible professor. Plays favorites, and calls you out if she doesn't like you. Isn't helpful at all. One essay we had to write an analogy, and instead of saying how to fix my analogy, she simply said "you obviously don't understand the concept of an analogy" and gave me a 2.0. Avoid taking unless there's no other choice

She grades the homework very tough unlike most professors I have had where you pretty much get credit for doing it. Not the worst class I've taken, but definitely not the best. Try getting to know her and go the extra mile-that's what I did and she graded my stuff pretty favorably compared to some of my other friends.

She basically just want you to write 4 essays throughout the quarter.  However she grade harshly and didn't teach much in class.  Besides her voice is so bored and made me fall sleep......Dont take her class only if u want to fail

Very inconsistent grading style. Student's essay is sometimes criticized rather than critiqued. Has a terrible attitude and if she does not agree with a student's opinion she becomes frustrated very easily and does not hold back picking on them. Lectures and due dates were unorganized.

She is very rude. She picks her favorites in class and if she doesn't like you, she tends to disregard your comments in class. If you are not very literate, she looks at you like you are stupid and calls you out in class. Her lectures are unorganized and she doesn't take critique well if she's wrong. Try to get on her good side.

The class was neither fun nor interesting. I learned a bit, but not as much as in other writing courses or my other classes this quarter. She makes a big deal over trivial stuff (e.g., it's an "ethical" requirement to write to write in a politically correct manner). Grades fairly leniently. Nice enough. Lectures boring; textbooks not so helpful.

oh my god, I hate her class and I hate writing now. I think it's the combination of her voice and subtle attitude that gets to me. She grades fairly though, so I just grit my teeth and do my best until it's over. There is zero creative/critical thinking in her class. It's all about follow templates from a book. Super boring. Time can't go fast enuf
Argh this professor has very little understanding of the subject matter she is teaching.

I've had lots of writing instructors, some were harder graders but exceptional teachers.  This one teaches poorly, and pushes bad form. Feedback on assignments is slow. Considering the subjective nature of grading writing assignments, prompt feedback is critical so you can give what she wants.

Not receptive to criticism, which is troublesome because many of her points are unfounded opinions rather than facts you can rely on. Didn't seem willing to change teaching style to adapt to students, rather it's all cookie cutter, and not very clear at it either. Assignment set up was nice, allowed for easy good grades. Not much learning though.

Very clear, helpful, and friendly. Always provides excellent feedback, and is always willing to accept constructive criticism of test and asignment clarity, fairness, etc. Does a good job of teaching writing to a group of people who aren't naturally writers.

Kalmin has a lot of industry-related experience and is a great professor. The subject can be difficult so expect to do some learning on your own time, but I never found myself grinding the textbook. As long as you attend lectures and attend her office hours, you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lesley was a great instructor. Her lecture can be quite slow, however, she is very helpful and will answer any questions you may have. Also, she is quite lenient, since she has given extensions/retakes to homework and the week before finals. I caught COVID-19 and she was very understanding about it and accepted late assignments.

Lectures are very boring. Tests are hard. Get ready to study on your own, lectures and the textbook are not helpful. Little to no feedback. Homework descriptions are very vague. She just doesn't seem to care about teaching at all.

I do not recommend this professor if you are a business student or first time taking a java class. She makes you hand write code and makes you do that on exams. The lectures are very boring and do not teach you anything. She is confused 75% of the time and students who do this for a living always correct her. I do not recommend at all. Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are very boring, barely write any code in class. The professor focuses heavily on students helping her fill the gaps because she gets this class and her other classes mixed up. Her slides and homework are never up-to-date because she doesn't prepare before the quarter starts. Makes you hand write code... Avoid this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I have no idea how this professor is rated good. If you are a business student DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. This is my first time looking at Java and the only students passing are ones who took programming in high school. Class average for exams are 65%, and grade needed to take 143 is 83%. Literally, reads off her slides only, really bad at teaching.
