Avoid his classes if you can.

Johnny is an awesome professor, he encourages questions and explain them very clearly even to little questions. Every time I go to him with questions, he doesn't just give me solutions but lead me to find the problem on my own, and that's a very important skill in cs. TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU WANT TO SUCCESS.

If you're going for CSS or another major/minor that requires 14X, don't take either with him cause they kill your GPA so fast. He was not clear at all when explaining concepts and the class is poorly structured. Grades incredibly hard on exams and homework. Ridiculous grading techniques.

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROF. Super tough grader for no reason. HW and book don't support his lectures, and he manages to be nitpicky over EVERYTHING. There's not enough class time to explain how he wants you to do HW or exams. Looks down on students if they don't understand material.

Not an easy professor - do not take his class if you are merely looking for an easy A. If you are interested in working hard and learning a lot then 14X with him is a great class. I tried to like him, I really did but he was nothing but rude to me from the first day. I worked really hard but nothing is ever "good" for him, he always has to complain about something. Extremely frustrating class. Should be easier than 142 but isn't because he is an extremely tough grader to the point that students complain constantly. He grades more on style than execution and assigns way too much at the end of the quarter. Lectures are super boring. Exams are extremely hard.

WAY harder than it needs to be. His lectures are confusing and disconnected, and fairly dry. Seems like it's turning into a UW Seattle weedout.

He is way too tough on grading and has unrealistic expectations. I was confused the whole way through. I would highly recommend a different prof. I've never worked so hard or been so stressed about a class that is supposed to be an intro class. Feels like a UWS weedout.

reviews.comment: The homework was massive, but doable. He is helpful if you ask, moreso through email than any other way. However he's so tough that I considered giving up for a brief moment. Exams are insane.

reviews.comment: Not very timely with feedback and does not explain complex programming concepts well at all. Grades very hard and does not notice good effort. Class is terribly organized and syllabus is extremely long. If you did well in CSS 142 you might actually do okay in his 143.
Very frustrating class and getting in touch with him is so hard. Grading is extremely subjective and difficult. Should be nicer to students. Does not communicate well.

Extremely intelligent but at the same time extremely intimidating. The tests are not impossible but yes, you will have to study your brains out. Uncaring about student problems, and makes me confused about concepts I thought I understood. I have no idea what is expected of me.

Good at explaining things and helpful enough in office hours, but the tests are unfortunately hard. As in STUPIDLY HARD. It's not just enough to read the book, go to class, take notes, and do homework. Kinda seems like he's setting us up to fail. Also very cold and impersonal.

Stubborn when helping students, often criticizing them if they ask questions that the whole class would actually benefit from. Johnny Lin is a great teacher, I can't emphasize it enough. I hear sometimes around campus that people don't like him, but I totally don't understand it! Johnny is really old school. No extra credit, your grade in Canvas is your final grade, and no test curves. Lecture heavy with "forced" participation (calls on people). reviews.comment: He is not very clear about his grading criteria. HW's don't have proper guidance as to what he is looking for. Other than that, his lectures are great but he gives you reading and only discusses what he thinks is important.
Very good intro to comp sci programming professor
Well taught class. Kept students involved during lectures.

Lin is an excellent professor. He is crystal clear & always encourages students to use their resources for help. If you want to succeed: THOROUGHLY read the text BEFORE classmake an effort to practice your programming. Quizzes: Read book. HWLabs: Be friends with students w logical skills. Exams: Study up! 1st half of the course is vital to pass.

Professor Lin is very clear and knows what he is talking about.  CSS161 clearly exists to separate logicalalgorithmic thinkers from the rest, and therefore it should be noted that many people will struggle with the content.  Professor Lin is very good at preparing students for future CSS courses, and is always willing to help if you ask.

Css 161 in general is a hard class and a weed out class. Compared to the other CSS professors Johnny Lin is good. He is always open to helping but makes you dig for the answer he just gives you hints. The tests are half multiple choice half long answer which is nice. There are no curves and the assignments and labs are very hard and time consuming.

professor moraiti is the greatest math professor i've ever had. everything is organized flawlessly, lectures are recorded and neat notes are always available. she replies to emails usually within an hour and her tests very much reflect the homework and group worksheets she assigns. she also drops the lowest test grade.

Prof. Marina was AMAZING. Best prof. I've had so far, she is very organized and is clear to follow in class. She records all lectures and makes it easy to find the past recordings. reviews.comment: Genuinely the best math teacher I've ever had! So patient and thorough with her explanations, and you can tell she really wants you to understand and will gladly take time to explain whatever you're confused about.

provides every resource you'll ever need to a point where you could literally pass the class without even showing up to lectures,easily available out of class, fast response times, and records every lecture on top of putting every lecture on zoom so if you're sick you can attend lectures and everything she writes down in class is on the canvas.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Moraiti is genuinely the best professor I have ever had. She makes the hardest concepts easy to understand. She also records and posts all of her lectures, and is always hosting extra office hours and study sessions. I wish she could teach every math class I need to take!! If you have a chance to take her for any class, do it immediately!

Wonderful teacher overall, very helpful. Took precalc 2 and calc 1 with her and she was amazing, always wanting to and giving as much time as you needed. Extra credit options available for surveys and hidden questions on midterms and finals. Class always welcome and nice, but was still focused on learning. Overall would definitely take again.

Really nice professor! Her teaching for me was good for unit 1 (limits) then it all went downhill from there. The derivatives weren't bad but you NEED to practice if you had no previous exposure to it. You can go to office hours, WORTH IT. DON'T BE AFRAID TO ASK QUESTIONS. She is really nice.

She is genuinely so nice and caring about you and your grade. The lowest midterm and homework scores are dropped which will save your life. She even sometimes curves the scores. She recommends the textbook but it is not required to get great grades at all. I genuinely recommend her!
I failed the class and I still think this is the best math professor on campus. If you can take her, DO IT!

Marina is an incredibly caring person who explains calculus really well. Although I've taken the class before, having a very clear and concise refresher was incredibly helpful. She really cares about whether you learn and truly understand the topic. Makes herself available for office hours frequently and is ready to help.

I had her for Calc 1. She's one of the most caring professors I've ever had! For personal life, and she cares about whether you learn or not. Will drop your lowest HW/midterm, which helped me so much! I used to hate Calculus, but now, I'm actually looking forward to what comes next. I would take this class again just for fun!

This professor is super nice and understanding. I did struggle a bit because Calc is a hard class overall. Her lectures are very example based and not so much explaining with given steps, which was hard for me to get used to. There are worksheets completed as a group weekly and three exams prior to the final.

If there's one professor I'd take for the rest of college, it'd be her. Even if it's calculus, it's worth the morning class if she's teaching it. Very understanding and great late policy, I've found it very easy to learn in her class.

Professor Moraiti is very kind and caring to her students and is very fair with all grading. Quizzes are open note, open teacher questions, and exams are with notecard. She's very sweet and I would 100% recommend taking her to learn calculus.

Amazing professor! I love her so much! She is very kind and very caring, she puts in a lot of effort in her lessons and the class lectures are always recorded. Workload is average, expected for Calc class. Midterms are easy (notecard allowed) and quizzes are open note! She is seriously the best calc professor ever take her class if u need credit!

Professor Moraiti genuinely cares about her students' success. She is incredibly engaging with her lectures, & if we have a question on homework, she'll record optional lectures to watch for clarity. She always holds extra office hours before exams, and always goes above and beyond for her students. She is the best math professor I've ever taken!

-MATH123 and 124
-quiz almost every week and 3 midterms throughout the quarter 
-provides lots of office hours and material, notes, examples you can use and find
-quizzes its all open note 
-lets us ask her if our answers are right/wrong and she points us in the right direction and provides extra time for quizzes/exams
-Curves exams
-homework lots

Dr. Moraiti both knows her material and how to teach well. If you're looking for a class where the professor cares about you I highly recommend a class with her. Most of the reviews here talking down on her were most likely people who didn't take her up on her outside help. If you need help ask her and she'll help, she cares about her students.

Nice professor, but very tough class with multiple quizzes and three midterms throughout the quarter. Definitely stay on top of your work and do not fall behind!! Missing class for even one day is a lot.

I had her for both BMATH 123 and STMATH 124, she's amazing and so kind. There's a textbook but imo you don't need it with how thoroughly she goes over everything in class. Quizzes are open note, so work along with her in class. Group work was easy to split up and the late penalty on hw problems was only 2% per day. Was very helpful with questions.

She has 3 midterms, the lowest gets dropped. She has 3 quizzes. She is very generous with extra credit. Attendance is not mandatory but if you come to class, she will give you extra credit on the midterms. Final is not bad but you definitely need to know your shit. She is very nice and approachable. I recommend taking her class.

Professor Moraiti is a wonderful math teacher who knows just about everything in the subject and has a clear passion for it. She provides a vast amount of resources for the students, gives them time to study, drops the lowest test grades, and takes the extra step for her students. The class is fast-paced, so be ready. Still, she is fantastic. 10/10

i'm telling you bro all the people who gave this professor a 5 star rating is LYING to you. she has to be one of the WORST instructors i've ever came across, like EVER. when she teaches it's like she's just reading information, almost like she has no idea what she's talking about. stay safe y'all.

There was no selection for B MATH 123 but she teaches this and is a very hard grader. Nice but can be really rude.

Marina is honestly the most kindest and sweetest person ever. She genuinely cares for her students and encourages us to go to her office hours for extra help. Take calc at your high school or community college instead of at UWB. Midterms are worth 42% of your grade. She's always ready to help her students as best as she can. I wish I worked a little bit more harder and met with her during her office hours so I could learn more. DO NOT BE AFRAID TO ASK QUESTIONS!!!

Extremely difficult class, if you fall behind you are screwed. I am a 4.0 student but this class has taken my grade all the way down. The professor is very sweet, but lectures are hard to listen to for two hours straight. Do not slack off and you could pass with a B with hard work.

An amazing professor! Works really hard in lectures to ensure that the students understand the class material. Genuinely cares about you learning and teaches in an encouraging manner. Would definitely recommend.

Great professor! Lectures are straight forward. If you miss a lecture she uploads all notes to Canvas. Homework is easy, you can also view an example if needed. She provides practice for her midterms and exams and they are harder than the actual test so the real thing isn't as difficult. Need help? She has office hours, great communication!
diva of the math field

True to previous reviews, this professor has a heart of gold. She's so kind you just can't imagine. I have bad experience with calculus classes before and I could say Prof Moraiti cured me out of it. She's one of those rare professors that still do proof-based teaching, something VERY fundamental and core. Study hard, you'll definitely succeed.

reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Nice sweet lady, answers questions well. Insane exams, averages were 50 percent with an applied curve. Calc is hard, her exams don’t make it easier sadly.

Pretty solid teacher, really nice and helpful. The average on all the midterms ranged from 55-70% and her final for this quarter had an average of 57 out of 115 which was corrected down from 120. I liked her and enjoyed the class though.

This professor is amazing and is very helpful especially during office hours. If you want to take a Calc class take it with her. She makes study guides that are similar to the tests. The study guides are usually a tad harder than the test so if you struggle through the study guide a bit you'll breeze through the exams. 4 midterms(drops 1) 1 final.
GIVE HER TENURE PLEASEEEE!!!!!!!!!!! She works hard and she deserves all the recognition

She has a heart of gold. Really caring and sincere. Calc 1 is hard and you're expected to work for it for sure, no excuse should be made. She has quizzes, but it's open book. She does it because she wants people to stay on track. Her tests are challenging, but in a good way. They are applicable. She helps until you understand

124 is a tough class. I dropped it because I didn't understand from the beginning and I should have taken 144. Prof Moraiti is a super helpful professor. She cares a lot about her students success and will make herself accessible outside of class. Make sure if you need help you ask her for it! Go to office hours, email questions, all that!

This was my 2nd time taking calculus 1 and I for the 2nd time failed the class. I don't have anything wrong with the professor herself but I dislike how the class is setup. Firstly there are 4 midterms which just stresses you out and the class is basically self learn. The lectures don't help, we have to do HW online?

Great professor for this class. Cares about students and is willing to help anyone that requires it. All of the lectures are previously recorded and classes are used to go over the recorded lectures for that week. 3 non-cumulative exams and 3 quizzes to go along with HW. The class is loaded with content, so try not to fall behind on the lectures.

Professor Moraiti does a really good job at answering questions thoroughly and engagingly. She's great at giving practice and example problems for quizzes and exams and is super helpful in explaining assignments. A great professor overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A solid choice, Marina's objective is for us to learn: she answers all questions and explains well. We had two midterms, a final, weekly Homework, and 5 R-labs (lowest dropped). We got at least 10% extra-credit for all of the exams and plenty of practice. I learned a lot but was never stressed (extensions). Marina is trustworthy and reliable.

Good professor, but I was not that engaged with the course. Her style of Zoom lectures were fast-paced and the participation points were given out unconventionally. The content she taught was interesting and she kept us updated on things when they came up. Be ready for tough grading and points off every assignment.

FIN305: Lecture was required and the only way that she taught was through prerecorded videos and zoom. No written instructions. Thank goodness that we only had her for 5 weeks due to course structure, and that her content was really easy, otherwise I would not have had the resources to pass. Could not follow lecture at all unless she used Excel.

The worst prof in Finance. Her handwriting is impossible to read, she explains things horribly and doesn't have a ton of office hours. Loke a bit mean too. If you can avoid taking her classes you will take a fat L.
Disorganized lectures, very confusing professor. I stopped going to class and started self studying and things made more sense. avoid her
Great overall professor. Participation is needed though in her class. Uses mainly coursepack to study, and it really help keep things organize when studying for a midterm or exam.
She is a great teacher, cares a lot about her students. Not the easiest class but very interesting you should take and the teacher is great.

Monica is an alright prof. Good prof, took M&A with her before and she's improved a lot.

reviews.comment: Monica is arguably one of the best finance professors this school has. Only uses a course pack (AKA- show up to class), assignments and exams are straightforward with no surprises. If you do the work, it's almost impossible to get a bad grade. Seriously one of the fairest and straightforward professors at foster.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: To be fair, the way she taught was pretty boring. However, I found that the content of the class material was really interesting. She gave lots of in-class examples as well as extra practices that I found really helpful. She was really helpful when being approached. Definitely will take her class again!

M&A class was really interesting! Lectures are a bit dry I admit it but she's very clear with all the concepts and doesn't spring stuff on you that she hasn't covered. You DO have to go to class though, because she follows the coursepack very closely and doesn't have any Panopto/recordings/notes/etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is the M&A course she offers. She's a solid choice. We go over synergies, transaction models, and how to finance the acquisition. She could definitely improve on making lectures more interesting, however.

reviews.comment: No textbook or lecture slides just a coursepack, tests are graded tough. Really just not a fan and would definitely not take again.

Monica is a great professor. She really cares about her students. If you are confused or need more time studying for her exams, just talk to her. She is willing to explain your questions and change exam dates if over half of the class agree. Sometimes she goes over materials fast, so just ask in class if you are confused. Great professor overall.
Monica is a very chill professor. The class isn't too hard as the exams are very straight forward. While she does post the slides, you kind of need to come to class to get the details.

Wow. Finance is incredibly boring and dry to begin with, but Marin needs to find another career.  Shame on the UW for this. Unprepared for class, and often looked like she was in a rush.  Lectures were excruciating.  Method of teaching consisted of writing down formulas.  Had to self teach 90% of the material in this course.  AVOID at all costs.

Monica Marin was a great teacher. I had her for two different FIN classes and each of them were structured the same, (FIN 428 and FIN 462). If you pay attention to her lectures and take decent notes on the examples in class then you will do perfectly fine. Also, she is VERY patient and helpful during her office hours. (DONT BUY BOOK)

Class is boring but the exams are easy. The homework are graded by a grader and the grader is terrible. Points may be taken off without comments. Although answers are provided you don't get feedback on the assignments.

Her class slides and lectures are dry and boring. She stretches a 30 minute class into an hour class by talking in circles without substantive material. She often trips over her own examples and sometimes contradicts herself. Her formulas are sometimes wrong.

Monica is very nice but not super engaging. Her slides are simple and posted online. Her lectures can also be disorganized sometimes,  making it hard to take notes. The tests are application based and questions are not always drawn from lectures, so they can be tricky. The final is heavily weighted (40%), which saved me from an average midterm

Her lectures are long and boring. Her examples often have mistakes in them that students usually catch, and she has to do the example all over again.  She's pretty bad at answering questions, and usually takes the question as an insult to her intelligence and defends her answer, without trying to help the students out. Wouldn't recommend to anyone

Such a variable experience, Monica is nice and eager to please however lacks the ability to make lectures interesting or informative. Lots of errors in her posted and in class problems

Worst teacher ever. Spent this whole quarter teaching myself. Take her if you want a laid-back class and go home to teach yourself. However, don't take her if you want your money's worth for the $1500 you're spending for the class (more for out-of-state and international students). Pretty much an online class for me as I read and taught myself lol

People like her because she gives back lots of points on exams and quizzes if you confront her. Her lectures consist of problems which she doesn't work out ahead of time. Dry and stops if people move. No clear rules on rounding and odd symbols. There is overlap from QMETH/ACCT301 or get ready to teach yourself if you are interested in learning.

Great class with easy tests. No idea why people are complaining. Will take other classes with her for sure. I guess the other low ratings are from the fin350 class where ppl know nothing about finance..

She's the WORSE professor I have ever had at the UW. Avoid her at all cost. I think there are MUCH better finance professors out there. As much as she is nice, I did not learn anything from her. Her explanations were very unclear and classes felt very disorganised. She also makes alot of math errors in class examples.
Monica is one of the best Professors and she is so knowledgeable. Come to class and you will be successful in any classes with her. Will take any classes with this Professor.
Two exams. 5 Homework assignments which are similar to that you do in the class. Nice and knowledgeable Professor. Would take any classes with her.
Professor is awesome. She makes the hardest material so understandable. Awesome lectures. Never miss her classes. I wish all Professors were like her.

She's really nice, also interesting. She does talk a lot and gets off track quite a bit, but u can tell she cares for her students and is very understanding. There is also a field trip, so make sure u go bc otherwise you'll be left out if you are unable to make it.

I'm not sure why the other reviews on this course are so bad. She's the easiest bio class I have ever taken (cellular, botany, anatomy, etc.) I do admit her lectures are long and can lag, but she throws in a few jokes. I missed a quiz on Canvas and told her the syllabus said it was due a different day, and she extended it a whole day for me.

I cannot stress enough how critical of a grader this professor is. I will give her credit that she provides a ton of feedback, but it's only useful if you find enough time to incorporate it all on top of writing a 3+ paged paper every week and have readings, posters, presentations, & your other 3 courses on top of all that.

THIS CLASS- 😤

She's nice as a professor. But for sure she played favorites. I was practically a teacher's pet because I did very well in this class. My friend often came late and tried to explain that her family is not able to travel all at once, and you know what the professor said? That my friend should have thought of that before taking this class.

reviews.comment: Don't.

reviews.comment:
RUN RUN RUN PLEASSE RUN!

She humiliates you when your answer is "wrong"

You've already learned much the material in bio 200 and 180 you wont learn anything new. DONT SIGN UP IF YOURE NOT A BIO MAJOR she tends to overcomplicate

I was heavily disappointed with her. 

The first week of the class was spectacular. I loved the concepts, and enjoyed the lectures until week three. I could not keep up with her rambling, incoherent freestyled lectures, it was awful. She gave a 5-page hard HW assignment 48 hours before it was due, an APRIL midterm, not MAY.

Worst class ever. 1/10!

Unorganized and proceeds to get side-tracked during lectures. Claims to understand students' busy schedules but proceeds to assign readings (that can be extremely heavy at times) the night before a lecture. She randomly cold calls like were still in high school which can be very confusing for students with no previous bio experience.

I mean.. she was decent. Her class was not terrible but it also didn't uphold the best standards. She will criticize you if you get a question wrong. Her lectures are long. Midterms/Finals are not too bad (she lets you use a half sheet).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: For a BCORE class, she really treated it as if it was a 200's bio class, lecture heavy, many papers and assignments. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I took her for a credit and she was very rude. She will criticize you for getting stuff wrong and lectures the whole class period. It is a semi easy class and there is no final (just a big project due at the end of the quarter). I just don't like how she is not understanding and rude. She will rarely give you an extension. Avoid her.
Truly one of the worst people I have met, let alone Professor. Vile.

she lectures heavy but rambles on about stuff we don't even need to know, gives out unnecessary assignments a couple days before the exam and expects you to work on them instead of study for the exam. Hands out exam materials really last minute (days before), she's extremely rude and unorganized. Wouldn't take this class if you don't have to.

greatest example for passive aggressiveness. Never try to help you and reply to emails late. Humiliate you for not understanding things and using discriminatory terms. I don't know why she is here. She should not be teaching Bio 2 because you won't gain much things in class. Always have incorrect answers on keys, HW problems drag your grades DOWN.

AVOID. Awful at grading on time. It's mid term and I had no clue what I'm getting in the class. Doesn't respond to emails at all. She falsely accuses people of academic dishonesty, I tried to talk it over with her but she just wouldn't listen. I needed this class for the NW credit as an American ethinc studies major but hardship withdrew bc her.

For someone who has been teaching a long time, she really does not know what she is doing. She mixes up her answers, has gotten corrected by students several times, quizzes on material that isn't even discussed in class, THERE ARE ERRORS IN HER EXAMS, and she spends most of her time trying to troubleshoot zoom than teaching the class. Unprepared.

Great professor! I would definitely take one of her classes again. She is a bit lecture heavy, we'd normally lecture most of the time. We also had a reading before each class. THESE HELP! You won't fail but she definitely discusses the readings as a class. She also posts the presentation before class, go through the slides before the lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Looking at the reviews below, I didn't have that many bad experiences with her. Her lectures can definitely lull you to sleep but if you go and get the gist of the lesson, you'll pass. She includes a lot of concepts with a random amount being on the midterms but she seemed lenient with due dates with lots of office hours.

Her class was so intense. We had to read a lot, write a lot, remember different terms, and on top of all that to test us, she would ask us random questions during class to make sure we read or did the HW. Classes setup like these are really good because they make you work but sometimes it's a little too stressful. There was just too much work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Even you spend a lot of time studying, you still get a bad grade.

Worst prof at UW. Do not take her. She's a horrible communicator, makes rude comments without thinking, wastes our time with tangets every class, unfair grader, lots of pointless assignments that bring down our grade, does random call like we're in high school, and doesnt prepare us for exams becasue she wastes time on things that dont matter.

Took her for a cancer course and she was alright. She knew her stuff but her lectures start to lag on and she goes no where with whatever she says. She also says some insensitive things and don't take responsibility for saying them. She's unorganized and doesn't communicate well with what she expects of her students.

Boring lectures. Moves too quickly through material. Doesnt communicate important messages to students before midnight, and generally the night before. Will say reading is optional, but assigns readings the night before class.

Took Dr. McNabb as a freshman. It was a great class to get into the flow of things. It was her first time doing a 50/50 Hybrid course and she was very unorganized. She covered SO much information over the quarter and some wasn't tested. Lots of groups work. Posts all lectures online after class and would be hard to get poor grade if you show up.

She's really passionate about what she teachers. She does have the "spacey professor" thing going on but its more comical than bothersome as some have claimed. There is alot of info on slides, but all tests were given with a study guide so you know what to look for.
This lady is awesome. Take this class. The readings are manageable and the tests help you learn, they aren't crazy hard or anything.
I would suggest you take this professor because she cares about your success, is accessible and very knowledgeable. Pay attention, take notes, the usual, and you'll its a science class. LOL.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Susan is the most boring and unorganized professor. She packs tons of information into her slides and lecture, there isn't much useful information to even take notes of. She changes her answers mid sentence most times, just seems like she's never prepared or has any knowledge of what she's talking about. Wont be taking a class with her again.

I had McNabb for BBio 200 2015. She had 7 PFs, which proves her 2014 students really liked her. If you get to know her, you will like her a lot and she might going to be your favorite professor at UWB. I still remember the negative raters from 2015 were probably the ones who texted & talked loud in class & got called out. I would take her again

I had her for BIO 200 lab not lecture. McNabb was the worst! During lab she was very rude and condescending to all students, but sometimes she was strangely overly nice. With the worksheets that were needed in lab she was very disorganized and would frequently change or didn't clearly state the dead lines.

I had her for B CORE and she has to be my favorite professor so far. While I'm not that into the subject area, she's still hilarious and has a great energy that made this one of my favorite classes. It's fairly easy and a great way to knock off a NW credit.

Here's the thing many of the negative raters probably didn't do the reading that they were asked to do resulting in a bad experience. That was the case for me when I began the course. However, after I started putting the effort and reading the assigned readings I started scoring 85-100 on every assignment. Professor McNabb is good at what she does

I had a lot going in my life, so disregard the grade. This  most helpful professor I have had. If you do not understand something she will help explain it so you fully understand the material. She is very passionate about wanting to see her students pass-although, the test are tough so be sure to read and go to review sessions.

Lectures are super boring and power points are filled only with pictures which she describes in class so be prepared to be taking notes from her mouth and not from a ppt slide. she changes her mind a lot for answers so I would buy a big eraser, you'll use it. Over all terrible lecturer but was very attentive during lab. She should just do labs.

The most disorganized professor I have had in college so far. She uses a textbook that no one even in a biology major would understand. Packs so much information into her lectures you cannot tell what will be on the exam. She is extremely forgetful, as she forgets what day assignments will be due each day of class. My advice do not take this class!

By far one of the most unorganized and scatterbrained professors I've ever had. She couldn't even remember what days the classes met. She means well and is passionate about what she teachers, but fails to do so effectively, and is very frustrating for students.

She's INCREDIBLY unorganized (she forgets why she has some slides in her lectures), she doesn't give consistant answers to the same question, she confuses HERSELF (let alone everyone else), and doesn't effectively answer questions (she'll say that she'll get back to that, then never does).

she is never clear on any of  her assignments. due date or the content of the assignments  when it comes to test and quizzes he questions are unclear. she's a go a good teacher just needs to be more organized and clear on all assignments

Worst bio teacher ever.  Unorganized lectures,  skips through slides and says "I forgot what I was going to say" very bot confident in material.  I majority did her worksheets in class and never listened.  Her midterms were great,  finals was the worse,  some short answers were not even learned or touched. If you don't need to take her,  DONT.

Dr. McNabb is definitely my favorite professor that I have ever had. She is a great teacher and is willing to go out of her way and spend extra time with students. She is also extremely funny and always makes classes entertaining. I am going to continue my relationship with her even though class has ended just because she is such a role model.

I took her for lab and she is so helpful! She also came to all the lectures and would talk through clicker questions with the students around her. As a lab professor she helped me think through problems rather than just telling me the answer. I would take another class with her, and I recommend her!

Always willing to help and will help you succeed if you ask her. Answers all questions, great use of office hours. Cares a lot about her students, very personable. Easily one of the best teachers. If you attend class, pay attention, and go to office hours, you will definitely get a 4.0. Gives plenty of opportunities for points and is a fair grader.

This teacher is extremely unorganized and doesn't appear to know how to use clickers properly or understand the school computers, which are Dells. She is very critical when grading, taking points off for trivial things that aren't a demonstration of our understanding of the subject at all. Not a good teacher! Don't take this person!

She's the kind of teacher that is hilarious without trying to be. Online quizzes are super easy and the class is relaxed. I took her my fall quarter and am signing for one of her classes spring quarter. Easy class to knock out those NW/QSR requirements.

Mary's classes were a bit boring, she mostly read off the assigned chapter from the last week, and we rarely did in-class activities until the final. She was extremely helpful when I needed questions answered, and overall, super easy course.

Professor McGuire is very kind and knowledgeable. Her attendance isn't necessarily required, but group work is, so you must attend class sometimes to participate and be a good group member. Every day before class, you are supposed to read the assigned chapters and come prepared to discuss with your group and share with the class.

Mary is a nice person. However, the class is set up weird- you do the reading and a quiz BEFORE the lecture on that topic. this makes the lectures very boring. I would not take her again, despite the class being pretty easy. It made it hard to learn or to care.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I love this professor! She's very sweet and understanding. This class is very lecture heavy but she breaks it up into lecture, activity, group talk, and then finishing off the lecture. Very interactive class, make friends with your table group or else you're kinda cooked for the final group presentation

Mary is a wonderful person so no issue there. However, her class is structured oddly. You are expected to complete readings and quizzes before class, and then she lectures on that chapter- so you're forced to read before a discussion. Group project was easy and definitely just an easy A; take a different prof if you want to learn more in depth.

Arguably one of the best professors at uwb. Mary was super helpful outside of class, and genuinely cares about how you're doing in the class. There is a group project, I just wish the assignment was presented earlier on rather then toward the end.

Industrial and Org. Psych was quite straightforward. Textbook based open note quizzes (3) and group project presentation “final”. Lots of in class conversation and speaking. Overall, highly recommend for this course BIS 348!

Mary is a very kind and helpful professor. It's clear she really cares about her students and she will help you with whatever you need to succeed in the class. There is a group project. It would have been beneficial to know more about it in the beginning of the quarter to better prepare for it, but overall a great prof!
She is very sweet and understanding. The only thing I have trouble with in her class is the textbook work because its a lot of reading. However I love her as a person and professor !

This professor is a really nice person but not great to learn from. Her teaching style relies heavily on the textbook instead of her own structure. In the course, you will experience heavy lectures with no real depth or breakdown of the material. Would not recommend for Introduction to psychology if you care to learn.
Very nice but lectures just repeated the required reading and didn't add much else to the point where I stopped showing up. Easy 4.0 though.

Her lectures are boring & not beneficial. It's like rereading the textbook. I did learn from her activities. Her quizzes and exams are online and there is a final group paper & presentation. Her class is manageable as long as you read the textbook & don't get behind. She is understanding, don't hesitate to talk to her if you need more time.
If you reach out and communicate with her, she will do whatever she can to help you. Very fair grader in my opinion, and you will be rewarded for putting in high effort.

Terrible professor. Never take her, she is boring and doesn't teach. she reads out of the textbook she assigns as homework so there is no point in showing up to class if you read the text book or no point reading the textbook if you show up to class. She is never clear on what she wants but yet grades hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: she's very nice but her entire class is based on textbook readings that are 30-50~ pages long and you get 2-4 days to read all of it before taking quizzes. it is essentially a teach-yourself course. It's overwhelming and her lectures are incredibly boring.  this course would kill any passion or inquisition you may have if interested in psychology.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Mary is a great professor. She's very caring, and she teaches really well. Every week, we had to read two chapters from the book, but it wasn't really required because she went over them during class. Exams were essay style (100-250 words per question), 4-5 questions about course content. Highly recommend!

The class had a lot of active learning components. She is a very sweet professor and helpful if you approach her after class. Readings and chapter tests associated with them are due before class. 4 quizzes in total and your highest is counted twice. The most I have ever had to read in college was for this class. Definitely hard for an intro class.

4 exams, lowest score replaced by highest, meaning highest score goes in twice. Quizzes weekly. Exams are taken at home online w/ no class on exam days. Read the book, watch youtube videos, and you will succeed. She's a nice lady and helpful one on one, lectures aren't too helpful though. It's very hard but you will succeed if you put the work in.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lots of homework but easy going

Intro to psych class taken at UWB - if you take the time to do the readings and participate in class everyday you will do totally fine in this class. Mary is so sweet and understanding so if you're struggling in some way all you have to do is communicate with her. Would take her class again for sure!

My major is CSS so take this rating with that in mind. There is so much reading, she uses the textbook extensively. It was really hard to study for this class as the exam questions were some situational and some definitions. If you are into psychology then I think you would be fine. But there was a lot of reading in this class. Also 1 group project
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: At the beginning of the year I sat through and read the chapter back to back but it was too overwhelming. Instead, I watched and taught myself the material from the textbook through YouTube and other online resources and have been doing better since. This class is very textbook-based. Other than that, she is very nice and a supportive professor.
her zoom meetings are usless, if you other important classes to work on skip her zoom meetings cuz they're waste of time and work on other courses instead that are important.

You take an exam on 3 chapters, she gives you a day or so to read the next chapter and take a quiz, she gives so much, it is like she doesn't care if you're taking other classes. Zoom meetings are very useless, lectures and activities are useless as well as it doesn't help with anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She will help you if you need it but VERY TOUGH class for intro course, it should be less stressful.

Okay, shes a nice teacher and she will help you if you need help but there is no time to prepare for quizzes for the exams you only have 2 days to read the chapter to take the quiz if you are taking other classes then good luck catching up because this is a fast-paced class. I def fallen behind and did terrible in the exams. exams are tough

Chapters are insanely long that it's impossible to even understand. The class participation she makes us do is so pointless and a waste of time. Lectures are also super long and hard to sit through. She's a super hard grader and is not specific at all when it comes to tests. Dont take this teacher if you dont have to

DO NOT take this teacher if you need this credit then do it but be warned she is such a tough grader and does not care about you as a person and does not take into consideration the hard times at the moment. AVOID THIS TEACHER AT ALL COSTS.

reviews.comment: I don't know why she's here as a professor. She made people basically read everything and expect everyone to understand the lessons. Then class was like 1h15'. Her lessons are basically wrap ups. I don't get any knowledge from her and spending time reading and teaching myself about the subject is ridiculous. I'm basically teaching myself

Okay, so her tests are really hard, but Mary is so sweet. Even if we didn't talk a lot I felt like she was really friendly. This class was a ton of reading. Even if most of the things we learned came out of the textbook, it still felt interesting, and her lectures tend to make it easier to understand the concepts we addressed in the reading.

Lectures are super interesting she's very passionate. Attendance/participation is required and tracked, but she cares a lot. She sees it when students are interested in class and wok hard, which she gives out in points called "citizenship" at the end of the quarter that boost your GPA - which is helpful when you do poorly on tests.

4.0 student? Prepare for a 2.5 GPA here. Class is structured based on exams that cannot be studied for. Paid test-creation leads to tests not being relevant to what's covered in lecture/quizzes/MindTap/readings. Spent on average 30 hours/week studying, still failed--professor literally couldn't care less. Told to "study more," when asking for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The tests are insane, 50 situational problems that have multiple possible answers. Very kind, cares whether or not you learn and gave some great in class exercises. The only assignments in the class are to read, and a couple essays. Really easy coursework.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Good class!
she is unbelievably sweet but OMG her psychology tests were impossible, she let me turn in a research paper late though so that's cool
she expects you always to participate, but shes super nice and caring. she allows you to makeup test that you got bad grades and also lets you turn in late work.

Prepare for lots and lots of reading if you want to do well in this class. Her lectures are not helpful of the tests at all. You really have to read the textbook, which is about 50+ pages per chapter, and each test covers 2-3 chapters. The lectures are very boring too. She will make you do class activities, that I personally found useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: McGuire is definitely a sweet heart, but man oh man is she BORING. Also, I have yet to talk to anyone that has received over a 3.0 in this class. From our exam stats, no one has gotten 100% on any, and the average is around 35/50. I'd say avoid if you can, but if you can't, make sure to reread the book multiple times.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The exams have absolutely nothing to do with the class. Most of my class got 50%  on all of their exams. No matter how hard you study it never prepares you for the exam. The class is generally boring and same lectures every class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She's a very kind and caring professor. In this class you'll definitely come out learning a lot. Lecture usually consists of both her teaching with slides, and group work/ discussion. Other than this, you do readings (about 50 pages) and online quizzes each week. Exams aren't too bad, just make sure to do the readings and you'll be good.

She's a sweetheart. She also needs to make exams easier and to know that nobody is going to read 50+ pages of the textbook after every class. Stay on her good side and she'll help you out with your final project.

You will have to try hard to leave Mary's classes without learning. Be prepared for constant reading. The Pearson study tools substitute for notes, but your style may vary from mine. She is a believer in active learning, so be prepared to read, present, and learn in groups daily. The Intro to Psych final project is not as difficult as it sounds.

Professors personality is very upbeat, however, the lectures are very short and are a very brief overview of what is actually going to be on the test. You definitely need to relate more to the textbook and make sure you read on your own time in order to pass. Most of the class time is spent in group work, which can be distracting at times.

To say the "tests are tough" is a HUGE understatement. Unless you have photographic memory, it is literally impossible to do well in her class.  There is no way to study for the exams, I made hundreds of note cards and still got Fs and Cs on all (which has NEVER happened). If you need this class, take it somewhere else and get the credit transfered
Mary is extremely helpful and understanding. She teaches in several different ways to appeal to almost everyone.

She is very nice and friendly, but not helpful whatsoever. Her tests are really challenging, and there's no way to effectively study for them. They're over 5 chapters at a time and her test will only cover a tiny part of those chapters. She knows how poorly the class is doing, yet doesn't do anything to help. Going to class is also pointless.

Nice lady and tries to effectively teach class but the tests do not match the reading what so ever. have to review up to 200 pages of hard material with no study guide but the tests will only be on minuscule parts of text. grades are very poor throughout class and lecture is extremely boring. Was really excited at first but ended up disappointed.

She had us rely mainly on the textbook, and didn't teach much in class, however she expected us to know all the definitions from the chapters to be memorized for the tests regardless of whether or not she had covered it in class.

Mary is a great professor. She makes learning fun, and she understands the stress level students have with other classes. She not an easy grader, but what she teaches is highly valuable in the real world. He has lengthy HW assignments so be prepared to spend time on them.

Nice teacher. Assignment also appear to be easy. At the end of the quarter she grades really hard which was surprising. I ended up getting a better grade in my other harder business classes. She has favourites, beware..good experience, but not good for GPA.

The class is not useful, and professor seems nice. You will not learn too much from this class. She gives you "super low" GPA, but grades nice on homework. This class totally messed up my GPA! Do not recommend for people who want to learn and get good grades.
Extremely nice during the quarter, but even all your works for 4.0 at the end you will get as max 3.2 - 3.6.
class is a waste of time.
the whole quarter was so easy then i unexpectedly got a 3.3 when my test, speeches, and assignments were 4.0s.  Horrible teacher avoid her she seems nice but grades bad

This class seemed so easy it was almost like it was for dummies. Then, I unexpectedly got a 3.3. Everyone in the class calculated that they would do well, and didn't. She seems nice, but really she's harsh and is too afraid to be up front. Do not take her class. Unless your ESL, then she seems to be more fair.

Wow, what a waste of tuition funds. So much useless busy work. I had to dumb myself down for the class. The class went in so many different directions, I was'nt sure what the class was for. Mary is nice, though she really needs to give her students more credit on being intellectuals. Worst class I have ever taken, because it was useless.

Fun professor, fun class. Nothing too particularly interesting - you learn how to write various business documents and give an oral presentation or two - but low-stress and low-involvement required. Busy-work assignments due each class, typically in the 1 hour of effort range. Good class if you're looking for a mellow 5 credits. Would recommend!
Mary is a good communicator. She is very clear on what she expects from students. Quiz is very easy. Participate in class discussions, and work hard on the team project to get a good grade.

She is a great teacher.  She's helpful and very interested in working with her students. One easy, open-book quiz and final group presentation. You MUST do the assignments, which are easy. Easy grader. Just do your part and you'll get a good grade. She like the students who answer questions and participate in the class.
Okay teacher. Nice but she spacey and slow.
boring as hell, not useful at all
Down to earth teacher.  Lectures were boring, but beneficial to her 1 quiz for the class.

Mary is an awesome teacher, I highly recommend her. However, you better be ready to do the assignments prior to every class session. Lots of teamwork exercises, but a very laid back class. Speak up, andswer questions, and you'll be fine. Easy open-book test, one final group project.
Easy! But less effective.
